title: AM/Manager– Procurement (Admin, Real Estate & HR)
description:
Buyer – Admin Real Estate & HR Procurement:

Role Overview:

The Buyer – Admin, Real Estate & HR Procurement will be responsible for managing end-to-end sourcing and procurement activities across Administration, Facility Management, Lease Rentals, and HR-related categories. The role includes vendor sourcing and management, commercial negotiations, contract and lease administration, PR-to-PO processing, spend analysis, and ensuring the timely procurement of goods and services in compliance with company procurement policies.

The ideal candidate should possess strong negotiation, analytical, stakeholder management, and coordination skills, along with a service-oriented approach and a keen eye for detail.

Key Responsibilities:

Administration Procurement:
- Manage procurement of office supplies, stationery, pantry items, and other administrative requirements.
- Coordinate procurement for facility management services, including housekeeping, security, pest control, and maintenance services.
- Source and procure office infrastructure such as furniture, workstations, printers, and related equipment.
- Track and manage Annual Maintenance Contracts (AMCs), ensuring timely renewals.
- Support procurement requirements for corporate events, employee engagement initiatives, and office activities.
- Coordinate travel and accommodation bookings in line with company policies.
- Ensure timely conversion of Purchase Requisitions (PRs) into Purchase Orders (POs).
- Maintain an updated vendor database and monitor vendor performance.
- Conduct cost comparisons and negotiate commercial terms within the approved authority limits.

Lease Rental Management:
- Manage procurement support for office spaces, branches, warehouses, fleet hubs, and other leased facilities.
- Collaborate with Business, Administration, Finance, and Legal teams for new lease acquisitions, renewals, amendments, and lease closures.
- Participate in commercial negotiations with landlords, property owners, and real estate consultants to secure competitive lease terms.
- Review lease proposals and ensure compliance with procurement policies and internal approval processes.
- Coordinate lease agreement execution and maintain trackers for lease expiries, renewals, rent escalations, security deposits, lock-in periods, and notice periods.
- Process lease-related PRs, POs (where applicable), rental invoices, and payment coordination.
- Monitor rental payments, Common Area Maintenance (CAM) charges, utility-related obligations, and other lease-associated commercial commitments.
- Maintain centralized lease documentation and ensure audit readiness.
- Identify opportunities for lease cost optimization through renegotiation, benchmarking, and space utilization initiatives.
- Coordinate with internal stakeholders and external landlords to resolve commercial and operational issues related to leased properties.

HR Procurement:
- Coordinate with employee benefits vendors, including Group Medical Cover (GMC) and Group Term Life (GTL) insurance providers.
- Support onboarding and management of Training & Development partners.
- Coordinate with recruitment agencies for billing, documentation, and vendor management.
- Manage background verification vendor coordination.
- Oversee procurement of employee onboarding kits, corporate gifting, and engagement materials.
- Support coordination with payroll and HRMS service providers.
- Track contract validity, renewals, and compliance for HR-related vendors.

Operational Responsibilities:
- Ensure compliance with procurement policies, governance standards, and approval workflows.
- Prepare comparative statements, vendor evaluations, commercial assessments, and sourcing recommendations.
- Monitor procurement timelines and proactively resolve vendor-related issues.
- Maintain procurement records and documentation to support audit and compliance requirements.
- Support budget monitoring, spend analysis, and cost optimization initiatives.
- Ensure timely contract renewals and drive effective vendor performance management.

Skills & Qualifications:
- Bachelor's degree in Commerce, Business Administration, Supply Chain Management, or a related discipline.
- Minimum 5 years of procurement experience, with exposure to Administration, - Facility Management, HR, and Lease Rental procurement categories.
- Strong understanding of sourcing, commercial negotiations, procurement lifecycle (PR-to-PO), contract administration, and vendor management.
- Prior experience in lease commercial negotiations and lease agreement management will be an added advantage.
- Excellent analytical and commercial evaluation capabilities.
- Proficiency in Microsoft Office, particularly Excel, Word, and PowerPoint.
- Strong negotiation, communication, and stakeholder management skills.
- High attention to detail with strong documentation and record management capabilities.
- Ability to manage multiple stakeholders and priorities while delivering high-quality procurement support.

title: Analytics Lead- User Growth I Exp- 8- 10 Years
description:
About Paytm
Paytm is India's leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
 
About the Role- 
 
KEY RESPONSIBILITIES
Business Insights & Growth
- Drive data-led growth across the acquisition, retention, churn, revenue and GMV lifecycle.
- Own deep-dive analytics to identify key drivers and opportunities for acquisition, engagement, retention and churn reduction.
- Drive Revenue and GMV growth in line with the Annual Operating Plan (AOP) through actionable insights and growth recommendations.
 
Customer & Lifecycle Analytics
- Analyse cohorts, journeys, segments and behavioural trends to improve customer lifetime value and repeat transactions.
- Build cohort and retention frameworks (D0/D7/D30, monthly triangles) across new, reactivated and repeat users.
- Diagnose churn and cancellation drivers and recommend structural fixes, not surface-level corrections.
 
Campaign Efficacy & Attribution
- Measure and optimize campaign efficacy — identifying the right segments, propositions, channels and levers to maximize incremental GMV and revenue.
- Conduct funnel, cohort, campaign and attribution analysis to identify performance gaps and recommend corrective actions.
- Reconcile promotional burn against incremental GMV; establish ROI and cost-per-incremental-user benchmarks by campaign and segment.
- Analyse A/B tests and control-group experiments to isolate true incrementality.
 
Metrics, Dashboards & Models
- Build and track key business metrics, dashboards, performance frameworks and analytical models to monitor growth against AOP.
- Own metric definitions and data integrity; maintain a single source of truth across teams.
- Develop forecasting and scenario models for GMV, revenue and user base to support planning cycles.
 
Stakeholder Partnership
- Partner closely with Product, Marketing, Growth, DWH and Business teams to convert insights into measurable outcomes.
- Translate complex data into clear, actionable narratives for senior stakeholders and drive data-backed decision-making.
- Own analytical inputs for MBRs and business reviews — with a clear storyline, not just charts.
 
REQUIREMENTS
Experience
- 8-10 years of experience in business analytics, growth analytics or data science — preferably in consumer internet, fintech, e-commerce or financial services.
- Demonstrated ownership of a product vertical or growth charter with measurable business impact.
- Experience with large-scale transactional and behavioural datasets in a high-velocity consumer business.
 
Technical Skills
- SQL — advanced: complex joins, window functions, CTEs and query optimization on large distributed datasets (Trino/Presto/Hive/Redshift/BigQuery).
- Python — pandas, numpy, statistical testing and automation; modelling libraries a plus.
- Advanced Excel — pivots, complex formulas & macros
- Data Modelling — dimensional modelling, star/snowflake schemas, event and funnel data structures, metric-layer design.
- Data Visualization — Tableau, Power BI, Superset or equivalent; dashboards that get used, not just built.
- Product & Web Analytics — Google Analytics, CleverTap, Mixpanel, Amplitude or Firebase for funnel and journey analysis.
 
Analytical & Business Capabilities
- Strong command of cohort analysis, funnel analysis, retention curves, LTV modelling, attribution methodologies and experiment design.
- Comfort with significance testing, regression, segmentation and clustering techniques.
- Commercial instinct — able to connect a metric movement to the underlying business mechanic and the money at stake.
- Excellent communication; able to defend a recommendation with evidence in front of senior leadership.
 
Education
- Bachelor’s in Engineering, Statistics, Mathematics, Economics or a related quantitative discipline. MBA or Master’s in a quantitative field preferred.
 
GOOD TO HAVE
- Exposure to wealth, investments, savings or commodity-linked products.
- Experience with SIP / recurring-payment analytics, including mandate and autopay behaviour.
- Familiarity with pricing, margin and unit-economics analysis.
- Experience mentoring junior analysts.
 
CORE COMPETENCIES
- Diagnostic mindset — pushes past the symptom to the root cause.
- Rigour — validates counts and stress-tests assumptions before publishing.
- Ownership — treats the business target as their own.
- Clarity — reduces complexity to a decision, not a data dump.
- Constructive dissent — challenges assumptions and targets with data, early.
 
Why join us: 
Work with a high-performing and passionate product, design, and engineering team. 
Shape the future of credit for millions of users. 
Build at scale in one of India’s most dynamic and regulated spaces. 
Flexible and inclusive work environment with fast decision-making and ownership. 
 
Compensation: 
If you are the right fit, we believe in creating wealth for you with enviable 500 mn+ registered users, 25 mn+ merchants and depth of data in our ecosystem, we are in a unique position to democratize credit for deserving consumers & merchants – and we are committed to it. India’s largest digital lending story is brewing here. It’s your opportunity to be a part of the story!

title: Area Collection Manager - Manager - Lending Collections (Frontend)
summary: Manage end-to-end collections, lead tele-calling and field collection teams, and ensure portfolio health and regulatory compliance.

enrichment.summary: Manage end-to-end collections, lead tele-calling and field collection teams, and ensure portfolio health and regulatory compliance.

description:
Role Overview  
The Area Collections Manager will be responsible for managing end-to-end collections across  bucket segments, driving resolution strategies, ensuring portfolio health, and leading large  on-ground and tele-calling teams. The role requires strong expertise in delinquency  management, compliance, analytics, and team leadership.

Key Responsibilities  
1. Bucket & Portfolio Management  
● Manage collections across delinquency buckets (0–30, 31–60, and higher DPD  segments)  
● Improve resolution rates in both early and late buckets  
● Focus on non-starter and delinquent accounts to prevent roll-forward  
● Drive collection efficiency and overall portfolio health  
● Monitor daily performance and ensure adherence to CAPE norms  

2. Tele-Collections Management  
● Handle soft delinquency buckets (0–30 & 31–60 DPD) through tele-calling strategies  
● Design and optimize calling patterns based on customer risk profiling  
● Improve dialer efficiency, call connect rates, and campaign performance  
● Maximize early-stage resolutions to prevent migration to hard buckets  

3. Field Collections & Risk Control  
● Ensure strong field discipline (app usage, visit tracking, audit trails)  
● Drive legal escalation for critical/high-risk cases  
● Conduct audits to identify and mitigate portfolio risks  
● Maintain strong governance and control mechanisms  

4. Team Leadership & Vendor Management  
● Lead large teams including Collection Managers, Team Leaders, and Executives  
● Manage third-party/vendor collection agencies  
● Allocate portfolios and set bucket-wise targets  
● Conduct daily huddles, reviews, and performance tracking  
● Coach teams on negotiation, objection handling, and resolution strategies  

5. Target Achievement & Performance Delivery  
● Drive monthly collection targets and improve resolution ratios  
● Enhance PTP (Promise to Pay) conversion and kept rates  
● Focus on First-Time Delinquent (FTD) customers to reduce future NPAs  
● Ensure productivity metrics such as calls, RPC (Right Party Contact), and CE% are met  

6. Compliance & Governance  
● Ensure strict adherence to RBI guidelines and regulatory standards  
● Handle escalations and customer grievances effectively  
● Maintain ethical and compliant recovery practices  
● Support internal and external audit requirements  

7. MIS, Analytics & Reporting  
● Track and analyze KPIs: CE%, RPC, PTP, dialer metrics, and resolution ratios  
● Manage large portfolio data and generate actionable insights  
● Identify gaps in collection strategies and recommend improvements  
● Present performance reports and insights to senior management.  

8. Key Skills & Competencies  
● Strong expertise in collections strategy (early & late buckets)  
● Proven leadership experience managing large teams and vendors  
● Analytical mindset with strong MIS and reporting skills  
● Knowledge of RBI regulations and compliance frameworks  
● Excellent communication, negotiation, and problem-solving skills  



● Ability to drive performance in high-pressure, target-driven environments

To merchants, Paytm offers acquiring devices like Soundbox, EDC, QR and Payment Gateway where payment aggregation is done through PPI and also other banks’ financial instruments. To further enhance merchants’ business, Paytm offers merchants commerce services through advertising and Paytm Mini app store. The role requires strong program management, technical understanding, client handling, and ability to drive execution across multiple internal and external teams.

Lead the implementation planning process across scope, timelines, milestones, dependencies, risks, and success metrics.
Ensure every enterprise deployment has a clear project plan, ownership structure, escalation path, and delivery cadence.

Create dashboards and review cadences to track implementation health across enterprise clients.

Build scalable delivery systems that reduce dependency on individuals and improve implementation quality at scale.

Lead and mentor Client Onboarding Managers across enterprise delivery workstreams.
Set clear goals, delivery standards, review mechanisms, and quality expectations for the onboarding team.
Work closely with Enterprise GTM, Pre Sales, Product, Engineering, Security, Legal, Finance, and Support teams.

compliant, well-governed, and audit-ready.

initiatives.

description:
About Us: 
Paytm is India’s leading mobile payments and financial services distribution company. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm builds technology that enables small businesses and consumers to participate in the digital economy. Our mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them into the mainstream economy through technology.
 
About the role:
You will own the campaigns that turn our merchant base into active borrowers. That means designing, launching and optimising multi-channel campaigns that drive loan eligibility checks, applications,disbursals and repeat borrowing among small businesses — kirana stores, retailers, restaurants and service merchants who accept payments on our platform.
You will work closely with Product, Risk, Credit, Analytics, Sales to grow disbursals while keeping acquisition costs in check.
 
What you will do:
• Own the campaign calendar for merchant lending: new-to-credit acquisition, pre-approved offer activation, top-ups, renewals and win-back of dormant borrowers.
• Plan and run campaigns across push notifications, SMS, WhatsApp, email, in-app banners, IVR/outbound calling and the field sales force.
• Build merchant segments using transaction volumes, tenure, category, geography and eligibility, and tailor offers and messaging to each.
• Design and run A/B tests on creatives, copy, offer framing, timing and channel mix; scale what works and kill what doesn't.
• Track the full funnel — reach, click, eligibility check, application, KYC, sanction, disbursal — and fix the biggest drop-offs with Product and Ops.
• Manage campaign budgets and incentives (cashback, fee waivers, interest-rate offers) against clear CAC and ROI targets.
• Coordinate with lending partners on offer constructs, approved bases and co-branded communication.
• Ensure every communication complies with RBI Digital Lending Guidelines, fair-practice codes and partner brand rules (KFS, APR disclosure, no misleading claims).
• Run festive and seasonal pushes (Diwali, wedding season, quarter-ends) when merchant working-capital needs peak.
• Report weekly on campaign performance and share learnings with leadership. Key metrics you will own
• Disbursal volume and count driven by campaigns
• Funnel conversion rates (offer view → application → disbursal)
• Cost per disbursal and campaign ROI
• Repeat / renewal borrowing rate
 
What we are looking for:
• 4–7 years in growth, lifecycle . Hands-on experience running CRM campaigns on tools such as CleverTap, MoEngage, WebEngage, Braze or Netcore.
• Comfort with data: you can write basic SQL or work fluently with dashboards and Excel to analyse campaign results.

description:
About Us
Paytm is India's leading financial services company that offers full-stack payments & financial solutions to consumers, offline merchants, and online platforms. The company is on a mission to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through payments, commerce, banking, investments, and financial services. One97 Communications Limited, which owns the Paytm brand, was founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma.

About the Role
We are looking for a high-energy, target-driven Key Account Manager focused primarily on hunting and bringing incremental business to the platform. This is a new-business acquisition role rather than a traditional account-maintenance role. The person will identify prospects, build a pipeline, pitch our offerings, negotiate commercials, close new business and deliver measurable monthly revenue.

Key Responsibilities
- Identify and acquire new merchants/accounts through outbound prospecting, market mapping, references, networking and other lead-generation channels.
- Build and maintain a healthy pipeline of qualified prospects and continuously convert prospects into live business.
- Own the complete sales cycle: prospecting, discovery, pitching, negotiation, closure and onboarding.
- Generate incremental business every month and take complete ownership of the revenue brought in.
- Develop strong understanding of the local market, competitor landscape and merchant opportunities.
- Create prospect-wise action plans to achieve monthly business targets.
- Follow up consistently and move opportunities through the sales funnel.
- Work with internal teams to ensure smooth onboarding and activation of newly acquired business.
- Maintain accurate sales pipeline, conversion and revenue reporting.
Identify opportunities for repeat business and upselling after initial acquisition.

Performance Expectations
- The role is heavily performance-driven and focused on incremental/new business generation.
- A strong incentive structure will provide high performers the opportunity to earn significantly above their fixed salary through incentives.

Ideal Candidate
- Strong hunting/new-business sales background.
- Demonstrated history of personally generating incremental revenue.
- Comfortable with cold calling, outbound sales and repeated follow-ups.
- Strong prospecting, negotiation and closing skills.
- Highly target-oriented and motivated by performance-linked earnings.
- Able to build a territory and pipeline from scratch.
- Strong communication and presentation skills.
- Comfortable working with numbers and tracking business performance.
- Experience in F&B, hospitality, lifestyle, beauty, local commerce, advertising, or marketplace businesses is an advantage.

Key Success Metrics
Qualified opportunities created 
New merchants/accounts acquired Conversion/closure rate
Monthly incremental business generated 
Consistency of monthly business generation
Revenue/incentive contribution

Join Us
A collaborative, output-driven environment that brings cohesiveness across businesses through technology.
Opportunities to improve Average Revenue Per User (ARPU) by unlocking massive cross-sell opportunities across Paytm’s user base.
A solid 360 circle feedback culture supported by peer teams aligned with your goals.

title: Lead-Affiliate Marketing
description:
Role: Affiliate & B2B Customer Acquisition – Paytm Money (PML)

About Us:
Paytm is India’s leading payments Super App, offering consumers and merchants a wide range of financial services. A pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution, Paytm’s mission is to bring half a billion Indians into the mainstream economy through technology-led financial inclusion.

Paytm Money is the wealth-tech arm of Paytm, enabling users to invest in mutual funds, equities, and derivatives seamlessly. Owned by One97 Communications, founded by Vijay Shekhar Sharma, the company is headquartered in Noida and backed by leading global investors.

Role Overview: We are looking for an experienced Affiliate Marketing leader to build and scale the affiliate and partnerships growth channel for Paytm Money. This role will own the end-to-end affiliate charter across mutual funds, equities, and derivatives, driving high-quality user acquisition through publishers, partners, and performance networks. The ideal candidate will bring deep expertise in affiliate ecosystems—especially within broking, fintech, or wealth platforms—and will focus on scaling this channel efficiently with strong ROI and quality metrics.

Key Responsibilities
Affiliate Strategy & Channel Ownership: Own and drive the affiliate marketing strategy across all investment products.
 Build a scalable affiliate engine leveraging networks, direct publishers, and strategic partnerships. Manage budgets, payouts, and ROI.
Partner Acquisition & Ecosystem Building: Onboard and manage affiliate partners including content platforms, fintech aggregators, influencers, and broker comparison platforms. Build strong publisher relationships and unlock new partnerships.
User Acquisition & Quality Control: Drive high-quality acquisition (demat accounts, SIPs, active traders) while monitoring traffic quality, conversion rates, and fraud. Ensure alignment with long-term LTV and retention
 Campaign Management & Optimization: Launch and optimize campaigns across partners. Improve creatives, messaging, and landing pages. 
Continuously refine commission structures and incentives.
 Data & Performance Analytics: Track performance using attribution tools. Monitor CAC, conversion, activation, and ROI. Identify funnel gaps and optimize continuously.
Product & Growth Collaboration: Work with Product and Growth teams to improve landing pages and onboarding journeys. Align campaigns with launches and offers.
 Compliance & Governance: Ensure adherence to regulatory guidelines in financial services. Monitor and prevent fraudulent traffic. Maintain transparency in partner engagements.
 Stakeholder Management & Leadership: Collaborate with internal teams and present insights to leadership. Build and scale the affiliate function.

Key KRAs / Success Metrics
User acquisition via affiliates (demat accounts, SIP registrations, traders), CPA and ROI, conversion rates (click to KYC to activation), activation metrics (first trade, SIP setup), traffic quality and fraud control, and overall contribution of affiliate channel to growth.

Qualifications & Experience:
8–12+ years of experience in affiliate, partnerships, or performance marketing. Strong background in broking, fintech, or wealth platforms. Proven track record of scaling affiliate channels.
Deep understanding of affiliate ecosystems and attribution tools. 
Experience managing large-scale publisher partnerships.

Key Skills
Affiliate marketing and partnerships, performance marketing and ROI optimization, data analytics and attribution, negotiation and partner management, fraud detection, and cross-functional collaboratio

title: Lead/Senior Lead - Data Devops
description:
About Us:

Pioneer of the mobile QR payments revolution in India, Paytm builds technologies that help small businesses with payments and commerce. Paytm’s mission is to serve half a billion Indians and bring them to the mainstream economy with the help of technology.
 
 Job Overview: 
We are seeking an experienced Data DevOps to lead our Data DevOps team in building, managing, and optimizing high-scale, secure, and reliable big data platforms. The ideal candidate will combine strong technical expertise with proven leadership skills, driving best practices in cloud infrastructure, automation, CI/CD, and big data technologies. This role involves managing cross-functional priorities, mentoring engineers, and ensuring delivery of high-quality, scalable data solutions. 

Key Responsibilities: 
● Lead, mentor, and grow a high-performing Data DevOps team, fostering technical excellence and ownership. 
● Drive architecture, design, and implementation of large-scale cloud and data infrastructure, ensuring scalability, performance, and security. 
● Collaborate closely with Data Engineering, Data Science, Analytics, and Product teams to deliver efficient and reliable data platforms. 
● Oversee operations and optimization of AWS-based infrastructure, including VPC, EC2, S3, EMR, EKS, SageMaker, Lambda, CloudFront, CloudWatch, and IAM. 
● Manage and scale big data platforms leveraging Kafka, Hive HMS, Apache Ranger, Apache Airflow, EMR, Spark, Trino, Looker, and Jupyter Notebooks. 
● Implement and maintain CI/CD pipelines and infrastructure automation using Terraform, Ansible, and CloudFormation. 
● Ensure system observability, proactive incident management, and SLA adherence. 
● Champion cloud security best practices, including API security, TLS/HTTPS, and access control policies.

The ideal candidate will have a strong understanding of digital monetization and have previously created or scaled revenue channels through partnerships, rather than simply managing existing partner relationships.

1. Build the 3P Publisher Business

Advertising / AdTech partners

Demand- and supply-side platforms

Experience in AdTech / digital advertising / publisher monetization.

description:
About Us:

Role Overview:
We are seeking an experienced Data Protection Lead, who will be responsible for overseeing the organization's data protection strategy and ensuring compliance with Indian laws such as the Information Technology Act, 2000, and the Personal Data Protection Bill. The DPPM will work closely with DPO and regulatory authorities to ensure that sensitive data is processed securely and ethically. This role is crucial in safeguarding our digital assets and maintaining compliance with industry standards and law.

6. Excellent communication, interpersonal, analytical and leadership skills.

title: Senior Manager/Manager - Third-Party Risk Management (TPRM) Governance
description:
Employment Type: Full-Time

Role Overview

The Senior Manager/Manager – TPRM Governance will lead the strategic design, operationalization, and ongoing oversight of the enterprise-wide Third-Party Risk Management framework. 

This role is responsible for identifying, assessing, monitoring, and mitigating third-party risks across all vendors, suppliers, and partners. 

The person will champion the TPRM framework as aligned to applicable compliances across regulations and statutory mandates—while serving as the primary bridge between cross-functional business units, executive leadership, internal and external stakeholders.

Key Responsibilities

TPRM Framework & Policy Governance

Establish robust governance mechanisms and the end-to-end design for formulating, executing, and enhancing TPRM control frameworks, policies, and standard operating procedures.

Ensure enterprise-wide adoption of third-party risk methodologies, aligning with applicable regulatory requirements.

Drive a data-driven risk-based approach to 3rd party evaluation, exception identification, and reporting.

Design, consolidate, and present executive TPRM dashboards, trend analyses, and exception reports directly to the Risk Management Committee, Board of Directors, and Senior leadership.

Third-Party Risk Assessment

Perform inherent and residual risk assessments, monitor SLA adherence, performance metrics, and control effectiveness across the vendor lifecycle.

Lead and oversee continuous vendor risk evaluations across multiple domains, including financial health, information security, operational resilience, legal, compliance, and reputational risk.

Maintain and govern a centralized, risk-tiered vendor inventory categorizing third parties based on service nature, data access, regulatory criticality, and concentration risk.

Define periodic due diligence and monitoring frequencies aligned with organizational risk appetite and regulatory standards.

Lead the ongoing monitoring strategy for critical third parties, utilizing SLA performance tracking, continuous financial health reviews, threat intelligence feeds, and regulatory sanction screening.

Manage and orchestrate structured, periodic vendor risk questionnaire assessments and remediation programs as defined under the TPRM framework.

Track vendor incidents, operational control failures, and risk events to drive remediation, while maintaining up-to-date policies, SOPs, risk registers, and governance reporting.

Required Skills & Competencies:- 
Industry Expertise: 6+ years of domain experience in Third-Party Risk Management, including Outsourcing Risk, Vendor Evaluation, Operational Risk, or Risk Governance within BFSI, FinTech, or a regulated environment.

Regulatory Frameworks: Deep understanding of regulatory guidelines on Third-Party Governance standards.

Vendor & Operational Oversight: Demonstrated expertise in 3rd Party due diligence, SLA governance, regulatory compliances, and audit support for key third parties

Multi-Domain Risk Evaluation: Proven capability to assess complex, multi-domain vendor risk scenarios across legal, financial, cyber, operational, and regulatory vectors.

Analytical & Data-Driven Mindset: Strong expertise in risk scoring models, trend analysis, exception tracking, and executive dashboarding. 

Qualifications & Experience

Education: Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Risk Management, Finance, Commerce, Law, Information Security, or a related discipline.

Certifications: Professional certifications in Risk Management or Information Security (e.g., ISO 27001 Lead Auditor, CISA, CRISC, or CERA) are preferred.

description:
Manager – Taxation & Finance

Location: Mumbai, India
Experience: 4–8 Years
Qualification: Chartered Accountant (CA) Preferred

About the Role :

We are looking for a dynamic and detail-oriented professional to join our Finance team as Manager – Taxation & Finance. The role is responsible for managing the Company's direct and indirect tax compliance, tax accounting, regulatory reporting, audits, and litigation while partnering with cross-functional teams to drive finance transformation and process improvements.

The ideal candidate will have strong expertise in Direct Tax, GST, tax accounting, ERP systems, and financial reporting, along with the ability to support strategic finance initiatives.

Key Responsibilities-

1. Direct & Indirect Tax Compliance
Manage end-to-end Direct Tax and GST compliance, including:
Return filing
Tax payments
Reconciliations
Statutory reporting
Ensure timely deduction, deposit, and reporting of TDS, TCS, and other applicable taxes.
Review tax implications of new products, business initiatives, contracts, and transactions.
Coordinate with tax consultants, statutory auditors, and regulatory authorities.
Support tax assessments, audits, notices, and litigation by preparing responses and maintaining documentation.
Monitor changes in tax laws and regulations and evaluate their impact on the business.

2. Tax Accounting & Financial Reporting
Ensure accurate accounting of:
Current Tax
Deferred Tax
GST
Other statutory levies
Review tax-related ledger balances and reconciliations.
Support preparation and review of financial statements from a taxation perspective.
Ensure tax provisions comply with applicable Accounting Standards, IND AS, and regulatory requirements.

3. Process Improvement & Tax Governance
Strengthen tax governance through robust SOPs, documentation, and internal controls.
Drive automation of tax compliance, reconciliations, and reporting processes.
Collaborate with ERP and Technology teams to enhance tax configurations and system capabilities.
Ensure tax-related master data and ERP configurations remain compliant with applicable regulations.
Identify opportunities to improve efficiency, accuracy, and compliance across tax processes.

4. Finance Operations & Cross-functional Support
Support month-end and year-end financial closing activities.
Participate in finance transformation, ERP implementation, automation, and process improvement initiatives.
Assist in preparation of MIS reports, management dashboards, and board or regulatory submissions.
Partner with Accounting, Treasury, Business, and Compliance teams on finance-related initiatives and projects.
Provide support on accounting, treasury, regulatory reporting, and other finance functions as required.

5. Audit & Regulatory Compliance
Support Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, Tax Audit, and regulatory inspections.
Ensure timely closure of tax and audit observations.
Maintain accurate documentation and audit trails for all tax-related transactions and compliance activities.
Ensure adherence to applicable tax laws, accounting standards, and internal governance policies.
Candidate Profile
Education
Chartered Accountant (CA) preferred
Additional qualifications in Finance or Taxation will be an advantage

Experience - 
4–8 years of relevant experience in:
Direct Tax
GST
Tax Accounting
Finance & Regulatory Compliance
- Experience in Financial Services, FinTech, Broking, NBFC, or Banking will be preferred.

The successful candidate will be expected to:

Ensure zero material tax compliance defaults or regulatory penalties.
Deliver timely and accurate Direct Tax, GST, and TDS/TCS compliance.
Successfully manage tax notices, assessments, and litigation matters.
Maintain accurate tax provisioning and reconciliations.
Ensure timely closure of audit observations and regulatory actions.
Drive automation and continuous improvement in tax processes.
Contribute effectively to finance transformation and cross-functional initiatives.

Location
Mumbai, India

Candidates based in Mumbai or willing to relocate are encouraged to apply.

title: AM/ Manager - Risk & Decision Science
description:
About the Team

Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit and built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys, Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of 10-100-1000 journey and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
As a Financial Services team, we always look at the bottom line. And the bottom line is - in this team, you should expect to have fun as you learn and grow.
 
About the Role
 
Lending is going to be our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale. Herein also lies potentially our biggest challenge for Meesho users: How do we assess risk of borrowers without any credit history? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
The Person will be responsible for driving the Policy, DS and analytics behind all these questions, from creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and owning policy decisions.
In the early phases, your role will focus on refining initially implemented policy by Analyzing and Designing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, alternate data. Creating Scorecards and models for approval. 
Designing experiments to test cohort behavior and experimental policies.
Automate reporting and tracking of the portfolio on multiple levels , Ops performance measures, key performance indicators and associated drivers.


What you will do
• Over the longer horizon, as the program scales you are expected to do the following:

• Owning an automated decisioning process and its outcome.

• Creating 6 Month Risk roadmap

• Refine the Credit policies and create new policies to lend in unexplored segments.

• Own end to end ML model development methodology : Feature creation, Model design and development, tuning, validating, monitoring and calibrating

• Coding up and maintaining BRE , automating credit policies as well as underwriting decisions if need be

• Independently drive and conceptualize projects on Risk and Data science.

• Initially an IC role but expected to guide and manage a team of analysts and grow into leadership role.

What you will need
• 3-6 years of relevant Fin-Tech experience, preferably in Digital Unsecured Lending, with products like BNPL, PL or consumer loan.

• Strong RCA skills along with excellent critical thinking skills, combined with the ability to present your beliefs clearly and compellingly, both verbally and in written form to leadership.

• Working knowledge of GCP, Vertex AI and cloud function for deployment.

• Solid understanding of credit bureau data (CIBIL, Equifax, CRIF), and banking risk frameworks.

• Expert in PD, EAD , LGD modeling in Python environment.

• Can identify use cases of AI to drive productivity internally in the team and in the decisioning process.

About us 
Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
Culture and Total Rewards
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, we uphold the following principles:
Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.

Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.

Support & Confidentiality: A dedicated liaison officer/committee addresses concerns and grievances, while maintaining strict confidentiality of disability-related information.
Awareness & Inclusion: We conduct awareness programs to promote a culture of inclusivity across the organization.
Meesho welcomes applicants and employees of all abilities and is dedicated to fostering an environment where differently abled persons can achieve their full potential.

title: AM/M - Risk Analytics - User Lending
description:
About the Team
Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here's your chance!
Financial Services (FS) is one of the biggest new bets we are taking at Meesho on the next 10x horizon opportunity for us. Just as Ant Financial did for Alibaba, and Mercado Pago did for Mercado Libre, our vision is to build financial services for Meesho, becoming our key growth and revenue driver.
We have found our Product-Market Fit, built and proved 0-1 and 1-10 journeys. Now looking for someone who can be the founding member of a 10-100-1000 journey, and this is possibly one of the most exciting and enriching experiences one could consider in their career.
About the Role
Meesho FS runs two lines of business: SME Lending, which offers Business Loans, and User Lending, which offers BNPL and Personal Loans (PL). 
User Lending is now our primary focus in this phase of our FS journey. We have 274Mn ATU, and risk management is at the core of building any sustainable credit business at scale - our being a captive audience means both Growth and Risk are an outcome of underwriting, which is owned by the Risk team.
Herein also lies one of our biggest challenges: how do we assess the risk of borrowers without any credit history or income data? How can we leverage alternative information to better profile borrowers? How can we leverage our platform uniquely to create a sustained competitive advantage?
This person will be responsible for driving the analytics behind these questions for User Lending - creating analytical frameworks, developing high quality analysis, driving insights and actions, and recommending policy decisions, across a well-established BNPL portfolio and a Personal Loans portfolio that is still scaling.
Your role will focus on:
Owning the risk for one or more segments of the portfolio while maintaining a healthy growth.
Analyzing credit policies using Meesho platform data, bureau data, SMS data, and other alternate data.
Creating policies, scorecards and models (Application Score, B-Score, Collection Scores) for BNPL and PL.
Designing experiments to test cohort behaviour, experimental policies, and new opportunities for growth.
Identifying pockets of risk within the portfolio that don't make sense, and identifying leading indicators / EWS.
Automating reporting and tracking of the portfolio at multiple levels - Ops performance measures, key performance indicators, and their drivers.
Refining credit policies based on data and creating new policies for unexplored segments, including building day-1 policies for Personal Loans as the product scales.
Configuring and testing rules in the real-time Business Rule Engine (BRE), and working with the Bureau Feature Store to define new underwriting features.


What you will do
• Own and drive risk analytics initiatives across digital lending portfolios, including BNPL, Personal Loans, and other unsecured lending products.

• Identify portfolio trends, diagnose emerging risks, and conduct deep-dive RCAs to understand key drivers of credit performance.

• Partner closely with Business, Product, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams to conceptualize and execute risk strategies and projects.

• Evaluate existing and proposed credit policies and translate portfolio insights into actionable risk interventions.

• Monitor key portfolio metrics including DPD buckets, roll rates, vintage curves, GNPA/NPA, collection efficiency, approval rates, losses, and portfolio yield.

• Use data to assess the impact of risk policies and strategies on portfolio growth, credit quality, and profitability.

• Perform data mining and analysis using SQL, Hive, Metabase, Python, and other relevant data tools.

• Build and implement basic scorecards, analytical frameworks, and risk rules in Business Rules Engines (BRE).

• Apply knowledge of PD, EAD, and LGD models to understand and evaluate Expected Credit Loss (ECL) and portfolio-level credit risk.

• Present insights, recommendations, and risk perspectives clearly and compellingly to senior stakeholders, both verbally and in written form.

• Work in a fast-paced environment, independently drive projects, and solve ambiguous business and risk problems using first-principles thinking.

• Leverage AI tools in day-to-day analytics, problem-solving, and productivity workflows.

What you will need
• 3.5 years to 8 years of relevant experience is required.

• Hands-on experience managing or analyzing portfolios in BNPL, Personal Loans, or other unsecured digital lending businesses.

• Strong understanding of credit risk metrics and portfolio performance, including DPD buckets, roll rates, vintage curves, GNPA/NPA, collection efficiency, approval rates, losses, and portfolio yield.

• Strong RCA, analytical, and critical-thinking skills, with the ability to translate complex data into clear business insights.

• Strong understanding of PD, EAD, and LGD modelling and their application in Expected Credit Loss (ECL).

• Strong working knowledge of SQL and experience with data-mining tools/systems such as Hive, Metabase, or equivalent databases.

• Hands-on experience with Python, including data wrangling, basic scorecard development, and implementing/coding risk rules in BRE.

• Ability to work effectively with Business, Product, Data Science, and other cross-functional teams.

• Strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to articulate and influence risk decisions using data and structured thinking.

• Experience working in a fast-paced, high-ownership environment with ambiguity.

• MBA, Engineering, or Master's degree in Statistics, Data Science, or a related quantitative field.

• Demonstrated ability to use AI tools effectively in day-to-day work and problem-solving, relevant experience in Credit Risk, Risk Analytics, Credit Risk Policy, or Decision Science, preferably within digital lending.

About the Role
As Assistant Manager - HR, you will help HRBP team deliver its OKRs across Meesho's business orgs- hiring best-in-industry talent, retaining that talent by reducing attrition across talent cohorts, through both structured and individual actions, keeping talent motivated and continuously upskilled and driving the productivity of our talent
You will work closely with HRBPs, the HR CoEs (Talent Acquisition, Performance, Rewards, HR Ops etc.) and business leaders to turn people priorities into programs that work across orgs. •
Shape talent brand and culture. Play an instrumental role in building the right talent brand and culture at Meesho, working closely with leaders across the company.

Drive cyclical people processes end to end. For PMS calibration, talent reviews, succession planning and promotion cycles across the business orgs, own the timelines, data packs, readiness checks and closure.

Postgraduate degree in Human Resources.

A sharp eye for detail and comfort working at Lightspeed.

title: Cluster Head  ( Security & Investigation)
description:
About the Team

Being part of Meesho's Fulfillment and Experience (F&E) team, will zip you to the cockpit of our
ever-burgeoning rocketship. And, you’ll shape the experience of Bharat’s next billion e-commerce users.
We’re an eclectic mix of over 100 professionals, all driven by the first principles of problem-solving. We
come with diverse skill sets and responsibilities ranging from running operations/support to managing
the supply chain, and maintaining analytics.
At Meesho, we’re trying to do what's never been done before – herald e-commerce into the tier-2, tier-3
cities of India. Our team’s role in this ambitious mission is to reimagine logistics from the ground up
completely. This means a host of "zero-to-one" projects (takers, anyone?) to build a supply chain that
reimagines e-commerce, not just in India but globally.
We focus on personal growth and fun at work just as much as we do on working hard. That is why, we
have regular 1-1s virtual meetings, fun-filled monthly all-team catch-ups, and timely rewards and
recognitions

About the Role

As a Cluster Head - Security and Investigations at Meesho, you’ll run a Regional org focused on reducing
Security incidents and identifying, reducing and resolving malicious losses and frauds on the ground.
You’ll achieve it by forging strong collaborations with the Business and Operations teams, Operations
partners and Sellers alike.
You’ll work closely with the mentioned teams in order to serve our users better. To this end, you’ll also
lead key initiatives, audits, formulating and implementing SOPs and deliver impactful projects to cater to
security and loss prevention needs for the organization.
Your guiding question in this role will be “How can we build an efficient, fraud-free, high on ownership
and integrity supply chain, while keeping customer experience at max”. You’ll answer this question every
day through owning the Security and Investigations charter for the Fulfillment and Experience, and
Meesho at large.


What You Will Do
Develop and Lead the Cluster Security and Investigations Charter for a Region comprising
multiple states.
● Coordinate with stakeholders from Operations and Central Control tower, Legal, Trust & Safety
and other relevant teams to design short and long-term security, loss and fraud identification
and prevention strategies.
● Partner with Cluster and Area operations teams to mitigate risk of theft, fraud and other high
impact incidents.
● Performing risk assessment of site & operation model and frame mitigation measures.
● Regularly do security analysis, and work with Central teams for setting the right SOPs across
nodes.
● Conduct regular security and process audits on the ground based on central data inputs
● Close the audit exercise by ensuring corrective measures and action on the identified
stakeholders (employees/delivery personnel/sellers/ops vendors).
● Create Org and liaisoning muscle to intervene in case of ops disruptions and untoward incidents
happening in different parts of the region.

What You Will Need
8-12 years of work experience with substantial experience in managing a geographically
dispersed security, investigations and loss prevention team, with KRs around detection and
prevention of security and loss incidents.
● Experience in Physical security operations and Investigations, preferably in E-commerce,
Fulfillment, 3P Logistics, Supply chain, Operations, or relevant security experience in similar high
growth tech startups.
● Outstanding organizational skills.
● Superior problem-solving and incident and case management skills.
● Experience in team building, managing, and coaching will be a plus.
● Knowledge & experience of laws applying to police & legal action and the judicial process.
● Ability to travel, sometimes at a short notice

Our Data Science team is the Avengers to Meesho’s S.H.I.E.L.D 🛡️. And why not? We are the ones who assemble during the toughest challenges and devise creative solutions, building intelligent systems for millions of our users looking at a thousand different categories of products. We’ve barely scratched the surface, and have amazing challenges in charting the future of commerce for Bharat.  
 
Our typical day involves dealing with fraud detection, inventory optimisation, and platform vernacularisation.

description:
About us
Meesho - Every story here begins with a spark of ambition and a touch of entrepreneurial magic. We're not just a platform — we're your partner in transforming dreams into reality.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone - Meesho started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for the next billion Indian consumers and enable small businesses to succeed online. We provide sellers with a range of industry-first benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping costs, growing their business by tapping the company's massive customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics at cost through third-party logistics providers and our in-house logistics arm Valmo, in an 'Everyday Low Cost' channel for sellers.
Affordable, relatable merchandise mirroring local markets has helped us make inroads with first-time internet users in the country. We cater to an underserved and unique customer base and cover every serviceable pincode in the country. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have enabled us to become the first Indian horizontal e-commerce company.
Know more about Meesho here: https://www.meesho.io/
About Valmo and the Data Science Team
Valmo is Meesho's own logistics arm, built to give sellers and customers cutting-edge, low-cost logistics and supply chain support. Supply Chain Network Optimization sits at the heart of the Valmo Data Science team: we design and plan the network that moves Valmo's shipments every day, from first-mile pickup through sort centres and line haul to last-mile delivery. We use OR, MILP, stochastic optimisation, simulation, ML and DL across network design, first/middle/last-mile optimisation, capacity planning and delivery promise, and we build for the long term, not just today's problems. This role is for someone ready to execute at speed, with a growth mindset, to build and scale these models.
 About the Role
As a Data Scientist 3(Operations Research), you will own a workstream within Valmo network design — not just a model. You will be accountable for the North Star Metric of that workstream (cost per shipment, end-to-end shipment speed, network capacity utilisation, on-time delivery, delivery promise), set its OR/ML roadmap, and mentor DS1s and DS2s in delivering it. You will take ambiguous, loosely-defined business problems, decide which ones are worth solving, formulate them mathematically, and ship optimization systems that run Valmo's network every day. Workstreams span network design, routing and scheduling across the first, middle and last mile.




What you will do 
•
Own a workstream end to end: decide which problems are worth solving, set and drive its roadmap, and be accountable for the movement of its metrics.

•
Formulate complex, loosely defined business problems in network design, routing, scheduling, allocation and capacity planning as LP, MILP, MINLP or constraint programming models, with explicit assumptions.

•
Solve them at scale with decomposition (Benders, Lagrangian relaxation, column generation, branch-and-price), heuristics and metaheuristics (large neighbourhood search, ALNS, tabu search) and constraint programming, within real planning-time budgets.

•
Handle uncertainty with stochastic, robust and chance-constrained optimisation, and test decisions through simulation before they reach the ground.

•
Combine OR with ML and DL, such as demand and volume forecasting, ETA prediction and learned heuristics, wherever it improves the decision.

•
Write production-grade code and work with engineering to ship solvers and models into systems that run every day, with testing, monitoring and reproducible pipelines. Use AI coding agents as part of how you build, and verify the formulations, code and results they produce.

•
Mentor DS1s and DS2s on formulation, modelling craft and code quality; align the roadmap with product, engineering, operations and business; and explain trade-offs to senior leaders in decision terms.

•
Publish your work at A* conferences and journals, as part of a team with a highly innovative work culture.

What you will need
•
Bachelor's, Master's or PhD in Operations Research, Industrial Engineering, Applied Mathematics, Statistics, Computer Science or a related quantitative field.

•
5–8 years of experience (or 3+ years with a PhD) applying operations research to real-world problems, with optimisation models deployed in production.

•
Deep expertise in mathematical optimisation (LP, MILP, network flows, integer and combinatorial optimisation), with a proven ability to formulate ambiguous problems, design heuristics, and break complex problems into simpler sub-problems.

•
Experience with large-scale solution methods (decomposition, column generation, heuristics and metaheuristics, constraint programming) and with optimisation under uncertainty and simulation.

•
Hands-on experience with solvers and modelling tools such as Gurobi, CPLEX, OR-Tools (including CP-SAT), HiGHS, Pyomo or PuLP.

•
Strong programming: expert Python and SQL, PySpark or similar for large datasets, and solid software engineering (object-oriented design, Git, testing, code review). Fluency with AI coding agents, with the judgement to check their output.

•
Working knowledge of ML and DL (forecasting, regression, tree-based models, neural networks) and of how to combine them with optimisation.

•
Experience leading a workstream and mentoring junior data scientists, and the ability to explain trade-offs and limitations to senior business and operations leaders.

Good to Have:

•
Domain experience in logistics, e-commerce, transportation or supply chain: network design, line haul, vehicle routing (including time windows) or last-mile delivery.

•
Experience with deep learning based forecasting, learning-augmented optimisation (ML for combinatorial optimisation, reinforcement learning) or GPU-accelerated optimisation.

•
Performance-critical programming in C++, Java or Julia, and familiarity with cloud platforms such as Google Cloud.

•
Publications at OR/ML venues (e.g. INFORMS, Transportation Science, Operations Research, NeurIPS, ICML, KDD) or open-source contributions.

Let’s get financially responsible! As Deputy Manager - FP&A, you’ll tell us how and where to spend our money. You’ll oversee the overall direction, control, compliance and timely and accurate reporting of management accounting and financial planning and budgeting. This role is critical for business performance and will require you to create a competitive business advantage for the team and the organisation. You’ll modify financial plans and budget amounts based on the changes in business plans.

What you will do
Budgeting & Forecasting and month closing:

• Support in preparation of annual budgets and rolling forecasts.

• Consolidate inputs from business teams and ensure alignment with company goals.

• Ensure books closure within the agreed timelines and rollout the P&L for management reviews

Cashflow Projection & Working Capital Analysis:

• Prepare short-term and long-term cashflow projections to ensure liquidity visibility.

• Monitor working capital (receivables, payables, inventory) and highlight risks/opportunities.

• Provide insights on cashflow impact of business decisions, capex, and financing needs.

Financial Analysis & Reporting:

• Prepare monthly management reports (P&L, Cash flow, variance analysis).

• Track actual vs. budget/forecast performance, identify variances, and explain key drivers.

• Support preparation of dashboards and KPIs for business leadership.

Business Partnering:

• Work closely with business stakeholders (sales, operations, marketing, etc.) to provide financial insights and decision support.

• Support evaluation of new business initiatives, investments, and cost-saving opportunities.

Competition Intelligence & Market Benchmarking:

• Conduct periodic review of competition and industry benchmarks on revenue models, pricing, user growth, cost structures, and profitability.

• Track emerging market trends and competitor strategies, and provide insights to leadership for strategic decision-making.

User Cohort & Growth Analysis:

• Perform cohort analysis to assess user acquisition, retention, repeat purchase behavior, and lifetime value (LTV).

• Provide insights into user economics to support pricing, promotions, and product strategy.

Post–listing Support:

• Assist in preparation of quarterly and annual financial reports in line with regulatory requirements.

• Support creation of earnings call decks, board presentations, and investor updates.

• Coordinate with Investor Relations and external stakeholders for financial data requests.

• Ensure consistency and accuracy in disclosures, KPIs, and performance narratives.

Strategic Support:

• Assist in long-range planning, scenario modeling, and sensitivity analysis.

• Conduct ad-hoc financial analysis to support strategic and operational decisions.

Process Improvement:

• Enhance financial models, tools, and reporting processes for efficiency and accuracy.

• Support automation initiatives and implementation of FP&A tools.

What you will need
• Chartered Accountant

• 2-4 years of experience.

• Experience in analytics, implementing analytics/management reporting/planning tools like Cognos, Qlik, Hyperion, etc.

• Ability to anchor/steer central calibrations around strategy, decision making and prioritisation

• Proven ability to form strong collaborations with stakeholders

title: Engineering Manager -Backend
description:
About Meesho 
 
Mission and Vision 
 
Meesho is India’s fastest-growing internet commerce company, driven by the mission to democratize internet commerce for everyone (DICE). Our vision is to enable 100 million small businesses and entrepreneurs in India to succeed online, making online commerce accessible to all. This core purpose guides us in empowering sellers across the country and bringing a diverse range of products to first-time internet shoppers. By leveraging technology and a unique zero commission model, Meesho has opened the doors of e-commerce to millions who were previously underserved. 
 
Technological Scale & Innovation
 
 At Meesho, technology is at the heart of our success. We have invested in a scalable infrastructure and innovative solutions to meet the demands of a vast user base and complex marketplace. Some key highlights include: 
 
Massive Scale: Our backend systems handle millions of orders per day from across India, reaching about 5% of all Indian households, all with near-zero downtime to date. Achieving this level of reliability and performance in a hyper-growth environment is a testament to our engineering excellence. 
 
 Marketplace Reach: Over 1.75 million sellers are registered on Meesho’s platform, supported by our state-of-the-art tech infrastructure and pan-India logistics network. This wide reach — covering virtually every serviceable pin code in the country — presents unique engineering challenges in areas like search, personalization, and payments at scale.
 
 Scalable Architecture: We continually innovate our architecture for growth.. Our quest to serve a billion Indian users has helped us evolve our technologies from a monolith to microservices to now a high scale federated architecture. This evolution allows us to build and deploy features rapidly while maintaining stability for a fast-growing user base. 
 
Cutting-edge Tech Stack: Our platform is built using modern, open-source technologies on the cloud while ensuring high efficiency. We strategically choose proven tools (for example, Java and Golang for services, Kafka for messaging, Dragonfly and Redis for caching, ScyllaDB, MySQL and Mongo for Data) and leverage GCP infrastructure to ensure high performance, reliability, and flexibility. By focusing on the right tools for the right problems, we innovate pragmatically rather than chasing every new tech hype, which helps us solve real-world problems effectively. 
 
Engineering Culture & Challenges 
 
Engineering at Meesho is driven by a bold and inclusive culture that values innovation, ownership, and continuous improvement. We believe that building great products goes hand-in-hand with building a great team. Key aspects of our engineering culture include: 
 
Long Term Thinking: We believe in thinking for tomorrow while building for today, this approach has helped us not only to handle and evolve for scale but also focus on extensibility and stability by investing in the platform
 
Lightspeed: We prioritize rapid iteration and delivery. Engineers are encouraged to ship fast and refine continuously, as we value in order to learn and adapt quickly. 
 
Continuous Improvement: We view failures and bugs as opportunities to improve. A blameless post-mortem culture ensures that mistakes become lessons, fostering an environment where learning from failure drives resilience and innovation.
 
 Ownership Mindset: Every engineer is empowered to act like an owner. We instill a “Founder’s Mindset,” encouraging engineers to take end-to-end ownership of projects and drive them with an entrepreneurial spirit. This means our teams proactively identify problems and champion solutions, just as a founder would for their own product. 
 
Engineering at Meesho is more than just writing code – it's about solving complex, impactful problems at an unprecedented scale. Our engineers tackle challenging use cases (from enabling real-time logistics across India to optimizing a vast product catalog for the next billion users), making a tangible impact on millions of entrepreneurs and customers. We maintain a
professional, yet passionate work environment where the drive to innovate is balanced with a pragmatic approach to problem-solving. 
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for Engineering Manager well-versed with emerging technologies to join our team.
 As an Engineering Manager, you will ensure consistency and quality by shaping the right strategies. You will keep an eye on all engineering projects and ensure all duties are fulfilled . You will analyse other employees’ tasks and carry on collaborations effectively. You will also transform newbies into experts and build reports on the progress of all projects.


What you will do
• Design tasks for other engineers as per Meesho’s guidelines

• Perform regular performance evaluation and share and seek feedback

• Keep a closer look on various projects and monitor the progress

• Carry on smooth collaborations with the sales team and design teams to innovate on new products

• Manage engineers and take ownership of the project while ensuring product scalability

• Conduct regular meetings to plan and develop reports on the progress of projects

 What you will need
• Bachelor's/Master’s in computer science

• At least 7+ years professional experience

• At least 2 years of experience in managing software development teams

• Able to drive sprints and OKRs

• Deep understanding of transactional and NoSQL DBs

• Deep understanding of Messaging systems – Kafka

• Good experience on cloud infrastructure - AWS/GCS

• Good to have: Data pipelines, ES

• Exceptional team managing skills; experience in building large scale distributed Systems

• Experience in Scalable Systems

• Expertise in Java/Python and multithreading

title: Head (Senior Manager) - Industrial Relations
description:
About the Team
You will join the Security & Investigations team within Fulfilment & Experience (F&E) at Meesho. F&E is the operational and technological backbone powering India's cost-efficient, reliable and scalable e-commerce network, serving 100M+ monthly active users. From enabling Valmo's distributed logistics network to building scalable fulfilment and experience platforms, F&E operates at the intersection of technology, operations and network innovation.
Within F&E, the Security & Investigations team safeguards the integrity and resilience of this network. The team investigates shipment loss, pilferage, fraud and misconduct, oversees physical security across operating sites, and coordinates with law enforcement and other stakeholders where required. Working closely with Operations, HR, Legal and logistics partners, the team helps keep the network secure, compliant and resilient.
About the Role
Valmo's operating network is powered by a large and diverse workforce spanning sort centres, hubs and last-mile operations. A significant portion of this workforce is engaged through logistics partners and other workforce arrangements, creating a complex industrial-relations environment across multiple locations and states.
As Head – Industrial Relations, you will own the Industrial Relations (IR) charter for the operating network, within the Security & Investigations function, and work closely with HR, Legal, Operations and partner leadership. Your mandate will be to build a stable, compliant and scalable workforce-relations framework that prevents avoidable disputes, enables fair and timely resolution of workforce issues, and provides strong governance when matters escalate.
The role combines strategic IR leadership with significant field engagement. You will build early-warning mechanisms, manage worker and union relationships, oversee dispute and disciplinary processes, strengthen partner workforce compliance, engage with labour authorities, and create playbooks and governance mechanisms that can scale with the network.


What You Will Do
Own IR strategy and governance. Build and continuously evolve a national IR framework covering workforce relations, grievance management, dispute prevention, statutory compliance, worker/union engagement, escalation and resolution.

Build workforce intelligence and early-warning mechanisms. Track workforce sentiment, grievances, absenteeism, wage-related concerns, shift and working-condition issues, emerging worker representation or union activity, and other indicators of potential disruption across the network.

Prevent and manage industrial disputes. Develop structured approaches to prevent disputes and lead the response to strikes, work stoppages, protests, gheraos and other workforce disruptions. Engage with worker representatives and union leaders and coordinate with Operations, HR, Legal, partners, local administration, labour authorities and law enforcement, as appropriate.

Bring IR rigour to investigations. Partner with Security & Investigations, HR and Legal on cases involving employees or partner workers, including theft, fraud, misconduct and policy violations. Ensure due process, appropriate documentation and legally sound decision-making.

Govern disciplinary processes. Oversee show-cause notices, domestic enquiries and disciplinary actions, ensuring that processes are fair, consistent, timely and legally defensible under applicable law, standing orders and organisational policy.

Drive partner workforce compliance. Establish and monitor governance over logistics partners covering contract labour requirements, wage and benefits compliance, statutory registrations, working hours, worker documentation, grievance mechanisms and other applicable labour requirements. Drive timely corrective action and escalation where gaps are identified.

Own government and authority engagement. Build effective working relationships with labour departments, labour commissioners, conciliation officers and other relevant government authorities. Represent the organisation in inspections, conciliation proceedings and hearings, in partnership with Legal, and coordinate with Security on matters requiring law-enforcement engagement.

Build effective grievance and escalation channels. Design and strengthen mechanisms such as worker helplines, site-level committees, grievance forums and escalation paths so that workforce concerns are surfaced and resolved before they become formal disputes.

Create scalable IR playbooks and capability. Develop SOPs, policies, escalation matrices and response playbooks for dispute management, investigation-linked disciplinary action, partner workforce issues and authority engagement. Train site leaders, partner supervisors, HR teams and security personnel on relevant IR practices and labour-law basics.

Build IR analytics and leadership reporting. Establish dashboards and regular reviews covering incidents, disputes, grievances, compliance health, partner risks, resolution timelines, repeat issues and emerging trends. Translate these into clear insights and actions for senior leadership.

Strengthen cross-functional governance. Establish clear interfaces between IR, HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and partner leadership, including decision rights, escalation threshold

What You Will Need
• 8–15 years of experience in industrial relations, employee relations, labour relations or labour-law compliance, preferably in large, distributed workforce environments.

• Experience in logistics, e-commerce, manufacturing, warehousing, retail, infrastructure or other large blue-collar and/or contract-workforce environments is strongly preferred.

• Deep working knowledge of applicable Indian labour and employment laws, including the Labour Codes and associated rules/notifications, contract labour requirements, industrial disputes, standing orders and relevant state-specific requirements.

• Practical experience applying labour law and IR principles on the ground across multiple sites and, ideally, multiple states.

• Proven experience handling industrial disputes, worker grievances, union/worker representative engagement, negotiations, strikes or work stoppages.

• Experience conducting or overseeing domestic enquiries and disciplinary proceedings, with a strong understanding of how employee investigations intersect with employment law and due process.

• Experience managing contract labour or partner workforce compliance, including audits, statutory requirements, wage-related compliance and remediation.

• Strong ability to engage with labour authorities, conciliation officers and other government stakeholders, preferably with experience representing an organisation in formal proceedings.

• Strong negotiation, conflict-resolution and stakeholder-management skills, with the ability to remain calm, credible and objective in high-pressure situations.

• Ability to work effectively across HR, Legal, Operations, Security & Investigations and external partners, with sound judgement on ownership, escalation and confidentiality.

• Strong communication skills in English and Hindi. Proficiency in one or more regional languages is an advantage, particularly for workforce-heavy operating regions.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving ability, including the ability to use workforce and incident data to identify patterns, risks and preventive actions.

• Willingness to travel extensively across operating locations and respond to sensitive on-ground situations at short notice.

• High integrity, discretion and maturity, with the ability to handle confidential matters and decisions that can materially affect employees and workers.

• A degree in law, HR, labour welfare, social work or a related discipline (LLB, MSW, MBA-HR or equivalent) is preferred.

Role Characteristics

• National scope with significant field engagement across the operating network.

• High level of cross-functional and external stakeholder interaction.

• Combination of strategic programme ownership, operational problem-solving and on-ground dispute management.

• Requires sound judgement, neutrality, confidentiality and the ability to balance business continuity with fair and compliant workforce practices.

description:

The Commerce Platform team at Meesho drives end-to-end growth, strategy, and operational excellence across key verticals:
User Growth: Scales the full lifecycle funnel, from acquisition and activation to retention. The User Growth team also houses Meesho’s branding pods, which shape how Bharat sees, trusts and keeps coming back to Meesho.

If you’re excited about building a brand that millions across Bharat love and return to, this role offers both strategic depth and hands-on impact.

As a Manager – Programs (Branding), you will anchor the branding pods within User Growth. You will own Meesho’s brand strategy end to end: understanding what holds users back and what brings them back, turning those insights into sharp brand briefs, and leading the campaigns that land them across TV, digital and influencers.

•
Hands-on Branding: Prior, direct branding experience is essential, including building brand strategy and briefs yourself.

•

•

•

Our Human Resources team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives.
