title: Manager – GTM & Sales Strategy, Meesho AI Services (MAS)
location_text: Mumbai, Maharashtra | Delhi NCR | Bangalore, Karnataka
description:
About the Team
MAS's mission is to accelerate the build and deployment of an AI workforce for every business — from kirana to conglomerate. Our vision is to deliver a billion-plus workflows through our agents in ways that drive real client outcomes, not automation for its own sake.
We go deep rather than wide. Today that means known, process-defined, repeatable service workflows — inbound contact-centre work (calls, chats, tickets), plus the outbound work that behaves like a cost workflow rather than a conversion one (lead qualification and verification, not lead conversion) — anywhere we can benchmark against a cost line the client already feels, guarantee savings, and hold the quality bar. We're deliberately building a technology company, not an AI BPO: models are a commodity, so our moat is the workflow knowledge, integrations, and client relationships that only come from actually running the work — not a generic AI layer bolted onto a call centre.
We've proven this model works — with marquee clients across consumer durables, auto, and D2C/marketplace businesses — and we're still early. We'll keep evolving it as we go, staying client-first rather than assuming we already have the answer. This is a 0–1 business inside Meesho: no fixed playbook, high ownership, and the ground floor of how India's enterprises adopt AI-led operations.
About the Role
This role is for a GTM generalist who thrives in ambiguity, is genuinely excited about AI-led offerings, and wants to build the full range of enterprise sales skills — with an eye on growing into a closer and sales leader over time, or moving into Business/GTM Operations. Both are real paths from this seat.
You own the middle mile of the deal: the stretch between a qualified conversation and a close-ready opportunity. That means deep client discovery, mapping who really decides, understanding how a client's teams actually work today, and making sure the deal never goes cold on your watch — following up, keeping momentum, and setting up the closer to walk into the room fully briefed. Our central team owns top-of-funnel lead-gen, but this isn't a purely inbound or coordination role — you'll still make cold calls and run early client meetings yourself when a deal needs it.
A lot of enterprise AI-services deals across this market stall before signature for a simple reason: nobody on the deal ever gets deep enough into the account to know what the client is actually buying, or who really decides. That's exactly the gap this role exists to close — the middle mile is where deals live or die.


 


What You Will Do
•
Own the middle mile of the sales cycle — from a client's first "yes, let's talk" through to a well-packaged, close-ready opportunity.

•
Run structured discovery conversations to understand a client's real pain points, current workflows, and AI-readiness.

•
Map client org structures — identify the true economic buyer, decision-makers, influencers, and blockers — and keep stakeholder engagement alive between senior-level touchpoints.

•
Help identify and nurture an internal champion for MAS within the account — someone advocating for us when we're not in the room.

•
Support structured, MEDDPICC-style account qualification alongside your closer, so every deal has an honest diagnosis of what's actually blocking it.

•
Make cold calls and run client meetings yourself where needed, working alongside (not just waiting on) the central lead-gen team.

•
Own the follow-up cadence after every client conversation — chasing next steps, addressing objections, and making sure momentum doesn't drop.

•
Build a working understanding of MAS's guaranteed-savings and outcome-based pricing models (per-minute, slab-based, pilot, risk-sharing) and contribute early pricing inputs on deals you're driving.

•
Brief and prep senior closers ahead of high-stakes conversations — sharp account context, clear stakeholder maps, clear next steps.

•
Bonus: build and iterate on client-specific product demos in partnership with Product/Tech.

•
Feed client and market insights back into the sales playbook and to Product, Tech, and Ops.

•
Bring structured, consultative thinking to every account rather than a transactional, task-based approach.

What you will need
•
4–7 years of experience in enterprise sales, GTM, business consulting, or client-facing analyst/BD roles, ideally with exposure to Indian mid-market/enterprise clients.

•
Strong discovery and analytical skills — able to quickly and accurately unpack a client's business problem and current workflow.

•
Comfort making cold calls and running early client meetings — this is not a purely inbound or coordination role.

•
A structured communicator — able to produce crisp meeting notes, account maps, and follow-up briefs.

•
Basic commercial acumen — able to understand and reason about pricing structures (you won't be expected to own pricing negotiations independently yet).

•
Genuine curiosity about AI and emerging technology — you don't need to code, but you should "get it."

•
Exposure to (or curiosity about) structured account-qualification frameworks like MEDDPICC is a plus — we'll teach you the specifics.

•
High ownership and follow-through — comfortable chasing a deal over weeks or months without losing momentum.

•
Comfortable working in ambiguity, without established playbooks, in a 0–1/1–10 business environment.

•
Ambition to grow — either toward a full closing/sales-leadership role, or into Business/GTM Operations — over time.

•
Bonus: prior exposure to building or presenting product demos.

•
Evidence that you're genuinely top-tier talent — that might show up as academic pedigree (a strong record at a top institute) or as a professional track record (success at a recognizable brand, or a reputation for excellence in high-stakes client work). We care about the evidence of excellence, not which box it comes from.

title: Manager – HRBP & ER
description:
About the Team 
 
Our HR team operates as a strategic partner to the business, focused on cultivating a high-performance culture where exceptional talent thrives. Our work is fundamentally guided by the DICE (Democratize Internet Commerce for Everyone) mission, which underpins our approach to all people strategies. Our core mandate centers on two critical pillars: driving world-class Talent Density and continuously elevating Employee Experience. We achieve this by relentlessly attracting, developing, and retaining the highest caliber of professionals, ensuring that every individual contributes significantly to our success. Concurrently, we are committed to shaping an unparalleled employee experience—one defined by transparent communication, meaningful development, and a deeply engaging, inclusive culture. As stewards of the company's most valuable asset—its people—we design, implement, and champion people strategies that directly translate into sustained business growth and a position as one of India’s most sought-after e-commerce destinations.
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for an experienced HR professional to lead two equally important charters: HR Business Partnering for the 3P/contract workforce and Employee Relations.
The role will manage a team of 6 direct reports supporting office, work-from-home, and field-based employees across multiple businesses and locations. The incumbent will partner closely with Business Leaders, HR Leadership, Legal, Finance, Talent Acquisition, HR Operations, Payroll, Ethics and Investigations, and staffing partners.
The role requires strong business understanding, people leadership, ER expertise, data-driven decision-making, and the ability to manage complex and sensitive matters with fairness, maturity, and speed.


What you will do 
•
Partner with Business Leaders and Finance teams on workforce planning, headcount budgeting, organizational design, productivity, cost optimization, and workforce deployment.

•
Maintain visibility on headcount, hiring, vacancies, redeployments, contract renewals, non-renewals, attrition, organizational structure, and workforce costs.

•
Partner with managers on performance management, talent development, succession planning, retention, and performance improvement plans.

•
Use workforce data to identify trends, risks, and improvement opportunities and recommend appropriate business and people interventions.

•
Lead the Employee Relations charter across businesses and locations, ensuring fair, consistent, and timely resolution of employee concerns.

•
Manage complex cases involving misconduct, fraud, harassment, absenteeism, behavioural concerns, conflicts of interest, dual employment, bribery, and policy violations.

•
Lead or oversee workplace investigations, including complaint assessment, interviews, evidence review, documentation, findings, and recommendations.

•
Partner with Legal, Ethics and Investigations, POSH committees, Business Leaders, and HR Leadership on complex or high-risk matters.

•
Guide HRBPs and managers on grievance handling, corrective action, disciplinary processes, performance concerns, and sensitive employee conversations.

•
Ensure ER decisions follow organizational policies, applicable laws, principles of natural justice, and established precedents.

•
Provide governance oversight for hiring, onboarding, background verification, attendance, payroll inputs, insurance, contract renewals, and exits.

•
Monitor compliance with minimum wages, statutory requirements, labour laws, contractor obligations, and internal policies.

•
Conduct periodic audits, review vendor performance, and strengthen SOPs, controls, dashboards, and governance mechanisms.

•
Lead, coach, and develop six direct reports across the HRBP and ER charters, with clear goals, accountability, and operating rhythms.

•
Build team capability in business partnering, investigations, documentation, data analysis, labour-law compliance, and stakeholder management.

•
Review key deliverables and escalations while enabling team members to independently manage their respective businesses and responsibilities.

What you will need
•
6 - 10 years of progressive HR experience, with significant exposure to both HR Business Partnering and Employee Relations.

•
Experience managing a large, distributed contract, third-party, fixed-term, field, operations, or high-volume workforce.

•
Proven experience handling complex ER cases, workplace investigations, disciplinary actions, grievances, performance concerns, and fraud-related matters.

•
Strong experience partnering with senior leaders on workforce planning, organizational effectiveness, performance, talent, and attrition.

•
Good understanding of labour laws, statutory compliance, minimum wages, contractor governance, and audit requirements.

•
Experience managing staffing partners and governing employee-lifecycle processes.

•
Prior experience leading and developing an HRBP or ER team is essential.

•
Strong stakeholder management, communication, conflict resolution, investigation, documentation, and data-analysis capabilities.

•
Sound judgment, high ownership, attention to detail, and the ability to handle confidential matters independently.

•
Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, ambiguous, and high-pressure environment.

•
Willingness to travel and support teams across multiple locations.

•
MBA/PGDM or equivalent postgraduate qualification in Human Resources. Certification in Labour Laws, Industrial Relations, POSH, or workplace investigations will be an added advantage.

•

description:
About the team

Would you like to be part of creating a unicorn within a unicorn? Solve some of the biggest challenges facing the financial inclusion of Bharat? Well, then here’s your chance! Financial Services (FS) is one of the fastest growing new businesses at Meesho. It's a large 10X opportunity for Meesho to build financial products for Bharat users and serve the unmet needs of millions of our users. And you will be at the center of this journey, building and scaling the business and serving millions of Meesho users. Meesho FS has several lines of products primarily in lending space for users and sellers of Meesho.

We aspire to create one of the country’s largest financial services businesses, drawing inspiration from global giants such as Alibaba, Shopee, and Mercado Libre, who have thrived in markets comparable to India and built large financial businesses.

About the Role

In this role, you will own the growth and governance of Meesho's Bank and NBFC partnerships across lending. Your first priority will be to scale existing partnerships by improving funnel performance, monitoring portfolio and risk, and deepening partner relationships. You will also lead new-partner integrations end to end, establish standard and increasingly automated operating processes, and build a qualified pipeline of new partners aligned with the supply roadmap. The role requires close collaboration with growth, credit risk, collections, product, technology, legal, compliance, finance, and operations teams to deliver timely launches and stable scale-up.


What you will do
• Own and grow existing Bank and NBFC partnerships by managing joint business plans, supply, funnel performance, and conversion, and by driving initiatives that increase disbursals and assets under management.

• Build deep relationships and strong governance with partner stakeholders across senior and working teams. Maintain regular engagement, understand strategic, policy, risk, and operational developments and provide timely internal and external updates.

• Track portfolio performance, funnel metrics, policy adherence, risk indicators, and operational health for each partner. Identify growth opportunities and emerging issues, and work with credit, growth, product, collections, and operations teams to improve the funnel and drive corrective actions.

• Lead new-partner integrations end to end, covering policy, commercial, legal, compliance, information-security, and tech construct alignment; UAT; launch; and post-go-live stability. Maintain clear owners, dependencies, milestones, and escalation paths so all teams deliver against a common timeline.

• Standardise and automate the partner integration and management playbook, including documentation, project trackers, governance forums, handoffs, and escalation processes, to reduce manual intervention and make execution faster and more predictable.

• Build a qualified pipeline of new Banks and NBFCs aligned with the supply roadmap and product and policy needs. Evaluate strategic fit, economics, risk appetite, and execution readiness, and drive the right partners from pitch and structuring through commercial and legal closure, onboarding, and launch.

• Executive communication: Write exec-level documents and present results and findings to senior management

What you will need
• 2-3 years of experience managing Bank and NBFC partnerships, preferably in a fintech or NBFC

• Good understanding of co-lending models, FLDG structures, and DLG guidelines

• Strong negotiation, communication, and relationship-management skills, with the ability to build trust across senior and working-level stakeholders and identify partner developments early

• Strong analytical ability to monitor partner funnels, portfolio performance, and risk metrics, and translate insights into growth initiatives or corrective actions

• High ownership, analytical skills, and ability to thrive in a fast-paced environment

• Demonstrated execution and program-management experience, including driving cross-functional integrations or other high-impact projects through launch and post-go-live stability

• Strong growth mindset and an inquisitive mindset, continuous problem solving to improve and grow the business

• Ability to independently drive problem statements and impact. Understand business needs and come up with right pitch and communication strategies

• First principles based critical thinking and data-led approach to problem-solving

What you will get
• A rare opportunity to build a large scale financial services business for millions of users

• Collaborate and drive growth of some of the latest fintech products and innovations

• End to end responsibility and ownership

• Once in a lifetime opportunity to create impact at scale

• Strong employee-friendly policies

• A fun and supportive team and leadership

We’re an eclectic mix of over 100 professionals, all driven by the first principles of problem-solving. We come with diverse skill sets and responsibilities ranging from running operations/support to managing the supply chain, and maintaining analytics to ensure the best possible user and seller experience. At Meesho, we are on a mission to achieve what has never been done before – introducing e-commerce to the tier-2 and tier-3 cities of India. Our team's crucial contribution to this ambitious endeavor involves completely reimagining fulfillment from the ground up. This translates into a multitude of "zero-to-one" projects, offering opportunities for those willing to seize them. Our focus is on constructing a supply chain and user experience that reshapes the landscape of e-commerce. Own a key part of user experience for one or more of marketplace participants - our entrepreneurs, their customers, or our suppliers

Participate in building strategy as an advocate for better user experience from the vantage point the programs you own

Influence product development choices using data and insights which originate from in-depth knowledge of your program

•
Drive program adherence with operations teams and continuously solve edge cases with suboptimal outcomes due to current processes

•
Engage the Meesho Leadership as active stakeholders in problem-solving for your programs

•
Manage internal and external stakeholders to ensure success of the programs you own.

•
The role requires strong generalist problem solving skills and offers mobility across different business verticals within the organization.

What you will need
•
Candidates from either Premium or Top B Schools with total work experience of 3-5 years of experience preferred

•
Experience in Fulfillment, 3PL Logistics and the entire supply chain process, and experience in similar tech startups preferred

•
Strong problem solving and analytical skills

•
Solid project management skills: ability to lead and collaborate with cross-functional partners, prioritize high impact activities, and work on complex projects

Data driven and inquisitive approach.

title: Principal Data Scientist
description:
About the Team
 
Our Data Science team is the Avengers to Meesho’s S.H.I.E.L.D 🛡️. And why not? We are the ones who assemble during the toughest challenges and devise creative solutions, building intelligent systems for millions of our users looking at a thousand different categories of products. We’ve barely scratched the surface, and have amazing challenges in charting the future of commerce for Bharat.  
 
 
About the Role
 
As a Principal Data Scientist in our AdTech team, you’ll drive innovation in our advertising platform using advanced machine learning and statistical methods. You’ll tackle complex problems in real-time bidding, ad ranking optimization, budget efficiency, and performance measurement that directly impact our business’s bottom line. This role requires technical excellence and business acumen and you’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams to transform data insights into actionable strategies that enhance our advertising ecosystem.


What you will do
• Design and develop sophisticated bidding, budget pacing and other algorithms that optimize ad spend or ROI.

• Create frameworks and experimental design to measure ad effectiveness and ROI.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to translate business requirements into efficient AI/ML solutions.

• Communicate long-term roadmap, insights and recommendations to tech and business leadership.

• Mentor junior data scientists and provide technical guidance.

• Lead research initiatives in machine learning, auction theory and advertising technology.

What you will need
• B.Tech in Computer Science, Machine Learning, or a related field with at least 6+ years of experience in AI/ML research.

• Experience in auction theory, predictive modelling, causal inference, and reinforcement learning.

• Expertise in PyTorch or TensorFlow, and proficiency in Python as well as big data technologies.

• History of mentoring junior data scientists, and comfortable in driving multiple problem statements.

• Excellent communication skills, able to explain complex concepts to both technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred Qualifications:

• M.Tech or Ph.d in Computer Science with a specialization in Machine Learning.

• 3+ years of experience applying machine learning and statistical modeling in AdTech, or related domains.

• Exposure in real-time bidding systems, programmatic advertising, or ad exchanges.

• Track record of successful research-to-product transitions.

• Strong publication record in top AI conferences (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, ICLR, KDD, CVPR, AAAI).

About us 
Welcome to Meesho, where every story begins with a spark of inspiration and a dash of entrepreneurial spirit. We're not just a platform; we're your partner in turning dreams into realities.
Curious about life at Meesho? Explore our Glassdoor - our people have a lot to say and they've helped us become a loved workplace in India.
Our Mission
Democratising internet commerce for everyone — Meesho (Meri Shop) started with a single idea in mind: to be an e-commerce destination for Indian consumers and to enable small businesses to succeed online.
We provide our sellers with benefits such as zero commission and affordable shipping solutions in the market. Today, sellers nationwide are growing their businesses by tapping into Meesho’s large and diverse customer base, state-of-the-art tech infrastructure, and pan-India logistics network through trusted third-party partners.
Affordable, relatable merchandise that mirrors local markets has helped us connect with internet users and serve customers across urban, semi-urban, and rural India. Our unique business model and continuous innovation have established us as a part of India’s e-commerce ecosystem.
Culture and Total Rewards
Our focus is on cultivating a dynamic workplace characterized by high impact and performance excellence. We prioritize a people-centric culture, dedicated to hiring and developing exceptional talent.
Total rewards at Meesho comprise a comprehensive set of elements — monetary, non-monetary, tangible, and intangible. Our 9 guiding principles, or "Mantras," are the backbone of how we operate, influencing everything from recognition and evaluation to growth discussions. Daily rituals and processes like “Problem First Mindset,” “Listen or Die,” our Internal Mobility Program, Talent Reviews, and Continuous Performance Management embody these principles.
We offer competitive compensation — both cash and equity-based — tailored to job roles, individual experience, and skill, along with employee-centric benefits and a supportive work environment. Our holistic wellness program, MeeCare, includes benefits across physical, mental, financial, and social wellness. This includes extensive medical insurance for employees and their families, wellness initiatives like telehealth, wellness events, and fitness-related perks.
To support work-life balance, we offer generous leave policies, parental support, retirement benefits, and learning and development assistance. Through personalized recognition, gratitude for stretched work, and engaging activities, we promote employee delight at the workplace. Additional benefits such as salary advance support, relocation assistance, and flexible benefit plans further enrich the Meesho experience.
At Meesho, we are committed to creating an inclusive and accessible workplace where every individual can thrive. In compliance with the Rights of Persons with Disabilities Act, 2016, we uphold the following principles:
Equal Opportunity: We ensure that employment opportunities are never denied on the grounds of disability if the candidate is otherwise competent to perform the job.
Accessible Workplace: Our facilities are designed to be fully accessible, with amenities and assistive devices provided to support differently abled individuals in their work.
Inclusive Hiring Process: We adopt a transparent and non-discriminatory selection process, including providing application forms in alternate formats and offering reasonable accommodations during interviews upon request.

title: Product Manager I
description:
About the Team 
 
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
 
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
 
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
 
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for a Product Manager I who is passionate about solving high-impact problems in a fast-paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category management, marketing, operations, finance, etc. to bring a new product to life.


What you will do
• Analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.

• Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.

• Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritised problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engineering., business, etc Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

• Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engg. business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.

• Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.

• Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.

• Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward-looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

What you will need 
• Overall experience of 3+ yrs with at least 1+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred).

• Exceptional problem-solving skills based on first principles of thinking.

• Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps.

• Good communication and stakeholder management skills to get work done across different functions and drive product development.

title: Security Architect - AI-Powered Security Engineering
description:
Security Architect - AI-Powered Security Engineering
About the Team
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. When 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this, with zero downtime! We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. By 2030, Meesho will be the world’s most trusted and secure digital ecosystem, operating on an AI-native, Zero-Trust, self-healing architecture. As we shift toward an era where autonomous agents generate and deploy code, we want to ensure our security scales seamlessly with engineering velocity. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member, fostering a strong 'Founder’s Mindset' that helps us move fast.
About the Role
We are looking for a highly technical, hands-on Security Architect (Individual Contributor) to guide and lead our AI-Powered Security Engineering charter. In this role, you will bridge the gap between conventional DevSecOps, infrastructure security, and the rapidly evolving landscape of AI. You will optimize our AI-driven Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC) by designing secure-by-default guardrails for both human developers and AI coding agents. Your mission is to ensure near-zero vulnerabilities from application and data security failures reach production. A significant portion of your focus will involve advanced Red Teaming, utilizing LLMs to improve Meesho's security posture, and architecting defenses for our autonomous AI systems against prompt injection, data leakage, and jailbreaking attacks.


What You Will Do
•
Lead AI Security Architecture: Drive the technical roadmap and high-level design to continuously prevent, detect, and autonomously contain threats across our systems and AI agents.

•
Hands-on Prototyping & POCs: Build proof-of-concepts for autonomous agent harnesses that automatically detect, analyze, and mitigate security vulnerabilities in real-time.

•
AI SDLC Optimization: Architect non-bypassable security guardrails across the SDLC for both developers and AI coding agents to ensure production systems are secured by default.

•
Red Teaming & Adversarial Validation: Proactively execute adversarial testing by simulating real attack scenarios across APIs, AI systems, and infrastructure to validate defense mechanisms.

•
Protect AI Systems: Design deep technical defenses to protect all AI agents and experimental features from prompt injection, system misuse, manipulation, and unauthorized actions.

•
Zero-Trust Governance: Architect a Zero Trust Identity Control Plane that eliminates implicit trust, ensuring access for both humans and autonomous agents is time-bound, least-privileged, and continuously verified.

•
Technical Leadership & Influence: Act as a security expert and IC leader. Mentor security engineers, provide architectural guidance across the organization, and partner closely with ML, DevOps, and Platform teams to evangelize secure coding practices without direct reporting lines.

What You Will Need
•
Experience: 10+ years of hands-on technical experience across different areas of security, including infrastructure security, product security, system design, and DevSecOps.

•
AI/ML Security Expertise: Proven track record of leveraging coding agents and LLMs for security workflows, Red Teaming GenAI models, and building defenses against jailbreaking, adversarial ML, and model hallucination risks.

•
DevSecOps & Cloud Mastery: Deep technical proficiency with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, including their security tools, Docker, and containerization technologies.

•
Technical Proficiency: Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, Node.js, and Python, combined with hands-on experience securing production code, developing security tooling, and performing manual source code reviews.

•
Strategic Vision & Threat Modeling: Ability to architect secure-by-default platform capabilities so all services inherit baseline security automatically, paired with advanced threat modeling skills for AI-native and distributed architectures.

Bonus Points

•
Relevant certifications such as GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT) or OffSec’s Advanced Web Attacks and Exploitation (WEB-300).

•
Strong understanding of emerging AI security frameworks (e.g., MITRE ATLAS, NIST AI RMF).

•
Experience participating in bug bounty programs or speaking at meetups/conferences.

•
Developing Security products and frameworks.

title: Security Engineer III - Infra Security
description:
About the Team
 
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. After all, when 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this – with zero downtime! 😎 Sounds impossible? Well, that’s the kind of Engineering muscle that has helped Meesho become the e-commerce giant it is today. We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. As a Security Engineer, you will be part of self-starters who thrive on teamwork and constructive feedback. We know how to party as hard as we work! If we aren’t building unparalleled tech solutions, you can find us debating the plot points of our favorite books and games – or even gossiping over chai. So, if a day filled with building impactful solutions with a fun team sounds appealing to you, join us.
 
About the Role
 
As a Security Engineer 3 in Infrastructure Security, you are a senior individual contributor who owns Meesho's infrastructure security and security operations (SOC) end to end. You will be one of the engineers securing everything from GCP organisation policy and IAM down to Kubernetes workloads and CI/CD infrastructure, so you will set the technical direction for infrastructure security, not just execute it. You operate with limited supervision, act as the trusted security voice in infrastructure and platform architecture discussions, and partner closely with other engineers whom you will mentor and uplevel. 
The role rewards breadth with depth: you should be comfortable moving between cloud architecture reviews, hands-on hardening, detection engineering, and incident response in the same week, and you will have unusual freedom to automate, consolidate, and build the guardrails that let a lean team secure a platform operating at Meesho's scale.




What you will do
Cloud Security Architecture & Design Review: Own secure design for Meesho's GCP estate, including organisation policies, project structure, IAM and service-account hygiene, VPC design, VPC Service Controls, workload identity, and encryption/key management (Cloud KMS). Lead threat modeling and security reviews for new infrastructure and platform services, and drive the resulting requirements into production with platform engineering.

Kubernetes & Container Security: Harden GKE clusters and containerised workloads end to end: cluster configuration, RBAC, network policies, admission control and policy-as-code, workload identity, image provenance and registry controls, and runtime posture. Define the secure-by-default patterns that platform and product teams build on.

Identity & Zero Trust: Drive Meesho's zero-trust roadmap for infrastructure: least-privilege IAM at scale, elimination of long-lived credentials and static keys, just-in-time and break-glass access patterns, secrets management, and strong isolation between production and non-production environments.

Posture Management & Hardening: Own cloud security posture management using GCP-native tooling (Security Command Center) and complementary controls. Continuously find, prioritise, and burn down misconfigurations and attack paths across the estate, and convert recurring findings into preventive guardrails rather than tickets.

Infrastructure as Code & Pipeline Security: Embed security into how infrastructure ships: IaC scanning and policy enforcement (Terraform), CI/CD pipeline hardening, artifact and dependency integrity, and software supply-chain controls for infrastructure components.

SOC & Detection and Response (End-to-End Ownership): Own Meesho's SOC and detection & response function: run the SIEM and the managed detection (MxDR) partner relationship, own alert triage quality, escalation paths, and on-call, and ensure infrastructure telemetry (cloud audit logs, Kubernetes audit, network and identity signals) is onboarded and high-signal. Build and tune detections for cloud-native attack techniques, lead incident response as the senior technical responder, and drive post-incident fixes to architectural closure.

Security Automation: Design and build automation that multiplies a lean team: auto-remediation for common misconfigurations, access-review tooling, inventory and attack-surface mapping, and self-service security workflows for engineering teams.

Vulnerability & Patch Management: Own the vulnerability lifecycle for infrastructure: OS and image patching posture, container base-image management, exposure tracking, and remediation SLAs, with metrics that drive engineering prioritisation.

AI Infrastructure Security: Contribute to securing the infrastructure behind Meesho's AI workloads, including the AI gateway plane, model-access controls, and isolation and egress controls for agents and AI services running in production.

Mentorship & Security Partnership: Mentor the SE2 on the team, review their work, and raise the team's technical bar. Act as the infrastructure security subject-matter expert for platform, SRE, and DevOps teams, influencing decisions without direct authority.

Compliance Enablement: Translate control requirements from frameworks such as ISO 27001, SOC 2, the DPDP Act, and CERT-In directions (logging, retention, incident reporting) into pragmatic technical controls, and provide evidence from systems you own.

What you will need
Experience: 5-7 years of hands-on experience in infrastructure, cloud, or platform security, with a demonstrated track record of owning security outcomes end to end in a production cloud environment.

Education: A Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field is preferred.

Core Technical Depth:

•
Strong hands-on cloud security experience, ideally on GCP (IAM, organisation policy, VPC and VPC Service Controls, Cloud KMS, Security Command Center, audit logging); deep AWS or Azure experience with willingness to go deep on GCP also works.

•
Deep, practical Kubernetes security expertise (ideally GKE): RBAC, network policies, admission control, workload identity, image and registry security, and runtime threat detection.

•
Proven ability to lead threat modeling for complex distributed infrastructure and translate findings into controls that ship.

•
Hands-on experience with infrastructure as code (Terraform) and with embedding security scanning and policy enforcement into CI/CD.

•
Strong scripting or programming ability (Python or Go preferred) and a bias toward building automation over running manual reviews.

•
Hands-on experience running detection and response: operating a SIEM (ideally with a managed SOC/MxDR partner), knowing what telemetry matters, writing high-signal detections, and leading infrastructure security incidents to closure.

•
Solid grounding in Linux, networking, and identity fundamentals (OAuth/OIDC, SAML, service identity).

General Skills & Acumen:

•
Sound judgment on risk prioritisation at scale: knowing which of a thousand findings actually matter and why.

•
Comfort operating in a lean team: self-directed, pragmatic about scope, and able to drive initiatives to closure across platform, SRE, and DevOps teams without direct authority.

•
Excellent communication skills, able to explain infrastructure risk to both engineers and leadership.

•
Ability and willingness to mentor an earlier-career security engineer.

Bonus Points

•
Relevant certifications such as CKS (Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist), Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer, OSCP, or GCPN.

•
Experience with zero-trust architecture rollouts or large-scale IAM remediation programmes.

•
Experience operating or integrating with a SIEM/SOC, including detection-as-code practices.

•
Exposure to securing AI/LLM infrastructure (model gateways, agent isolation, egress controls) and software supply-chain security (SLSA, artifact signing).

•
Offensive security exposure: cloud-focused red teaming, attack-path analysis, or published research/CVEs.

•
Exposure to India regulatory requirements such as the DPDP Act and CERT-In directions.

•
Experience speaking at meetups or conferences.

title: Security Engineer IV
description:
About the Team
 
The security team at Meesho is like the Avengers to Meesho's S.H.I.E.L.D. After all, when 5% of Indian households shop with us, it’s important to build resilient systems to manage millions of orders every day. We’ve done this – with zero downtime! 😎 Sounds impossible? Well, that’s the kind of Engineering muscle that has helped Meesho become the e-commerce giant it is today. We value speed over perfection, and see failures as opportunities to become better. We’ve taken steps to inculcate a strong ‘Founder’s Mindset’ across our engineering teams, making us grow and move fast. We place special emphasis on the continuous growth of each team member - and we do this with regular 1-1s and open communication. As a Security Engineer, you will be part of self-starters who thrive on teamwork and constructive feedback. We know how to party as hard as we work! If we aren’t building unparalleled tech solutions, you can find us debating the plot points of our favorite books and games – or even gossiping over chai. So, if a day filled with building impactful solutions with a fun team sounds appealing to you, join us.
 
About the Role
 
As a Security Engineer 4, your role is integral in ensuring the security of our products throughout their development lifecycle. You will be involved from the very beginning, participating in threat modeling and design reviews to identify potential risks early. You'll also integrate and manage SAST tools within our CI/CD pipeline, ensuring continuous security testing as code evolves. Additionally, you'll lead and conduct vulnerability assessments and penetration testing (VAPT) to proactively uncover and address security vulnerabilities before they reach production. 


What you will do
• Lead and manage all aspects of the Secure Software Development Lifecycle (SDLC).

• Implement and manage security tools within the CI/CD pipeline (DevSecOps).

• Conduct and oversee VAPT for web applications, APIs, iOS, and Android apps.

• Perform threat modeling, design, and architecture reviews to identify potential risks.

• Execute manual source code reviews and enhance security in production environments.

• Manage and optimize a self-managed bug bounty program.

• Provide security architectural guidance to Engineering and IT teams.

• Manage issues identified from penetration tests and bug bounty programs.

• Lead security training and awareness campaigns across the organization.

• Manage Web Application Firewalls (WAF) to ensure robust protection.

• Engage in the Security Champions program to integrate security practices within teams.

• Assist in creating and maintaining Security Risk Models for both new and existing systems.

What you will need
• 7+ years of experience in product security, with a focus on application security and Dev SecOps.

• Proven experience in leading architectural changes or cross-team efforts to mitigate security vulnerabilities.

• Proficiency in programming languages such as Java, React, Node.js, and Python.

• Hands-on experience with manual source code reviews and securing production code.

• Expertise in deploying and managing security tools in CI/CD pipelines.

• Experience with Git, Jenkins, Artifactory, or other similar technologies.

• Strong background in securing the software development lifecycle, including eliminating classes of vulnerabilities.

• Proficiency with cloud platforms like AWS or GCP, including their security tools.

• Experience with Docker and containerization technologies is highly desirable.

• Additional experience in infrastructure security, particularly in GCP, Docker, and containerization, is a bonus.

Bonus Points
• Relevant certifications such as GIAC Web Application Penetration Tester (GWAPT), OffSec’s Advanced Web Attacks and Exploitation (WEB-300), etc.

• Strong understanding of SSO protocols, including OAuth and SAML.

• Experience speaking at meetups or conferences.

• Experience participating in bug bounty programs.

title: Senior Associate - Performance Marketing
description:
About the Team
 
We’re revolutionizing the way India shops — and we need curious, driven minds like yours to lead the charge.Imagine seeing your favorite influencer in a show-stopping outfit, only to find there’s no way to buy it online. Frustrating, right? That’s the very gap we’re solving at Meesho through Content Commerce  and additionally trying to shape more influencers become entrepreneurs— and you could be at the heart of it.As our next Senior Associate – CC, you’ll play a pivotal role in solving one of the most common yet unexplored problems in Indian e-commerce: how to connect aspiration to access. And the solution lies in building a creator-driven commerce engine.
 
About the Role
 
This role sits within the Content Commerce GM org, one of Meesho’s most exciting and high-potential bets. Content Commerce is the hottest new trend in e-commerce globally, and we’re working to make it mainstream in India, just like we did with reselling.Within the Content Commerce org, you will be part of the Meesho Creator Club (MCC) team — a core team that focuses on onboarding, activating, and scaling creators across the country. The team’s mission is to enable creators to drive immersive, trustworthy, and high-conversion shopping experiences for Meesho users, directly impacting GMV and revenue.

• Discovering new creator growth channels – from social platforms to community groups

• Designing growth experiments and campaigns to bring new creators into the Meesho ecosystem

• Activating and enabling creators to consistently participate in content commerce by building toolkits, incentives, and playbooks

• Collaborating cross-functionally with internal teams (product, ops, tech, creative) and external partners to drive outcomes.

• 3-4 years of experience in managing digital performance campaigns (Meta ads and Google Ads is preferred)

• In depth understanding of how to run a performance marketing campaign and knowledge of how to make analytical driven decisions from the campaign data and taking corrective actions to meet the objectives

• Organizational skills Excellent communication skills, written and verbal

• Problem-solving and project management skills

title: Senior Business Development Manager (SBDM)
description:
About the team

ValMo is Meesho’s logistics and supply chain organization, responsible for building India’s most cost-efficient, reliable, and scalable fulfillment network. From first-mile pickup to last-mile delivery and reverse logistics, ValMo powers millions of shipments every month for small businesses across the country.
Valmo (Meesho’s Logistics Arm) is building India’s largest and most efficient hyperlocal self-pickup network: Meesho Pickup Point. We are partnering with local Kiranas, pharmacies, and telecom shops to serve as highly dense, zero-effort pickup points for our prepaid customers.


About the Role

As the SBDM, you will be the CEO of your "Mega Region," directly managing a large team of Business Development Managers (BDMs) to blanket your city with Meesho Pickup Points.


What you will do
● Hire & Build: Recruit, train, and deploy high-performing BDMs across specific hyper-local zones (using data-driven geographic mapping).

● Drive Scale & Onboarding: Own the regional target for Meesho Pickup Point acquisition. Ensure your BDMs are successfully pitching the "Zero-Touch, Passive Income" model to Kirana owners.

● Network Health & Activation: Onboarding is just step one. You will ensure that stores actually start receiving shipments, track the First-3-Days "Valmo Pilot Handshake," and ensure 95%+ delivery-compliance by shopkeepers.

● Cross-Functional Leadership: Act as the bridge between the Meesho Pickup Point network and Valmo Delivery Ops. Resolve on-ground friction between the Delivery Pilots (who drop the cargo) and the Meesho Pickup Point (Store Owners).

What you will need 
● 5 to 8 years of hardcore experience in Field Sales Management, Merchant Acquisition, Telecom Distribution, or FMCG Distribution.

● Proven experience managing a large on-ground sales team of 50+ BDMs/Sales Executives.

● A background in scaling merchant networks (e.g., QR code deployment for Fintechs, telecom SIM distribution, or B2B retail apps) is a massive plus.

● Data-driven mindset: You should be comfortable reading heatmaps, understanding route density, and tracking daily active scanning metrics.

● Aggressive executioner who knows the streets of his cities like the back of their hand.

title: Senior Copywriter
description:
About the Team
 
As the Growth team, we play a key role in making Meesho one of the most sought-after e-commerce destinations in India😋 We hold end-to-end responsibility to launch and scale-up users on the platform by ensuring the right selection, competitive pricing and sales. As our senior copywriter, you’ll join us to create the best user experience in the online shopping journey – word by word✍
 
From acquiring users onto the social media channels through social-first campaigns to monthly sales campaigns, we look after all funnels of the user’s life on Meesho. We also engage and retain our users on the platform with growth-related initiatives. We want to enable every user to experience the power of Internet commerce💪
 
We focus on personal growth and team bonding just as much as we do on working hard. That’s why, we have regular 1-1s, monthly outings, and timely rewards and recognitions🥳
 
About the Role
 
Short version: We’re searching for someone with a blackbelt in wordplay. An experienced wordsmith ninja who loves cracking lame jokes, puns, and witty one-liners. Someone who has a flair for turning ordinary briefs into something extraordinarily creative. 
 
Long version: Being a Senior Copywriter in the User Growth team of Meesho is a role that requires someone who can craft copy that strikes precision and leaves a lasting impact. We’re looking for a creatively energetic person who is excited to immerse themself in creative thinking and push boundaries to develop fresh and innovative ideas. Are you ready to unleash your creativity and bring a touch of quirkiness to every project?


 What you will do
• Wield the power of words to create compelling and engaging copy that inspires action across various platforms, including social media, push notifications, digital ads, and more.

• Dive deep into the brand's essence, understanding its voice and personality. Your copy will seamlessly integrate with the brand's identity, leaving a lasting impression.

• Collaborate with the creative team, brainstorming ideas that push the boundaries. Your imagination will know no bounds as you come up with innovative concepts.

• Unleash your sharp-eyed grammar ninja skills to ensure flawless copy that is free of typos, inconsistencies, and grammatical errors.

• Navigate the ever-changing landscape of project timelines and deadlines with agility. Your ability to multitask and prioritize will ensure that no copy challenge is left unconquered.

Requirements:

• You must possess a black belt in copywriting, with a proven track record of crafting impactful and persuasive copy.

• Your mind is a treasure trove of creative ideas, and you can think outside the box to deliver copy that stands out from the crowd.

• You have an eagle-eyed focus on the tiniest of details, ensuring that every comma, semicolon, and hyphen is in its rightful place.

• A quirky sense of humor! Your copy will surprise, entertain, and tickle the funny bones of your audience.

What you will need
Experience :

• 3-5 years of copywriting experience.

• A combination of ad agency and client-side experience is a plus.

• Have previously worked on a myriad of brands and industries. (Kudos, if you’ve worked on an e-commerce brand)

• Experience in writing ad films for any medium. Great recommendations by previous employers.

We need someone who can solve complex communication challenges with deeply contextual, high-performing video formats that resonate culturally and drive engagement at an unprecedented scale.

title: Senior Manager, CEO's Office
description:
About the Role
Meesho's CEO's Office sits at the centre of how the company makes decisions. As Senior Manager, you'll work directly with the CEO and CXOs/GMs on company strategy, the operating rhythm, and the cross-functional bets that matter most.
This is a leadership role, not a support role. You'll own outcomes, not just inputs. Scope will shift as company priorities shift, and you'll often work without formal authority. It suits someone who is part thinker, part builder, part operator.
You'll get a front-row seat to building and scaling a public tech company, direct impact on the company's trajectory, and a launchpad for future leadership roles at Meesho.
About the Team
The CEO's Office works as a force multiplier for the CEO. We run the company's operating system: the reviews, planning cycles and performance tracking that keep leaders aligned and accountable.
We also pick up the problems that don't sit neatly inside one function. These cut across business, product, tech and operations, and we drive them to closure with the owners.
It's a high-trust team. We see the company's most important decisions early, and we're expected to handle that with discretion and sound judgement.


What you will do
Partner with the CEO

•
Be a thought partner to the CEO: help pick, structure and drive the highest-impact priorities

•
Speed up CEO decisions with sharp briefs, decision frameworks and analysis

•
Represent the CEO in leadership forums when needed

Run the company operating system

•
Design and evolve the operating cadence: reviews, planning cycles, performance tracking

•
Improve clarity, alignment and accountability across leadership teams

•
Make sure CEO and leadership decisions get followed through, with clear owners and dates

Lead strategic, cross-functional projects

•
Lead high-impact projects across business, product, tech and operations

•
Incubate and evaluate new business opportunities and adjacencies

•
Take ambiguous problems, break them down, and turn them into plans that ship

•
Work with CXOs and GMs to unblock and speed up key priorities

Shape culture and leadership

•
Reinforce leadership principles and drive leadership communication

•
Influence how decisions get made and how leaders work together

•
Raise the bar on thinking quality and execution discipline

What you will need
Detail orientation. You think in specifics. You can walk through a P&L line by line, know the unit economics of the businesses you've worked on, and cite the numbers without being asked.

Strong opinions. You take a clear position and defend it under pushback. You'll tell a senior leader what isn't working, including in your own team's work. You don't stop at "it depends".

Curiosity. You ask the second and third question. You want to understand how the whole business works, not just your part of it, and you learn fast.

Humility. Low ego, high accountability. You can name your own mistakes specifically, and you separate what you did from what your team did.

Self-awareness. You know why you made each career move, what you're good at, and what you're not.

Managerial style. You get results through others. You build systems rather than stepping in as the hero, and you've led across functions without formal authority.

Must have

•
Strong structured problem solving and executive communication

•
A record of solving complex, ambiguous business problems

•
Proven cross-functional execution, with high ownership and bias to action

•
Comfort working with senior leadership teams

Strong advantage

•
Built or scaled tech products or businesses

•
Startup or high-growth operating experience

•
Founder's office, CEO office or strategy roles

•
Close work with product and tech teams

•
Marketplace, e-commerce or platform businesses

title: Senior Product Manager
description:
About the Team
 
Product Management in Meesho closely resembles our rocketship growth. Because we obsess over understanding customer behaviour, we’ve been able to carve out an e-commerce niche in Tier 2/3/4 towns in Bharat. Our business growth is testimony to a singular focus on how we think of ‘product’ for our unique customers - ones that have barely shopped online, but are now able to because of Meesho.
 
Fun fact: Nearly 7% of India’s households shop with us. 😉
 
We are driven by a ‘user-first’ mindset. We have a strong bias for action. Above all, our team is driven by impact, not features. We drive ‘problem discovery’ & delivery - not only obsess over “what to build”, but execute with rigour to create impact.
 
But there’s more – we love to have fun as much as we love to work hard. From movie buffs, to sportspersons, we have a super cool team. So, if a game of badminton after a day of brainstorming at work sounds like something you would love to do, then join us!
 
About the Role
 
We are looking for a Senior Product Manager who is passionate about solving high impact problems in a fast paced start-up environment with a high degree of autonomy. This is inherently a cross-functional leadership role where you will work closely with teams such as software engineering, UX design, category mgmt., marketing, operations, finance, etc to bring a new product to life.


What will you do
• Market & Customer Understanding: Understand the e-commerce market and needs of customers/sellers deeply through landscape analysis, customer interviews, user research, competition analysis and other qualitative/quantitative techniques.

• Problem Identification & Prioritization: Adopt a structured approach to identify what problems need to be solved and break them down into smaller chunks. Prioritize what problems need to be solved now vs. later.

• Solution Discovery: Facilitate a process to come up with the best technology-led ideas to solve the prioritized problems. Harness the creativity of not just yourself but of other teams such as design, engg., business, etc. Be willing to experiment with multiple solution ideas and test them using MVPs, prototypes, etc.

• Product Delivery: Define detailed product requirements and work collaboratively with a cross-functional team (design, engineering, business, analytics, etc.) to bring a product to life. Ensure high product quality through processes such as user acceptance testing, dogfooding, etc.

• Go-to-Market Planning: Create a go-to-market plan working with business/marketing stakeholders to maximize product adoption and success.

• Adoption & Metrics: Define product metrics for your area, and track them continuously. Identify usage patterns and come up with action plans to move metrics in the right direction.

• Roadmap Creation: Create a product roadmap for your area that has at least a 3-month forward looking view of key customer/business problems to be solved.

• Team Leadership: Manage a small team of product analysts and associate product managers, and guide them towards product execution.

What you will need
• Overall experience of 7+ yrs with atleast 5+ yrs in product management in a tech-led company (consumer internet space is preferred)

• Exceptional problem solving skills based on first principles thinking

• Good understanding of technology, and comfort with product management processes such as A/B experimentation, writing product requirement documents, managing product backlogs, and creating roadmaps

title: Account Executive
description:
About Hevo Data

Hevo is a no-code Data Pipeline platform trusted by 1,000+ companies globally, including Postman, Shopify, Doordash and Gartner. Backed by $42M from Peak XV Partners and Chiratae Ventures, we power the data infrastructure of companies that move fast.
 
We are consistently rated #1 on G2 in the ETL and Data Integration category (4.5+ rating) and are a Snowflake Premier Partner. Our product is in the market, loved by customers, and now entering its next growth phase.
 
With 600+ US customers already on the platform and a product that has matured significantly over the last two years, this is the ground-floor moment. Before the team scales, before the brand becomes obvious. The upside is real and uncapped.
 

Why This Role, Why Now
Own US mid-market and enterprise territory at a company with real product-market fit and 600+ reference customers already in the market.
Sell a product that CDOs, Heads of Data, and VP Analytics actually want to buy.
Inbound intent is high, and the G2 rating does your first slide for you.
Structured support: 50% of your pipeline comes via BDR coverage and inbound. The other 50% is yours to build, with LinkedIn Sales Navigator, Apollo, and Outplay in your hands.
Solutions Engineering alignment for complex PoCs. You will not be alone in the technical room.
10% commission on every outbound deal you close. No ceiling.
Three-month protected ramp: full variable payout in months 1–3 while you build pipeline and close your first logos.


What We Are Looking For
Must-Haves

• 4 - 7 years of B2B sales experience, with meaningful time in a quota-carrying, net-new business role.

• Demonstrated track record of consistent quota achievement. Not just hitting numbers, but understanding why you hit them.

title: Associate Director - Technical Account Management
description:
About HevoHevo Data is a no-code data pipeline platform that helps companies consolidate data from multiple sources for faster analytics. Our fully managed pipelines let data teams move data from 150+ sources (databases, SaaS applications, cloud storage, SDKs, streaming services) into warehouses and lakes, all without writing code.
Over 2,000 data teams in 45+ countries use Hevo, including DoorDash, Foot Locker, Arhaus, and Santander. We’re top-rated in the G2 Data Pipeline category, backed by Sequoia Capital, Qualgro, and Chiratae Ventures, and operate out of San Francisco and Bangalore.
Why This Role MattersHevo’s customers are data engineers, analytics leaders, and platform teams who rely on us for critical data infrastructure. Customer Success here goes well beyond satisfaction surveys. The job is to help technical teams get real value from their pipelines, cut the time it takes to get to insight, and grow their data operations.
We’re looking for a strong leader to build and run the CS function. You’ll own the full post-sales journey (onboarding, adoption, renewal, expansion) and be directly accountable for Net Revenue Retention and customer health across our global base.
The Setup
A growing team of TAMs, based primarily in Bangalore and Pune
A product with 1000+ customers but an evolving post-sales playbook for 250-300 accounts
A customer base spanning SMB to enterprise across e-commerce, fintech, medtech and B2B Software companies.
Strong executive support and buy-in for investing in Technical Account Management
A chance to shape CS strategy at a company that’s defining the data pipeline category
Responsibilities
Build and Own the TAM Program
Design and roll out Hevo-specific TAM playbooks covering onboarding, adoption, health scoring, renewal, and expansion
Segment the customer base (enterprise, mid-market, self-serve) and build the right engagement model for each
Own net revenue retention, gross retention, and expansion metrics
Drive Customer Outcomes
Improve renewal rates and reduce churn by driving deeper product adoption and making sure customers see tangible results
Work with Sales on cross-sell and upsell opportunities, always leading with retention
Build customer advocacy through NPS programs, case studies, and community engagement
Grow lifetime value by catching risks early through health monitoring and having clear playbooks for when to step in
Customer Lifecycle
Map out the customer journey for Hevo’s technical buyers and end users
Set up the right checkpoints across the lifecycle (usage data, satisfaction signals, support sentiment) and create standard responses for each stage
Keep improving based on what the data and customer feedback tell you
Lead and Grow the Team
Hire and develop strong TAMs
Put together an onboarding process that gets new hires productive fast
Build a team culture where people are technically curious, care about customers, and take ownership of outcomes
Measure What Matters
Define and track operational metrics: time-to-value, adoption rates, health scores, NRR, GRR.
Build dashboards and regular review cadences, and report key metrics to the executive team and board
Cross-Functional Work
Work with Product to make sure customer insights feed into the roadmap
Coordinate with Sales on ideal customer definition, handoff process, and expansion pipeline
Team up with Marketing on customer campaigns, advocacy programs, and lifecycle comms
Work with Finance on forecasting, renewal projections, and unit economics
Invest in CS/TAM Technology
Use AI and automation to make the program more efficient and scale the team’s impact without growing headcount at the same rate

Must-Have
10+ years of overall experience, and 5+ years leading Technical Customer Success or Tech Account Mgmt teams in B2B SaaS, with experience building or scaling a technical CS/TAM function
Experience with technical or developer-facing products, ideally in data infrastructure, analytics, or related areas like ETL/ELT, data warehousing, observability, or DevOps
Track record of owning and improving net revenue retention in a subscription / recurring-revenue business
Comfortable managing technical CSEs who spend their days working with data engineers and analysts
Analytical and numbers-driven. You make decisions based on data and you build the systems to track it
Strong communication skills. Comfortable presenting to the board and working across functions to get things done

Nice-to-Have
Time spent at a modern data stack company (Fivetran, dbt, Snowflake, Databricks, Airbyte, or similar)
Familiarity with usage-based or consumption-based pricing models
Mix of technical (engineering, solutions) and business (CS, account management) experience
Experience managing CSEs across multiple geographies or time zones

Why Hevo?
We’re in a large, growing market (data integration is projected to hit $17B+) and we’re one of the leaders
Our customers actually like the product. Top-rated on G2, with strong word-of-mouth growth
Sequoia Capital-backed with strong investor support
CS is treated as a growth function here, not a cost center. You’ll have real ownership
Low-ego team with deep engineering and product roots

summary: Implement SaaS connectors, build REST API components, debug data pipelines, and develop internal AI tools as an Associate SDE.

enrichment.summary: Implement SaaS connectors, build REST API components, debug data pipelines, and develop internal AI tools as an Associate SDE.

description:
About Hevo:
Hevo is a Series B data infrastructure company with $42M raised.
More than 2,000 companies across 40 plus countries use Hevo to move data from more than 150 sources into platforms such as Snowflake and BigQuery.
Our customers include DoorDash, Shopify, Pinterest, Postman and Icelandair.
Our engineering team is built in India, and so are the decisions.
We are not the remote engineering office of a US company.
The people building the product are the people deciding what to build.
 
What we are building:
We are building an AI system that creates data connectors by itself and keeps them working by itself.
No engineer should need to manually build every connector. No engineer should need to come back six months later because the source API changed.
Work that traditionally takes weeks or months should take hours. But building a connector is not the hardest part.
The real question is: Would you trust this system to run by itself, with nobody watching, for months?
That is the job.
What you’ll own as Associate SDE at Hevo:
Implement SaaS connectors for assigned applications, learning application specific nuances like basic auth and data extraction.
Assist in building simple REST API components, focusing on clean implementation and testing.
Debug and optimize code for data pipeline efficiency under mentorship.
Contribute to feature breakdown, coding, and documentation for smaller tasks.
Apply logical thinking to solve integration issues and improve component quality.
Build internal tools with AI for business teams to run their functions
 
What you’ll bring to the table:
Basic object-oriented programming skills and familiarity with design principles.
Exposure to data pipelines or APIs; eagerness to learn concurrency and performance basics.
Foundational knowledge of REST APIs (e.g., making calls, handling JSON) – no deep expertise needed.
Proficiency in Java/TypeScript/Python, good problem-solving with data structures and algorithms.
Strong analytical and logical thinking for real-world challenges.
 
Candidate Persona:
Freshers with experience in software development, ideally with internships in integrations or data tools.
B Tech in Computer Science or equivalent from a reputed college.
 
Why this role:
Very few teams are building autonomous AI systems that operate production infrastructure where being wrong has real consequences.
This is not a chatbot. It is infrastructure that has to remain correct, quietly, for months.
If that kind of problem excites you, there are not many places working on it this early.
You can talk to anyone in the company, including the CEO.
What you are trusted with depends on what you can do, not your title.

About Hevo

Role Summary
An Associate Customer Experience Engineer owns customer issues end-to-end, keeps unnecessary escalations to a minimum, and ensures every interaction reflects a high standard of customer experience.
This role centers on troubleshooting JDBC-based sources and integrations, partnering closely with Product and Engineering whenever an issue calls for deeper investigation. The role calls for building solid technical depth over time, following and refining support workflows, putting AI and automation to good use, and adding to the team's shared knowledge so issues get resolved faster and more consistently across the board.
Key Responsibilities
Own customer issues and drive them to resolution within SLA timelines, combining structured investigation with clear, timely updates to the customer.
Investigate issues by digging into SQL, logs, API responses, database behavior, product documentation, and other diagnostic tools available.
Loop in Product and Engineering as needed, sharing the relevant technical context, investigation findings, and steps to reproduce the issue.
Keep unnecessary escalations to a minimum by building strong product and technical knowledge and resolving issues independently wherever possible.
Follow established support processes and flag improvements that cut down on rework, manual effort, and resolution time.
Use AI-assisted tools, automation, and diagnostic capabilities to make troubleshooting faster and more consistent.
Build deeper technical expertise in JDBC-based sources and integrations, along with databases, APIs, ETL, and related technologies.
Add to SOPs, KB articles, onboarding material, and other knowledge assets the wider team relies on.
Support teammates when needed and take an active part in team training, enablement, and knowledge-sharing activities.
What Success Looks Like
Steady SLA adherence combined with consistently high-quality resolutions on owned tickets.
A growing ability to resolve technically complex issues without outside help.
An avoidable escalation rate that stays low and keeps trending downward.
Customer communication that is clear, accurate, and easy to act on.
Meaningful, ongoing contributions to SOPs, KBs, and broader team enablement.
Real, measurable use of AI and automation to cut down on manual effort and resolution time.
Visible growth in technical depth and troubleshooting capability over time.

Solid grasp of cloud technologies and core database concepts, including the basics of database administration.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting databases, applications, or integrations.
Strong command of SQL.
Familiarity with data warehousing, ETL, REST APIs, and webhooks.
Working knowledge of Java or another object-oriented programming language.
Sharp troubleshooting, debugging, research, and problem-solving abilities.
Background in technical product support, including email-based support.
Able to write and maintain clear technical documentation such as KBs and SOPs.
Strong written and verbal communication with a sharp eye for detail.
Genuinely curious and customer-first, with the ability to break down and synthesize technical information effectively.
Preferred Qualifications
2–5 years in technical product support, application support, database support, or a similar technical role.
Hands-on experience troubleshooting JDBC-based sources or integrations.
DBA experience with PostgreSQL, MySQL, SQL Server, Oracle, or a similar database platform.
Background supporting B2B SaaS products or integration platforms.
Exposure to ETL/data integration platforms.

title: Engineering Manager
description:
About Hevo:
 
At Hevo, we are changing the way companies leverage data to drive user experience, growth, and business processes. There has been a fundamental change in the amount of data companies are generating on a day-to-day basis. More and more users in an organization are now looking to use data to drive business decisions. Data is no longer a second-class citizen and companies are seeing data as a competitive advantage. We see this change and we are on a mission to change the way companies leverage their data. 
 
With a technology platform processing more than 100 billion records a month and doubling itself every 6 months, Hevo is poised for exponential growth in the coming future. This position provides a unique opportunity to create a massive impact on all existing and future customers of Hevo through technology innovation.
 
If you are the one who is looking to take a leap of faith and work on the technology of the future, if you obsess over customer satisfaction and experience then we are looking for you.
 
About the Role:
 
We’re looking for an experienced Engineering Manager to lead the development of highly scalable, reliable, and secure platform services and database connectors that power mission-critical data pipelines for thousands of enterprise customers. These pipelines connect to modern data warehouses such as Snowflake, BigQuery, and Databricks, as well as Data Lakes like Apache Iceberg.
 
This is a rare opportunity to own and build foundational systems, solve complex engineering challenges, and lead a high-impact team delivering best-in-class performance at scale.
 
You will play a central role in shaping our platform vision, driving high accountability, and fostering a culture of technical excellence and high performance—while working closely with cross-functional stakeholders across product, program, support, and business teams.
 


What You’ll Do:
• Lead, mentor and inspire a team of software engineers who take pride in ownership and delivering impact.

• Ensure operational excellence through proactive monitoring, automated processes, and a culture of continuous improvement with strong accountability.

• Drive a strong quality-first mindset , embedding it into the development lifecycle—from design to deployment.

• Drive technical leadership through architecture reviews , code guidance, and solving critical platform challenges.

• Build and operate multi-tenant, distributed backend systems at scale.

• Act as a technical leader —you’ve operated at least at T ech Lead, Staﬀ Engineer, or Principal Engineer level in your career.

• Champion a culture of high accountability , clear ownership, and high visibility across engineering and cross-functional stakeholders.

• Collaborate deeply with Product, Program, Support, and Business functions to drive alignment and execution.

• Embed principles of observability, reliability, security, and auditability into all aspects of the platform.

• Inspire the team to pursue engineering excellence , driving best-in-class implementations and visible results.

• Define and track data-driven KPIs to ensure operational eﬃciency, performance, and team eﬀectiveness.

• Take end-to-end ownership of product lines, ensuring on-time delivery and customer success .

• Contribute to team growth , hiring, and building an inclusive, learning-focused engineering environment.

What We’re Looking For:
• 10+ years of experience in backend or systems software development.

• 2+ years in a formal or informal Engineering Manager, Sr. Engineering Manager, or Tech Lead role in a fast-paced engineering environment.

• Progression through senior IC roles like Tech Lead, Staﬀ, or Principal Engineer .

• Strong experience with distributed systems, cloud-native architectures , and multi-tenant platforms.

• Proven ability to drive cross-team collaboration with product, support, business, and program teams.

• Demonstrated ability to drive accountability , set clear goals, and raise the performance bar for the team.

• Expertise in system design, scalability, performance optimization, and cost control.

• Proven track record of mentoring engineers , guiding architecture, and leading impactful initiatives.

• Clear communicator, adept at both strategy and execution.

Bonus Points:
• Experience with data engineering platforms, ETL systems, or database internals .

• Exposure to product-driven companies , especially in infrastructure, SaaS, or backup/data systems.

• Demonstrated history of fast-tracked growth or high-visibility impact.

• Led or contributed to re-architecture or greenfield systems at scale.

Lead. Build. Inspire.
 
Join us to shape the future of data infrastructure—where your leadership, expertise, and vision will directly power business-critical decisions for the world’s leading companies.
