title: Specialist, Information Security and Privacy
description:
Mindtickle is hiring a Specialist, Information Security and Privacy to join our Information Security and Privacy team in Pune. This role sits at the intersection of compliance, technical security, third-party risk management, and customer trust. You will be responsible for various functions related to the security, privacy, and protection of Mindtickle's growing cloud platform.
Your role will involve handling enterprise customer and prospect security RFP requests, managing third-party risk, and owning the operational backbone of our compliance program across SOC 2 Type II, ISO (27001, 22301, 27701, 27017, 27018 & 42001), 21 CFR Part 11,  HIPAA, and DR testing. You will coordinate with customers, vendors, and internal teams to ensure Mindtickle adheres to the highest data security standards. A proactive and pragmatic approach to data security and privacy is essential as you help build systems that make compliance self-evident. This role reports to the Senior Manager, Information Security and Privacy.


Key Responsibilities
•
Serve as the main point of contact for sales and customer teams regarding security, privacy, and compliance topics, communicating with customers and prospects through RFPs, emails, or calls.

•
Review customer/prospect questionnaires and security addendums, providing and building necessary information, collaterals, and resources.

•
Maintain information security reports, RFP knowledgebase, and security assets for the security due diligence process utilizing existing RFP management tools.

•
Work flexibly across all teams in the organization, driving security RFP and third-party risk management projects, including sales, customer success, product, and engineering.

•
Own the third-party risk management process, including planning, scoping, needs analysis, ongoing project management, and communication with stakeholders.

•
Conduct security due diligence on new third parties and perform periodic risk reviews of existing third parties.

•
Own and manage controls across SOC 2 Type II, ISO standards, 21 CFR Part 11, and HIPAA frameworks, maintaining an up-to-date control landscape and evidence inventory.

•
Coordinate and support external audits end-to-end - from audit scoping and evidence preparation to auditor walkthroughs and post-audit remediation tracking.

•
Manage compliance tracking across Google Workspace (Sheets, Drive, Docs, Gmail) - maintaining structured control registers, evidence repositories, and policy documentation.

•
Send and track corrective action communications to control owners, following up through resolution and maintaining a clear audit trail.

•
Conduct periodic internal compliance reviews and produce structured reports for leadership.

•
Collaborate closely with privacy, internal governance, audit, Engineering, DevOps, Legal, and HR teams to gather necessary information related to compliance and ensure controls are implemented.

•
Work with engineering, business applications, legal, and other teams as required to fulfill customer, prospect, or third-party compliance requirements.

•
Maintain and periodically review information security policies, procedures, and standards in Google Docs, ensuring they remain current and aligned with framework controls.

•
Coordinate access reviews, vendor security assessments, and third-party risk evaluations as part of the ongoing compliance calendar.

•
Undertake any other reasonable and related tasks associated with the role.

Requirements
Experience and Background

•
3-5 years of experience in information security and compliance, with exposure to cloud software platforms (AWS/GCP).

•
Extensive experience in handling customer security queries, including RFPs, questionnaires, security architecture reviews, and data protection evaluations.

•
Experience in managing third-party risk evaluation and management processes.

•
Strong understanding of cloud governance and technology security controls covered in SOC 2, ISO Standards, NIST, GDPR, HIPAA, CSA STAR, CIS, etc.

Tooling and Workflow

•
Proficient in Google Workspace - comfortable using Sheets for control tracking, Drive and Docs for policy and evidence management, Gmail for formal communications, and Calendar for scheduling.

•
Utilize existing RFP management tools to maintain the knowledge base in line with changing customer needs, global standards, product releases, and updates.

•
Experience using Jira for cross-functional issue tracking and Slack for team collaboration.

Soft Skills and Working Style

•
Excellent communication, interpersonal, project management, and issue-resolution skills.

•
Strong written communication skills - able to draft clear policy documents, corrective action notices, and executive summaries.

•
Strong analytical and organizational skills, with the ability to work effectively as part of a team.

•
Proactive, pragmatic, and self-driven - able to learn quickly, take initiative, identify gaps, propose solutions, and drive complex projects in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

Good to have:
•
Certifications: CISSP, CISM, CISA, CRISC, CCSP, ISO 27001, ISO 42001, ISO 22301, CompTIA Security+, etc.

•
Understanding of data privacy principles under GDPR and HIPAA, including data classification, retention policies, and subject rights processes.

title: Staff Engineer
description:
Who we are
Mindtickle is the leading AI-powered revenue enablement platform, helping sales teams learn faster, practice smarter, and perform at their best. We bring together onboarding, training, coaching, content, digital sales rooms, conversation intelligence, and AI role-plays into one platform so revenue teams have everything they need to build winning sellers.
Global companies, like Fortune 500 organizations, trust Mindtickle to support their revenue teams. Customers and industry analysts have also recognized us. G2 has ranked us the #1 Sales Training & Onboarding platform for 28 consecutive quarters, and Forrester has recognized Mindtickle as a Leader in revenue enablement. Mindtickle was also recognized as AI-Based Sales Solution of the Year by the 2025 AI Breakthrough Awards and has received Stevie Awards for Technology Innovation and Customer Support Excellence.
At Mindtickle, we're helping companies create high-performing revenue teams, and we're looking for people who want to help shape what's next.


Job Summary
The Staff Engineer is the senior individual contributor at Mindtickle. The role is defined by scope, not tenure or technology.

Staff Engineers shape technical direction across teams. They take on problems that cross system boundaries, i.e., foundational platform decisions, architectural work that spans multiple services, performance and reliability challenges that no single team owns, and AI capabilities that need to be woven into the product rather than bolted on.

This is not a senior engineer with a different title. The role exists for a different category of problem.

Key Responsibility
•
Solve Organization wide problems - crisply define the problem, propose the solution, implement it and get it adopted. One of the finest examples of this is the data platform at Mindtickle.

•
Take on problems that span teams — performance regressions across services, integration patterns that cut across domains, AI capabilities that have to hold up across varied customer configurations.

•
Review designs from other teams. Identify architectural risks before they become incidents. Propose and drive migrations, deprecations, and platform investments.

•
Set the technical standard through your work — the code you write, the design documents you publish, the reviews you give. Influence through clarity, not authority.

•
Be the champion of AI transformation at Mindtickle. Evaluate where AI-native approaches should replace or augment traditional systems. Reasons about cost, latency, reliability, explainability, and maintenance burden. Help shape how the engineering organization itself uses AI tooling.

•
Own the operational health of the systems you influence. Drive reliability, observability, and performance work proactively, with data and clear proposals.

•
Make other engineers better — through design reviews, technical mentorship, and creating clarity in areas where others are stuck. Distribute knowledge rather than concentrate it.

Required Qualification
•
Clear evidence of significant industry experience as an individual contributor in software engineering, with the most recent years operating at Staff scope or equivalent. Scope is defined by the kind of problem owned, not the title held.

•
Demonstrated architectural ownership. Evidence that you have defined or significantly shaped system architecture in production that has stood the test of time — structural decisions you made, not designs you implemented.

•
Cross-team technical influence. Concrete examples where your work has shaped systems beyond your immediate team and thrived — patterns adopted by others, disagreements resolved across boundaries, design proposals taken up by other teams.

•
Production discipline. Direct ownership of systems running in production, with demonstrated work on reliability, observability, or operational improvement that survived contact with real customers.

•
Incident management. Track record of leading the response to production incidents — driving diagnosis under pressure, owning the post-incident review, and translating findings into structural improvements that prevent recurrence.

•
Strong written technical communication. Design documents, RFCs, or technical proposals that articulate complex trade-offs in writing.

•
Depth in at least one domain: multi-tenant SaaS systems, integration-heavy platforms, workflow or rules engines, configuration-driven architectures, real-time analytics, data pipelines, or platform infrastructure serving multiple internal teams.

•
Judgment on complexity. A record of making systems simpler — deprecations led, abstractions removed, boring technology chosen where it sufficed.

Preferred Qualification
•
9+ years of industry experience in software engineering, with multiple years operating at Staff scope or equivalent.

•
Experience leading large-scale migrations or platform transitions that affected multiple teams.

•
Familiarity with AWS and the architectural patterns relevant at scale — multi-region or multi-AZ design, managed data services, identity and security boundaries, cost-aware infrastructure choices.

•
Understanding of product metrics and product analytics — how systems are instrumented to support product decisions, how telemetry shapes prioritization, and how engineering choices surface in business outcomes.

•
Open-source contributions to systems-level projects — databases, infrastructure, runtime, build, observability — rather than feature contributions to consumer products.

•
Published technical writing — engineering blog posts, conference talks with substantive material, RFCs, design documents, and / or conference papers.

•
Experience in environments where customer variation is a first-class constraint — meaningfully different customer configurations, integrations, or data shapes within a single product line.

•
Familiarity with the broader Mindtickle problem space — sales enablement, revenue productivity, learning systems, content intelligence, or call analytics.

Our Culture & Values
We hire builders, people who move fast, learn from failure, and use AI as a default part of how they work. Our values- Delight Your Customers, Act as a Founder, and Better Together- aren't wall decor. They're how we make decisions here.
Growth at Mindtickle looks like owning more, not just doing more. Your scope will outgrow your job title if you want it to. You'll work alongside people who've scaled revenue tech globally, get direct feedback from leaders invested in your development, and take on challenges before you feel ready because that's how the best growth happens.
Our team spans 5+ countries, backgrounds, and perspectives. We believe the best products are built by people who bring different ways of seeing the same problem - and everyone has a seat at that table.
We hire for potential. Apply even if your experience doesn't match every requirement; your skills, perspective, and drive matter here. At Mindtickle, you can be yourself, build your career, and do the best work of your life alongside people who genuinely want to see you succeed.
We believe the best products are built by teams with different backgrounds, experiences, and ways of seeing the world. We welcome every unique identity, and we mean that.

title: Assistant Manager(Controllership)
description:

About this Role:

In this role, you will be responsible for maintaining accurate financial records, managing Accounts Receivable (AR) and Accounts Payable (AP) reconciliations, and ensuring compliance with financial regulations.


On the Job
• Maintain accurate and up-to-date financial records, ensuring all transactions comply with accounting standards

• Manage end-to-end Accounts Receivable and Accounts Payable processes, including aging analysis and reconciliations

• Perform monthly bank, vendor, and inter-company reconciliations to ensure data accuracy and integrity

• Use ZOHO Books for day-to-day accounting, reporting, and process automation

• Support GST, TDS, and other statutory compliance filings, and assist in year-end audit preparation with organized documentation

• Prepare periodic financial statements (P&L, Balance Sheet) and MIS reports for management review

 Must-haves (Min. qualifications)
• Semi-Qualified CA (Inter CA cleared)

• 3–5 years of practical experience in bookkeeping and accounting

• Prior exposure to CA firms or managing multiple client accounts/audit assignments is a strong plus

• Hands-on experience with ZOHO Books or the ZOHO Finance Suite

• Advanced Excel proficiency (VLOOKUPs, Pivot Tables, financial modeling)

• Strong understanding of AR/AP cycles, reconciliations, and statutory compliances (GST/TDS)

Good to have
• Strong attention to detail with a high level of accuracy

• Good analytical thinking and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work independently and manage tight month-end timelines

• Effective communication skills to coordinate with vendors and internal/external stakeholders

Why join us?
• Work in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Gain exposure to diverse financial portfolios and real business impact.

• Competitive compensation and accelerated career growth for ambitious finance talent.

 
Perks That Go Beyond the Paycheck
• Relocation assistance to make your move seamless.
• Free office meals (lunch & dinner).
• Generous leave policy, including birthday leave, period leave, paternity and maternity support, and more.
• Salary advance and loan policies for any financial help.
• Quarterly rewards and recognition programs, and a referral program with great incentives.
• Access the latest gadgets and tools.
• Comprehensive health insurance for you and your family, mental health support.
• Tax benefits with options like food coupons, phone allowances, car/device leasing.
• Retirement perks like PF contribution, leave encashment and gratuity.

FamApp focuses on financial inclusion of the next generation by providing UPI & card payments to everyone above 11 years old. Our flagship Spending Account, FamX, seamlessly integrates UPI and card payments, enabling users to manage, save, and learn about their finances effortlessly.
 
Revolutionizing Payments and FinTech
FamApp has enabled 10 million+ users to make UPI and card payments across India, removing the inconvenience of carrying cash everywhere. Users get to customise their FamX card with doodles, which lets them add a personal touch to their payments.
 
Trusted by leading investors
We’re proud to be supported by renowned investors like Elevation Capital, Y-Combinator, Peak XV (formerly Sequoia Capital India), Venture Highway, Global Founder’s Capital, and esteemed angels Kunal Shah and Amrish Rao.
 
Join Our Dynamic Team
At Fam, our people-first approach is reflected in our generous leave policies, flexible work schedules, comprehensive health benefits, and free mental health sessions. We don’t mean to brag, but we promise you’ll be surrounded by some of the most fun, talented and passionate people in the startup space.
 
Want to see what makes life at Fam so awesome? Check out our shenanigans at @lifeatfam 😛
PS - We’re looking for someone with an AI-native mindset, who actively leverages AI in their day-to-day work, as we encourage and embed it across every level at Fam.

About the team
The Core Infrastructure team builds the platforms and systems that power everything at Fam, from real-time app experiences to high-volume payments. It operates as a small, high-leverage team with deep ownership. Every service at Fam runs on the platform this team builds, so it cares obsessively about system fundamentals, operational excellence, and mechanical sympathy.
What our systems process
1 Billion+ API requests per day powering ~10M daily transactions for 10M+ users at 20,000+ RPS.
470+ node Kubernetes cluster (~2,500 vCPUs and ~8 TiB RAM) under active orchestration.
Dynamic, multi-dimensional auto-scaling powered by 195+ HPAs paired with Karpenter.
12+ TB of active transactional data (and counting) across our high-throughput database clusters.
Event Streaming - 400+ topics, and 3,800+ partitions at ~46,700 messages/sec
Our Next Chapter
While our core systems already handle massive scale, our next vision as a team is to turn infrastructure into a frictionless platform discipline.
We are building towards a world where internal engineering teams consume platform primitives compute, storage, and event streams via self-serve contracts without waiting on us. We're also laying the groundwork for AI-native platform operations, developing agent plane and agent skills so agents can safely interact & operate infrastructure primitives alongside our team. We look to the CNCF landscape for best-in-class tools our systems, with a long-term commitment to contributing back to open source.


What You'll Do
• Build and operate compute, storage, and networking at scale that powers FamApp.

• Design platform contracts for other teams: Modules, golden paths, and abstractions with clear inputs, outputs, and guarantees.

• Take medium-to-large infrastructure projects from design to rollout, manage dependencies across engineering teams, and work through ambiguity without waiting to be unblocked.

• Build idempotent, retry-safe automation with its own observability, integrated with CI/CD, ticketing, compliance, and incident workflows.

• Build reusable infrastructure with Infrastructure as Code and Configuration as Code with clear interfaces, validation and versioning backed by safe provisioning ci/cd workflows.

• Operate Kubernetes as the Operating system - Own the cluster lifecycle (worker plane, node groups, add-ons) . Ability to extend it with controllers, operators, and CRDs so teams consume platform capabilities as Kubernetes-native APIs.

• Define user-facing SLIs, SLO targets, burn-rate alerts, and error-budget actions for what you own. Carry the pager, cut alert noise, and lead post-incident follow-up with blameless postmortem.

• Track cloud spend for your services and look for savings without compromising reliability or compliance.

• Maintain golden pipeline templates, GitOps release patterns, and self-service onboarding, with security gates and least-privilege pipeline identities built in, which enables developers to ship their code to different environments.

• Turn requirements into technical design docs that cover the full life of a system: how teams adopt it, how it's operated and maintained, and how it stays reliable (monitoring, SLIs, backup, DR, incident response), so anyone on the team can follow them.

Must Haves
• 3-6 years in DevOps, SRE, or platform engineering, with ownership of production systems.

• Cloud compute and Linux fundamentals - Instances, images, and block storage on any major cloud: diagnosing throughput/IOPS limits, memory pressure, inode and file-descriptor exhaustion, and systemd issues, and correlating OS-level evidence with cloud metrics and dashboards.

• Cloud networking - Network and subnet design, CIDR planning, routing, firewall and security-group rules, and DNS. You can design cross-account or cross-project connectivity, weigh peering against transit hubs and private endpoints, and debug asymmetric routing and overlapping CIDRs.

• Hands-on Kubernetes in production managed services like EKS, GKE, or AKS.

• Terraform or equivalent IaC with reusable, versioned modules and safe change workflows.

• Programming ability in Python or Go to build automation that is idempotent, retry-safe, and observable.

• CI/CD and GitOps experience - pipeline templates, release and rollback patterns, security gates.

• Reliability practice: SLIs/SLOs, actionable alerting, on-call, and blameless post-mortems.

identify new signals and approaches that can improve our ability to detect evolving fraud patterns.

 Zeta is seeking an Associate Director – Legal to serve as a strategic advisor within its legal team. The role supports the company's technology business, including its SaaS platforms for banks and financial institutions, as it scales across India, the US, the UK, and other global markets.This is a high-impact, product-facing role for a seasoned lawyer with deep expertise in technology contracts and a strong understanding of the banking and financial services sector that Zeta's platforms serve.
 
The role involves making sure Zeta's products, partnerships, and client engagements are structured and delivered in a legally sound way. Reporting to Zeta's India legal leadership, the Associate Director will work closely with the Product, Sales, Engineering, Compliance, and Information Security teams, with significant autonomy and visibility. The ideal candidate will own matters end to end, negotiate directly with clients, financial institutions, and technology partners, and lead a team of capable lawyers. They will also help shape the legal function of a fast-growing global technology company.


Responsibilities
•
Draft, review, and negotiate B2B SaaS contracts, outsourcing contracts, software development agreements, license agreements, and managed-services, partnership, and third-party vendor agreements with clients, financial institutions, and technology partners, making sure they align with legal and business requirements.

•
Serve as the subject matter expert on all aspects of technology contracts.

•
While anchored in technology law, provide practical legal advice across all matters that affect the business, including corporate, commercial, employment, and intellectual property issues, and offer innovative solutions to minimize and manage legal risks across jurisdictions.

•
Manage the input from internal stakeholders that is needed to draft and review critical agreements.

•
Lead and mentor a team of lawyers, overseeing the quality and turnaround of contract reviews and negotiations.

•
Constantly improve the legal team's templates and playbooks, drawing on learnings from each client engagement.

•
Act as a business enabler, keeping the legal team aligned with Zeta's speed of delivery and culture of teamwork.

Skills
•
Regulatory and commercial acumen : Commercially minded, pragmatic; translates complex legal and regulatory issues into clear, actionable guidance for non-legal stakeholders.

•
Stakeholder management and communication : Strong communication and negotiation skills, sound and independent judgment, ability to counsel senior management strategically.

•
Execution and prioritization : Highly organized and detail-oriented; manages multiple matters simultaneously in a fast-paced, high-growth setting; ability to leverage AI for legal work highly preferred.

•
Team leadership and people management : Ability to lead and manage a team effectively.

•
Ownership and adaptability : Proactive self-starter, energized by ambiguity, comfortable in unfamiliar areas of law, takes ownership of outcomes, thrives in a collaborative, product-driven culture.

•
5-year BA LLB, BBA LLB or equivalent law degree from a recognized institution; qualified to practice law in India. An LLM is a plus but not mandatory

•
9-12 years of post-qualification experience in the technology law practice of a top-tier law firm and/or as in-house counsel at a B2B SaaS technology company. Law firm experience mandatory.

Excellent grasp of the laws and market practices that apply to technology agreements, intellectual property, and data protection.

•
Strong contract drafting, review, and negotiation skills across B2B SaaS, outsourcing contracts, software licensing, software development, IT services, and IP licensing agreements.

Understanding of the nuances of technology agreements in the banking and financial services sector, with exposure to cross-border matters.

•
Proven experience leading and managing a team, including handling administrative responsibilities alongside substantive legal work.

About the Role:
As a Cloud Security & DevSecOps Engineer II, you will play a key role in strengthening the security posture of our cloud infrastructure, Kubernetes/container platforms and software delivery ecosystem. 
You will work closely with Cloud/Platform, SRE, DevOps, Engineering, Product Security and Risk & Compliance teams to identify and mitigate security risks, build scalable security controls, automate recurring security activities and drive security findings through remediation and closure. 
The role covers Cloud Security Posture Management (CSPM), IAM & Access Governance, DevSecOps, Kubernetes Security, Infrastructure Security, Vulnerability Management, Security Monitoring, Security Automation and Compliance Engineering, while also contributing to broader Information Security initiatives across the organisation.


Responsibilities
•
Perform continuous security posture assessments across AWS, Azure and GCP environments and identify cloud misconfigurations, insecure configurations and deviations from security baselines.

•
Conduct IAM and SSO access reviews , covering users, roles, groups, service accounts/service principals, permissions, access keys and privileged access, and identify excessive or stale access.

•
Identify and assess publicly exposed cloud resources , insecure network configurations and unnecessary external exposure across compute, storage, databases, load balancers and other cloud services.

•
Integrate security controls into CI/CD pipelines , including SAST, SCA, secrets scanning, Infrastructure-as-Code scanning, container/image scanning, DAST and software supply-chain controls.

•
Perform Infrastructure-as-Code security reviews and support secure implementation of Terraform and similar technologies.

•
Perform Kubernetes and container security assessments , including cluster configurations, Kubernetes RBAC, workload security, image security, hardening and security posture management.

•
Analyse vulnerabilities and security findings, validate risks and false positives, prioritise remediation and work with Engineering/SRE/DevOps teams to drive findings through closure.

•
Develop security automation using Python, Bash, cloud APIs and CLIs for IAM reviews, asset inventories, security assessments, compliance checks, monitoring, reporting and evidence collection.

•
Review cloud network and edge security controls including VPC/VNet, Security Groups/firewalls, load balancers, WAF, TLS/mTLS and public/private connectivity .

•
Monitor and review CloudSEK alerts and findings , perform initial analysis and validation, and coordinate remediation or escalation with relevant stakeholders.

•
Support CloudSEK block-rule activities , including review and validation of relevant indicators, domains and URLs, and coordinate appropriate blocking actions with responsible teams.

•
Support investigation of cloud and security alerts, exposed credentials, suspicious access, provider security notifications and other security events.

•
Participate in cloud architecture and design security reviews and provide practical security recommendations based on risk, secure-by-design and least-privilege principles.

•
Support security and audit requirements aligned with frameworks such as CIS, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP .

•
Develop and maintain security standards, SOPs, hardening guidelines, assessment methodologies, technical documentation and operational runbooks.

•
Continuously identify opportunities to automate preventive and detective security controls and improve overall Cloud Security and DevSecOps maturity.

•
Participate in broader Information Security activities including vulnerability management, security assessments, incident investigations, security reviews, audit/compliance.

Skills
To be successful in this role, you should have:

•
Strong hands-on understanding of at least one major public cloud platform, preferably AWS , with working knowledge of Azure and/or GCP being an advantage.

•
Good understanding of cloud security across IAM, compute, storage, networking, encryption, logging and monitoring .

•
Knowledge of cloud security services such as AWS IAM/IAM Identity Center, Security Hub, AWS Config, CloudTrail, KMS and EKS , or equivalent services in Azure/GCP.

•
Hands-on understanding of CI/CD and DevSecOps security , including SAST, SCA, DAST, secrets scanning, IaC scanning and container/image security.

•
Experience with CI/CD technologies such as Jenkins, GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Bitbucket Pipelines or equivalent platforms .

•
Working knowledge of Terraform and Infrastructure-as-Code security .

•
Good understanding of Docker, Kubernetes, Kubernetes RBAC, container security and cluster hardening .

•
Experience with scripting and automation using Python, Bash or similar languages .

•
Strong understanding of IAM, least privilege, MFA, privileged access, credential management and access governance .

•
Understanding of CSPM, KSPM, CWPP and CNAPP concepts.

•
Knowledge of cloud/network security concepts including VPC/VNet, Security Groups, firewalls, WAF, TLS/mTLS and private/public connectivity .

•
Experience with security monitoring, alert triage and threat/exposure-management platforms such as CloudSEK or equivalent solutions .

•
Exposure to security tooling such as Snyk or equivalent SAST/SCA, CSPM, container and infrastructure security solutions .

•
Understanding of vulnerability management, risk-based remediation and security incident investigation.

•
Knowledge of security standards and frameworks including CIS Benchmarks, NIST, PCI DSS, ISO 27001 and OWASP .

•
Ability to independently analyse security findings, document security risks and provide clear and practical remediation recommendations to technical stakeholders.

Experience and Qualifications
•
3–6 years of relevant experience in Cloud Security, DevSecOps, Infrastructure Security, Platform Security or related security engineering roles.

•
Strong hands-on technical experience in cloud security, infrastructure security, vulnerability management and security automation .

•
Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, Cyber Security, Engineering or a related discipline , or equivalent relevant industry experience.

•
Relevant cloud/security certifications such as AWS Certified Security – Specialty, AWS Solutions Architect, Certified Kubernetes Security Specialist (CKS), Microsoft Azure Security Engineer, Google Professional Cloud Security Engineer or equivalent are an added advantage.

About the Role
The Manager – Accounts will be responsible for overseeing end-to-end finance operations including Accounts Payable, General Ledger, month-end close, statutory and group audits, treasury operations, and providing finance support for corporate restructuring initiatives across Zeta Group entities.
The role requires strong technical accounting knowledge, leadership capability, and the ability to operate in a fast-growing, multi-entity environment.
An ambitious individual who can deal with ambiguity and is interested in working for a growth-phase company would be an ideal fit for the role.


Responsibilities
1. Financial Accounting & Month-End Close

• Own and manage the monthly, quarterly, and annual financial close process, ensuring accuracy and timeliness.

• Review and approve journal entries, accruals, provisions, and reconciliations.

• Ensure compliance with Ind AS / IFRS and Group accounting policies.

• Monitor balance sheet integrity and drive resolution of open items.

2. Accounts Payable & Payments

• Oversee Accounts Payable operations, including vendor accounting, invoice processing, and aging management.

• Ensure timely processing of vendor payments in line with agreed credit terms and internal controls.

• Review and approve bank payments through ERP and banking platforms.

• Drive process improvements and automation in AP workflows .

3. General Ledger & Controls

• Lead the General Ledger function across multiple entities.

• Ensure robust internal controls, SOPs, and documentation.

• Partner with internal stakeholders to resolve accounting issues and improve data quality.

4. Audits & Compliance

• Act as the primary point of contact for statutory, internal, and group audits.

• Coordinate audit planning, data readiness, and closure of audit queries.

• Ensure timely completion of audits with minimal adjustments and no major qualifications.

• Support compliance with statutory requirements, including filings and regulatory submissions.

5. Treasury & Banking

• Oversee treasury operations, including cash flow monitoring, fund utilization, and banking relationships.

• Manage bank accounts, signatories, and payment authorization controls.

• Support cash forecasting and liquidity planning in coordination with leadership.

6. Restructuring & Special Projects

• Provide accounting and finance support for group restructuring, de-mergers, mergers, and internal reorganizations.

• Assist in implementation of accounting treatments, disclosures, and audit coordination related to restructuring.

• Support system migrations, process transitions, and finance transformation initiatives.

7. Team Leadership & Stakeholder Management

• Lead, mentor, and develop the finance operations team.

• Review team deliverables and ensure adherence to timelines and quality standards.

• Partner with cross-functional teams including Legal, Tax, FP&A, and Business teams.

Skills
• Strong knowledge of Ind AS / IFRS.

• Expertise in month-end close, AP, GL, audits, and treasury

• Experience in multi-entity / group structures

• Strong analytical, review, and problem-solving skills

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, evolving environment

• Excellent communication and stakeholder management skills

Experience and Qualifications
• Chartered Accountant (CA) mandatory

• 4-6 years of post-qualification experience in finance and accounting

• Experience in Big-4, technology or fintech

• ERP experience (Oracle preferred)

About the Product
Zeta is building a new consumer banking product for the US market. The focus is learning fast which features drive adoption, engagement and retention — and building them well.
 
About the Role
You'll help grow the product through a steady cadence of experiments and feature launches. Each PM owns a business-outcome metric for one area of the product, and the roadmap that moves it. Example areas: onboarding and activation, engagement and retention, revenue, and trust and risk.
We need a hustler. The work will feel like a very early-stage startup: ambiguous problems, incomplete information, shifting priorities and no playbook. You'll bring structure to the chaos: find the answers, make the calls and get things shipped.
We expect PMs to use AI tools across the lifecycle — research, specs, prototyping, analysis — to keep iteration cycles short. PMs here go deep on how things are built, so hands-on software development experience is mandatory.


Responsibilities
1. Own a metric

• Own a business-outcome metric for your area, plus the guardrail metrics it must not trade away.

• Keep a ranked backlog of experiments and features, prioritised by expected impact (RICE, ICE or similar).

2. Run experiments

• Write each bet as a hypothesis with a primary metric, guardrails and a decision rule, all set before launch.

• Match the method to the traffic: A/B tests and holdouts at scale; fake doors, usability tests and cohort analysis at low volume.

• Size tests properly, report null and negative results as plainly as wins, and make the ship, iterate or kill call.

• Keep a running log of what was tested, what was learned and what changed.

3. Build features

• Take features from problem definition through spec, build, QA, launch and adoption.

• Write specs engineers can build from: flows, edge cases, failure states, event instrumentation and acceptance criteria.

• Work through technical design with engineering — APIs, data models, ledger and payment flows, third-party integrations — and make trade-off calls quickly.

4. Measure

• Define output metrics (acquisition, activation, revenue, engagement) and the input metrics that drive them (funnel conversion, feature usage).

• Own event instrumentation and data quality for your area.

• Do your own analysis in SQL, product analytics tools (such as Mixpanel, Amplitude or MoEngage) and BI tools (such as Metabase or Superset).

5. Research users

• Run continuous discovery with US customers through remote interviews, usability tests and surveys.

• Turn what you hear and what the data shows into clear problem statements that feed the backlog.

6. Shape the UX

• Partner with designers on simple flows that earn users' trust.

• Own product copy for your area.

7. Launch and support

• Ship behind feature flags and in stages, with monitoring and a rollback plan.

• Work with compliance, risk, banking partners, operations and support so every launch meets regulatory requirements and can be supported from day one.

Skills
• Statistics and experiment design: hypothesis testing, significance, power and sample sizing, and common traps such as peeking and novelty effects.

• Strong SQL, and fluency with product analytics and BI tools.

• Ability to work through messy data sets and turn them into decisions.

• Engineering fundamentals you still use: reading code, system design, APIs and data models.

• A keen eye for design, and strong UX writing.

• Clear written and verbal communication — specs and experiment readouts people can act on.

• Meticulous program management across parallel workstreams.

• Hands-on experience with user research.

Experience and Qualifications
• 6+ years of total experience, including: 3–4 years in product management, with features shipped and measured in production. At least 3 years of hands-on software development, writing and shipping production code as an engineer. This is mandatory.

• A track record of experiments that changed a product decision.

• Preferred: consumer fintech, payments or banking experience, ideally in the US.

• Preferred: B2C products with a growth or experimentation focus.

Equal Opportunity

description:
About the role: 
 
As a Portfolio Intelligence & Fraud Analytics Lead Analyst, you will play a critical role in helping Nium understand, monitor, and manage portfolio performance, fraud risk, payment abuse, and emerging customer behavior trends across its global payments ecosystem.
 
You will leverage data, analytics, and risk intelligence to identify opportunities, detect emerging risks, support fraud prevention initiatives, and provide actionable insights to business stakeholders. Working closely with Fraud, Risk, Compliance, Product, Operations, and Data teams, you will transform complex data into meaningful intelligence that supports business growth, effective risk management, and operational decision-making.
 
This role is ideal for a highly analytical professional who combines strong SQL and data analysis capabilities with an understanding of payments, fraud risk, portfolio monitoring, and customer behavior.


 Key Responsibilities: 
• Analyze customer, product, corridor, and market performance to identify emerging trends, risks, and growth opportunities.

• Develop and maintain portfolio monitoring dashboards and reporting frameworks and perform deep-dive analysis on customer segments, transaction behavior, payment flows, and portfolio concentration risks.

• Monitor key portfolio KPIs and KRIs, identifying significant changes and potential risk indicators.

• Conduct ad hoc analytical reviews to support business initiatives and strategic decision-making.

• Monitor fraud, chargeback, dispute, and payment abuse trends across products and geographies.

• Investigate fraud events to identify root causes, attack patterns, and control gaps.

• Support development and optimization of fraud rules, thresholds, and monitoring strategies.

• Assess fraud-control effectiveness and provide recommendations for improvement.

• Analyse customer friction metrics to balance fraud prevention objectives with customer experience.

• Support remediation activities for emerging fraud risks and elevated loss trends.

• Build and maintain dashboards using Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar analytics platforms.

• Develop and optimize SQL queries for fraud, portfolio, compliance, and operational reporting.

• Create recurring and ad hoc reports for Risk, Compliance, Product, and senior stakeholders.

• Develop data visualizations that communicate actionable insights effectively.

• Partner with Data Engineering teams to improve data quality, accessibility, and reporting capabilities.

• Monitor portfolio performance against internal risk thresholds and payment network requirements.

• Track fraud-to-sales ratios, chargeback ratios, dispute rates, approval rates, and transaction-risk indicators.

• Analyze emerging payment-risk trends and provide early warning indicators to stakeholders.

• Provide analytical support for fraud prevention, risk management, and portfolio optimization projects.

Requirements: 
• 4-7 years of experience in Fraud Analytics, Portfolio Analytics, Payments Risk, Financial Crime Analytics, Business Intelligence, or Data Analytics.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills.

• Experience working with large datasets and identifying actionable insights.

• Advanced SQL skills and experience performing complex data analysis.

• Proficiency in Python for data analysis and automation.

• Experience building dashboards and visualizations using Looker, Power BI, Tableau, or similar tools.

• Understanding of payment ecosystems, fraud typologies, chargebacks, and transaction-risk indicators.

• Strong communication and stakeholder-management skills.

• Ability to present analytical findings to both technical and non-technical audiences.

• Preferred Qualifications

• Experience within fintech, payments, banking, card issuing, or acquiring environments.

• Knowledge of Visa and Mastercard fraud monitoring programs.

• Familiarity with AML, transaction monitoring, or financial crime controls.

• Experience with machine learning models or predictive analytics.

• Exposure to cloud data platforms such as Snowflake, Redshift, Databricks, or BigQuery.

title: Sr Data Scientist
description:
Nium provides global infrastructure for real-time cross-border payments. We were founded on the mission to deliver the global payments infrastructure of tomorrow, today. Our platform enables banks, fintechs, and global businesses to move money instantly, everywhere.   
Co-headquartered in San Francisco and Singapore with offices in 14 markets worldwide, we are entering one of the most exciting chapters in our journey. In March 2026, we delivered the largest month in our 11-year history with record revenue, record volumes, and EBITDA profitability. Today, Nium moves nearly $60B in payments annually, almost entirely for enterprises, while continuing to strengthen an already healthy balance sheet.  
It is an incredible time to join us, and we are only just getting started.  
Our payout network spans 190+ countries and 100 currencies, with 100 + corridors in real time. We power seamless transfers to accounts, wallets, and cards, support local collections in 35 markets, and as a principal card issuer on Visa, Mastercard, Discover, and UATP, Nium issues over 50 million card tokens every year. Backed by regulatory licenses in 40+ markets, we make it simple for our partners to onboard, integrate, and scale globally. This scale and innovation have earned us recognition as one of CNBC’s World’s Top Fintech Companies 2025, winner of Best Cross-Border Payments Solution at the PayTech Awards, and inclusion in FXC Intelligence’s Top 100 Cross-Border Payments Companies list.  
In 2024, we raised US$50 million in Series E funding at a US$1.4 billion valuation to accelerate network expansion, product innovation, and talent growth. With the B2B payments market projected to hit US$175 trillion by 2030, Nium offers ambitious builders the chance to shape the future of global money movement with the scale of a leader and the energy of a high-growth company.

title: Senior Applied Scientist - Knowledge Graphs & AI
description:
About Outreach
 
Outreach, founded in 2014, is the only complete agentic AI platform for revenue teams. Outreach infuses agentic AI, conversation intelligence, and assistive AI to power hundreds of use cases across revenue motions. From new logo prospecting to expansions, deal acceleration, driving retention, and forecasting, Outreach AI automates workflows and frees sellers to focus on more strategic conversations and actions. Revenue leaders benefit from connected account visibility, performance insights, and higher forecasting accuracy across every GTM team. World leading enterprise organizations use Outreach to power their revenue teams, including Databricks, SAP, Siemens, and Verizon to name a few.  


About the Team: 
 
Data is at the core of Outreach's strategy. It drives us and our customers to the highest levels of success. We use it for everything from customer health scores and revenue dashboards to operational metrics of our AWS infrastructure, to helping increase product engagement and user productivity through natural language understanding, to predictive analytics and causal inference via experimentation. As our customer base continues to grow, we are looking towards new ways of leveraging our data to deeper understand our customers’ needs and deliver new products and features to help continuously improve their customer engagement workflows.
 
The mission of the Data Science team is to enable such continuous optimization by reconstructing customer engagement workflows from data, developing metrics to measure the success and efficiency of these workflows, and providing tools to support the optimization of these workflows.
 
As a member of the team, you will work closely with other data scientists, machine learning engineers, and application engineers to define and implement our strategy for delivering this mission.


Your Daily Adventures Will Include:
Key Responsibilities:

• Knowledge Graph Design & Construction: Design and implement entity resolution and ontology population within established graph schemas. Write and optimize queries for graph traversal and feature extraction. Own data quality for assigned domains.

• Information Extraction: Build pipelines that extract structured knowledge from unstructured conversational and document data (sales calls, emails, CRM notes), in cluding coreference resolution, relation extraction, and event detection. Run experiments to compare approaches and improve accuracy metrics.

• Contextual Reasoning & Recommendation: Implement graph traversal logic and feature queries that feed downstream scoring signals. Build and maintain features for deal risk, next-best-action, or coaching recommendation surfaces.

• Representation L earning: Train and evaluate link prediction and node classification models using established graph embedding methods. Implement evaluation pipelines and track model performance over time.

• Domain Modeling: Translate sales concepts, such as deal stages, buyer engagement patterns, rep behaviors, and account health, into graph nodes and relationships under the guidance of senior scientists. Contribute to ontology design and documentation.

• Cross-functional Collaboration: Work with software engineers to deploy models and pipelines into production. Write clean, tested code. Monitor system health and respond to incidents. Participate in code review and design discussions.

Our Vision of You:
Qualifications:

• PhD in a relevant field such as Computer Science, NLP, Machine Learning, or a related discipline with a focus on knowledge representation and reasoning, information extraction and relation ship extraction, graph neural networks, recommendation systems, or conversation AI and dialogue systems. MS + 2 years of relevant experiecne will also be considered.

• Solid engineering fundamentals. You can write production-quality code, not just prototype notebooks. You can write clean, tested Python code. Experience with graph databases or query languages (e.g., Neo4j, SPARQL, Cypher).

• Demonstrated ability to build and evaluate ML models. You've trained models, measured performance using appropriate metrics, and iterated on results.

• A track record of building things: whether that's research prototypes that went beyond the paper, open-source contributions, or side projects that required real systems thinking. You understand the gap between a research prototype and a reliable production system, such as monitoring, data drift, latency, and operational excellence.

• Strong Ownership: Take end-to-end responsibility for research and model development initiatives, from problem formul ation and data analysis through experimentation, production deployment, and ongoing performance monitoring, driving outcomes with minimal oversight.

• Good communication skills. You can explain technical concepts to engineers and product managers.

• Eager to learn. You are excited to develop deep expertise in knowledge graphs and applied NLP under the mentorship of senior scientists.

Nice to Have: 
• Hands-on experience applying knowledge graphs or graph-based learning methods to real-world data in a production setting.

• Strong fundamentals in at least two of: knowledge graph construction, information extraction, graph neural networks, or recommender systems.

• Experience working with large-scale unstructured text data (conversational transcripts, email, or similar)

• Experience with probabilistic graphical models, conversational AI, or sales/revenue domain data

• Pub lished research at top-tier venues

Why Join Us? 
• Greenfield Architecture: Shape the design of a core AI system from the ground up, with the latitude to make foundational technical decisions that define the platform.

• Depth That Matters: This role genuinely requires PhD-level thinking; you will tackle problems in entity resolution, temporal reasoning, and graph learning that demand it.

• Applied Impact: Work with real production feedback loops and millions of sales interactions, not just benchmarks; see your models change how thousands of teams sell.

• High Leverage, Low Bureaucracy: Join a small, senior team where your contributions are visible, your ideas ship fast, and you have direct access to leadership.

• Career Growth: Opportunity to lead initiatives and mentor engineers.

Why You’ll Love It Here
 
● Highly competitive salary
● 25 days annual vacation time + sick time and casual leave
● Group medical policy coverage available to employees and up to 5 eligible family members
● OPD benefit covered up to INR 10,000
● Life insurance and personal accident insurance at 3x annual CTC
● 26 weeks of maternity leave pay, and 15 days of paternity leave pay
● Opportunity to be part of company success via the RSU program
● Diversity and inclusion programs that promote employee resource groups like OWN+ (Outreach Women's Network), Adelante (Latinx community), OBX (Outreach Black Connection), Mosaic (AAPI community), Pride (LGBTQIA+), Gender+, Disability Community, and Veterans/Military 
● Employee referral bonuses to encourage the addition of great new people to the team
● Fun company and team outings because we play just as hard as we work
 
Outreach is an equal opportunity employer. All applicants will be considered for employment without attention to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, veteran or disability status.
 
Our success is reliant on building teams that include people from different backgrounds and experiences who can elevate assumptions and ideas with fresh perspectives. We're dedicated to hiring the whole human, not just a resume. To that end, we look for a diverse pool of applicants-including those from historically marginalized groups. We would like to invite you to apply even if you don't think you meet all of the requirements listed below. We don't want a few lines in a job description to get between us and the opportunity to meet you.

Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention

The Customer Success Manager - Growth and Retention is responsible for reducing churn, improving customer health, and protecting recurring revenue through early risk detection, cross‑functional mitigation, and scalable retention programs. The role partners closely with Renewals, Customer Success, Customer Engagement, Competitive Intelligence, and Pricing & Packaging to orchestrate coordinated customer‑save strategies.

This role also provides renewal objection handling expertise , enabling teams to navigate downsells, downgrades, competitive threats, pricing pushback, TCO/ROI concerns, and budget constraints. The ideal candidate excels at influencing cross‑functional teams, handling commercial risk, and translating customer insights into save actions.

Key Responsibilities

1. Churn Risk Identification & Health Intelligence

• Maintain a standardized customer risk scoring framework leveraging health signals, product usage, support patterns, sentiment, and competitive exposure.

• Identify early risk indicators (e.g., discount cliffs, adoption gaps, under-deployed licenses, sponsor turnover).

• Partner with Renewal Ops, Data team to automate risk workflows in Salesforce

• Collaborate with Competitive Intelligence to map competitive displacement trends and update counter strategies.

2. Cross‑Functional Risk Orchestration (Renewals, CS, CI, Pricing)

• Lead weekly renewal risk reviews/war rooms with Renewals, CSMs/CEMs, and Sales to align on mitigation actions.

Serve as the subject‑matter expert for Renewals by providing guidance, playbooks, and strategic support to overcome critical renewal objections.

• Partner with Competitive Intelligence to address competitive pricing challenges, coach teams on TCO and switching‑cost comparisons, and collaborate with Pricing on controlled incentive structures.

• Provide Renewals reps with ROI models, justification materials, payment‑flexibility options, pricing guardrails, and negotiation strategies to resolve budget and pricing objections while protecting retention revenue.

4. Preemptive Retention Programs

• Discount cliff mitigation

5. Insights, Reporting & Executive Readouts

Preferred Qualifications

• Time-to-mitigation for escalated risks

description:
About the Role

We are seeking an experienced Database Reliability Engineer to own the reliability, performance, and scalability of our end-to-end database infrastructure. You will manage both our low-latency transactional engines and our real-time analytical/lakehouse storage systems. You will bridge systems engineering, database internals, and automation to maintain rock-solid data integrity, low query latency, and high availability across the entire data lifecycle.

What you'll do

• Performance & Query Optimization: Diagnose and resolve latency regressions, lock/latch contention, index strategies, and memory/disk bottlenecks across both row-oriented and columnar engines.

• Disaster Recovery & Data Integrity: Ensure strict RTO/RPO adherence, automated backup validation, PITR (point-in-time recovery), and data consistency across transactional and analytical stores.

• Storage Optimization & Compaction: Manage compaction policies, partition strategies, file sizing, and storage tiering to minimize storage costs and read amplification.

• Transactional Reliability & Operations: Manage HA, automated failover, replication topology, and zero-downtime maintenance for production RDBMS clusters.

• Analytical Storage Infrastructure: Maintain, scale, and optimize real-time analytical engines (ClickHouse) and lakehouse formats/engines (Apache Iceberg, BigQuery).

• Infrastructure as Code & Observability: Build declarative automation for cluster provisioning, schema migrations, and metric alerting (Prometheus, PromQL, Grafana)

Experience you'll need

• Database Internals & RDBMS Fundamentals:

• Deep understanding of ACID guarantees, WAL, checkpointing, and recovery mechanics (e.g., ARIES-style recovery).

• Comprehensive grasp of concurrency control, transaction isolation levels, lock protocols (2PL, deadlocks), and MVCC architectures.

• Deep knowledge of storage structures: B+ Trees, LSM-Trees, and columnar storage layouts (e.g., Parquet, ORC, ClickHouse Wide/Compact formats).

• Operational Database Experience:

• 4+ years running production database infrastructure, with deep expertise in [PostgreSQL / MySQL].

• Experience optimizing and managing cost/quotas in Google Cloud BigQuery (partitioning, clustering, reservation slots).

• Experience with OLAP DB like: ClickHouse, BQ

• Systems & Kernel Engineering:

title: Director - Renewals and Quote Desk Strategy & Ops
description:
Director - Renewals and Quote Desk Strategy & Ops

Location: Bangalore

Rubrik is on a mission to secure and accelerate the world's AI transformation. Rubrik (NYSE: RBRK), the Security and AI Operations Company, leads at the intersection of data protection, cyber resilience, and enterprise AI acceleration. With Zero Trust Data Security™, Rubrik helps organizations achieve business resilience against cyberattacks, malicious insiders, and operational disruptions.

About the Team

Rubrik's Renewals and Quote Desk Strategy & Ops team sits at the intersection of commercial strategy, systems, and execution, translating go-to-market priorities into the operational infrastructure that drives predictable, scalable business outcomes.

The team spans renewal operations and quoting, and works closely with Customer Success, Sales, Finance, and Product so that every renewal and new business deal is handled with speed, accuracy, and strategic intent. We're a high-impact team in a period of active build, which means the work is visible, the problems are real, and there's a genuine opportunity to shape how this function grows.

As the Director of Renewals and Quote Desk Strategy & Ops team you will be the senior-most leader of our India team and a strategic right hand to the Senior Director of Global Renewals & Quoting Operations. You will take our India-based Renewal Operations, Data Assurance and Quote Desk teams to the next level of scale, rigor, and impact.. This role is ideal for someone with a consulting, strategy, or operations background who wants to own solutions in a fast-paced SaaS environment.

What You Will Do

Build the Foundations of the Renewals Business

• Design and implement the systems, policies, and processes that enable renewals to scale, with clear rules of engagement, strong governance, and a great experience for sales and customers.

• Develop quoting frameworks and standards for multi-year, co-term, and mid-term expansion scenarios that maximize ARR retention.

• Partner with IT, RevOps, and Finance to define requirements for system enhancements, integrations, and automation.

• Create playbooks, guidelines, and standard operating procedures that make excellence repeatable across regions.

Evolve and Lead Our Data Quality Function

• Define the next chapter for the team responsible for the accuracy and integrity of the data powering global renewals operations, supporting a large global base of account executives and renewal sales professionals.

• Raise the standard of the function through clear data definitions, quality metrics, audit rhythms, and governance controls across CRM and renewal systems.

• Shift the team from reactive clean-up to proactive, preventive, and increasingly automated data quality.

• Turn data insights into action for sales leadership, and partner with Business Intelligence so reporting meets business needs.

Lead the Quote Desk Center of Excellence

• Own the strategy, service standards, and quality bar of our India-based Quote Desk, which serves sales teams worldwide, and scale it into a recognized center of excellence.

• Drive adoption of the Quote Desk and build trusted relationships with the sales leaders who rely on it.

• Streamline end-to-end workflows from opportunity identification to quote to close, reducing cycle times and improving accuracy.

Influence and Partner Across the Business

• Partner with India renewals sales leadership and senior stakeholders across Sales and Finance globally, bringing structure, data, and a clear point of view.

• Navigate high-stakes conversations and competing priorities with poise, and align leaders around trade-offs and decisions.

• Present renewal performance, forecasts, and operational insights to senior leadership in partnership with the Senior Director.

Build and Inspire the Team

• Attract and hire exceptional talent, and set a higher bar for what great looks like across roles.

• Coach and develop high-potential people into future leaders, building clear career paths and strong succession.

• Raise the overall caliber, capability, and culture of the India team over time.

Desired Skills & Experience

Required

• 12+ years of experience in Management Consulting, Strategy & Operations, Sales/Renewal Operations, or Business Operations, ideally within a high-growth technology or SaaS business.

• 5+ years of people leadership, including hiring, developing, and retaining high-performing teams.

• Demonstrated experience building, scaling, or transforming an operations, data quality, or shared-services team that supports a large sales organization, including raising talent quality and operating standards.

• Experience setting up or scaling a center of excellence in India, including driving adoption and stakeholder buy-in.

• Proven ability to influence senior sales and finance leaders across geographies, including through difficult conversations and pushback.

• Thrives in ambiguity, with exceptional prioritization and problem-solving skills and a high degree of ownership and autonomy.

• Excellent communication skills (written, oral, and presentation), with the ability to simplify complexity for any audience.

• Strong analytical skills, with experience driving insight through tools such as Excel, Google Sheets, Tableau, Salesforce, or Clari.

• Strong project management skills, including defining and executing against timelines, dependencies, and risks.

• B.A./B.S. degree; MBA or equivalent advanced degree highly preferred.

Preferred

• Experience with CPQ tools (e.g., Salesforce CPQ) and/or forecasting platforms such as Clari.

• Familiarity with renewal quoting workflows, including multi-year and co-term deal structures.

• Understanding of SaaS renewal metrics: ARR, NRR, GRR, churn rate, renewal rate, and pipeline coverage.

• Exposure to subscription lifecycle management, contract data, and revenue recognition concepts.

• Knowledge of SQL or Python for data extraction and ad hoc analysis.

Why this role: If you're ready to take real ownership of execution, with a seat at the table, a team to build, and a business to shape, this is that opportunity.

GSI Service Delivery Program Manager

Location: Bangalore, India

Job summary:

We are seeking a highly skilled and customer-focused Services Program Manager to develop a post-sales enablement and service-delivery quality framework for Rubrik’s Global System Integrator (GSI) partners. Success in this role guarantees consistent and successful service delivery from Rubrik’s largest and most complex GSI partners to ensure customer success, satisfaction, and retention worldwide. Pro-active and assertive development of the partner services relationships is a critical success factor for this role. It is both strategic and tactical and requires clear operational oversight, strong partner advocacy, and an ability to incent and reward top performance from Rubrik SMEs at all levels within the partners’ organizations. The ideal candidate understands how to work effectively with the Partner’s organization in collaboration with Rubrik’s Sales and Service Delivery teams to make Rubrik the preferred vendor for easy enablement and adoption of Rubrik best practices to deliver high value and margin-rich services to their largest and most complex customers.

The GSI Services Program Manager is a critical contributor in the Partner Services Operations team within Rubrik’s Global Customer Success organization. Partner Services Operations enables partners to deliver post-sales support and services to their customers using reliable and innovative systems, processes and programs that ensure a high level of Customer Satisfaction with minimal dependence on Rubrik. The ideal candidate will have strong technical acumen, excellent analytical and problem-solving skills, and a passion for collaborating with and advocating for partners for the benefit of our mutual customers.

Key Responsibilities:

• Program Leadership & Management: Lead and coordinate a scalable high-growth engine of post-sales support and professional services GSI engineers. Motivate this strategic workforce to achieve high Rubrik standards in product knowledge and service quality.

• Partner Collaboration: Build and maintain strong relationships with GSI partners and their Rubrik account teams, acting as the primary point of contact for post-sales service issues, escalations, and proactive management of a seamless hand-off from sales to services. Must be able to navigate and present to all management levels within the partner and Rubrik organization.

• Customer Satisfaction: Maintain strong customer focus to ensure all managed partners are delivering world-class customer services, in collaboration with Rubrik, by measuring and monitoring customer satisfaction.

• Training & Enablement: Facilitate and track role-based training and certification to GSIs that ensures they are well-equipped to deliver services aligned with Rubrik’s company standards, in partnership with Rubrik University, Rubrik Sales, and Global Customer Success.

• Process & Quality Improvement: Implement and refine processes for support and professional services delivery, promoting best practices, scalability, and eliminating friction and inefficiencies.

• Metrics & Reporting: Develop and maintain program KPIs, track performance metrics, and prepare regular reports for executive leadership and stakeholders. Facilitate Services QBRs to ensure continuous improvement on both sides of the partnership. Analyze program quality metrics to correctly assess and incent high partner performance, while requiring non-performers to improve or exit the program.

• Partner Advocacy: Comprehensively understand the partners’ go-to-market strategy, global support structure, and service delivery plan; document and present partner’s approach to internal key stakeholders as an advocate for what the partners need from Rubrik to be successful.

• Support Oversight : Provide oversight on partner’s open support cases and product gaps, to ensure timely resolution and appropriate resourcing and visibility within Rubrik. Facilitate resolution for any customer complaints regarding partner-delivered services.

ABOUT YOU:

• Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science or related technical field; advanced degree preferred.

• 10+ years of experience in program management, operations, technical support, or professional services, in a customer-facing role at an enterprise technology solution provider.

• Strong technical background and aptitude in Networking, Storage, Backup and Recovery, Cloud solutions (AWS, Azure, GCP etc.), and Hypervisors (VMware, Hyper-V, etc.). Cyber Security experience is desired.

• Demonstrated experience working with GSIs or large multi-regional channel partners. Quickly understands the business issues, data challenges, and both the commercial and services aspects of strategic partnerships within global service delivery teams.

• Strong leadership and stakeholder management skills with excellent communication and presentation ability, specifically to summarize complex product issues into clear executive summaries.

• Strong project management background, with demonstrated success coordinating multiple programs, workstreams, and people toward common, measurable objectives.

• Highly detail-oriented with strong analytical skills, including hands-on experience analyzing customer data to facilitate data-driven decisions and to develop executive presentations. Experience with Salesforce, Atlassian, and Tableau reporting and data preferred.

• Motivated, proactive self-starter with a customer-centric mindset, focused on delivering measurable outcomes from cross-functional teams, including those outside direct influence.

• Able to work independently in a fast-paced growth environment.

• Able to travel to other locations and customer sites on occasion as required.

• Able to adjust work hours to overlap with USA and EMEA business hours as required.

title: IT System Administrator I
description:
About The Team:

Come join our growing team to deliver amazing technology support experiences that fuel the vision of Dynamic Work for our employees. As a System Administrator, you will focus on delivering world-class technology support for both our employees and our workspaces, driven by the importance of the overall technology experience.

This role centers on swift resolution of employee IT issues and driving proactive improvements, all while maintaining a strong commitment to a customer-first approach. Operating with an automation-first mindset , we tackle complex problems, rely on data-driven decision-making, and prioritize the overall employee experience in everything we do.

As a member of our globally distributed remote and onsite IT support team, you will be the primary link for our internal customers. Your core responsibility is to provide essential Service Desk support to employees, which includes troubleshooting via Slack, Zoom, or Email, as well as managing and escalating high-priority incidents and concerns. Furthermore, you will contribute to employee productivity by sharing knowledge, mentoring peers, and guiding users in the effective use of technology.

You will have a security-first mindset and let policies guide how you work with our customers. You will be a strong advocate for our employees, learning and understanding their technology challenges and championing change with modern AI and automation solutions that make it easier to get our best work done.

The successful System Administrator is expected to possess a strong grasp and proven capability in resolving issues across various technologies. This includes proficiency with hardware (Apple/Windows), mobile devices, networks, and operating systems, as well as common internet and SaaS applications (browsers, Slack, Google Workspace, Office, Okta) and AI agent workflows. The ideal candidate will also have great attention to detail and will be comfortable working independently in a fast-paced environment.

Our goal is to make sure that our customers have an amazing technology experience and that they have everything they need to be successful.

What you’ll do:

• Deliver an exceptional customer support experience to all Rubrik employees and contractors. This position necessitates a 24/7 commitment, requiring flexibility to work across various shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays.

• Strive to achieve first-contact resolution for all employee support interactions whenever feasible. Diligently and proactively manage competing priorities within a high-velocity environment.

• Connect with employees via Slack and Zoom to provide real-time troubleshooting support, along with providing a superior transfer of support experience as needed.

• Manage end-to-end ticket lifecycles across Incident, Change, and Problem Management using JIRA.

• Drive ticket hygiene across the queue, build operational dashboards, and actively track and chase team KPIs and SLAs.

• Mentor junior team members on complex ticket resolutions, troubleshooting methodologies, and IT best practices.

• Apply an automation-first approach to identify process gaps, using critical thinking to streamline workflows and build custom AI agents (using tools like Claude Cowork/Code) for continuous process improvement.

• Support key Employee Lifecycle processes (onboarding and offboarding) and manage provisioning and deprovisioning of applications via Okta and Okta Workflows.

• Strong demonstrated written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to communicate policies and technical processes with customers of all levels.

• Actively contribute to team knowledge by documenting newly found solutions for common issues and proactively sharing information with the team.

• Handle escalations from Level 1 Service Desk agents.

• Support complex problem-solving related to Slack, Google Workspace, MS O365, MDM tools (Jamf & Intune), and JIRA reporting.

• Perform regular audits on assets, onboarding, and offboarding data for accuracy and hygiene.

• Track and manage shift handovers.

Preferred qualifications:

• 5+ years supporting internal or external customers in a Global IT Service Desk environment.

• 5+ years experience supporting Mac and Windows devices.

• 5+ years managing user and role-based access in a predominantly SaaS-based environment.

• Hands-on experience administering Okta, building Okta Workflows, and managing macOS environments via Jamf.

• Hands-on experience with Claude (Cowork/Code) with proven ability to build AI agents for IT process automation and improvement.

• Strong ITIL foundation with proven experience handling Incident, Change, and Problem Management, alongside SLA/KPI tracking and dashboard creation.

• An automation-first outlook paired with strong critical thinking skills to identify operational gaps and eliminate manual tasks.

• Familiarity with or demonstrated experience in supporting video conferencing systems is desired.

• Proficiency in troubleshooting Windows and Mac platforms, leveraging expertise in Jamf and/or Intune.

• Proficiency in scripting languages such as Bash or Python for automation tasks related to Jamf is highly desirable (not mandatory, but good to have).
