title: Legal Counsel
description:
Legal Counsel, Channels

Bangalore, India preferred (Hybrid in office 2 days a week) | Open to fully remote within India for the right candidate

About Our Team

The Rubrik Commercial Legal Team manages Rubrik's global commercial contracts and revenue-related legal matters. Within Commercial Legal, the Channels & Alliances legal team supports Rubrik's partner ecosystem: the distributors, resellers, managed service providers, global and regional system integrators, and alliance partners through which Rubrik sells its data security and cyber resilience products worldwide.

Rubrik goes to market primarily through a two-tier channel: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, the Distributor sells to a Reseller, and the Reseller sells to the end Customer. This role is the day-to-day legal partner for that business unit. You will be the first point of contact for the Channels organization on reseller and distributor agreements, amendments and partner program requests, keeping deals moving and partners compliant. You will join a small, collaborative team and work alongside a Channels Legal Counsel peer, reporting to the Director of Legal who leads Channels & Alliances, Marketplaces and Inbound Licensing.

This is a hands-on role for an attorney who already works in the channel world, enjoys negotiating with partners and wants to be a trusted advisor to a fast-moving sales organization.

Where You Can Make an Impact

• Own day-to-day channel contracting: Draft, review and negotiate reseller agreements, distributor agreements, amendments, adoption agreements for partner affiliates, resale enablement amendments and other documents partners need to resell Rubrik's SaaS and subscription products.

• Live in the two-tier channel model: Apply a deep working knowledge of Rubrik's go-to-market: Rubrik sells to a Distributor, who sells to a Reseller, who sells to the end Customer. Understand how order flow, pricing and discounts, deal registration, flow-down terms and end-user agreements work across each tier, and spot when a request breaks the model.

• Be the front door for the Channels organization: Manage the channel contract-request intake queue. Triage, prioritize and route incoming requests, resolve routine matters yourself and escalate exceptions with a clear recommendation.

• Support the Partner Program: Advise Partner Programs and Partner Operations on partner program requests, program terms and conditions, tier and status changes, program exceptions, incentive and referral arrangements, and partner onboarding and offboarding.

• Advise channel leaders and account managers: Act as a trusted advisor to Channel Account Managers, Distribution leaders, Alliances and the Channels Global Partner Organization. Answer their questions with practical, business-ready guidance and help them close deals on standard terms.

• Negotiate directly with partners: Lead negotiations and calls with partner legal, procurement and business teams. Hold Rubrik's standard positions, use approved fallbacks and know when to escalate.

• Build and maintain templates and playbooks: Create and update channel agreement templates, amendment forms, negotiation playbooks, fallback positions, FAQs and training so the ecosystem stays on standard terms and the business can self-serve.

• Drive deals to signature: Coordinate internal approvals, signature requests and e-signature execution, and work with Partner Operations and Deal Desk so executed agreements are recorded correctly in Salesforce and partners can transact.

• Apply a compliance and competition lens: Identify and escalate antitrust and competition law issues common to distribution (resale price maintenance, dual distribution, territorial and customer restrictions, exclusivity), as well as anti-corruption, sanctions and export, and public-sector procurement issues.

• Collaborate cross-functionally: Partner with Commercial Legal, Privacy, Security, Revenue, Tax, Deal Desk and Partner Operations to deliver consistent answers and keep channel terms aligned with Rubrik's customer-facing terms.

• Support a global channel: Work IST business hours while supporting partners and stakeholders worldwide, with a primary focus on APAC and EMEA and meaningful AMER coverage. Flex your hours during quarter-end and other peak periods to support AMER deals.

• Improve how we work: Spot repeat questions and bottlenecks, propose process and template fixes, and use technology (including AI tools) to speed up routine work.

Ideal Background

• Licensed attorney in India (LL.B. and enrolled with a State Bar Council) with 3 to 6 years of post-qualification experience, including meaningful in-house experience at a technology or SaaS company.

• Currently working in a channel, partner or distribution contracting role. You negotiate reseller and distributor agreements today and understand two-tier distribution and how SaaS is resold through partners.

• Comfortable negotiating directly with partner legal and procurement teams and advising business stakeholders without a safety net.

• Working knowledge of partner programs, deal registration, subscription and SaaS commercial models, and how channel terms interact with end-customer terms.

• Awareness of competition and compliance issues in distribution relationships and of anti-bribery and anti-corruption rules that apply to selling through partners.

• Excellent English drafting and communication skills. You write clearly, explain risk in business terms and give a recommendation, not a menu.

• Organized and reliable in a high-volume, deadline-driven environment. You prioritize well, track your queue and close the loop.

• Independent, proactive and business-oriented, with sound judgment about what to decide and what to escalate.

• Experience with Salesforce, DocuSign or similar e-signature tools, and contract lifecycle management systems is a plus.

• Willingness to flex working hours periodically to support AMER-based deals and quarter-end activity.

Working Model

Our preferred candidate is based in Bangalore and works from the Rubrik office two days a week. We will consider remote candidates elsewhere in India for the right fit. You will work standard IST business hours and support a global partner base, with a primary emphasis on APAC and EMEA and regular AMER coverage. Periodic late-evening availability for AMER deals and quarter-end is expected, but not an everyday requirement.

description:
Job Location : Bangalore

Shift Timing : 5:30 PM to 2:30 AM (IST)

Rubrik is looking for an experienced and results-oriented People Manager to run our Renewals Business in the North American region. You will play a key role in the growth and success of Rubrik, our customers and Renewals team members. Your team will be working directly with our Channel partners, customers and will help develop an outstanding renewal process that delights customers and delivers strong business results.

You will provide the coaching and mentorship that will enable our renewals team to positively impact customers, deliver strong business results, develop skills, and grow their careers over time. In addition to recruiting, retaining, and developing talent, you will also be responsible for crafting and executing the Rubrik renewal motion which includes management of team activities, Pipeline Management & hygeine, identifying risk and forecasting, design and execution of renewals strategy in the Americas region and working with stakeholders in Sales, Customer Success and Operations.

Success in this role requires exceptional communication and Interpersonal skills, operational excellence, deal formulation and negotiation experience, a strong understanding of Rubrik products and policy and a proven ability to inspire and lead your team. We are looking for someone who thrives in a fast paced and ever changing environment and who is motivated by the opportunity to have a big impact on your team, customers and Rubrik’s business.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Bangalore/interested to relocate for our hybrid working model.

What you will be doing:

• Hire, onboard and develop a team of engaged and high performing renewals professionals through thoughtful enablement, performance coaching and career development planning

• Execute a 180 day renewal process for your team in collaboration with internal stakeholders that provides an excellent customer experience while also maximizing contract value to achieve or exceed renewal targets

• Implement renewal forecasting cadence within your team and regularly deliver an accurate renewal forecast summary to Renewals leadership

• Effectively lead team to exceed quarterly and annual bookings plan while also exceeding forecasted GRR & NRR and manage budgeted Churn forecast.

• Ensure the team has the necessary ongoing enablement in relevant areas including: product, pricing, opportunity management, data quality/accuracy, quoting and forecasting

• Support your direct reports by joining customer meetings, internal account team meetings, and escalating issues as necessary internally

• Take a lead role in collaborating with internal teams (Deal Strategy, Finance, Customer Success, Sales, etc...) to develop playbooks for common renewal scenarios

• Develop trusted relationships with Sales and CS leadership through regular stakeholder engagement and proactive collaboration

We’re looking for someone with:

• Passion for and experience in hiring, developing and managing a team of individual contributors; Your team and their success are your top priority.

• A proven track record and experience with fast-growing teams, using data to drive initiatives and guide your decision-making processes.

• Proven ability to capture and communicate an accurate forecast.

• You know how to deal with ambiguity and be able to navigate through it with perseverance, a positive mentality and a point of view; As a new function, we will look to you to help us establish and evolve processes.

• A strong desire to embrace partnership and collaboration; You’ll be working with multiple teams on a regular basis (Sales, Marketing, Support, Product, etc.) and helping to establish the Renewals Team role and “brand” across the AMER region.

• You have experience in working and collaborating with internal and external partners with diverse cultural and professional backgrounds.

• Outstanding verbal and written communication skills with the ability to present to a diverse audience both internally and externally; Ability to manage customer escalations through to a satisfactory resolution for both the customer and Rubrik.

• A Bachelor's degree combined with 5+ years of people management experience, preferably in a customer success or account management capacity

• Adept in working with Salesforce, Clari, CPQ, Excel and should possess good analytical skills with the ability to interpret data and make decisions based on insights.

title: Principal Engineer
description:
About the role

Rubrik is the Security and AI Operations Company. As we move from protecting data to securing and accelerating our customers' AI transformation, we are rethinking how the whole company works and fully embracing AI in everything we do.

The Principal Engineer is a strategic, hands-on role at the same level as an Engineering Director. You will define and execute the technical strategy for Rubrik's AI software factory, the platform on which agents and people take an idea all the way to customer value.

To get there, we are moving from an AI-assisted Software Development Lifecycle to an AI Product Development Lifecycle (AI-PDLC), which covers every stage, not just code. Agents do the synthesis, drafting and execution, while people provide judgment and give accountable approval at every key decision. The platform is at an early stage, and you will lead the build of the shared foundation that every function at Rubrik, from Product, Design and Engineering to Sales and Marketing, will use it for its AI workflows.

Your primary focus is problem seeking: finding where AI can make the biggest difference, from building products to serving customers, and making the case to fund it.

What you'll do

Platform strategy

• Define the technical vision for the AI-PDLC platform: orchestration, approval gates, model and tool gateways, agent runtimes, context, evals and cost visibility.

• Make the platform usable by every function through clear contracts, paved paths and self-serve tooling.

• Decide what Rubrik should own, build on and borrow.

• Turn business opportunities and productivity gaps across Product, Design, Engineering, Support and go-to-market teams into multi-quarter roadmaps.

Technical leadership and standards

• Set the standards for trustworthy agentic workflows: a person approves every agent output, and no workflow skips its quality or security checkpoints.

• Champion eval-driven development, managed agent identities with native access control, and outcome metrics such as landed rate, revert rate and cost per landed change.

• Own cross-cutting initiatives (up to about 18 engineers' effort) end to end. Stay hands-on: prototype, write code and review critical changes.

Influence and growth

• Build consensus across Engineering, Product, Design, Support, Security and business functions.

• Lead the organizational change that AI-native work requires, where ownership means accountability rather than gatekeeping.

• Coach Engineers toward Principal-level impact, raise the hiring bar, and represent Rubrik externally.

About you

• Typically 15+ years in software engineering, with a significant focus on developer or internal platforms.

• Proven at Director-level scope, driving technical strategy across multiple complex systems and organizations.

• Hands-on experience running LLMs and agents in production, including orchestration, tool integration (for example, MCP), context engineering, evals and guardrails.

• Deep expertise in a general-purpose language (for example, Go, Java, C/C++, Scala or Python) and strong first-principles thinking.

• Experience scaling secure, highly available platforms, including identity, access control and cost governance.

• Data-driven: defines outcome metrics and uses them to steer investment and prove impact.

• A consensus builder and coach who communicates clearly with executives, non-technical stakeholders and global teams.

description:
Product Management Intern – Identity Resilience

About the Team & Role

The Product Management team at Rubrik drives forward our vision of delivering a market-leading platform that addresses the world’s most critical cyber resilience and data security challenges.

The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik’s fastest-growing business unit, operating with a high-velocity "0-to-1" charter. Today, modern cyberattacks almost exclusively weaponize identity systems. When identity fails, the entire enterprise halts. Our mission is to ensure enterprise identity environments are secure, observable, compliant, and instantly recoverable.

We are looking for a strategically sharp, technical, and execution-minded Product Management Intern for a high-impact 2-month internship based in Bengaluru. As an intern, you will own a core strategic initiative – bridging enterprise customer pain points, competitive differentiation, and technical architecture to deliver a concrete product roadmap for next-generation identity protection.

What You’ll Do (2-Month Charter)

• Market Landscape & Threat Vector Analysis: Benchmark the enterprise identity attack surface across hybrid environments. Map emerging threat vectors to potential resilience and recovery capabilities.

• Customer Discovery & Pain Point Synthesis: Work alongside PM and GTM mentors to analyze customer requirements, telemetry data, and enterprise security frameworks to pinpoint the highest-friction operational gaps for Security and IAM teams.

• Feature Strategy & PRD Ownership: Define the scope, user workflows, and success metrics for a targeted identity protection/recovery feature. Author a high-quality Product Requirement Document (PRD) balancing enterprise-grade depth with Rubrik’s trademark simplicity.

• Cross-Functional Architecture Alignment: Collaborate closely with Engineering, UX Design, and Architecture leads to evaluate technical trade-offs, define API/data pipeline requirements, and ensure feasibility.

• Executive Strategy Pitch: Conclude your internship with an Executive Product Readout to Senior Leadership, defending your business case, technical trade-offs, and proposed roadmap.

What You’ll Need

• Education: Currently enrolled in a premier MBA/management program (IIM, ISB, or equivalent global top-tier business school) graduating in 2027/28

• Technical Foundation: Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Technology, or an equivalent engineering discipline. Prior product management or technical experience in enterprise systems, cloud platforms, or cybersecurity is a strong plus.

• Systems & Security Thinking: An understanding of enterprise software fundamentals; familiarity with core identity concepts is an advantage.

• Problem Solving: Comfort with ambiguity, structured thinking, and the ability to break complex, undefined problems into crisp, actionable requirements.

• Communication & Influence: Exceptional written and verbal communication skills with the ability to articulate technical trade-offs to senior product and engineering leaders.

• Location: Based in or willing to relocate to Bengaluru for the 2-month internship duration (Hybrid model).

What You’ll Gain

• True 0-to-1 Problem Ownership: Direct ownership of a real-world, high-priority product problem in enterprise cybersecurity – not a back-burner sandbox project.

• High-Stakes Leadership Visibility: Regular 1:1 mentorship from seasoned Product Managers and a final presentation to Product & Engineering leadership.

• Cybersecurity PM Expertise: Hands-on exposure to cutting-edge identity governance, threat modeling, and resilience frameworks inside an enterprise security market leader.

title: Senior AI Evals Engineer
description:
About the Role

The Senior AI Evals Test Engineer is a hands-on technical role responsible for defining, developing, and executing robust evaluation frameworks and test strategies for AI agents built using the Google Agent Development Kit (ADK) or similar sort of agentic frameworks . This role bridges AI development and reliable deployment — ensuring our agents are safe, ethical, effective, and meet high-quality performance standards. A significant focus of the role is on Responsible AI and Safety Evals, including adversarial testing, red-teaming, bias detection, and toxicity measurement . The engineer will design scalable evaluation pipelines , build synthetic test environments, and work closely with AI/ML Engineers, Researchers, and policy teams to ensure agents are production-ready and compliant with regulatory and ethical standards. The role is 70% Automation and 30% Manual Testing , and sits within the Applied AI: Test Engineering team as a key technical authority.

Key Responsibilities

• Design and build agent evaluation frameworks — create end-to-end infrastructure for evaluating LLM-based agents across correctness, latency, cost, safety, and task completion rate

• Build synthetic testing environments and simulation strategies to stress-test AI agents under diverse real-world conditions, with specific focus on agents built on Google ADK and related Google AI/ML services (e.g., Vertex AI, Gemini models)

• Build golden datasets and test harnesses — curate domain-specific evaluation sets for Rubrik's product verticals (data security, SaaS protection, cyber recovery, compliance)

• Establish eval-as-a-service — build and enhance centralized evaluation platform that any IT team members can self-serve to test their agents against standardized and custom benchmarks

• Automate regression and drift detection — implement CI/CD-integrated eval pipelines that catch regressions on every model or prompt change before production deployment

• Define eval taxonomies and rubrics — establish structured scoring criteria for agentic workflows (tool use accuracy, multi-step reasoning, hallucination rate, policy adherence, error recovery)

• Instrument production observability — build real-time monitoring for agent quality in production: success rates, user corrections, fallback triggers, escalation patterns

• Benchmark and select models — run structured model comparisons (cost, quality, latency trade-offs) to inform model selection decisions across agent use cases

• Analyze and interpret evaluation results , providing clear, actionable quality and safety reports to stakeholders and development teams, with specific focus on risk metrics, trend analysis, and mitigation recommendations

• Define comprehensive end-to-end QA strategies — functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT) — tailored for conversational and goal-oriented AI agents with tool-use, memory, and multi-turn reasoning capabilities

• Develop and maintain detailed test artifacts (test plans, test cases, test scenarios, automated test suites) covering agent features, tool invocation, memory persistence, and reasoning accuracy across evolving model versions

• Identify, document, prioritize, and track defects , performance regressions, and alignment failures using Jira, collaborating closely with Applied AI Engineers to analyze root causes and validate fixes

• Evaluate new technologies and patterns (e.g., new tools for Agent Evals), run proofs-of-concept, and influence the platform roadmap

• Partner with policy and legal teams to ensure agent evaluations systematically cover regulatory compliance, fairness objectives, and emerging AI governance requirements

• Provide technical leadership to engineers , including solutioning, design reviews, code reviews, pair programming, and mentoring of junior and contract engineers

• Collaborate cross-functionally — work closely with ML engineers, product teams, platform engineers, and security to embed eval-driven quality gates into the agent development lifecycle

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience

• 8+ years of overall software Test engineering experience , with 5+ years focused on test engineering, QA automation, or developer tooling, and demonstrated ability to build evaluation systems across multiple AI/ML domains, conversational agents, or Large Language Models (LLMs)

• 2+ years working with ML/AI systems, building , testing, or evaluating models in production environments, including hands-on experience with LLM-based applications, prompt engineering, RAG pipelines, or agentic workflows

• 2+ years as a senior/lead, owning evaluation strategy, quality frameworks, and technical decisions for complex AI agent systems in an enterprise product environment

• 1+ years in designing or operating evaluation frameworks specifically for generative AI / LLM agents, including benchmarking, red-teaming, and production quality monitoring in the AI ADLC model

Technical Skills

• Deep hands-on experience with LLM evaluation — familiarity with frameworks and libraries such as LangSmith, DeepEval,LLM as a Judge, Promptfoo, RAGAS, Hugging Face evaluation tooling, custom eval harnesses

• Strong understanding of agentic AI patterns — tool use, function calling, multi-step planning, ReAct/CoT reasoning chains, retrieval-augmented generation (RAG)

• Production experience with eval pipelines — building automated, CI-integrated evaluation infrastructure (not just notebooks)

• Proficiency in Python — strong scripting and tooling skills; experience with pytest, async patterns, and data processing at scale

• Familiarity with Google Cloud Platform (GCP) or any Cloud Service relevant to AI/ML (e.g., Vertex AI) and experience integrating testing into MLOps workflows

• Statistical literacy — ability to design experiments, interpret eval metrics with appropriate confidence, and avoid common pitfalls (overfitting to benchmarks, metric gaming)

• Enterprise product sensibility — understanding of how AI quality translates to customer trust in a B2B/enterprise context (security, compliance, reliability SLAs)

• Excellent communication — ability to present eval results and quality trade-offs to engineering leadership, articulate risks and safety findings to non-technical audiences, and drive alignment on ship/no-ship decisions

• Hands-on experience with CI/CD pipelines and Git-based workflows , including automated testing, static analysis, deployment automation, and environment configuration for our DevTestOps

Tech Stack:

• Languages: Python(Must), TypeScript, Java (Optional)

• Test Automation:Selenium, Playwright

• LLM Providers: Anthropic Claude, OpenAI, Azure OpenAI, open-source models

• Eval Tooling: DeepEvals(Must), LLM as a Judge (Must), Promptfoo/RAGAS/LangSmith/ Custom harnesses

• Agent Evals Frameworks/libraries: LangGraph, Claude Agent SDK, custom orchestrators

• Infrastructure: DevOps (Basic), Kubernetes, CI/CD (Jenkins/GitHub Actions), observability stacks (Datadog/Grafana)

Preferred Qualifications

• Deep Learning/NLP Knowledge : Fundamental understanding of how LLMs work, including concepts like RAG, prompting, and the technical challenges related to alignment

• Data Analysis: Experience with data analysis and visualization tools (e.g., Pandas, SQL) for analyzing evaluation and safety results

• Policy Background: Familiarity with AI ethics principles and industry standards for responsible AI development

• Garbage-in/Garbage-out (GIGO) Tools : Any tool or framework that specializes in testing the model's response to highly ambiguous, misleading, or malformed inputs to test for robustness and safety failures

• Experience testing complex APIs, especially for tool-integration and function-calling scenarios in agentic workflows

• Experience with prompt injection (Must) and data poisoning skills is a plus

• Certifications in AI/ML , cloud platforms (GCP, AWS), AWS Machine Learning Specialty, Google Professional ML Engineer, DeepLearning.AI specializations and software testing methodologies

Soft Skills

• Proven ability to lead without direct authority , influencing cross-functional teams and driving technical decisions through clarity and data rather than hierarchy.

• Experience working in agile environments , collaborating closely with product owners, scrum teams, and distributed stakeholders across time zones.

• Excellent communication and documentation skills , comfortable presenting solutions and trade-offs to engineers, managers, and senior business stakeholders.

• Strong architectural thinking and problem-solving skills , including the ability to decompose complex business processes into simple solutions

Nice to have

• Experience evaluating agents in cybersecurity, data protection, or infrastructure domains

• Familiarity with Rubrik's product portfolio or similar enterprise data management platforms

• Hands-on with human-in-the-loop eval workflows (annotation platforms, inter-rater reliability)

• Experience with model fine-tuning evaluation (pre/post quality comparison)

• Background in building internal developer platforms or tooling teams

• Contributions to open-source eval frameworks or published work on AI evaluation methodology

• Drive red-teaming and adversarial testing — design adversarial evaluation suites for jailbreak resistance, data leakage prevention, and boundary enforcement in enterprise-grade agents

title: Senior Applied AI Engineer
description:
About the Role

We are looking for a Senior Applied AI Engineer to join Rubrik's Applied AI team, building production-grade, full-stack applications and APIs for our internal Business teams while embedding AI-agentified capabilities into these internal platforms. This is a hands-on build role: you will own features end to end — from database schema through backend services and distributed systems to the user interface — and bring practical, hands-on experience building or integrating AI agents, tool-calling workflows, or LLM-powered features into production systems that our business stakeholders rely on.

The ideal candidate combines strong full-stack engineering fundamentals with a systems mindset for reliability and scale, and has spent meaningful hands-on time (1–2 years) building AI-agentified applications — not just experimenting with AI tools, but shipping agentic features in production. We are targeting 8+ years of overall software engineering experience; this is flexible for candidates who demonstrate strong depth across full-stack, distributed systems, and applied AI during technical evaluation.

Key Responsibilities

• Own features end to end — database schema, backend services, APIs, and frontend (React/Next.js) user interface — operating as an owner rather than a ticket-taker.

• Build full-stack web applications: responsive, production-grade frontends using React/Next.js, backed by well-designed REST APIs and backend services.

• Design and build APIs and services that are consumed by applications, internal tools, and AI agents/LLMs, including tool-calling interfaces..

• Build and productionize AI-agentified features — agentic workflows, LLM-powered automation, and AI-assisted tooling — grounded in 1–2 years of hands-on experience with these systems.

• Architect for distributed systems concerns: scalability, fault tolerance, data consistency, and service boundaries across backend and data layers.

• Apply reliability engineering practices — observability (logging, metrics, tracing), SLAs/SLOs, incident response, and post-incident reviews — to keep production systems healthy.

• Design and optimize relational database schemas, including joins, indexing, and query performance tuning.

• Build clean, well-tested, production-grade frontend and backend code that others can read, test, and extend.

• Clarify requirements upfront, surface blockers early, and communicate progress proactively without being asked.

• Collaborate openly with internal Business stakeholders, Product, QA, DevOps, and UX or designer teams; avoid working in silos.

Required Qualifications

Education & Experience

• Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent practical experience.

• 8+ years of hands-on software engineering experience across full-stack development (flexible based on demonstrated strength in technical evaluation).

• 1–2 years of hands-on experience building, integrating, or operating AI-agentified applications (agentic workflows, tool-calling, RAG, or LLM-powered features) in production..

title: Senior Engineering Manager - Dev Platform
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM

The Systems Engineering team in Rubrik's Developer Platform organization owns the reliability of Rubrik Cloud Data Management (CDM) and RSC-P products. Our customers trust Rubrik to recover their data on the worst day of their year. We make sure the software holds up under that pressure, at scale, over months of continuous operation, and in the face of failure.

We build the infrastructure and pipelines that let product teams validate stress, scale, longevity and resilience, and we own the call on whether a release is reliable enough to ship. We work with component teams, product management and release managers to build reliability early, rather than inspect for it at the end.

What we own

• Release reliability certification. We own the reliability decision behind every CDM and RSC-P release, based on evidence from the platforms and pipelines we build.

• Stress, scale and chaos platforms. We build the infrastructure and pipelines for these validations, and give product teams self-service tools so they can validate their own work without waiting on us.

• Extreme-scale simulation. We build simulators that reproduce very large customer environments cost-efficiently.

• Long-running, customer-like environments. We operate and evolve clusters that run for months and mirror real customer deployments, so we find longevity problems before customers do.

• AI-driven triage and reliability. We build triage agents that investigate bugs, incidents and alerts, and we apply AI across our own workflows to speed up detection, diagnosis and certification.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

As Senior Manager of Systems Engineering, you will own how Rubrik proves its products are reliable before customers depend on them.

• Own release reliability. Be accountable for the reliability call behind every CDM release, and make ship-or-hold decisions with release managers and component leaders.

• Drive the qualification roadmap. Set one roadmap for release workflows and fast build qualification, improving both quality and speed.

• Build self-service platforms. Lead the engineers building our stress, scale, chaos and longevity infrastructure, simulators and long-running environments, so component teams can validate their own work.

• Lead and grow a high-performing team. Build a culture of transparency, innovation and security-first thinking in a fast-paced environment. Hire, coach and retain engineers across geographies.

• Run the team with operational rigor. Set a clear operating rhythm (sprint planning, stand-ups, regular reviews), keep the bar high, give direct feedback and hold the team accountable for delivery.

• Run on metrics. Track certification cycle time, customer-found escapes, triage time and infrastructure cost, and act on them.

• Reimagine reliability in the AI era. Use and promote AI and emerging technologies in the team, in line with the Company and Engineering vision, including AI-driven triage and automation, and measure the results.

• Partner broadly. Align priorities with component leaders, product managers and program managers, and communicate with stakeholders at every level.

ABOUT YOU

You are a results-oriented leader who cares about enterprise software quality and about building strong teams.

• 12+ years in the software industry, with hands-on experience building and delivering enterprise-grade products as both an individual contributor and a manager.

• 3+ years leading teams of software or systems engineers, with a track record of delivering high-quality enterprise releases.

• Technical depth in distributed systems, test infrastructure, or release and reliability engineering.

• Experience hiring and building top-tier teams, including teams spread across geographies.

• Experience building engineering practices, processes and operational rigor.

• Track record of communicating clearly and influencing across engineering, product and executive leadership.

• Ability to execute in ambiguous, fast-paced environments.

• AI-forward leadership: proven use of AI to improve your own work and your team's, for example by building or adopting AI agents and tooling that measurably cut triage time, speed up infrastructure and pipeline delivery, or automate release workflows.

title: Senior Information Security Analyst - Customer Trust
description:
Senior Information Security Analyst - Customer Trust

Location:Bangalore (Hybrid, 3 days a week)

About the team:

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through critical initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our assets, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data governance and data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

About the role:

Rubrik is seeking a Senior Information Security Analyst to support and oversee activities within the Customer Trust function at our Bangalore, India office. As a member of the Customer Trust team, you will be a highly motivated professional responsible for executing key service areas and driving their continuous improvement and maturity. The successful candidate will build and maintain strong cross-functional relationships across the organization while demonstrating exceptional interpersonal skills and the ability to confidently lead customer-facing discussions and engagements. This role requires strong leadership, communication, collaboration, and decision-making skills, along with the ability to work effectively across multiple stakeholders and priorities.

What you’ll do:

We are looking for a highly motivated individual that wants to be a part of a front-line customer facing function of security within Rubrik that helps sales close revenue opportunities by sharing Rubrik’s security posture with customers. Key responsibilities include sharing Rubrik's security posture with customers by interacting with key security stakeholders in the customers organization, responding to customer RFPs, redlining security terms in customer contracts, facilitating customer audits and other customer requests that are related to Rubrik's enterprise or product security and compliance capabilities. In this role, you will:

• Respond to security and compliance portions of customer RFPs in an accurate and timely fashion (i.e., within agreed upon internal SLAs), leveraging AI generated responses and validating responses..

• Lead and collaborate with other Information Security, Product security and Engineering SMEs, as needed to respond to customers and drive security posture outcomes.

• Build narratives and perform security reviews of new products to ensure there are accurate responses for RFPs.

• Support security and compliance related customer audits, as requested.

• Be well-versed in Rubrik's products, particularly as they pertain to security and compliance features and secure SDLC practices.

• Work with Sales Operations, Field Operations, Sales, Sales Engineering, Marketing, and Engineering teams to intake requests and drive improvements to the customer trust process.

• Execute operational activities related to the maturity and measurement of the customer trust process to provide high quality services that enable sales at Rubrik.

• Drive the maturity of the customer facing collateral that disseminates security and compliance related announcements and thought leadership to new customers and prospects.

• Support the finalisation of security and compliance language in customer contracts.

• Be well versed with industry leading frameworks such as DORA, ISO 27001, SOC 2, PCI,DSS, HIPAA and HITRUST

Experience you'll need:

• 5+ years of related work experience in Customer Trust & Security Assurance in the tech industry, preferably in the cyber resilience space.

• Experience in the cyber security practice at a Big 4 audit firm (Deloitte, PwC, EY, or KPMG) is highly preferred.

• Have driven several security and/or operational Information security processes within a company.

• Experience reviewing and negotiating contracts as it relates to security and compliance obligations

• Ability to meet demanding timelines and SLAs, manage changing priorities and execute tasks with minimal supervision.

• Knowledge of common security risks, vulnerabilities, and threats and can translate these issues through triage / risk treatment conversations.

• Understanding of information security frameworks and compliance requirements, such as DORA, ISO 27001/2 (including ISO 27017 & 18), FedRAMP, SOC 2 Trust Services Criteria, CIS Top 20, PCI DSS, HIPAA, and NIST CSF / 800-53.

• Detail-oriented and able to understand the bigger picture by using your technical expertise and problem solving abilities to prioritize and manage blocking issues.

• Able to discuss issues at technical and business levels with audiences of various backgrounds.

• Bachelor’s degree in Security, Computer Science, Management Information Systems or related field preferred.

The Identity Resilience team is Rubrik's fastest-growing business line, laser-focused on solving the most critical identity security challenges facing enterprises today. We operate as an entrepreneurial, "0-to-1" portfolio within Rubrik.

As a product organization, we empower PMs to be central leaders who own the entire lifecycle - from board-level strategic vision to deep technical execution. You will define how enterprises secure, audit, and rapidly recover their crown-jewel identity infrastructure (e.g., Active Directory, Entra ID, Okta, Ping, etc).

This is a high-visibility, high-leverage role. You will partner deeply with Engineering, Design, and Go-To-Market (GTM) leadership to transform a rapidly evolving domain into a market-leading, multi-million dollar business line.

Key Responsibilities

• Product Strategy & Vision: Own and evolve the multi-year product roadmap for enterprise identity protection, aligning technical capability with Rubrik's broader data security platform.

• 0-to-1 Execution: Lead the definition, design, and launch of next-generation features for workforce and customer identity platforms, driving products from early discovery to mainstream market adoption.

• Technical Leadership: Partner with Principal Engineers and Architects to navigate complex technical trade-offs in scale, security, and cloud/on-prem hybrid topologies.

• Customer & Market Discovery: Act as a trusted advisor to enterprise CISOs and IT executives, distilling complex customer pain points, compliance frameworks, and active threat vectors into crisp product requirements.

• High Impact, High Visibility: Shape the anchor growth engine of a premier data security company.

title: Senior Software Engineer - CPD
description:
Location : Bangalore/Pune
About Team & About Role:

As a Senior Software Engineer (SSE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.

• Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.

• Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.

• Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.

• Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.

• Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.

• Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.

• Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).

• Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.

• Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

Requirements

Must-have

• Minimum experience of at least 8 Years

• Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang .

• Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.

• Working knowledge of Active Directory .

• Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS .

• Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.

• Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.

• Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.

• Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

• Directory internals (schema, bind operations).

• HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).

• Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).

• Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.

• Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).

title: Senior Software Engineer - Enterprise AI
description:
About Rubrik and the team

The Enterprise AI team is Rubrik’s internal AI enablement engine. We evaluate where AI can make a real difference, build the platforms and patterns that make adoption easy, and help engineering teams across the organization work smarter and faster. We operate at the intersection of applied AI, distributed systems, and enterprise operations, with the primary mission of making Rubrik more efficient through AI-powered workflows.

This is a high-impact, high-autonomy team where you will work closely with engineering, product, and operations teams across Rubrik to bring AI capabilities to life.

About the Role

We are hiring a Senior Software Developer to design, build, and operate the platform and backend systems that power Rubrik at scale. You will own core infrastructure, spanning Kubernetes, cloud-native services, APIs, and developer tooling. Working closely with product, AI, and security teams, this is a hands-on, high-ownership role where you write production code, design systems, lead code reviews, and raise the bar for the entire engineering organization.

What you'LL do

• Own end-to-end delivery of major platform initiatives, from design through deployment and post-launch success.

• Own Kubernetes at depth — clusters, networking, operators, container lifecycle, and multi-tenant orchestration.

• Design, develop, and optimize distributed services and cloud-native infrastructure on AWS and/or GCP for scale, reliability, and performance.

• Drive engineering excellence through code quality standards, design reviews, automation, and CI/CD best practices.

• Collaborate across teams — Product, AI, and Security — to align architecture with business objectives.

• Be a mentor and multiplier, guiding engineers through architecture decisions, trade-offs, and delivery.

• Partner with leadership to align engineering strategy with product objectives and technical roadmap.

What we're looking for

• 7+ years of professional software engineering experience in backend and infrastructure development, with a proven record of delivering and running production systems.

• Strong hands-on coding in C++, Go, or Java, plus working fluency in Python, with production code beyond scripts and configs.

• Solid grounding in data structures, algorithms, concurrency, and memory management.

• Someone who has built applied AI tooling (e.g., Claude, LiteLLM, AI gateways, agent frameworks) and the ability to build backend services that integrate with them.

• Experience designing distributed systems (consistency, replication, fault tolerance, scalability), with strong system design and architectural judgment.

• Familiarity with storage and database systems (SQL, NoSQL, key-value, file/object storage).

• Experience building and operating container clusters (Docker, Kubernetes), not just deploying to them.

• Cloud-native fluency on AWS or GCP (compute, storage, IAM, networking, managed services).

• Hands-on infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD pipelines.

• Strong debugging, profiling, and performance-tuning skills.

• Clear written and verbal communication, including design docs, and effective partnership across product, security, and AI teams.

Nice to Have

• Observability stacks — Prometheus, Grafana, Datadog, OpenTelemetry.

• Multi-cloud or hybrid infrastructure experience (AWS, GCP, on-prem).

• Familiarity with API gateways, AI gateways, and policy/authorization frameworks (ABAC,
OPA).

• Service mesh or platform-as-a-service design experience.

• Track record of improving engineering productivity at scale.

summary: Design, build, and harden identity and access flows using Golang, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, and SAML 2.0 for enterprise data backup platforms.

enrichment.summary: Design, build, and harden identity and access flows using Golang, OIDC/OAuth 2.0, and SAML 2.0 for enterprise data backup platforms.

description:
Location : Pune
About Team & About Role:

As a Software Engineer (SE) in the Continuous Product Delivery (CPD) team, you will play a key role in providing long term stability and last mile delight to our customers. You will work closely with the core engineering team, product, and support org.

You will be working across Rubrik releases on our on-premise data backup & management offering, with a focus on the identity and access layer that secures it. You are expected to develop a strong understanding of our product and engineering architecture — particularly how authentication and authorization flow through the system, including our integrations with enterprise identity providers, directory services, and certificate-based trust chains.

We are seeking a highly skilled Golang developer with deep, practical experience in identity protocols (OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0) and applied cryptography/PKI. As a Software Engineer on this team, you will be responsible for designing, building, and hardening the systems that authenticate users, machines, and services across our platform — reasoning carefully about threat models, not just shipping features. You should have strong programming and troubleshooting skills, excellent design skills, and a solid understanding of distributed systems, OS fundamentals, and networking. The successful candidate will preferably have working knowledge of Active Directory and be able to work independently and as part of a team.

Responsibilities

• Design, build, and harden identity and access flows — OIDC/OAuth 2.0, SAML 2.0, Active Directory integrations — that sit in front of mission-critical systems.

• Own token and assertion lifecycle correctness: issuance, validation, expiry, rotation, and failure-mode handling for JWT/JWKS and SAML assertions.

• Apply strong applied-cryptography and PKI practices (X.509 certs, key rotation, TLS) to keep the auth path secure by default, not as an afterthought.

• Build and maintain reverse-proxy/HTTP-layer components (TLS termination, header handling) that front customer authentication traffic.

• Debug and resolve customer-facing identity/access issues, working with support to triage escalations quickly.

• Contribute to build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI) as needed.

• Maintain a small Windows companion application written in C#/.NET.

• Write and enhance end-to-end tests covering auth flows, failure modes, and edge cases (clock skew, revoked tokens, malformed assertions, etc.).

• Document known issues, workarounds, and design decisions in the team knowledge base as the team and product mature.

• Communicate clearly with product and engineering stakeholders on design tradeoffs, security posture, and escalation status.

Requirements

Must-have

• Strong hands-on programming skills in Golang .

• Deep, practical knowledge of identity protocols: OIDC/OAuth 2.0 and SAML 2.0 — including token/assertion internals, standard flows, and failure modes.

• Working knowledge of Active Directory .

• Applied cryptography/PKI experience: X.509, JWT/JWKS, key rotation, TLS .

• Strong security engineering discipline — comfortable reasoning about threat models and building software to protect mission-critical systems, not just make features work.

• Solid understanding of OS fundamentals, networking, and concurrency.

• Working knowledge of Linux; comfortable writing shell/bash scripts.

• Simple, effective written and verbal communication.

Nice-to-have

• Directory internals (schema, bind operations).

• HTTP internals and reverse proxying (TLS, header injection).

• Build/release and cross-platform packaging (Linux deb/rpm, Windows MSI).

• Secret-manager internals, Redis, Win32, policy engines.

• Basic C#/.NET (to maintain the companion app).

title: Software Engineer - UI Test
description:
ABOUT THE TEAM
The mission of the UI Test team is to ensure best-in-class UI experience for Rubrik products. The team accomplishes this by testing and automating customer workflows, providing UI automation infrastructure for end to end validation and benchmarking, checking usability and user experience and consistency across the features and products. Key stakeholders are product component teams, product management, release managers and end customers.

The key responsibilities of the team include qualifying new features for production release and leading UI release regression qualification across Rubrik's on-prem and cloud products. We do manual and automated testing, including developing the test infrastructure needed. We build and use AI-native skills that automate the entire testing lifecycle, starting from generating the UI test plan to executing them in real environments.

ABOUT THE JOB

UI Test team responsibilities:

• Feature qualification:

• The UI Test team qualifies new features from the end-user point of view (UI) for all Rubrik products before rolling out to production. We make sure every feature adheres to the quality standards and integrates well with the rest of the product.

• Maintains high quality bar in test processes, strategy and test execution.

• Release regression testing:

•

title: Sr AI Engineer, Agentic Systems
description:
About the team

Rubrik secures and accelerates the world’s AI transformation. As AI agents reshape the enterprise, Rubrik’s Enterprise AI Incubation team proves it on Rubrik itself. We're building a thinking enterprise: applications that don't just record the business but help run it. They learn from our data, act through our own agents, and improve with every decision. Fully backed by executive leadership, this team drives meaningful, large-scale enterprise transformation.

About the role

We want senior engineers who have already shipped agents that real people rely on, and who are ready to do it again at higher stakes. You will drop into the real work, redesign it around agents that carry it end to end, and ship it as the new way that part of Rubrik operates.You’ll own your agent systems end to end: understanding the workflow, designing the architecture, writing the code, deploying, and running it in production. Rather than simply querying an API, you engineer robust, production-grade infrastructure around model endpoints, integrating custom tooling, context pipelines, automated evaluations, and defensive guardrails to ensure resilience against unstructured real-world data.

You also decide whether a problem needs an agent, a simpler automation, or nothing at all, and you have explicit authority to stop or re-scope work that won’t deliver impact. You thrive in ambiguous environments with a low-ego mindset, leveraging AI coding tools as core collaborative partners in your engineering workflow.

What you’ll do

• Lead product discovery alongside Product Managers and domain experts to understand real workflows, map them out, and define clear problems, baselines, and success criteria as the foundation for building agentic solutions.

• Design, build, test, and deploy production agents, automations, and internal tools using coding agents, LLM APIs, and agent frameworks, integrated with Rubrik’s internal agent platform and business systems.

• Turn complex processes into multi-agent workflows that carry real work and make decisions: orchestrators that qualify and routes deals, workers that move orders through approval and fulfillment under business rules, agents that monitor signals and recommend actions for customer health, or coordinated agents that handle hire-to-retire steps across HR, IT, and managers with shared state and clear handoffs.

• Engineer agents for autonomy with reliability, including tool and orchestration flows, context management, caching, retries, and failure handling.

• Leverage full-stack engineering across backend services, APIs, data models, interactive screens, approval UIs, and chat interfaces as the complete medium to deliver high-ownership, user-facing agent systems.

• Apply solid software engineering practices to AI systems, treating prompts, skills, configs, and specs as versioned artifacts, with code review, tests, CI or CD, and staged rollouts.

• Implement evaluation, guardrails, and quality control: derive evals from workflow data, establish quality gates and guardrails, integrate human-in-the-loop approvals where needed, and monitor production runs to refine agents over time.

• Use measured results to decide how to evolve or retire agents, and turn successful systems into patterns and libraries that can be reused.

Experience you’ll need (must haves)

• Around 7 or more years of professional software engineering experience in production systems, and around 2 or more years of professional, hands-on experience building AI agents and agent powered production applications with measurable outcomes.

• Strong full stack engineering background, with a track record of designing, building, and owning services end to end, including backend APIs and integrations, data models, and user facing interfaces such as approval UIs, dashboards, or chat surfaces.

• A builder mindset: comfortable defining baselines and metrics, reporting results in business terms, working in a fast moving environment, and closing the loop by building, demoing, learning, and building again. If you like seeing improvements in hours saved, errors avoided, and teams unblocked, you will have plenty of chances to measure that here.

Software engineering skills and best practices

• System design: break down complex problems, design APIs and data models, reason about latency, throughput, and failure modes, and choose simple, robust architectures.

• Algorithms, data structures, access control permissions, and data provenance.

• Spec driven development: turn vague requirements into clear problem statements, write or refine design docs, and use a Spec → Plan → Task → Code→ Converge flow so work is traceable from design to code, including when you use AI coding agents.

• Execution discipline: use version control, code review, automated tests, CI or CD, staged rollouts and rollbacks, logging, metrics, and tracing, and improve systems based on issues and signals from production.

AI engineering skills and best practices

• Build agents in code using LLM APIs, SDKs, and libraries, not just no code or low code tools, and have shipped agentic systems that real users rely on.

• Design robust agent harnesses and multi agent orchestrations: model tools and resources, manage context and state, and keep runs reliable under real world data and load.

• Establish continuous evaluation and safety mechanisms: turn production failures into test cases, gate changes on eval suite results, and enforce guardrails across agent workflows.

• Exercise clear judgment on AI fit: decide when a problem needs an agent versus a simpler automation or no build, and make tradeoffs around model choice, latency and cost, context strategy, and autonomy using data rather than intuition.

Preferred qualifications (nice to haves)

• Knowledge/context graphs: entities and relationships, GraphRAG, hybrid retrieval.

• Agent frameworks and runtimes: Google ADK, LangGraph, OpenAI style, cloud or container platforms.

• Backend: Python, FastAPI or similar stacks.

• Tools integration: MCP, Slack or Teams bots, REST APIs, webhooks.

• Data systems: Snowflake, Salesforce, graph stores.

• UX: conversational flows, chat surfaces, guided forms, simple dashboards for agent output.

title: Staff Cloud Security Architect
description:
About the team

The Information Security organization advances the overall state of security at Rubrik through purposeful initiatives and coordination of large security projects. Information Security builds technologies, tools, and processes to better enable teams at Rubrik to develop secure software and protect data and systems with appropriate security controls. Information Security also develops systems to monitor and respond to attacks against our systems, provides awareness education to teams on security best practices for data protection, and ensures data sharing relationships with third parties in order to securely protect Rubrik information.

About the role

The Staff Cloud Security Architect will serve as a critical subject matter expert, responsible for defining, designing, and implementing secure cloud architectures and solutions across our enterprise environments. As a key technical leader, you will collaborate with engineering and cross-functional teams across Rubrik to integrate security across all aspects of cloud deployment, operations, and management. Your strategic insights will help shape cloud security strategies, reference architectures, governance frameworks, and compliance requirements. Your deep technical expertise, ability to influence, build and establish best practices, and thought leadership will ensure the secure enablement of our cloud technologies across our hybrid and public cloud environments. This is a hands-on technical role, and you will be expected to rely on your extensive cloud expertise to make an immediate impact on existing and new initiatives.

What you'll do

• Define and implement cloud security architecture frameworks, principles, and guidelines to secure enterprise cloud environments and workloads.

• Collaborate with cross-functional teams to ensure security maturity initiatives are prioritized effectively and addressed in a timely and sustainable manner.

• Partner with cloud security architects, developers, and engineers to design scalable solutions addressing complex infrastructure-related security challenges.

• Design, build proof of concept, tools, and platforms to proactively address and resolve security issues at scale.

• Conduct architecture reviews, security assessments, threat modeling, and risk analysis of cloud-native services and infrastructure.

• Establish secure reference architectures, reusable cloud security patterns, standards, and best practices to ensure consistency in cloud deployments at scale.

• Lead efforts related to strategic planning and continuous improvement of cloud security capabilities, including public cloud native security products and third-party cloud security tools.

• Partner with incident response teams and SOC analysts to ensure effective processes and technology are in place to quickly detect, investigate, and mitigate cloud security incidents.

Experience you'll need

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, Information Technology, or related fields.

• 15+ Years of experience securing complex on-prem or cloud deployments with a minimum of 6+ years of dedicated experience in cloud security architecture and design, including significant experience across AWS, GCP, and/or Azure environments.

• Deep technical understanding of core cloud service models, including compute, network, and storage technologies on AWS, GCP, and/or Azure platforms.

• Proficiency in at least one programming language or scripting language such as Python, Go, or Java for automating and managing security tools and processes.

• Extensive working experience with containerized applications (Kubernetes, Docker), CI/CD pipelines, and microservices architectures.

• 5+ years of experience with IAC (Infrastructure as a Code) deployments for complex systems [Terraform, Ansible etc]

• Demonstrated expertise in articulating complex technical issues clearly to both security specialists and non-technical stakeholders.

Additional skills

• Effective communication skills, both written and verbal, with the ability to convey complex information clearly to technical and non-technical audiences.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving skills, with the ability to lead cross-functional collaborations and drive technical security initiatives.

• Ability to quickly learn, adapt, and lead in fast-paced and dynamic technical environments.

In collaboration with our partners and Celonis Services, you will help customers drive measurable business impact across various processes and industries and accelerate their adoption of our platform. You will blend process and industry expertise with a consulting skill set, an AI-solution mindset, and strong analytical skills at the forefront of one of the fastest-growing tech companies worldwide.

Identify & Frame Value

• Discover and translate customers’ strategic priorities into high-impact Celonis use cases

• Support customers and partners in building business cases, leveraging industry benchmarks and best practices in order to retain and scale customers, driving Annual Recurring Revenue (ARR) growth

• Orchestrate Value Assessments and support in communicating value opportunities and strategic roadmaps to C-Level executives

Realize Value

• Guide customers and partners on how to use Celonis to identify and qualify opportunities for process enhancement

• Drive improvement measures in core business functions and initiate improvement actions and enterprise-wide change initiatives

• Support presentation of results and realized value to senior management and C-level executives

Scale Value

• Responsible for the customer value journey, driving expansion, adoption, and renewals

• Partner with customers to develop strategic Celonis roadmaps embedding Celonis Process Intelligence as a strategic business transformation platform in their organization

• Provide feedback to our product development teams to enhance the Celonis platform and Apps based on new use cases

Ideally in a customer-facing role in Customer Success, Sales Engineering or IT/Management Consulting with a Business Software / SaaS Provider or a Consultancy.

• Data, Analytics, Applications & IT: Good knowledge of Business Software / SaaS applications (e.g. SAP), experience with implementing RPA and/or BI Tools and/or building Dashboards, Apps and Action Flows. Experience on Python and/or SQL. Experience in collaborating with IT teams.

• Process Improvement & Value Realization: Experience in identifying use cases for business process improvement and deploying improvement measures, being a change agent and training users/process owners to realize value.

description:

In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.

The work you’ll do:

Lead complex data integration and ingestion

• Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.

• Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.

• Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.

• Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.

• Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.

• Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.

• Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

Actions, automation, and AI connectivity

• Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.

• Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

Identity, security, and governance

• Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.

• Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

Customer and team impact

• Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.

• Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.

• Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

The qualifications you need:

• 8+ years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.

• Oracle data engineering experience: hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.

• Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.

• Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.

• Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).

• Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.

• Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

• Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.

• Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.

• Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).

• Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.

• Docker and Linux server administration experience.

• Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

description:
