The Role:

In this role you will work across diverse enterprise source systems such as SAP, Salesforce, and cloud databases, with a strong focus on the Oracle technology ecosystem. You will drive data extraction from Oracle environments (Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle E-Business Suite, Oracle Database and Autonomous Database) and build integrations with Oracle’s AI and automation infrastructure.

You will own complex, highly customized integration projects end to end, anticipate blockers before they surface, and shape the best long-term solution together with the customer and Celonis internal teams. You are a trusted technical advisor to customer IT, data, and security leaders, and a go-to partner for colleagues across Services, Product & Engineering, and Go-to-Market.

Beyond day-to-day delivery, you invest part of your time in growing the SA practice: building reusable assets, and driving small initiatives that advance team strategy, including our Oracle integration playbooks.

The work you’ll do:

Lead complex data integration and ingestion

• Own Oracle data extraction. Architect and deliver ingestion from Oracle Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, and Oracle Database / Autonomous Database, including JDBC and PL/SQL-based approaches, while understanding the underlying business processes in these systems.

• Build real-time and CDC integrations. Design change data capture and event-driven architectures using Oracle GoldenGate, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kafka, and REST/SOAP APIs, and use them to power Celonis Action Flows.

• Deliver Oracle ERP and other enterprise connections. Lead Oracle ERP connections or cloud based equivalents (e.g. via Oracle BICC). Deliver customized JDBC setups, including Dockerized and real-time configurations.

• Build and own custom API connectors. Design advanced connectors, including complex authentication, pagination, and delta loads, and advise on API design topics such as synchronous versus asynchronous APIs and OData.

• Architect push-based and lakehouse pipelines. Lead Python-based pipelines with Celonis data ingestion API with data engineering and SDLC best practices, and design Landing Zone and lakehouse solutions (for example Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric), including zero copy solutions.

• Solve hard infrastructure problems. Work with customer IT on DMZs, network bridges, WAFs, proxies, certificates, on-premise agent deployments, and Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) networking.

• Keep pipelines healthy. Tune extraction schedules and delta strategies, optimize database and pipeline performance (for example on Oracle DB and Exadata), and resolve data load failures so customers get timely, trustworthy data.

Actions, automation, and AI connectivity

• Deliver advanced writebacks and automation. Configure Action Flows with customized agent settings and direct API-based integrations, including writebacks into Oracle systems, and advise on bot integrations, permissioning, and security.

• Connect Celonis to enterprise AI. Design AI integration patterns that connect Celonis Orchestration and Action Flows with OCI Generative AI Agents, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), or Oracle Digital Assistant, and guide customers in connecting Celonis to their LLMs and AI agents through MCP, covering authentication, permissions, and governance.

Identity, security, and governance

• Own authentication and provisioning. Configure SSO (SAML, OIDC) with identity providers such as OCI IAM, Microsoft Entra ID, Okta, and Ping, and set up SCIM-based user and group provisioning.

• Lead security conversations. Coordinate with the Celonis security team on customer questionnaires, answer questions confidently on live calls, and explain architecture and data flows to customer security and compliance stakeholders.

Customer and team impact

• Act as a trusted advisor. Recommend solutions that set the customer up for long-term success, knowing when to build the ideal setup and when to compromise, drawing on best practices in data management, ETL, streaming, and project management.

• Be a recognized expert. Build deep expertise in Oracle integrations and other product areas, give structured feedback to Product & Engineering on Oracle connectors and AI agent capabilities, and become a source of trust for product managers and engineers.

• Advance team strategy. Set up and run initiatives such as knowledge bases and best-practice libraries (for example Oracle integration templates): define goals and success criteria, document the plan, and hold yourself and others accountable.

The qualifications you need:

• 5-8 years of experience in data engineering, technical consulting, or solutions architecture in a customer-facing role, including leading customer implementations.

• Oracle data engineering experience: hands-on experience extracting data from and understanding business processes in Oracle systems (Fusion Cloud ERP, Oracle EBS R12, Oracle Database / Autonomous Database), with PL/SQL and Oracle SQL skills.

• Oracle Cloud: experience with Oracle Cloud Infrastructure (OCI) and its integration and data services such as Oracle Integration Cloud, alongside familiarity with AWS, Azure, or GCP is a plus.

• Python and SQL skills, and ETL pipeline creation for large volumes of enterprise data, including migration scripting and custom transformations.

• Hands-on experience with REST/SOAP APIs, authentication patterns, and API design concepts (synchronous and asynchronous APIs, OData).

• Network and security fluency at the level needed to engage customer enterprise IT (DMZ, WAF, proxies, certificates, VPNs), plus comfort with Linux environments.

• Excellent communication and storytelling across written, verbal, and slide formats, tailored to technical and executive audiences, and fluency in English.

• A Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Information Systems, Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience.

Nice to have

• Experience with Oracle Exadata, Oracle Select AI (Database 23ai), Oracle Digital Assistant, or Oracle Analytics.

• Familiarity with SAP (ECC/S/4HANA, PI/PO, SNC, RISE, CPI, BTP) or other enterprise ERPs.

• Experience with Snowflake, Databricks, or Microsoft Fabric, and with iPaaS or low-code tools (MuleSoft, Boomi, Workato, Power Automate).

• Experience with LLMs, AI agents, or MCP.

• Docker and Linux server administration experience.

• Relevant certifications (Celonis, Oracle/OCI, cloud, or SAP).

• Consistent delivery quality

Responsibilities:

• Act as a trusted RGM advisor, not just a delivery manager.

• Lead governance forums, value reviews, and roadmap discussions for RGM initiatives.

• Lead, mentor, and grow RGM analytics teams (10–20 members) across analysts, consultants, and leads.

• Support recruitment, onboarding, and capability uplift in RGM-specific skills.

• Embed best practices in RGM analytics delivery, documentation, and quality assurance.

5. Quality, Scale & Value Realization

Ensure high quality, scalable deliverables aligned to commercial KPIs such as:

• Net Revenue Growth

• Price Realization

• Promo ROI

• Trade Efficiency

• Margin Improvement

Responsibilities:

• Track value realization, not just output delivery.

• Drive standardization and reusability of RGM assets, models, and dashboards.

• Identifying new RGM opportunities

Must-Have

• 12 ± 1 years of overall experience, with 8+ years in analytics delivery.

• Proven track record of managing multi-client, multi-workstream delivery programs.

• Ability to engage with business and technical stakeholders and connect analytics to commercial decisions.

• Strong analytical mindset with ability to derive insights that influence RGM outcomes.

Technical & Analytics Skills

• Solid understanding of commercial data models (pricing, promo, trade, mix & assortment).

• Working knowledge of cloud and data platforms: Snowflake, Databricks, Azure, AWS.

• Familiarity with data quality, governance, and access controls in enterprise RGM setups.

• Strong hands-on experience with BI & visualization tools: Power BI, Tableau, Looker, Qlik.

Domain Expertise (Highly Preferred)

Deep exposure to CPG / Retail commercial domains, including:

• Pricing & Promo Mechanics

• Trade Terms and Investment Structures

• Category and Channel Dynamics (Modern Trade, GT, eCommerce)

Additional Preference:

• Experience working with global or regional RGM teams is a strong plus.

title: Account Executive, Commercial & SMB (India)
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies—from the world’s largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups—use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone’s reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the team

India is home to a large and rapidly evolving base of digital businesses. SaaS companies, e-commerce businesses, platforms, marketplaces, and AI-first companies are scaling quickly, serving increasingly sophisticated customers, and expanding beyond India.

Stripe’s Commercial & SMB team partners with high-potential businesses at an important stage of their growth. Some are already using Stripe and can benefit from a deeper partnership. Others are evaluating how to modernize their payments and financial infrastructure. Our role is to understand their ambitions, help them make well-informed decisions, and bring together the right capabilities across Stripe.

This is a full-cycle sales role with meaningful ownership. You will create pipeline, win new users, expand existing relationships, and help shape Stripe’s commercial strategy in India. You will join a focused, entrepreneurial team in Bengaluru while working closely with colleagues across Stripe’s global Product, Solutions Architecture, Customer Success, Risk, Legal, Finance, and Operations organizations.

What you’ll do

You will own a portfolio of high-potential commercial and small-to-medium businesses across India. You will operate with a dual mandate: acquire new users and grow existing relationships through greater adoption, new use cases, and long-term strategic value.

Responsibilities

• Build and execute a territory plan focused on high-potential Indian SaaS companies, digital-native businesses, e-commerce companies, platforms, marketplaces, and global-first businesses

• Generate your own pipeline through thoughtful outbound engagement, referrals, ecosystem relationships, events, partnerships, and rigorous account research

• Lead the complete sales cycle, from prospecting and discovery through solution design, commercial negotiation, contracting, and launch

• Develop trusted relationships with founders and senior stakeholders across finance, product, engineering, operations, and procurement

• Understand each user’s business model, growth priorities, technical architecture, and current financial infrastructure

• Translate complex customer needs into clear solutions and business cases, connecting Stripe’s capabilities to measurable outcomes

• Identify opportunities for new product adoption, deeper integrations, improved payment performance, new business models, and international expansion

• Lead compelling product and solution conversations in partnership with Solutions Architecture and other specialists

• Navigate multi-stakeholder decisions involving commercial, technical, operational, risk, and regulatory considerations

• Negotiate pricing and commercial terms with sound judgment, balancing user value, competitive context, and Stripe’s long-term objectives

• Manage pipeline and forecasting with rigor, using data to prioritize accounts and maintain a clear view of risks, dependencies, and next steps

• Partner with Customer Success and cross-functional teams to ensure a strong transition from sale to implementation and long-term adoption

• Bring structured market and user feedback to Stripe’s Product, Marketing, and leadership teams

• Represent Stripe in India’s technology and business ecosystem, building relationships with founders, investors, accelerators, partners, and industry communities

What success looks like

In this role, success means:

• Creating a healthy, self-generated pipeline in priority segments

• Winning high-quality new users and expanding existing relationships

• Increasing adoption of relevant Stripe products and use cases

• Building senior relationships that position Stripe as a long-term strategic partner

• Running disciplined sales cycles with clear qualification, strong business cases, accurate forecasting, and effective close plans

• Helping Stripe develop a sharper understanding of India’s commercial and SMB opportunity

Who you are

We’re looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• 7+ years of experience in full-cycle, consultative B2B technology sales, including meaningful experience in the Indian market

• A demonstrated track record of generating pipeline and closing new-business or expansion opportunities

• Experience selling to founders or senior stakeholders across finance, product, technology, or operations

• Strong discovery, qualification, and solution-selling skills

• Ability to understand technical products and translate complex requirements into clear customer and business value

• Strong commercial judgment, including experience building business cases and leading pricing and contract negotiations

• Analytical discipline and comfort using data to prioritize a territory, assess opportunities, and forecast accurately

• Ability to manage multiple sales cycles at different stages without compromising quality or customer trust

• Experience coordinating complex work across multiple internal teams

• Ability to operate with ownership, resilience, and sound judgment in an ambiguous, fast-moving environment

• Strong written and verbal communication skills in English

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience in payments, fintech, SaaS, cloud, developer tools, e-commerce, or financial infrastructure

• Experience selling to digital-native businesses, SaaS companies, platforms, marketplaces, or companies expanding internationally

• Existing relationships within India’s founder, technology, venture capital, or business ecosystem

• Familiarity with APIs, online payments, subscription business models, fraud prevention, platforms, or cross-border commerce

• Experience selling multiple products or solutions into the same customer relationship

• Experience working in a global organization with geographically distributed teams

• Experience with spreadsheets, CRM analytics, SQL, or a demonstrated willingness to learn

Why this role matters

Commercial and SMB businesses represent an important part of India’s digital economy and Stripe’s long-term opportunity in the market. In this role, you will help ambitious businesses strengthen their financial infrastructure, launch new products, and expand internationally. You will also help build the sales motion, relationships, and market understanding that will shape Stripe’s growth in India for years to come.

description:

About the team and the role

The People Systems Operations Administrator supports the day-to-day work that keeps Stripe’s People technology running accurately and reliably. The role sits in the Service Delivery Center and works as part of the wider People Solutions team, with a close dotted-line partnership to People Solutions Systems Management.

You’ll own a defined set of routine tier 1 and tier 2 operational work across Workday and related People Systems. This includes monitoring support channels and system inboxes, triaging requests, completing repeatable administrative tasks, maintaining documentation, and routing complex issues to the right People Systems owner.

This is a hands-on operations role. It creates clearer separation between routine support work and the configuration, architecture, governance, and project delivery owned by the People Systems team.

What you’ll do

Support queue and request triage

• Monitor the Salesforce case management queue and Jira requests for People Systems work.

• Triage incoming requests by urgency, business impact, data sensitivity, and defined support process.

• Resolve standard requests using documented procedures, and route exceptions or higher-complexity work to the appropriate People Systems owner.
Keep request records accurate and complete, including status updates, required approvals, supporting documentation, and clear handoffs.

• Identify recurring request patterns and flag opportunities to improve documentation, self-service, or system processes.

Workday operations

• Monitor the Workday inbox for business process errors, stuck transactions, alerts, and other operational issues.

• Complete routine Workday support tasks, including standard access requests, account maintenance, and operational follow-up.

• Support Salesforce and JIRA run work and respond to common People Systems questions using approved guidance.

• Help with recurring operational tasks such as account monitoring, account resets, and quarterly account reviews.

• Support year-end activity, including schedule extensions, alert configuration, audit requests, and tracking follow-up items.

• Assist with release readiness by reviewing assigned Workday updates, completing test steps, documenting results, and escalating issues found during testing.

• Support recurring People programs, such as performance-cycle launches, using established runbooks and checklists.

Reporting, documentation, and Jira support

• Intake and triage Workday reporting and data requests. Confirm required information, route requests to the right owner, and provide status updates to requesters.

• Complete standard reporting tasks and access-related requests where there is a documented process and appropriate approval.

• Maintain runbooks, Trailhead content, standard operating procedures, and request templates so guidance stays current and easy to find.

• Support data-quality checks and follow established processes to correct or escalate issues.

Partnership with People Systems

• Work closely with People Systems analysts and engineers to understand support priorities, upcoming releases, recurring work, and escalation paths.

• Provide clear handoffs for work that requires configuration changes, advanced reporting, integrations, security decisions, or policy interpretation.

• Participate in regular reviews of queue trends, service levels, documentation gaps, and operational risks.

• Build platform knowledge over time, with opportunities to take on more complex administration and configuration work as skills develop.

Minimum requirements

• Experience in People operations, HR administration, systems support, service delivery, or another operations role involving high-volume, process-driven work.

• Strong attention to detail, particularly where accuracy affects People records, access, payroll, compliance, or reporting.

• Ability to work through a queue independently, prioritize requests, follow defined processes, and escalate issues at the right time.

• Clear written communication and comfort giving requesters concise status updates.

• Experience using Jira, Salesforce, or a similar case-management or ticketing tool.

• Comfort learning enterprise systems and following structured procedures across multiple tools.

• Strong organization skills and a consistent approach to documenting work and following requests through to resolution.

• Good judgment when working with confidential information.

Preferred qualifications

• Experience supporting Workday, including Core HCM, business processes, security administration, reporting, or Workday inbox monitoring.

• Experience handling reporting requests, data access requests, and standard user provisioning.

• Experience supporting cyclical People programs, compliance activities, audit requests, or system-release testing.

What success looks like

Within the first six months, you will:

• Own the defined tier 1 and routine tier 2 People Systems queue work with accurate, timely resolution and clear escalation.

• Establish dependable monitoring for People Systems tickets in Salesforce, JIRA, the Workday inbox, and recurring operational tasks.

• Reduce avoidable handoffs and ensure complex work reaches the right People Systems owner with the context needed to act.

• Keep core runbooks and self-service guidance current based on recurring request patterns.

• Give People Systems analysts and engineers more capacity for configuration, governance, architecture, and strategic delivery work.

This role has a broad remit across all India tax matters — leading direct tax, tax compliance and controls, controversy, planning, policy developments, product and market expansion, and business advisory, and partnering closely with Stripe's global SME teams on India-specific indirect tax and transfer pricing matters. A central focus will be leading India tax controversy: developing audit and litigation strategy, managing interactions with tax authorities and external advisers, and driving matters to effective resolution. You will work closely with colleagues across Finance, Legal, Treasury, Product, Partnerships, Operations and Policy. The position will be based in Bangalore and report to the APAC Head of Tax.

• 12+ years of relevant India tax experience in a Big 4 firm, law firm and/or multinational organisation, with demonstrated ownership of complex tax matters.

• A professional qualification such as Chartered Accountant, lawyer or equivalent, and deep technical knowledge of Indian corporate and indirect tax law.

• Significant hands-on experience leading India tax audits, assessments, appeals or litigation, including developing controversy strategy and engaging with tax authorities and advisers.

• Broad working knowledge of Indian direct and indirect taxes, transfer pricing, and withholding tax, with demonstrated ownership of tax compliance, controls, controversy and business advisory for a multinational group, and experience partnering effectively with global SME teams.

• Strong judgement and the ability to translate complex tax issues into clear, pragmatic recommendations for non-tax stakeholders and senior leaders.

• A track record of working independently, setting priorities and driving cross-functional matters to resolution in a fast-moving environment.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, with the credibility to represent Stripe externally and influence stakeholders at all levels.

• Flexibility to adapt quickly to changes in tax law, administrative practice and Stripe’s business.

• A willingness to work with a diverse set of individuals who care deeply about Stripe’s tax issues and each other.

It would be nice if you have

• Experience working in a high-growth, rapidly scaling environment.

• Experience in technology, payments or financial services.

• Experience with tax policy or industry engagement in India.

• Familiarity with international tax issues.

‘Nice to have’ really means ‘nice to have’. It’s completely possible that you don’t have any of these and are still a great fit for the team.

• LinkedIn profile and resume

title: Software Engineer, Intern
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a technology company focused on improving the conditions for economic growth and prosperity. We build programmable financial infrastructure, rethinking from first principles how financial services should work, to make it easier and cheaper for any business to start and scale. More than 10 million businesses build on Stripe, spanning the economic frontier—from solo founders to established enterprises—united by a practical focus on growth. The most ambitious companies in the world use Stripe as core infrastructure to grow faster. They process trillions of dollars a year on Stripe, equivalent to around 1.6% of global GDP. While economic growth makes everyone better off, open markets also enable greater variety. When any business can easily serve a global customer base, the quality and diversity of products in the world increase, and craft and creativity are unleashed into the smallest niches. Our own growth is wholly contingent on the success of the businesses building on Stripe. We therefore invest back into our technology at an unusual rate. We make upgrades to our products every single day to deliver compounding gains to our customers. We maintain some of the most reliable APIs on the internet. We build entirely new pieces of financial infrastructure to enable new ideas. And our significant advances in risk and fraud infrastructure over many years are making the internet economy safer and more accessible.

Though people at Stripe don’t tend to take themselves seriously, Stripe is a fairly serious place: our customers are depending on us for their livelihoods. We admire ambition, intensity, curiosity, humility, and rigor. The most effective people become knowledgeable about many domains besides their own. Any company is an applied exercise in understanding some aspect of society or the market. In working with so many (especially the new and innovative ones), we think that Stripe is one of the very best places to learn about how the world works.

What you’ll do

As an intern at Stripe you’ll work on projects across our stack that directly impact the way millions of businesses operate. You’ll own problems end to end with the support of your manager and teammates. It’s an opportunity to work alongside some of the most creative and technically rigorous engineers in the industry and learn how to ship high-quality work at scale. By contributing to Stripe’s codebase you’ll work across domains that give you insight into how the global economy works. Recent intern projects include expanding Stripe’s Payments Foundation Model capabilities to improve generalized anomaly detection, building more approachable fraud controls, creating safer payouts, and developing user-facing solutions that prevent costly pricing mistakes and make merchant checkout setup easier.

Our internship program is competitive and the expectations are high.

Responsibilities

•
Operate as a real member of the team you join; engage in team discussions, decisions, and the technical design process.

•
Write software that will be used in production, and has meaningful impact to Stripe’s business and users.

•
Give and receive technical feedback through code reviews or design discussions

•
Collaborate with other engineers and cross-functional stakeholders to proactively seek and incorporate feedback.

•
Learn quickly by asking great questions, working with your intern manager and teammates effectively, communicating the status of your work clearly, and building with the latest AI tooling.

Who you are

•
Ambitious builder: You’re energized by building solutions without clear precedent and solving problems with far-reaching consequences. Successful Stripes are deeply curious, and prefer the joy of discovery to the comfort of certainty.

•
Rigorous thinker: You appreciate that things worth doing are rarely simple. You enjoy working on problems that have never been tackled before.

•
Adaptable problem solver: You adapt quickly and treat obstacles as opportunities. At Stripe we embrace kindness while encouraging Stripes to take measured risks and act boldly, even in the absence of consensus.

Minimum requirements

•
A strong fundamental understanding of computer science through pursuit of a Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in computer science, math, or a related discipline.

•
Experience and familiarity with programming, either through side projects or classwork. We work mostly in Ruby, Java, Javascript, Go, and Scala. We believe new programming languages can be learned if the fundamentals and general knowledge are present.

•
Experience from previous internships or other multi-person projects, including open source contributions, that demonstrate evaluating and receiving feedback from mentors, peers, and stakeholders.

•
Ability to learn unfamiliar systems and form an understanding of those systems, through independent research and working with a mentor or subject matter experts.

•
Ability to leverage AI tools to accelerate development while applying rigorous critical thinking and professional judgement to review, refine, and validate all outputs.

Preferred qualifications

•
At least 1 year of university education, or equivalent work experience.

•
One or more areas of specialized knowledge (frontend, backend, infrastructure or other technologies) balanced with general skills and knowledge.

•
Experience writing high quality pull requests, with good test coverage, and working knowledge to complete projects with minimal defects.

•
Familiarity with navigating and managing your work in new code bases, with multiple languages.

•
Clear written communication skills, with the ability to write clearly to explain your work to stakeholders, team members, and other Stripes.

title: Staff Engineer, Core Infrastructure
description:
Who we are

About Stripe

Stripe is a financial infrastructure platform for businesses. Millions of companies — from the world's largest enterprises to the most ambitious startups — use Stripe to accept payments, grow their revenue, and accelerate new business opportunities. Our mission is to increase the GDP of the internet, and we have a staggering amount of work ahead. That means you have an unprecedented opportunity to put the global economy within everyone's reach while doing the most important work of your career.

About the Organization

The Core Infrastructure organization operates the foundational systems that power Stripe globally — including databases (MongoDB, PostgreSQL), high availability and disaster recovery (HADR), AWS cloud infrastructure, Linux servers, container orchestration, mesh networking, service discovery, and network edge infrastructure.

Within Core Infra, the Regional Enablement Platform (REP) team helps Stripe launch and operate new regions without learning about broken dependencies from users. REP builds the regionalization, validation, deploy-safety, and operator tooling needed to answer practical launch-readiness questions: can critical payment paths run from the new region, which services still depend on a remote control plane, what breaks under packet loss or failover, and what must be fixed before deploys, launches, traffic shifts, or failovers proceed. The team uses traffic replay, synthetics, failover drills, dependency analysis, CI/CD gates, and incident data to turn those findings into platform fixes, service-owner asks, and reusable readiness checks across networking, HADR, and service teams.

This role is based in Bangalore and serves as a senior technical anchor for Core Infrastructure in India, with direct cross-region influence across AMER, EU, and APAC.

What you'll do

As a Staff Engineer on REP, you will play a key leadership role in enabling Stripe's infrastructure to power all of our products, globally and at scale. You will decide how Stripe validates that a new region can safely take traffic and continue working through network loss, failover, and deploy changes. You will define the checks that must pass before launch or failover, build validation systems that replay real production paths against regional infrastructure, and turn those checks into CI/CD gates, operator workflows, and concrete fixes for service or platform owners. You will also help build Core Infrastructure's senior technical bench in Bangalore through design review, mentoring, and cross-region technical leadership.

Responsibilities

• Define evidence-based readiness criteria for regional launches, traffic migrations, and failovers — replacing manual checklists with repeatable, globally consistent patterns

• Proactively identify and mitigate risks on critical payment paths; use system data to drive ownership and validate that platform mitigations measurably reduce impact

• Lead end-to-end cross-functional delivery for new-region infrastructure, including safe service behaviors for remote control planes

• Build reusable validation tooling that accelerates infrastructure integration for new acquisitions and reduces high-priority blockers

• Convert recurring operational friction into scalable platform capabilities used across teams

• Lead technical conversations and define decision mechanisms across Core Infrastructure and product teams

• Develop and communicate a multi-year technical strategy for REP with clearly defined quarterly milestones and success metrics

• Debug production issues across services and levels of the stack

• Mentor and grow senior engineers, elevating technical planning, design standards, and cross-region execution from Bangalore

• Collaborate effectively in a global, distributed environment with asynchronous decision-making across AMER, EU, and APAC

Who you are

We're looking for someone who meets the minimum requirements to be considered for the role. If you meet these requirements, you are encouraged to apply. The preferred qualifications are a bonus, not a requirement.

Minimum requirements

• BS or MS in Computer Science or equivalent field

• 12+ years of professional experience in software or infrastructure engineering

• Proven track record leading complex, cross-team or company-wide infrastructure projects with high reliability and scale requirements

• Strong engineering background in distributed systems, platform engineering, or backend infrastructure, with a focus on operational safety and correctness

• Experience optimizing the reliability and security of distributed systems

• Experience scaling and migrating systems with little to no downtime

• Strong technical judgment and written communication skills, including design docs and trade-off analysis

• Experience mentoring engineers at various stages of their careers

Preferred qualifications

About the team

Our Customer Satisfaction & Incident (CSI) team protects the Agoda brand while delivering exceptional customer satisfaction. We are the final line of support, handling the most complex and challenging escalations across Agoda's core business. Our specialists work with a wide range of stakeholders, from customers and partners to senior leaders and external authorities, to resolve high-impact issues and make every engagement an opportunity to improve.

The Opportunity

As a Senior Support Specialist based in Gurgaon supporting English and Hindi language customer queries, you will own our most complex, sensitive and high-risk escalations from first contact to final resolution. This includes frontline and executive escalations, regulatory matters, partner and supplier complaints, and technical or pricing issues. You would also be a direct point of contact for our partners when a situation calls for it, and you will work closely with our Partner Success, Commercial and other teams based in multiple locations across the world.

This role calls for sound judgment, strong ownership and calm, decisive communication in high-stakes situations. You will often work in grey areas where standard processes need careful, case-by-case handling, and you will make well-reasoned decisions that balance customer satisfaction with financial, legal and reputational risk.

This role operates on a 24/7 schedule, so you'll work in rotating shifts, including nights, weekends, and public holidays. Based in Gurgaon.

What you'll do

• Own high-risk cases end to end, from intake to final resolution, including escalations from frontline teams, senior leadership, partners and third parties such as government bodies or attorneys. Cases can run for days or weeks and need persistence and clear accountability.

• Speak with customers/partners by phone, video or in person when needed, to resolve escalations, explain outcomes and protect the relationship.

• Work closely with Partner Success, Commercial and other teams in multiple locations, joining regular calls to align partner issues, risks and follow-ups.

• De-escalate and negotiate with highly emotional, frustrated or sensitive customers who have already been through standard support, reaching resolutions that protect the customer relationship, our partners and the business.

• Investigate complex situations by gathering and reconciling information from many, often conflicting, sources, and keep thorough, accurate and timely records of every action and decision.

• Make sound, defensible decisions within your authority, and escalate promptly when financial, legal, regulatory, privacy, safety or reputational thresholds are reached.

• Turn complex cases into short, factual updates for senior leaders and, where needed, regulators, focused on impact, resolution and preventing recurrence.

• Partner with teams such as Legal, Fraud, Finance, Public Relations, Product, Technology and Supply, clearly explaining what you need and why it matters, and influencing action without direct authority.

• Identify major errors, fraud indicators or suspicious customer or property behavior, and act to reduce risk to customers, partners and the company.

• Respond quickly to critical incidents and urgent escalations, coordinating stakeholders and keeping communication clear under pressure.

• Prioritize a complex caseload by business risk, financial impact and deadlines rather than arrival order, and adjust quickly as new information comes in.

• Analyze case trends and run root-cause analysis to find systemic gaps, take part in post-incident reviews, and propose preventive improvements.

• Turn new or unusual case resolutions into clear, reusable guidance for the wider team, and flag procedures that need updating.

• Give respectful, constructive feedback to frontline teams to improve case handling and prevent repeat errors, and ensure smooth handover of cases.

What you'll need to succeed:

• At least 4 - 5 years of relevant experience in customer escalations, complaints resolution, incident management or partner-facing support.

• Excellent command of spoken and written English & Hindi skills, with the ability to explain complex situations clearly and confidently to anyone, from upset customers to partners and senior executives.

• Confidence speaking directly with business partners and senior stakeholders, with excellent phone and email manner .

• Strong listening, negotiation and de-escalation skills, and emotional resilience to stay objective and professional under pressure.

• Sound judgment in ambiguous situations, with a critical-thinking, investigative approach and close attention to detail.

• A data-driven approach: comfort using data and case trends to spot systemic issues and support recommendations.

• A strong understanding of compliance, data privacy and risk, and a commitment to keeping actions and communications within legal and regulatory requirements.

• A high degree of integrity, impartiality and confidentiality when handling sensitive cases.

• The ability to manage your own caseload independently and to work well in a diverse, cross-functional team.

• Willing to work in shift rotations (am/pm/midnight shift) to ensure we have 24/7 service levels

• Able to work on public holidays and weekends

Nice to have

• Experience leading or coordinating major incidents across multiple stakeholders with limited information, and knowledge of incident management processes.

• SQL or similar data skills to analyze trends in customer issues and support data-driven decisions.

• Experience in travel, hospitality or online marketplaces.

Why Agoda

• Competitive compensation with performance-based incentives

• Annual discretionary performance bonus

• Health insurance and other locally competitive benefits

• Agoda travel discounts and special rates on accommodation and related products

• Work from anywhere for up to 30 days per year

• Structured training, coaching, and clear performance metrics

• Opportunities to grow your career within the Customer Experience Group or across Agoda

• An inclusive, international work environment where your ideas and feedback are valued

description:
About Agoda

At Agoda, we bridge the world through travel. Our story began in 2005, when two lifelong friends and entrepreneurs, driven by their passion for travel, launched Agoda to make it easier for everyone to explore the world.

Today, we are part of Booking Holdings [NASDAQ: BKNG], with a diverse team of over 7,000 people from 90 countries, working together in offices around the globe. Every day, we connect people to destinations and experiences, with our great deals across our millions of hotels and holiday properties, flights, and experiences worldwide.

No two days are the same at Agoda. Data and technology are at the heart of our culture, fueling our curiosity and innovation. If you’re ready to begin your best journey and help build travel for the world, join us.

Get to Know our Team:

The Customer Experience Group of Agoda effectively serves our customers and partners to ensure satisfying results. This great task is accomplished with the support of our Global Service Vertical team. We serve as the backbone for Customer Experience Group’s global operations. Our team is comprised of project managers, process owners, analysts, and talent management. Together we work nonstop to improve the quality and efficiency of our customer and partner support processes. Working with the Global Service Vertical team is a great opportunity to collaborate with various stakeholders and develop initiatives with our sister companies and external partners all over the world. We are a very data-driven environment, eager to move fast and learn through experimentation. A clear focus on supporting our customers and partners is bolstered by a strong, entrepreneurial culture that enriches us and Agoda’s business performance.

The Opportunity:

The Capacity Planner role (CP) operates as a specialist role within CEG’s WFM team. Providing support, through forecasting and operational capacity performance analysis, to the CEG front line operations. The CP is a ‘subject matter expert’ in WFM, in this way the role holders support CEG balance the demands to customer SLA targets and business objectives.

The goal of this role is to forecast the contact center contact demand, executing and recommending appropriate resource and demand interventions, to enable SLAs to be realized in line with strategic business guidance, and providing support to Associate Capacity Planners and Capacity Planners.

The CP plays an important role across the broader WFM team and CEG operations, to enable a continuous improvement culture. In doing this, it is common that the CP will be involved in collecting and providing feedback on common challenges, supporting change initiatives, and providing input and feedback to enable a smoother and more consistent delivery of SLAs.

Activities Performed on the job:

• Medium and short-term forecasting

• Create medium term forecast (4-12 weeks) based on latest HC model FC, considering latest demand and AHT trends

• Calculate daily and hourly HC requirement (per channel) to be used by Schedule Planners in roster planning

• Create short-term forecast (0-4 weeks) to see possible short falls on staffing based on actual scheduled HC

• Shrinkage planning

• Manage planned shrinkage (external and internal) based on team’s capacity

• Communicating any increase or decrease in planned shrinkages to stakeholders e.g., Ops teams, LnD, etc. '

• Levers planning

• Planning overflow of supply (FL support, Chameleon) based on over or under supply of HC vs requirement

• Planning of demand suppression in the form of demand levers

• Stakeholder Engagement:

• Collaborate with key stakeholders (e.g., CST Service Delivery Managers, LnD, wider WFM team) outside bi-weekly meetings regarding medium and short-term forecasting, shrinkage planning, possible agent behavior issue based on data.

• Present in bi-weekly meetings discussing the review and learnings in the past 2 weeks and preview of what to expect in the next 8 weeks, including recommendations on how to eliminate/minimize possible pain points in delivering business requirements.

• Participate with added value in meetings and engagements with key stakeholders (e.g., CEG tech Team, Regional Managers and wider WFM team).

• Other non-core tasks:

• Support new team members and interns.

• Process improvement

• Other activities as defined by WFM Manager.

• Prepare related WFM report

Nice to have

• Experience in capacity planning within/outside contact center environment

Creating a work environment where tasks and responsibilities are accomplished successfully within the time available.

Definition

Continuous improvement
Regularly identifies improvement opportunities, quantifies them, and follows through to measurable/demonstratable outcomes. Embraces both successes and failures to learn and maximize the benefit.

title: Assistant Manager - Internal Audit
description:
About Groww:

We are a passionate group of people focused on making financial services accessible to every Indian through a multi-product platform. Each day, we help millions of customers take charge of their financial journey. Customer obsession is in our DNA. Every product, every design, every algorithm down to the tiniest detail is executed keeping the customers’ needs and convenience in mind. Our people are our greatest strength. Everyone at Groww is driven by ownership, customer-centricity, integrity and the passion to constantly challenge the status quo.

Are you as passionate about defying conventions and creating something extraordinary as we are? Let’s chat.

Our Vision

Every individual deserves the knowledge, tools, and confidence to make informed financial decisions. At Groww, we are making sure every Indian feels empowered to do so through a cutting-edge multi-product platform offering a variety of financial services. Our long-term vision is to become the trusted financial partner for millions of Indians.

Our Values

Our culture enables us to be what we are — India’s fastest-growing financial services company. It fosters an environment where collaboration, transparency, and open communication take center-stage and hierarchies fade away. There is space for every individual to be themselves and feel motivated to bring their best to the table, as well as craft a promising career for themselves.

The values that form our foundation are:

• Radical customer centricity

• Ownership-driven culture

• Keeping everything simple

• Long-term thinking

• Complete transparency

Reimagine Internal Audit with us | What You'll Do

Internal Audit at Groww is not just about checking controls. It’s about understanding the business deeply, asking the right questions, spotting what others may miss, and helping build a stronger, safer and more resilient organisation.

• Know the business inside out
Understand Groww’s businesses, products, systems and processes, with exposure across Digital Lending, Broking, Wealth Management and other evolving areas.

• Spot what others may miss
Use data, analytics and professional scepticism to identify anomalies, emerging risks and early warning signals—and turn them into meaningful insights.

• Go beyond the rulebook
Build expertise across RBI, SEBI, stock exchange and other regulations , translating requirements into impactful audit procedures.

• Own audits end-to-end
Plan and execute risk-based audits, identify root causes, and work with stakeholders to drive practical, sustainable remediation .

• Reimagine how audits are done
Leverage Gen AI, Agentic AI, data analytics and automation to make Internal Audit smarter, faster and more continuous.

• Influence, don't just report
Build trusted stakeholder relationships, challenge constructively and help turn audit findings into meaningful business improvements.

• Make insights matter
Communicate key risks and themes clearly to senior leadership and the Audit Committee, while building institutional knowledge for the team.

• Keep raising the bar
Stay ahead of emerging risks, technology, regulations and evolving audit practices. Bring an outside-in perspective and continuously challenge the status quo.

What Makes You a Great Fit

• CA, preferably on the first attempt , with up to ~2 years post-qualification experience in Internal Audit, Statutory Audit, Finance, Risk or related areas.

• Experience in startups, fintech, BFSI or technology-driven environments is preferred.

• Strong analytical and problem-solving mindset with an ability to work with data and connect the dots.

• Interest in Internal Audit, Risk, Fraud, Regulatory Compliance and Controls.

• Curiosity about AI, Data Analytics and automation, including AI agents and tools such as n8n, Claude Code, Codex, Cursor, Windsurf or similar

• Strong communication, stakeholder management and constructive challenge skills.

• High ownership, resilience and ability to thrive in a fast-paced, high-growth environment.

• Willingness to travel on a need basis.

If you’re excited about rethinking what Internal Audit can be, come build it with us.

title: Intern, Automation Engineer
description:
About Workato

Workato is the leading Control and Execution Platform for Enterprise AI — the neutral platform enterprises trust to put AI to work across their business. Workato unifies data, applications, and processes into a single platform so AI can reliably orchestrate business processes in production at enterprise scale. Built on more than a decade of running mission-critical processes for over half the Fortune 500 — including Nasdaq, Amazon, Cisco, Vodafone, Atlassian, and Lucid Motors — Workato turns over 14,000 enterprise systems AI needs to act on into one governed execution layer. For more information, visit workato.com .

Why join us?

Ultimately, Workato believes in fostering a flexible, trust-oriented culture that empowers everyone to take full ownership of their roles . We are driven by innovation and looking for team players who want to actively build our company.

But, we also believe in balancing productivity with self-care . That’s why we offer all of our employees a vibrant and dynamic work environment along with a multitude of benefits they can enjoy inside and outside of their work lives.

If this sounds right up your alley, please submit an application. We look forward to getting to know you!

Also, feel free to check out why:

•
Business Insider named us an “enterprise startup to bet your career on”

•
Forbes’ Cloud 100 recognized us as one of the top 100 private cloud companies in the world

•
Deloitte Tech Fast 500 ranked us as the 17th fastest growing tech company in the Bay Area, and 96th in North America

•
Quartz ranked us the #1 best company for remote workers

Responsibilities

We are looking for an exceptional Automation Engineer Intern to join our team. In this role, you will support the SaaS applications and platforms that power our demo and field environments, investigating access issues, misconfigurations, and recurring requests. You will focus on identifying root causes, developing lasting solutions, and documenting your findings. Working alongside Automation Engineers and Field Systems Analysts, you will receive regular mentorship, take ownership of well-scoped problems, and identify opportunities to automate repetitive work using Workato.

In this role, you will also be responsible for:

•
Assist with acquiring and setting up SaaS, PaaS, and IaaS platforms for demos and proofs of concept, including Salesforce, SAP, Workday, NetSuite, ServiceNow, Snowflake, AWS, and GCP, ensuring environments meet user requirements.

•
Collaborate with technical teams to keep demo applications integrated and functioning as expected.

•
Administer demo applications by adding users, configuring permissions, and assigning licenses.

•
Support complex application configurations and verify that they align with organizational requirements.

•
Review application settings regularly to help maintain performance and security.

•
Support users in accessing demo environments and applications, serving as the first point of contact for their requests.

•
Investigate and troubleshoot access problems, misconfigurations, and failed logins, identifying root causes and recommending lasting solutions.

•
Assist with routine governance activities, including access reviews, license tracking, and compliance checks, and flag any anomalies.

•
Identify recurring issues and repetitive manual tasks, and propose or help build automations and tools on Workato to manage demo infrastructure.

•
Help build and maintain environments that support high-quality Workato product demonstrations.

•
Document troubleshooting steps, configurations, and how-to guides to make solutions repeatable.

•
Keep stakeholders informed of request status and escalate blockers promptly.

•
Share findings and lessons learned with the team, including approaches tried and their outcomes.

Requirements

Qualifications / Experience / Technical Skills

•
Degree in Information Systems, Computer Science, Engineering, or a related field.

•
Demonstrated problem-solving ability through coursework, projects, work, or personal experience involving the diagnosis and resolution of a complex issue.

•
Hands-on exposure to at least one SaaS application or administration console, such as Google Workspace, Slack, Salesforce, Okta, or Jira.

•
Basic understanding of user access concepts, including roles, permissions, and least privilege.

•
Professional working proficiency in English.

•
Experience delivering a project involving application, integration, or system troubleshooting is a plus.

•
Exposure to cloud platforms such as AWS or GCP, or enterprise applications such as Salesforce, Workday, or NetSuite, is a plus.

•
Familiarity with single sign-on and identity concepts, including SAML, OAuth, and MFA, is a plus.

•
Basic scripting or low-code/no-code automation experience using Workato, Python, or similar tools is a plus.

•
Experience using spreadsheets or data tools for analysis and reporting is a plus.

•
Interest in IT governance, security, or compliance is a plus.

Soft Skills / Personal Characteristics

•
Methodical approach to problem-solving, with a focus on understanding issues and identifying root causes before proposing solutions.

•
Strong analytical mindset, with the ability to gather information from multiple sources, question assumptions, and draw evidence-based conclusions.

•
Persistence when facing blockers, with sound judgment about when to escalate or ask for help.

•
Clear written communication skills, with the ability to explain problems, reasoning, and solutions so others can follow.

•
Strong attention to detail and a consistent habit of verifying work.

title: Backend Engineer (Java)
description:
This is Adyen

Adyen provides payments, data, and financial products in a single solution for customers like Meta, Uber, H&M, and Microsoft - making us the financial technology platform of choice. At Adyen, everything we do is engineered for ambition.

For our teams, we create an environment with opportunities for our people to succeed, backed by the culture and support to ensure they are enabled to truly own their careers. We are motivated individuals who tackle unique technical challenges at scale and solve them as a team. Together, we deliver innovative and ethical solutions that help businesses achieve their ambitions faster.

About the Team

The Payment Gateways team (used to be known as IPP Payments Backend ) is a critical pillar of Adyen’s Core Payments solution. The Core Payments group handles the foundational business logic, diverse payment flows, and global features that empower Adyen’s merchants worldwide.

As part of the Payment Gateways team, you will design and build the infrastructure powering Adyen’s in-store payment experience . This means engineering systems capable of handling massive, simultaneous global traffic while maintaining rock-solid reliability for thousands of physical terminals, mobile devices, and merchant hosts.

What You Will Do

As a Backend Engineer (Java) , you will orchestrate complex payment flows by integrating multiple Adyen systems and defining the unified architecture for our next-generation payment features.

• Design & Deliver: Build, test, and deploy high-volume, low-latency Java applications that form the backbone of our global payment systems.

• Architect for Scale: Collaborate across Data and Platform engineering teams to design highly resilient, scalable services with reliability at their core.

• Own the Technical Lifecycle: Drive engineering best practices, contribute to scalable architecture designs, and actively participate in product roadmap discussions.

• Data-Driven Optimization: Define, implement, and monitor performance KPIs to proactively identify and eliminate system bottlenecks.

• Collaborate Globally: Partner cross-functionally with global product managers and engineers, occasionally collaborating directly with merchants to understand how businesses consume your solutions.

Who You Are

• Java Developer: You have 3-9 years of hands-on experience delivering high-impact backend services using Core Java, web services, and SQL/PostgreSQL , with a proven track record of technical leadership and mentoring junior engineers.

• Scalability: High availability, fault tolerance, and low latency aren't afterthoughts for you—they are non-negotiable architectural prerequisites.

• API Expert: You possess a strong understanding of modern API frameworks (such as REST and OpenAPI), alongside best practices for API security and developer experience.

• Curious & Forward-Thinking: You actively evaluate emerging technologies and alternatives, confidently presenting your findings during architectural reviews.

• Collaborative Communicator: You know how to get things done by actively seeking out diverse perspectives and bringing people together to solve complex problems.

• Customer-Centric: You balance deep technical rigor with genuine Customer Empathy , always keeping the end-merchant's business success in mind.

Our Diversity, Equity and Inclusion commitments

Our unique approach is a product of our diverse perspectives. This diversity of backgrounds and cultures is essential in helping us maintain our momentum. Our business and technical challenges are unique, and we need as many different voices as possible to join us in solving them - voices like yours. No matter who you are or where you’re from, we welcome you to be your true self at Adyen.

Studies show that women and members of underrepresented communities apply for jobs only if they meet 100% of the qualifications. Does this sound like you? If so, Adyen encourages you to reconsider and apply. We look forward to your application!

What’s next?

Ensuring a smooth and enjoyable candidate experience is critical for us. We aim to get back to you regarding your application within 5 business days. Our interview process tends to take about 4 weeks to complete, but may fluctuate depending on the role. Learn more about our hiring process here . Don’t be afraid to let us know if you need more flexibility.

Adyen is an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

All your information will be kept confidential according to EEO guidelines.

This role is based out of our Bengaluru office. We are an office-first company and value in-person collaboration; we do not offer remote-only roles.

title: Emergency Response Manager, APAC
description:
Airbnb was born in 2007 when two hosts welcomed three guests to their San Francisco home, and has since grown to over 5 million hosts who have welcomed over 2 billion guest arrivals in almost every country across the globe. Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

This position is employed by Airbnb Inc., however the role will provide direct support to Airbnb.org, an independent 501(c)(3) nonprofit that focuses on emergency response and provides temporary housing for people in times of crisis. Airbnb.org is governed by an independent Board of Directors and its mission is to provide emergency housing in times of crisis. From Australia to France, hosts have offered to open up their homes and helped provide accommodations to over 250,000 people. Our goal is to exponentially increase Airbnb.org’s reach and impact over the next three years. Learn more at Airbnb.org .

The Difference You Will Make:

You will manage Airbnb.org’s emergency responses in the APAC region but will also be expected to support responses globally as required. You will monitor disasters around the world, decide with your manager when an event meets our activation criteria, stand the response up, and manage it through to close-out.

You will do this work with partners on the ground. Local nonprofits and agencies find displaced people, confirm eligibility, and provide case management. Your job is to make sure those partners are ready before an event, and that during one they have the housing supply, the guidance, and the answers they need. Speed matters, and so does the quality of the placement.

You will run several responses at the same time, in different countries and at different stages. You will keep internal teams and external partners informed before they have to ask. You will work across Operations, Strategic Partnerships, Marketing, Communications, Legal, Finance, and Product to deliver one coordinated response.

Reporting to the Senior Lead of Global Emergency Response, this position requires a background in humanitarian and disaster response operations, strong leadership, and expertise in building effective partnerships with nonprofits and government agencies. Experience in Social Impact for tech companies is a big plus. Much of the work is not defined in advance. You will need to set direction yourself, decide with incomplete information, and move things toward clarity and action. You must also be able to deploy to the field on short notice to manage disaster response programs on the ground if needed.

A Typical Day:

• Monitor global disasters via news, partner alerts, government advisories, and internal signals to assess and recommend responses based on Airbnb.org criteria.

• Establish, activate, and oversee emergency housing responses in close collaboration with on-the-ground partners responsible for the intake and case management of individuals displaced by disasters.

• Oversee diverse, simultaneous disaster responses. Set priorities across them, and hold an accurate record of status, spend, and the number of people housed.

• Proactively communicate status, decisions, and next steps to internal and external cross-functional stakeholders and partners.

• Manage each response end-to-end: verify partner readiness, determine response size and stay lengths, launch operations, monitor placements, solve issues, and conclude based on clear exit criteria.

• Manage partnerships (including onboarding new partners and managing existing partners) during active emergencies, and ensuring smooth handoff to the Partnerships team at the conclusion of emergency responses.

• Promptly answer partner questions during live responses, escalating unresolved ones.

• Work closely with the Partnerships team to build and manage partnerships with organizations that vet and support guests, while working with our Operations team to optimize housing supply, reduce costs, and maximize positive impact for those affected.

• Collaborate with the Strategic Partnerships team to unify efforts and amplify our reach in response to major disasters.

• Enhance operational readiness during non-crisis periods. Sharpen activation criteria and playbooks, pre-position partner agreements, expand 24/7 global coverage, increase team capacity, and advocate for the product features the operation needs.

• Integrate best practices from experts and agencies, and cultivate relationships with government bodies and emergency management authorities in key regions before an event happens.

• Deploy to disaster zones on short notice to manage ground operations, and hand over cleanly when you leave.

• Write the after-action review for each response, and make sure the changes it calls for actually happen.

Your Expertise:

• Min 8-16 years of experience in US / APAC or International emergency and disaster response operations, with a focus on managing large-scale programs.

• Direct experience activating and running disaster responses end to end. Experience working in Social Impact at tech companies is a big plus.

• Strong track record of building and maintaining partnerships with nonprofits, government agencies, and key stakeholders.

• Clear, timely, and proactive communication with internal and external cross-functional stakeholders and partners, in writing and in person.

• A proactive self-starter. You take initiative, move work toward clarity and action with limited direction, and you are comfortable with ambiguity.

• Proven ability to manage multiple work streams at the same time in a matrixed organization.

• Strong execution skills for delivering on organizational goals.

• Excellent leadership and communication skills, with the ability to influence across functions and teams you do not manage.

• Adaptability, and the ability to make sound decisions at speed in fast-paced, high-pressure environments.

• Willingness to travel on short notice for up to 30-50% of the year, with the ability to remain flexible regarding the length of stays.

Our investigators and agents review high-risk activity every day, and the quality of their tools directly shapes the speed, accuracy, and consistency of every decision they make. You will join a team of operators, analysts, and program leaders who partner closely with Platform, Engineering, Data Science, Design, and Legal to keep our community safe.

The Difference You Will Make

As the Senior Risk Tools & Automation Lead, you will own the end-to-end agent experience for risk and fraud operations. You will define what our investigators need, design and conceptualize the next generation of the risk workbench, and drive automation through process efficiencies and AI. You will be the voice of the agent in tooling decisions and the bridge between operational reality and technical execution. Your work will reduce manual effort, shorten handle times, improve decision quality, and free our experts to focus on the most complex cases.

A Typical Day

Agent experience

• Own the end-to-end agent experience across risk and fraud investigation workflows, from case intake through decision, documentation, and quality review.

• Spend time with agents to observe workflows, map pain points, and quantify friction in handle time, clicks, context switching, and error rates.

• Establish feedback loops (surveys, office hours, champion networks, ticket intake) so agent needs are captured, prioritized, and closed out transparently.

• Partner with Training, Quality, and Workforce Management to ensure tooling changes land with clear enablement, documentation, and adoption tracking.

Tooling requirements and improvements

• Translate operational needs into clear, prioritized business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that Platform and Engineering can build against.

• Own and manage the operational risk tooling roadmap and backlog, balancing quick wins, foundational investments, and policy or regulatory needs.

• Lead intake, triage, and prioritization of tooling requests using impact sizing (time saved, loss prevented, accuracy gained, risk reduced).

• Drive user acceptance testing (UAT), launch readiness, and post-launch measurement for every tooling release.

Workbench design and conceptualization

• Define the long-term vision for a unified risk workbench that brings signals, account history, payment data, linked entities, and decisioning into a single, intuitive workspace.

• Partner with Platform, Design, and UX Research to run discovery, build journey maps, create wireframes and prototypes, and conduct usability testing with agents.

• Champion design principles of simplicity, consistency, and accessibility so agents can make accurate decisions quickly and confidently.

Automation through efficiencies and AI

• Identify, size, and prioritize automation opportunities across manual and repetitive work, including case routing, data gathering, enrichment, summarization, and low-risk decisioning.

• Partner with Platform, Engineering, and Data Science to design and deploy AI-assisted capabilities such as case summaries, recommended actions, agent copilots, and automated documentation.

• Define human-in-the-loop guardrails, quality controls, and monitoring so automation improves efficiency without compromising accuracy, fairness, or compliance.

• Build business cases that tie automation to measurable outcomes and report progress to senior leadership.

Cross-functional leadership

• Serve as the primary operations policy partner to Platform, Engineering, Data Science, Design, Policy, Legal, Compliance, and Finance on all risk tooling initiatives.

• Influence without authority, align technical and non-technical stakeholders on priorities, tradeoffs, and timelines.

• Communicate roadmaps, launches, and impact clearly to audiences ranging from frontline agents to executive leadership.

• 10+ years of experience in operations, program management, or product management.

• 5+ years of experience in fraud, payment risk, trust and safety, or a related investigations industry.

• Bachelor's degree required; Master's degree preferred.

• Proven track record of writing successful business requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria that led to shipped tools with measurable impact.

• Familiarity with user experience testing and design, including discovery interviews, journey mapping, usability testing, and working from wireframes or prototypes.

• Demonstrated success in cross-functional collaboration with both technical partners (Engineering, Data Science, Platform) and non-technical partners (Operations, Legal, Compliance, Finance).

• Experience identifying and delivering automation or process efficiency improvements at scale, with results tied to metrics such as handle time, throughput, accuracy, or loss.

• Strong analytical skills, with comfort using data to size opportunities, build business cases, and measure outcomes (SQL or similar skills a plus).

• Excellent written and verbal communication, with the ability to simplify complex technical and operational concepts for executive audiences.

Preferred Qualifications

• Hands-on experience designing or launching agent workbenches, case management systems, or investigation consoles.

• Experience applying generative AI or large language models in operational settings, such as agent copilots, case summarization, or automated decision support.

• Working knowledge of fraud and risk domains such as payment fraud, chargebacks, account takeover, identity verification, or AML.

• Familiarity with workflow and automation platforms (for example, rules engines, RPA, or low-code tools) and with agile delivery practices.

• Experience leading change management and driving adoption across large, globally distributed operations teams.

title: Systems Engineer, Tech Foundations (Jira cloud)
description:

Every day, hosts offer unique stays and experiences that make it possible for guests to connect with communities in a more authentic way.

The Community You Will Join:

The world is changing how it works; not just in where we do it, but in how fast and how well we can do it. Airbnb has already shown that we can move with speed and intention. We navigated a pandemic, rebuilt our company from the ground up, had a successful IPO, and shipped product upgrades – all while working remotely. That experience didn't just change where we work. It changed what we believe is possible.
Now, a new shift is underway. AI is fundamentally changing the leverage available to every team – compressing timelines, breaking down traditional job description silos, raising the ceiling on quality, and enabling small, focused groups to accomplish what once required much larger ones. At Airbnb, we are not treating AI as a future consideration. We are moving fast to embed it into how we operate today – using it to multiply the impact of every employee, every system, and decisions we make every day. The companies and teams that embrace this shift with urgency and discipline will define what's possible in the years ahead. We intend to be one of them.

The Difference You Will Make:

The Systems Engineer is a hands-on builder who moves fast, delivers with quality, and uses AI as a force multiplier in day-to-day work. In this role, you will configure, maintain, and continuously improve Airbnb's Atlassian platforms, and you will own end-to-end delivery of defined projects within the Jira Data Center deprecation and transition to Jira Cloud. You will work autonomously on projects that span several components and may not be fully defined, partnering with senior engineers and your manager to shape the details. You will spot where AI and automation can reduce toil and improve reliability for the teams we serve, then build those improvements. You bring solid platform knowledge, sound technical judgment within your domain, and the curiosity to grow toward senior-level scope.

Support and maintain Airbnb's custom Forge applications in partnership with supporting systems engineering teams

• Participate in Agile ceremonies (sprint planning, retrospectives, standups) for platform-focused workstreams

• Participate in the on-call rotation, respond to Atlassian platform incidents, and contribute to post-incident reviews

• Identify and reduce technical debt over time; provide constructive input in design and configuration reviews, and help teammates learn through specific examples and timely feedback

• Solid working knowledge of Jira workflow design, including post functions, validators, and conditions; strong command of JQL for filters, subscriptions, dashboards, and board configuration

• Hands-on experience contributing to Jira migrations (Data Center to Cloud), including project configuration migration and data integrity validation
