title: Applied AI Architect
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As an Applied AI team member at Anthropic India, you will be a Pre-Sales architect focused on becoming a trusted technical advisor helping large enterprises across India and the Asia-Pacific region understand the value of Claude and paint the vision on how they can successfully integrate and deploy Claude into their technology stack. You'll combine your deep technical expertise with customer-facing skills to architect innovative LLM solutions that address complex business challenges while maintaining our high standards for safety and reliability.

Working closely with our Sales, Product, and Engineering teams, you'll guide customers from initial technical discovery through successful deployment. You'll leverage your expertise to help customers understand Claude's capabilities, develop evals, and design scalable architectures that maximize the value of our AI systems.

Responsibilities:

•
Partner with account executives to deeply understand customer requirements and translate them into technical solutions, ensuring alignment between business objectives and technical implementation

•
Serve as the primary technical advisor to enterprise customers throughout their Claude adoption journey, from discovery to initial evaluation through deployment. You will need to coordinate internally across multiple teams & stakeholders to drive customer success

•
Support customers building with both the Claude API and Claude for Work

•
Create and deliver compelling technical content tailored to different audiences. You will need to be able to spread the gamut from technical deep dives for engineering & development teams up to business value focused conversations with executives

•
Guide technical architecture decisions and help customers integrate Claude effectively into their existing technology stack

•
Help customers develop evaluation frameworks to measure Claude's performance for their specific use cases

•
Identify common integration patterns and contribute insights back to our Product and Engineering teams

•
Travel occasionally within India and the APAC region to customer sites for workshops, technical deep dives, and relationship building

•
Maintain strong knowledge of the latest developments in LLM capabilities and implementation patterns

•
Collaborate across time zones with global teams while serving as the technical expert for the India market

You may be a good fit if you have:

•
10+ years of experience in technical customer-facing roles such as Solutions Architect, Sales Engineer, or Technical Account Manager

•
Experience working with enterprise customers in India or the APAC region, navigating complex buying cycles involving multiple stakeholders

•
Exceptional ability to build relationships with and communicate technical concepts to diverse stakeholders to include C-suite executives, engineering & IT teams, and more

•
Strong technical communication skills with the ability to translate customer requirements between technical and business stakeholders

•
Experience designing scalable cloud architectures and integrating with enterprise systems

•
Comfortable with Python

•
Familiarity with common LLM frameworks and tools or a background in machine learning or data science

•
Excitement for engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

•
A love of teaching, mentoring, and helping others succeed

•
Excellent communication and interpersonal skills, able to convey complicated topics in easily understandable terms to a diverse set of external and internal stakeholders. You enjoy engaging in cross-organizational collaboration, working through trade-offs, and balancing competing priorities

•
Passion for thinking creatively about how to use technology in a way that is safe and beneficial, and ultimately furthers the goal of advancing safe AI systems

•
Ability to work effectively across cultures and time zones as part of a global team

Logistics

Minimum education: Bachelor’s degree or an equivalent combination of education, training, and/or experience

Required field of study: A field relevant to the role as demonstrated through coursework, training, or professional experience

Minimum years of experience: Years of experience required will correlate with the internal job level requirements for the position

Location-based hybrid policy: Currently, we expect all staff to be in one of our offices at least 25% of the time. However, some roles may require more time in our offices.

Visa sponsorship: We do sponsor visas! However, we aren't able to successfully sponsor visas for every role and every candidate. But if we make you an offer, we will make every reasonable effort to get you a visa, and we retain an immigration lawyer to help with this.

For roles performing work in California: We will consider for employment all qualified applicants, including those with arrest or conviction records or criminal histories, in a manner consistent with the requirements of applicable state and local laws, including the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance, the City of Los Angeles’ Fair Chance Initiative for Hiring Ordinance, the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers, and the California Fair Chance Act.

We encourage you to apply even if you do not believe you meet every single qualification. Not all strong candidates will meet every single qualification as listed. Research shows that people who identify as being from underrepresented groups are more prone to experiencing imposter syndrome and doubting the strength of their candidacy, so we urge you not to exclude yourself prematurely and to submit an application if you're interested in this work. We think AI systems like the ones we're building have enormous social and ethical implications. We think this makes representation even more important, and we strive to include a range of diverse perspectives on our team.

Your safety matters to us. To protect yourself from potential scams, remember that Anthropic recruiters only contact you from @anthropic.com email addresses. In some cases, we may partner with vetted recruiting agencies who will identify themselves as working on behalf of Anthropic. Be cautious of emails from other domains. Legitimate Anthropic recruiters will never ask for money, fees, or banking information before your first day. If you're ever unsure about a communication, don't click any links—visit anthropic.com/careers directly for confirmed position openings.

How we're different

We believe that the highest-impact AI research will be big science. At Anthropic we work as a single cohesive team on just a few large-scale research efforts. And we value impact — advancing our long-term goals of steerable, trustworthy AI — rather than work on smaller and more specific puzzles. We view AI research as an empirical science, which has as much in common with physics and biology as with traditional efforts in computer science. We're an extremely collaborative group, and we host frequent research discussions to ensure that we are pursuing the highest-impact work at any given time. As such, we greatly value communication skills.

The easiest way to understand our research directions is to read our recent research. This research continues many of the directions our team worked on prior to Anthropic, including: GPT-3, Circuit-Based Interpretability, Multimodal Neurons, Scaling Laws, AI & Compute, Concrete Problems in AI Safety, and Learning from Human Preferences.

Come work with us!

Anthropic is a public benefit corporation headquartered in San Francisco. We offer competitive compensation and benefits, optional equity donation matching, generous vacation and parental leave, flexible working hours, and a lovely office space in which to collaborate with colleagues. Guidance on Candidates' AI Usage: Learn about our policy for using AI in our application process.

title: Regional Research Economist, Economic Research
description:
About Anthropic

Anthropic’s mission is to create reliable, interpretable, and steerable AI systems. We want AI to be safe and beneficial for our users and for society as a whole. Our team is a quickly growing group of committed researchers, engineers, policy experts, and business leaders working together to build beneficial AI systems.

About the role

As a Regional Research Economist at Anthropic, you will collaborate with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region to measure and understand AI’s effects on the economy and explore research-driven policy interventions. You will contribute to the development of the Anthropic Economic Index and its extension to generate regionally relevant insights, establish new methodologies to measure the usage, diffusion, and impact of AI throughout the economy, and work to broaden access to and usage of the insights generated by the Index. You will use frontier methods in econometrics, machine learning, and structural estimation. Such rigor will drive impact, shaping both policy discussions externally and informing Anthropic’s internal business and product decisions.

Our team combines rigorous empirical methods with novel measurement approaches. We’re building first-of-its-kind datasets tracking AI’s impact on labor markets, productivity, and economic transformation. Using our privacy-preserving measurement system ( Clio ), we analyze millions of real-world AI interactions to understand how AI augments and automates work across different occupations and tasks.

For this role, we’re looking for candidates who can combine rigorous economic analysis with novel measurement approaches to understand AI’s transformative effects on the economy. The ideal candidate will be comfortable working at the intersection of empirical economics, technological change, and policy impact.

Key responsibilities

• Build and maintain relationships with academic institutions, policy think tanks, and other research partners as the primary point of contact for these organizations on economic impact work in your region

• Advance research collaborations that answer country- or regional-specific economic impact questions

• Translate research insights into actionable recommendations for policy discussions

• Make fundamental contributions to the development and expansion of the Anthropic Economic Index , including country- and regional-specific analysis

• Design and collaborate on empirical research on AI’s economic effects with governments, academia, industry, and civil society in your region

title: Member of Technical Staff (Senior - Specialized Indexing)
description:
Category-defining tech. Career-defining work.

For more than a decade, Cockroach Labs has built database technology trusted to power some of the world's most mission-critical applications. Now, as AI transforms how software is created and operated, the infrastructure behind it has to keep pace. Cockroach Continuum is built to meet this moment, bringing individual databases together into one fleet designed for agentic applications, where AI agents help teams provision, scale, and optimize workloads at machine speed.

At Cockroach Labs, you'll solve problems that didn't exist five years ago alongside people who believe the simplest solutions often require the most sophisticated thinking. Your work will run in production at some of the most innovative companies in the world. The people who thrive here are the ones who want to own that opportunity.

The Role

The SQL Queries team is responsible for the core of CockroachDB’s query execution and optimization layer. This group designs and delivers features that make our distributed SQL engine fast, reliable, and flexible for a wide range of workloads.

AI is transforming how we search, learn, and build, and databases are evolving to keep up.

We’re forming a new Specialized Indexing subteam within SQL Queries to expand CockroachDB’s indexing capabilities beyond traditional relational workloads. This team will design and implement high-performance indexing systems such as vector, full-text, and geospatial indexes to support the next generation of AI-native and search-driven applications .

As part of this team, you’ll work on deep systems problems, collaborate across the SQL organization, and build production-quality features that make CockroachDB a unified platform for both structured and unstructured data.

You Will

• Design, build, and maintain specialized indexing features for CockroachDB, including vector , full-text, and geospatial indexing.

• Improve the performance and reliability of existing vector indexing systems, including backfill, query planning, and import workflows.

• Partner with other database teams to integrate new indexing mechanisms into the query engine.

• Develop hybrid search capabilities that combine vector similarity and text-based search for modern AI and search workloads.

• Participate in design discussions, code reviews, and release planning within the SQL organization.

• Take full ownership of your work, from design through implementation, testing, and release.

The Expectations

In your first month , you’ll get familiar with CockroachDB’s SQL architecture, vector indexing implementation, and the surrounding systems. You’ll also begin contributing to smaller improvements and fixes.

Within three months , you’ll take ownership of components related to specialized indexing, making measurable improvements to performance and reliability.

After six months , you’ll play a key role in advancing hybrid search capabilities and help shape the roadmap for future indexing and search features.

You Have

• Passion for databases, indexing systems, and high-performance distributed architectures .

• A strong background in backend or systems programming, preferably with Go, C/C++, or Rust .

• Experience working on indexing or query execution systems such as vector, text, or spatial search.

• Solid understanding of data structures, algorithms, and distributed systems .

• Curiosity about AI-driven and hybrid workloads that combine structured and unstructured data.

• A focus on building reliable, maintainable, and high-performance software.

• Collaborative mindset and ability to work effectively with a distributed global team.

• Typically 10+ years of experience building large-scale, production-grade systems.

• Demonstrated ability to translate ambiguous problems into scalable, production-grade AI-enabled solutions.

• A builder's instinct for reuse and extensibility — your output becomes a platform, pattern, or capability others depend on.

• Clear judgment about where AI should be deeply integrated and where traditional approaches are more reliable.

The Team

The SQL Queries team is one of the most impactful and technically challenging groups at Cockroach Labs. Joining the Specialized Indexing subteam means working at the frontier of databases and AI, helping shape how CockroachDB powers intelligent, hybrid applications.

You’ll be part of a small, autonomous team based in India, collaborating with engineers and leaders across the world. You’ll have the chance to own complex, high-visibility features that directly influence how customers use CockroachDB.

If you’re excited about building innovative systems that push the boundaries of what a database can do, we’d love to meet you.

Cockroach Labs is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer building a diverse and inclusive workforce. If you need additional accommodations to feel comfortable during your interview process, please email us at accessibility@cockroachlabs.com .

Cockroach Labs has a hybrid work model, with Roachers that are local to one of our offices coming in on Mondays, Thursdays, and Fridays and working flexibly the rest of the week. While we’ve learned valuable lessons working remotely, nothing can replace the connection, creativity, and fun that occurs when Roachers get together and we are committed to fostering a workplace that encourages collaboration and allows us all to do our best work.

• Flexible Time Off

• Paid Parental Leave

• Mental Wellbeing Benefits

• Internet Reimbursement

• Wellness Allowance

• Food Allowance

• Office Commute Reimbursement

• And more!

description:

The bar is high, the environment is intense, and we like it that way. This isn't a place for complacency, it’s a place to be pushed past your perceived limits. If you're ready to build the future of finance alongside people who refuse to settle for "good enough," you belong here. Coinbase is a remote-first, but not remote-only company. Expect to get together quarterly for intense in-person working sessions called “surges.” Learn more about working at Coinbase .

The CX Intelligence team is part of Coinbase’s Enterprise Applications and Architecture org and builds the customer-facing and internal CX experiences that connect the Help Center, chatbots (CBCB), and agent workflows. The team owns the multi-agent platform that powers Coinbase chat, Help Center, and agent tooling, partnering closely with Conversation Design, CX, and engineering teams to deliver secure, compliant, and scalable AI-powered support. Our work helps customers get answers faster while enabling agents to resolve cases more effectively.

We are hiring an IC4 Machine Learning Engineer to help evolve our conversational ecosystem by building a seamless hybrid vendor-internal chatbot experience. You will contribute to the design and implementation of a unified orchestration layer that coordinates interactions between vendor AI, internal multi-agent systems, and human participants. This role is ideal for someone who enjoys solving complex ML systems problems, building reliable handoff logic across LLM frameworks, and shipping AI-enabled products that are measurable and scalable.

What you'll do:

•
Build and improve the orchestration layer that manages state transitions, context sharing, and intent routing across vendor and internal LLM frameworks in a distributed conversational environment.

•
Develop production-grade Python services that bridge advanced AI and ML capabilities with reliable customer-facing products.

Drive well-scoped ML projects from design through delivery, balancing technical trade-offs and collaborating across teams.

Contribute to system design, coding standards, and AI/ML development best practices across the team.

The Opportunity:

The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer is the senior technical authority responsible for connecting governed enterprise data and business meaning with scalable analytics and artificial intelligence solutions. This role defines the architecture, standards, and engineering patterns for semantic models, governed metrics, AI-ready data products, machine learning operations, and generative AI consumption.

Operating at the intersection of Analytics, Data Engineering, Data Science, Governance, and AI Platform Engineering, this role ensures that enterprise data, metrics, models, and knowledge assets can be reliably discovered, understood, deployed, monitored, and reused. The Principal AI & Semantic Engineer provides hands-on technical leadership, guides complex implementations, and mentors engineers and analysts while remaining an individual contributor.

What you’ll do…

Semantic Architecture & Governed Metrics

• Define enterprise standards and reference patterns for semantic models, dimensional models, business metrics, KPIs, hierarchies, calculations, and reusable analytical assets.

• Architect semantic consumption patterns across Microsoft Fabric, Power BI, Databricks Gold-layer data, and approved AI applications.

• Partner with business domain owners, analysts, and Data Governance to translate business concepts into consistent, governed definitions and analytical models.

• Lead design reviews for semantic models and analytical data products, balancing usability, reuse, performance, security, and maintainability.

• Ensure semantic assets are documented with appropriate metadata, lineage, ownership, and change controls.

AI Engineering & MLOps

• Define engineering standards for deploying, versioning, testing, monitoring, and governing machine learning and generative AI solutions.

• Architect reusable MLand LLM patterns, including CI/CD, model and prompt versioning, experiment tracking, evaluation, observability, rollback, and production support.

• Guide implementation of feature pipelines, model registries, inference workflows, retrieval pipelines, vectorized knowledge assets, and AI evaluation frameworks.

• Partner with Data Scientists and AI product teams to move prototypes into secure, scalable, and supportable production services.

• Implement technical controls for traceability, reproducibility, model performance, data drift, responsible AI requirements, and operational reliability.

AI-Ready Data & Knowledge Enablement

• Design curated, governed data products and knowledge assets for predictive analytics, generative AI, copilots, agents, and retrieval-augmented generation.

• Define how structured data, enterprise metrics, metadata, documents, embeddings, and retrieval indexes are linked and consumed.

• Ensure AI applications use approved business definitions, metrics, access policies, and authoritative data sources.

• Collaborate with Architecture and Governance teams on ontology, glossary, metadata, lineage, classification, and policy integration.

Technical Leadership & Collaboration

• Serve as the technical escalation point for complex semantic, analytics, MLOps, and AI engineering decisions.

• Create reference implementations, reusable frameworks, coding standards, and engineering playbooks.

• Mentor Senior Analytics & AI Engineers, Semantic Engineers, Data Analysts, and Data Scientists.

• Influence cross-functional roadmaps and communicate architecture decisions, trade-offs, risks, and business outcomes to technical and executive audiences.

Evaluate emerging technologies and recommend pragmatic adoption paths aligned with enterprise architecture and governance standards.

Who you are?

• 10+ years of experience across analytics engineering, business intelligence, semantic modeling, data engineering, machine learning engineering, MLOps, or related disciplines.

• Demonstrated experience serving as a principal-level technical leader or architect for enterprise data, analytics, or AI solutions.

• Deep expertise in SQL, dimensional modeling, semantic model design, analytical performance optimization, and governed metric implementation.

• Hands-on experience with Microsoft Power BI and/or Microsoft Fabric semantic models, including DAX and enterprise-scale model design.

• Hands-on experience with Databricks or a comparable cloud data and AI platform, including production data pipelines and model lifecycle capabilities.

• Experience designing or operating CI/CD, experiment tracking, model registries, monitoring, evaluation, and observability for ML or generative AI solutions.

• Working knowledge of generative AI patterns such as embeddings, vector retrieval, RAG, prompt and model evaluation, and agent-based solutions.

• Strong understanding of metadata, lineage, data quality, access control, business glossary, and responsible AI principles.

• Proven ability to mentor technical professionals, lead architecture reviews, and influence stakeholders without direct authority.

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, Data Science, Information Systems, or a related field; equivalent practical experience will be considered.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with Microsoft Purview, Unity Catalog, MLflow, Azure DevOps or GitHub Actions, and cloud observability tooling.

• Experience supporting enterprise Finance, GTM, Product, Customer, or Workforce analytics domains.

• Experience establishing reusable semantic or AI platform capabilities in a federated operating model.

The Opportunity:

The Sr Analyst - Procurement Operations plays a critical role in enabling procurement operational excellence through data governance, system administration support, reporting, compliance monitoring, and continuous process improvement. This highly analytical, detail-oriented individual contributor serves as a steward of procurement data, systems, workflows, controls, and reporting accuracy across the enterprise.

This role is responsible for maintaining the integrity of procurement platforms and related data structures, ensuring audit readiness, monitoring compliance with procurement policies and delegated authority frameworks, and delivering actionable insights that improve transparency, governance, and business decision-making. The Procurement Data Analyst partners closely with Procurement, Finance, Accounting, Internal Audit, Legal, Information Security, Business Technology, and other cross-functional stakeholders to strengthen operational controls, improve process effectiveness, and support enterprise risk management objectives.

Unlike traditional procurement roles focused on sourcing, contracting, supplier negotiations, or category management, this position is centered on procurement operations, analytics, governance, controls, reporting, and technology enablement. The successful candidate will combine strong analytical skills, business acumen, and technical expertise to identify risks, uncover process inefficiencies, improve data quality, and support ongoing transformation initiatives across the procurement function.

What you’ll do…

Procurement Data Governance & System Integrity

• Serve as a primary steward of procurement master data, ensuring accuracy, completeness, consistency, and integrity across procurement systems and platforms.

• Maintain and monitor supplier records, procurement hierarchies, approval structures, delegated authority matrices, user permissions, organizational relationships, and workflow configurations.

• Conduct recurring data quality reviews to identify duplicate records, incomplete data, stale records, policy violations, approval anomalies, and system inconsistencies.

• Support procurement technology governance activities by evaluating system configurations, controls, and operational effectiveness.

• Develop and maintain governance standards related to procurement data management, user access, and system administration support.

Operational Reporting & Analytics

• Create recurring and ad hoc reports that provide visibility into procurement activity, workflow performance, stakeholder adoption, approval cycle times, supplier onboarding metrics, and policy compliance.

• Monitor reporting accuracy and consistency to ensure executive decision-making is supported by reliable and trustworthy data.

Compliance, Audit & Controls Management

• Support internal and external audit activities by preparing audit-ready documentation, evidence repositories, reporting packages, and control validation materials.

• Track compliance exceptions and control failures while ensuring timely remediation activities are completed.

• Maintain documentation supporting audit readiness, control design, process ownership, and operational procedures.

• Assist in control effectiveness testing and remediation planning.

Workflow Monitoring & Operational Excellence

• Monitor procurement intake channels, approval workflows, supplier onboarding activities, and operational processes for accuracy, efficiency, and compliance.

• Analyze workflow performance data to identify bottlenecks, delays, approval routing issues, and process inefficiencies.

• Monitor procurement technology adoption rates and user engagement trends.

Process Improvement & Automation

• Support system implementations, upgrades, workflow redesign efforts, and procurement transformation initiatives.

• Participate in user acceptance testing (UAT), validation activities, release testing, and post-implementation support.

• Document business requirements, process maps, operating procedures, and system enhancement recommendations.

Who you are?

• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Finance, Accounting, Supply Chain, Information Systems, Data Analytics, Management Information Systems, Economics, or related field.

• 5+ years of experience in procurement operations, procurement analytics, business operations, governance, compliance, finance operations, data management, or related analytical functions.

• Experience developing dashboards, scorecards, reports, KPIs, and executive-level analytics.

• Advanced Microsoft Excel skills include PivotTables, Power BI, Power Query, complex formulas, and data modeling.

• Experience working with procurement, ERP, workflow, or spend-management platforms. Zip experience is a plus.

title: Enterprise Agentic AI Architect
description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Why join us now?

Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

About the Role

Coursera’s AI adoption has moved fast — engineering teams code AI-first, dozens of internal tools have shipped, and functions across the business are building their own AI agents and automations. The next phase requires something different: a shared technical foundation that lets many teams build safely and cost-effectively at scale, instead of each team solving governance, security, and cost from scratch.

This role owns that foundation. The Senior Agentic AI Architect Lead designs and builds the core architecture that Coursera’s AI Builders and business pods will run on — so that a small team (a Business Product Owner, a Process Expert, an IT Product Owner, and an AI Engineer) can redesign a workflow and ship an AI-native solution in weeks, not months.

This is a hands-on architecture role, not a pure strategy role: you will be building, not just advising.

What You’ll Own

• Context & Semantic Architecture - Design how AI agents access and understand Coursera’s internal data and knowledge, so agents retrieve the right information rather than guessing or over-fetching. Establish reusable patterns for RAG, semantic search, structured data access, and enterprise context, partnering with the Data team on existing data models and pipelines.

• Agentic Architecture & Harness Engineering - Design reusable patterns for agent orchestration, tool use, multi-step workflows, state management, and human-in-the-loop decisions. Build the engineering harness around agents, including testing, evaluation, guardrails, retries, observability, and failure recovery, so agentic solutions are reliable and production-ready.

• Governance Architecture - Build technical guardrails that enforce—not just document—who can build what, what data and systems an agent can access, and what gets logged for audit and review. Establish standards for agent ownership, lifecycle management, and production readiness.

• Security Architecture - Design defenses specific to agentic AI, including agent identity and access control, least-privilege permissions, prompt injection, data leakage, secure credentials, and safe tool execution. Coordinate with Security to extend existing enterprise security standards.

• Self-Serve AI Development (“Vibe Coding”) with CI/CD Automation - Extend and mature Coursera’s self-serve deployment path so AI-assisted, conversational development ships through automated testing, security checks, and evaluation gates—safe by default, not safe by manual gatekeeping.

• LLM Cost & Performance Optimization - Design caching, model routing (matching task complexity to the right-sized model), token and context optimization, and usage monitoring so AI adoption can scale without costs growing linearly. Establish cost, latency, quality, and usage metrics.

• Agent Operating Model & Adoption - Define agent ownership, lifecycle management, production-readiness standards, adoption metrics, and reusable patterns so business teams can scale AI capabilities consistently across functions. Measure success through usage, workflow outcomes, productivity, quality, and business value.

• Architecture Strategy & Execution - Turn ambiguous business problems into scalable technical direction, practical roadmaps, architecture decisions, and production delivery.

• Enterprise Systems & Integration Architecture - Design AI solutions that understand dependencies across enterprise systems, business processes, integrations, and downstream impacts. Establish reusable patterns for APIs, enterprise tools, and Model Context Protocol (MCP) or comparable integration standards where appropriate.

• Production Readiness & Operational Excellence - Establish standards for reliability, observability, incident response, security, operational ownership, and continuous improvement across AI platforms and solutions.

How This Role Works With Others

This role sits at the intersection of four groups and requires strong cross-functional partnership—it does not operate in isolation.

• Engineering Leadership: Partner directly with Engineering leadership to align architecture decisions and share resources and infrastructure where possible, avoiding duplicate build efforts across the company.

• IT: IT owns broader company-wide tooling and platform decisions (procurement, provisioning, cost governance, enterprise policy). Coordinate closely with IT so agentic architecture decisions align with company-wide technical direction rather than creating a parallel, ungoverned stack.

• Data Team: The Data team owns Coursera’s underlying data strategy. Partner with them to ensure context and semantic architecture aligns with existing data models, pipelines, and ownership rather than building a parallel, disconnected data layer for AI.

• Security Team: Design security architecture specific to agentic AI—including access control, prompt injection defense, and credential handling—in coordination with the Security team, which owns broader security standards and policy.

• Business Pods: Enable the 3–4 person pods (Business Product Owner, Process Expert, IT Product Owner, AI Engineer) to redesign workflows, build AI-native solutions, and drive measurable business outcomes using reusable architecture.

• Change Management & Enablement: Help teams adopt AI-enabled workflows through enablement, feedback loops, process redesign, and continuous improvement.

People Leadership

Build, coach, and develop the architecture and engineering capability required to scale the platform. This includes hiring, delegation, technical leadership development, performance management, and creating clear ownership across teams.

Build strong technical leaders who can independently own architecture, delivery, stakeholder alignment, and operational outcomes.

AI Center of Excellence / VP, AI and Operations

Report directly to the VP, AI and Operations, providing regular updates on architecture progress, risks, business impact, and resourcing needs.

What We’re Looking For

Must-Have

• 12+ years of experience with clear progression from engineer to senior/staff engineer to architect leader, including ownership of platforms or infrastructure used by multiple teams—not just individual feature delivery.

• Hands-on experience with agentic AI frameworks and orchestration (e.g., LangGraph or comparable) and familiarity with Model Context Protocol (MCP) or similar standards for connecting AI systems to enterprise data and tools.

• Experience designing agent harnesses, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, testing, observability, and failure recovery for production AI systems.

• Practical experience with enterprise context architecture, RAG, semantic search, or structured data access.

• Practical experience with LLM cost and performance engineering—prompt caching, model routing, token economics—with quantifiable results.

• AI security fundamentals, including access control, data isolation, prompt injection defense, and secure tool execution.

• CI/CD, cloud infrastructure, APIs, and production operations experience.

• Experience defining enterprise AI architecture, reusable platform patterns, operating models, or governance standards across multiple teams.

• Direct people-management experience, including hiring, coaching, delegation, performance development, and building technical leadership capacity.

• Experience measuring AI adoption, productivity, quality, reliability, cost, and business value.

• Hands-on experience taking architecture from design through implementation, deployment, observability, and production operations.

• Strong architecture decision-making and communication skills, with the ability to align technical and business stakeholders around trade-offs involving value, risk, cost, and execution.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

How we work

Job Location - Bangalore

Working hours - 5:30 PM - 2:30 AM IST || 4 AM - 1 PM PST

We let you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

About this role

Coursera’s IT department is responsible for the Corporate tools and technology that are required for the company to operate efficiently and effectively. We are a growing IT department that plays an integral role in the company’s ability to perform its day-to-day tasks. While supporting an ever-growing number of global users with top-tier tools and applications, our IT team is always aiming to achieve the highest goals and produce the best experience possible for our end users.

The Global IT Service Desk Manager plays a pivotal role in overseeing and managing the efficient operation of the IT Service Desk on a global scale. This position requires a strategic leader with strong technical acumen, exceptional communication skills, and a proven track record in managing service delivery in a multinational environment.

About your skills:

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Coursera + Udemy lets you choose the best way to work, whether it’s from home, an office, or a collaboration space. We’re a globally distributed team that comes together intentionally for collaboration, complex problem-solving, and key milestones — creating opportunities for teams to come together. If you’re ready to make a global impact, help scale unique products across Coursera + Udemy, and grow your career, apply below.

What you’ll be doing:

• Lead, guide, and mentor a geographically dispersed team of IT support professionals, fostering a collaborative and inclusive team culture to ensure a consistent end-user experience and maintain operational excellence in IT Service Management through execution of strategic initiatives that create efficiencies and process optimization.

• Streamline IT Service Desk operations by developing and implementing efficient processes, monitoring key performance indicators for continuous improvement, and ensuring timely incident resolution & request fulfillment in accordance with service level agreements (SLAs).

• Support the strategic management of the IT budget, optimizing resources for maximum efficiency, and actively contribute to organizational objectives through participation in strategic planning.

• Lead change by collaborating with cross-functional teams to identify opportunities that improve security, unlock productivity, and accelerate execution and oversee workflow or projects involving the IT Service Desk team.

• Drive global standards, standard operating procedures, user experience enhancement initiatives, and continued digital transformation.

• Oversee and lead the development, execution, and continuous improvement of employee development programs, conduct performance reviews, provide coaching, and establish clear career paths for the ServiceDesk team to enhance individual and collective professional growth.

Qualifications:

• A minimum of 6 years technical support and service management experience with a minimum of 3-4 years in supervisory role is required and ability to provide exceptional internal and external customer care with a Customer first mindset and a “Get it done” attitude.

• Experienced managing Enterprise support in a large and complex environment in a web-based service and technology through principles and practices of the ITIL framework and Service Desk as a Service and a proven track record of making sound decisions under pressure, taking calculated risks, and owning the outcomes, while willingly and effectively accepting high levels of responsibility and being fully accountable for decisions made and actions taken.

• Profound knowledge and proven experience in defining, managing, and exceeding support KPI’s and critical technical support metrics such as CSAT, Time to Resolution (TTR), SLAs, Backlogs, etc.

• Experienced in developing, leading, and executing comprehensive organizational change initiatives from conception to successful implementation, including effectively building commitment and winning support for initiatives, communication, training, and stakeholder engagement strategies.

• Experienced in overseeing relationships with third-party vendors and service providers aligned to asset inventory management and optimization to implement best practices in cost-savings, accuracy, license optimizations, and overall efficiency improvements related to hardware and software assets.

• Skill in oral and written communications to staff and other stakeholders at a variety of levels, ranging from informal meeting discussions to formal presentations and from casual email communications to formal reports.

• A degree or equivalent experience, preferably in Information Technology.

• Extensive experience with configuring & troubleshooting Mac OS & Windows 10 and higher and IT Tools.

• Proficiency in service management tools, demonstrating a high level of competence in leveraging the platform for streamlined service management and support processes.

• Technical and leadership certification such as ITIL 4, CompTIA ITOps, HDAA CHDM, COBIT, PMP, Six Sigma.

About the Team (Job Location - Pune) :

As an AI Platform and LLMOps Engineer, you will join a fast-paced innovation team at Coursera working on AI enablement for our organization and customers. As an internal focus area, this team builds and maintains the infrastructure & tooling required to drive meaningful AI adoption across the organization, providing a platform for non-technical team members to build and deploy tools and transforming entire business functions into AI-native operating models. As a customer-facing focus area, this team builds custom AI-powered solutions tailored for our enterprise customers supporting them in their journey of AI adoption and upskilling beyond just the content on our platforms.

You will own the operational backbone that lets our agentic AI systems run reliably in production — from prompt and pipeline versioning to evaluation, monitoring, incident and cost management. You will work closely with a cross-functional team of Software Engineers, AI Specialists and Product Managers – helping turn promising AI prototypes into reliable, observable, and cost-effective production systems.

Key Responsibilities

• Build and maintain the operational tooling for our LLM-powered systems, including prompt/pipeline versioning, evaluation harnesses, and CI/CD workflows tailored to non-deterministic AI outputs

• Implement monitoring and observability for production LLM systems — tracking latency, token usage, cost per request, output quality, and drift over time

• Design and run automated evaluation suites to catch regressions, hallucinations, and quality degradation before they reach customers

• Manage RAG pipelines and vector store infrastructure, keeping retrieval sources fresh, accurate, and performant

• Implement safety and compliance guardrails — content filtering, PII redaction, and access controls — in line with enterprise data privacy and residency requirements

• Own cost governance for LLM usage: caching strategies, model routing, and usage reporting to keep spend predictable as adoption scales

• Collaborate closely with Product Managers and Senior Engineers to scope operational requirements and translate them into reliable systems

• Participate in sprint planning, technical grooming, and retrospective discussions

Education

• Bachelor’s or Master’s degree in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or a related field

Basic Qualifications

• 4+ years of experience in a software engineering role, with a solid background in Backend Engineering and DevOps fundamentals

• Hands-on experience operating or supporting LLM-powered systems in production (via APIs, RAG pipelines, frontier/open weight/fine-tuned models)

• Proficiency in a backend language such as Python, Java, TypeScript or Go, and familiarity with Docker and container orchestration (Kubernetes)

• Experience implementing APIs, working with SQL and NoSQL databases, and writing automated tests

• Working knowledge of at least one cloud platform (AWS, GCP, or Azure), across both managed and self-hosted services

• Familiarity with infrastructure-as-code (e.g., Terraform) and CI/CD tooling (e.g., GitHub Actions, Jenkins)

• Comfort debugging production issues involving non-deterministic systems, with attention to detail and a bias towards reliability

• Strong belief in engineering quality and building tooling that creates leverage for others

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with LLMOps-specific tooling such as LangFuse, LangSmith, Weights & Biases-style evaluation frameworks, or vector databases like Pinecone, Weaviate, pgvector

• Working knowledge of RAG architectures, MCP implementation & governance, agent orchestration frameworks like LangGraph and LLM Gateways such as LiteLLM, Open Router & enterprise AI ecosystems such as Vertex AI, Bedrock

• Exposure to prompt management and versioning practices treated as code along with model access management, deterministic guardrails and evals

• Understanding of AI governance considerations — data privacy, residency, and compliance in enterprise AI deployments

• Ability to work in a fast-paced, ambiguous environment with a proactive, ownership-driven mindset

• Strong communication skills and comfort collaborating across engineering, product, and strategy functions

Why Join Us?

• Work at the operational core of Coursera's AI transformation — solving problems that keep real production AI systems reliable, safe, and cost-effective

• Build hands-on expertise in one of the fastest-growing and most in-demand engineering disciplines

• Join a supportive, innovative team with a strong culture of continuous learning and improvement

• Be part of a mission-driven company transforming global access to education and upskilling in the AI era

title: Senior AI Specialist
description:
About Coursera + Udemy

Coursera and Udemy are now one company, bringing together two mission-driven brands to create the world’s most powerful platform for turning learning into progress. Together, we help more than 300 million learners and 12,000+ enterprise customers build the skills they need for a world being reshaped by AI. Read more about the combined company by visiting our blog .

Why join us now?

AI is transforming how people learn, work, and grow, and the need for new skills has never been greater. Coursera brings trusted content and credentials from leading university and industry partners, while Udemy brings a dynamic skills marketplace and global network of real-world experts. By combining these strengths, we can connect more people and organizations to the skills they need, when they need them.

Shape what comes next

By joining our team, you’ll have the opportunity to reshape how the world learns and applies skills—and help millions of people participate in the new economy. Bring your ideas, expertise, and perspective to meaningful work that can make a difference at global scale.

Job Overview

Coursera is seeking a Senior AI Specialist to own the technical design and delivery of complex AI applications for business and customer needs. You’ll turn ambiguous requirements into production-grade solutions, working across data exploration, experimentation, architecture, implementation, evaluation, and deployment. This is a hands-on senior IC role: you’ll lead architectural decisions independently, build critical components, and resolve difficult problems across models, agents, applications, and data. You’ll partner with Product Managers, Data Engineers, Software Engineers, LLMOps, and forward-deployed teams to deliver solutions within enterprise and customer environments. Your work will establish reusable approaches and technical standards that improve AI quality, reliability, security, and delivery across projects.

About your skills:

AI Systems Architecture — Design end-to-end applied AI solutions, combining models, retrieval, agentic workflows, and application services while balancing quality, scalability, security, and cost.
AI Delivery & Reliability — Build production grade AI components and reliable data workflows, integrating enterprise data, models, and tools into tested, maintainable applications. Define how AI quality is measured and monitored, using evaluation frameworks, agent tracing
Technical Leadership — Own complex technical decisions, lead design and code reviews, AI evals, and guide cross-functional teams from experimentation through validated production deployment.

What you'll be doing

• Own AI solution architecture - Translate ambiguous requirements into robust system designs, service boundaries, data contracts, and implementation plans. Lead build v/s buy decisions and document trade-offs across model quality, latency, throughput, reliability, security, and cost.

• Architect RAG systems. Design retrieval-augmented generation pipelines using vector databases, sparse and dense retrieval, hybrid search, metadata filtering, and reranking. Define document parsing, chunking, embedding, and indexing strategies.

• Evaluate and fine-tune models . Determine when model adaptation is warranted over prompting or retrieval. Curate training and validation datasets, implement supervised fine-tuning and parameter-efficient techniques such as LoRA, and benchmark against baseline models for task accuracy, safety, latency, and cost.

• Develop AI services and data integrations. Build critical Python/TypeScript services, APIs, and asynchronous workflows. Partner with Data Engineering on ingestion and indexing pipelines, including normalization of customer data, schema validation, incremental updates, lineage, and recovery.

• Build enterprise agentic systems. Develop stateful workflows with task decomposition, planning, multi-step tool use, dynamic tool selection, structured outputs, memory management, and multi-agent orchestration where justified. Build tool and MCP integrations with validated inputs, scoped permissions, and human approval for sensitive actions. Evaluate retrieval and agent quality against defined accuracy and grounding metrics .

• Implement AI security, and governance controls. Implement defenses against prompt injection, sensitive-data leakage, unauthorized tool execution, and retrieval access violations. Contribute threat models, adversarial tests, and evidence for governance reviews. Translate centrally defined policies into application controls for identity, tenant isolation, data residency, retention, and auditability.

• Adapt solutions to enterprise environments. Work with Engineering and forward-deployed teams to implement cloud, hybrid, and customer-controlled deployments.

• AI evaluation and production observability. Define evaluation datasets and measure retrieval quality, groundedness, task completion, tool correctness, latency, and cost. Combine deterministic checks, calibrated LLM-as-judge, and human review. Partner with LLMOps on CI/CD release gates, prompt and model versioning, tracing, and safe rollouts and rollbacks.

• Own technical quality and system reliability. Set and enforce quality standards across the team, with accountability for code quality, maintainability, and production reliability. Lead architecture and code reviews, mentor AI Specialists, and drive root-cause analysis across model, retrieval, application, and data layers. Improve developer productivity through reusable libraries, reference architectures, tooling, and runbooks.

Qualifications

• 6+ years in applied AI, machine learning, or software development, including architecture and production ownership of complex AI systems.

• Experience applying enterprise AI controls , including scoped tool authorization, tenant isolation, PII handling, prompt-injection defenses, audit logging, and human approval for sensitive actions.

• Experience designing enterprise semantic layers or context graphs that connect business entities, relationships, and definitions across systems.

• Strong experience with cloud deployments using GCP/AWS including serverless technologies, CI/CD pipelines using GitHub, Docker and Kubernetes and model platforms such as Vertex AI, Bedrock, etc.

• Familiarity with centralized LLM gateways such as LiteLLM, covering multi-provider routing, fallbacks, rate limits, token budgets, caching, and access policies.

• Production-grade development using Python, TypeScript, and SQL , with typed interfaces, APIs, asynchronous processing, and automated testing.

• Build enterprise agentic systems using LangGraph, Mastra, or equivalent frameworks , including planning, multi-agent orchestration, state and memory management, checkpointing, and failure recovery.

• Applied knowledge of LLM inference and context engineering , including structured outputs, embeddings, hybrid retrieval, reranking, and evaluation-driven model selection or fine-tuning.

• Practical work with Databricks, Spark, and Postgres , spanning analytical and transactional workloads, batch and real-time pipelines, and normalization of messy customer data.

• AI evaluation using Braintrust or equivalent , including golden datasets, custom scorers, regression testing, and calibrated LLM-as-judge to measure task success, tool correctness, safety, and cost.

• Worked on enterprise AI observability layers , including agent traces, model and tool spans, prompt versions, error attribution, latency, token usage, and cost tracking.

Software Engineering - Core competency for designing, developing, and maintaining production-grade systems deployed in customer environments.

AI Fluency - Essential for building and deploying agentic AI solutions and understanding AI capabilities for customer problem-solving.

Customer/Stakeholder Focus - Essential for understanding customer needs, scoping ambiguous problems, and maintaining focus on business impact throughout engagements.

• 1+ years of experience building production-grade agentic AI solutions.

• Experience with backend languages such as Python, Java, or Typescript and technologies such as Docker, Kubernetes, and Kafka, with demonstrated ability to work across the full stack.

• Background in cloud platforms (AWS preferred) and ability to design and operate multi-tenant and hybrid customer-cloud deployment models.

• Experience with data engineering fundamentals including ingesting, cleaning, and normalizing messy, inconsistent customer data across disparate source systems.

• Working knowledge of identity and access management, encryption and key management, and secure network patterns (VPC peering, PrivateLink, mTLS) for customer-embedded or regulated environments.

title: Credit and Collections Manager
description:
GAQ427R213

This Manager role within Databricks’ Credit & Collections organisation is responsible for driving credit strategy, strategic customer collections, AR performance, and complex escalations across a high-growth, usage-based Data/AI business. The role combines financial and commercial judgment with hands-on customer engagement, functional oversight of collection operations, and governance of the outsourced collections model. This is a high-impact opportunity for a CA, CPA, or experienced finance professional to take ownership of credit risk, cash, strategic customer relationships, and AR performance at Databricks scale. This is an individual contributor position with an expectation to be hands-on.

The impact you will have:

• Lead the Credit & Collections function for an assigned scope within Databricks, including credit policies, collection practices, risk mitigation, and escalation protocols

• Own credit assessment, risk reviews, credit limits, payment terms, credit holds/releases, and exception management within the established approval framework

• Make credit recommendations and decisions within delegated authority, balancing credit risk, cash conversion, and commercial considerations

• Personally manage collections strategy and executive-level escalations for strategic and high-value Databricks customers

• Lead resolution of complex disputes, contractual payment issues, and commercially sensitive collection matters

• Own the monthly AR performance framework, including collection targets, cash collected vs. target, CEI, ageing, write-offs, and cash forecasting

title: Deployment Strategist
description:
About the Team

The FDE (Forward Deployed Engineering) team is a new, strategic initiative sponsored from the CEO and Founders down. Our mission is to win C-suite-sponsored, high-value AI opportunities by selling and delivering outcomes , not just a platform.

You will be part of the founding team, embedded with our most strategic customers from the very first sales call, all the way through to a production-ready solution. You will be the "product manager" for the customer's problem, responsible for the "why" and "what," while our FDEs (Engineers) will be your partners responsible for the "how."

Role Description

As a Deployment Strategist (DS), you are the critical bridge between a customer's multi-million-dollar business problem and Databricks' technical solution. You are a product manager for the field, owning the technical and product direction of the engagement from initial discovery through production launch and adoption.

You will build C-suite trust, perform deep discovery to map the customer's political and technical landscape, and scope the value. You will define the Minimum Viable Product for a pilot, write the PRD that guides the engineering team, and manage the project to a successful landing. You will also lead technical discovery, shape solution architecture with FDEs, and ensure that each proposed solution can move from prototype to production.

This role requires a rare combination of executive presence, deep product thinking, technical depth, and a hands-on delivery mindset.

The impact you will have

• C-Suite Scoping & Value Definition: Partner with Sales to perform deep discovery, map the customer's organization, quantify the business value of $10M+ problems, and define the pilot, including its MVP, success criteria, and timeline.

• End-to-End Product Ownership: Author the PRD, prioritize the engineering backlog, manage scope, and act as the primary hands-on QA tester. Translate business requirements into clear data, integration, security, and operational requirements that engineers can build against.

• Technical Solution Leadership & Delivery: Drive the FDE build team through an agile delivery process, manage stakeholders from the C-suite to individual engineers, and unblock technical or organizational issues. Lead technical discovery and design reviews. Understand the customer's data flows, integrations, platform constraints, and operational environment; pressure-test architecture choices; and identify technical risks early.

• Solution Launch & Landing: Own the "Day 0" launch, manage the war room, and drive the solution from launch to full adoption by capturing user feedback, iterating, and proving the defined business value. Own production readiness across data quality, testing, security, performance, and operations. Work with the team to diagnose issues and drive them to resolution.

• Strategic Handoff & Growth: Scope the ongoing maintenance plan, create customer documentation/training, and leverage your trusted advisor status to identify the next high-value FDE engagement. Codify reusable solution patterns and bring field insights back to Product and Engineering.

What we look for

• Executive Presence & Communication: You are a trusted advisor with strong executive presence and excellent communication skills. You are confident and humble, can build rapport quickly, and can help senior stakeholders make difficult decisions.

• Product Judgment & Delivery: You can define what to build and why, write strong product requirements, prioritize engineering work, manage scope, and lead complex agile software projects from an ambiguous problem to a measurable outcome.

• Technical Fluency & Architecture Judgment: You understand modern data and AI architectures, including cloud platforms, data pipelines, data models, distributed systems, APIs, security and governance, machine learning, and generative AI application patterns. You can lead architecture discussions, evaluate trade-offs, and pressure-test technical decisions.

• Hands-on Technical Ability: You are proficient in at least one language such as Python, Java, or SQL. You can explore data, work in notebooks, read and review code and pipelines, build or adapt prototypes, and contribute meaningfully to troubleshooting.

• Relevant Experience: Typically 7+ years of experience delivering complex, customer-facing data, analytics, AI, or software engagements, or equivalent experience as a founder or technical builder. You have helped deliver data, machine learning, or generative AI systems into production and understand the integration, operational, and adoption challenges that appear in real environments. Experience in a high-growth technology company, forward-deployed organization, or leading consultancy is valuable. You enjoy working onsite with customers (often 25-50%, sometimes higher) to drive delivery.

title: Director of Engineering (Data Infrastructure)
description:
(P-1490)

Databricks processes petabytes of data and billions of transaction events daily - every cluster launch, every query executed, every dollar billed flows through infrastructure that must never fail. When we process billions in billing transactions with 99.999% accuracy requirements, when we ingest terabytes per second across 100+ regions, when a five-minute outage costs millions in revenue and customer trust - infrastructure isn't just important, it's existential. The next phase of our growth demands disaster recovery systems that prove reliability rather than hope for it, testing frameworks that catch production-scale problems before deployment, correctness guarantees that make billing errors structurally impossible, and automation that scales operations sublinearly with growth.

In this leadership opportunity, you will build the data infrastructure organization that makes Databricks' continued growth possible. You'll establish foundational teams in Bengaluru owning the bedrock systems that guarantee billing correctness, operational resilience, and zero-downtime recovery across our entire monetization stack, alongside multi-region data ingestion, developer platforms, and deployment automation that eliminate friction at petabyte scale. This isn't about maintaining what exists; it's about architecting the infrastructure that enables Databricks to scale while reducing operational burden. You'll define what world-class infrastructure looks like for the next decade of data platforms.

You will pursue these challenges as a founding technical leader in our fastest-growing engineering hub and strategic partner to global infrastructure leaders. In addition to building world-class teams, you will shape architectural decisions that ripple across the company and champion infrastructure-as-product thinking that transforms infrastructure into force multipliers globally. You'll work in an engineering culture born from Apache Spark and open source, where technical depth matters and infrastructure engineers are celebrated as craftspeople.

The perfect candidate has built infrastructure organizations at companies where five nines weren't simply aspirational, where petabyte-scale wasn't marketing but Monday, and where the infrastructure team's technical leverage determined whether the business could scale or stall. You have the technical depth to debate data architecture, the strategic vision to define multi-year platform roadmaps, the leadership craft to build teams that top engineers want to join, and most importantly, the conviction that data infrastructure done right doesn't just support the business; it defines what's possible.

The impact you’ll have:

• Deliver the infrastructure vision for systems processing billions in daily billing transactions with zero tolerance for error, building disaster recovery that's provably reliable, testing frameworks that catch what production sees, correctness systems that make billing errors structurally impossible, and observability that predicts failures before they happen

• Build Bengaluru's data infrastructure organization by establishing it as the destination for India's top infrastructure talent , hiring multiple engineering managers who become force multipliers, and creating a culture where solving hard distributed systems problems at scale is the daily work

• Own business-critical systems operating 24/7/365 across 100+ regions where even 99.9% uptime means hours of customer pain, driving reliability improvements that prevent millions in revenue loss while eliminating operational toil through frameworks that make systems self-healing, self-tuning, and self-documenting

• Ship platforms that compound engineering leverage across Databricks: correctness frameworks that catch billing errors before customers do, deployment automation that makes regional expansion push-button, data integration systems that process petabyte-scale flows without human intervention, and testing infrastructure where comprehensive coverage is automatic, not heroic

• Position infrastructure as product by treating internal engineering teams as customers with SLAs, measuring adoption and satisfaction, iterating based on feedback, and demonstrating that every dollar invested in infrastructure returns multiplicative gains in product velocity, reliability improvements, or cost reductions

What you’ll need:

• 14+ years in distributed systems engineering with 6+ years leading infrastructure organizations and 4+ years managing managers at companies where infrastructure failures meant immediate revenue impact, customer escalations, or regulatory consequences - and you built the systems and teams that made those failures rare

• Technical depth across petabyte-scale data pipelines and distributed systems reliability where you can engage from "how should we architect multi-region disaster recovery" to "why is this Kafka cluster exhibiting this latency pattern" while knowing when to coach versus when to decide

• Track record defining multi-year infrastructure vision and translating it into sequential deliverables that show value quarterly while building toward architectural end states, positioning infrastructure investments as business enablers rather than cost centers, and making build-vs-buy decisions that compound over time

• Experience building 99.999%+ reliable systems with established practices for SLOs/SLIs, chaos engineering, disaster recovery, and sophisticated observability that predicts failures before they happen

• Proven ability to scale infrastructure organizations in high-growth environments where you've doubled engineering while maintaining quality bar, developed engineering managers, and created teams where retention is high because the problems are interesting and the culture is strong

• Communication skills to make complex infrastructure decisions legible to executives (translating technical investments into business outcomes), influence cross-functional partners without authority, build trust across global teams in different timezones with different working styles, and represent Databricks' technical brand externally

• BS in Computer Science or Engineering; MS or Ph.D. preferred. Experience with Apache Spark, Delta Lake, large-scale data infrastructure, fintech/billing systems, or leading infrastructure through hypergrowth strongly preferred

title: Global SAP Consolidations Manager
description:
GAQ327R292

We're building a finance function that stays ahead of the curve - leveraging AI, automation, and modern tooling to operate at the pace Databricks demands. We are looking for a Global Consolidations Manager to join our Global Accounting team based in India. This is a foundational hire - you will own the end-to-end consolidation and intercompany accounting process across Databricks' 23-entity global footprint, build deep SAP Group Reporting expertise during our S/4HANA implementation, and establish the permanent organisational capability that scales with the business post go-live.

This role blends hands-on consolidation execution with technical accounting judgment. As part of the Global Accounting organisation, you will ensure the accurate and timely production of consolidated financial statements under both US GAAP and IFRS, while partnering closely with International Accounting, Corporate Accounting, Tax, and FP&A to drive close integrity across all reporting frameworks.

The impact you will have:

• Own and execute the global consolidation process end-to-end - intercompany reconciliation, elimination entries, currency translation, and multi-entity roll-up across our 23-entity footprint.

• Lead multi-GAAP close execution, producing parallel US GAAP and IFRS consolidated books each period, identifying and documenting reconciling differences for audit and leadership review.

• Deep understanding of US GAAP consolidation requirements (ASC 810, ASC 830) and working knowledge of IFRS consolidation standards (IFRS 10, IAS 21). Multi-GAAP reporting experience is strongly preferred.

title: SAP Functional SME
description:
GAQ226R76

About Databricks

At Databricks, our mission is to help data teams solve the world's toughest problems—and that begins with empowering our own employees with exceptional internal products. The Databricks IT organization is a product-led engineering team building intelligent, AI-powered platforms that simplify how work gets done across the company. For Finance, our vision is to eliminate manual, repetitive work by automating complex business processes, surfacing actionable insights, and orchestrating end-to-end workflows. We are reimagining finance operations so teams spend less time processing transactions, chasing approvals, and resolving exceptions, and more time delivering strategic insights that accelerate the business.

We're looking for an SAP Functional SME to own the functional design of our core finance processes on S/4HANA and to shape how AI and agentic automation reimagine them. In this role, you'll be the deep functional authority for your domain—translating how the business actually runs into standard, clean-core S/4HANA solutions, using process intelligence to find what's broken, and defining where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process . You'll work at the intersection of SAP and AI, bridging Finance and Engineering to deliver a simpler, smarter, more automated experience.

The Opportunity

SAP will serve as the foundation for Databricks' core finance processes, including Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, and Order-to-Cash. As the SAP Functional SME, you'll own the functional blueprint for those processes—leading discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design, configuring S/4HANA, and defining the requirements for the intelligent, agentic layer that automates routine work and guides users through exceptions and approvals. You'll use process mining and business process intelligence to quantify opportunity and prioritize what to build, and you'll make the call on where AI-driven recommendations belong versus deterministic rules. Your mission is to combine deep functional expertise with the power of Databricks AI to create a modern, highly automated finance experience that lets the business scale.

What You'll Do

• Own Functional Design: Lead end-to-end process discovery and AS-IS/TO-BE design for major finance processes (Record-to-Report, Source-to-Pay, Order-to-Cash), define S/4HANA solution scope, and design to standard, clean-core capabilities wherever possible.

• Configure S/4HANA: Own functional configuration, business rules, and master-data strategy for your domain, and partner with developers on extensions, APIs, and orchestration where standard functionality falls short.

• Drive Process Intelligence: Use process mining and business process intelligence (leveraging SAP Process Intelligence and related tools) to identify root causes, quantify opportunity, and prioritize improvements; translate those findings into concrete S/4HANA requirements.

• Shape the AI & Agentic Layer: Define the requirements for AI-assisted and agentic process improvements—task automation, intelligent recommendations, anomaly detection, and generative assistants—and make clear judgments about where AI belongs in a controlled, auditable process, where human-in-the-loop is required, and where a deterministic rule is the better answer.

• Bridge Business and Engineering: Serve as the connective tissue between Finance process owners and the engineering pods, partnering with architects and developers to embed AI safely and to define the data flows between S/4HANA, process intelligence tools, SAP BTP, and Databricks AI.

• Run Workshops and Validate Value: Facilitate stakeholder workshops to validate business value, define acceptance criteria, and lead user acceptance testing for both functional and AI features.

• Measure Outcomes: Define KPIs and track ROI for process improvements—cycle time, touchless transaction rate, exception and manual-touch reduction, adoption—and build the business cases for prioritized automation and AI initiatives.
