SDE-3 – Data Engineering and Capabilities Team

About the Team

At Glance, we are building a first-of-its-kind generative AI-powered commerce platform that transforms how users discover and shop across mobile surfaces, TV, and brand stores.

The Data Engineering & Capabilities Team is responsible for building the intelligence backbone that powers personalization, recommendations, multimodal search, experimentation, analytics, and AI-driven commerce experiences. We bring together data from affiliate feeds, OEM integrations, commerce catalogs, user interactions, and transaction systems to create trusted, scalable, and ML-ready data products.

As an SDE-3 Data Engineer, you will play a key role in building and scaling the foundational data systems that power Glance's next generation of AI products.

Role Overview

We are looking for a highly skilled and hands-on Data Engineer to own the design, development, and operation of large-scale data platforms and capabilities.

You will work closely with Applied Scientists, ML Engineers, Product Managers, Analytics teams, and Platform Engineers to build reliable data pipelines, feature stores, identity systems, catalog infrastructure, and self-service capabilities that accelerate experimentation and machine learning development.

You will be expected to independently drive complex technical initiatives from design through production while maintaining high standards of quality, scalability, and operational excellence.

Key Responsibilities

Data Platform Development

• Design and build scalable batch and real-time data pipelines using Spark, Flink, Kafka, and Airflow.

• Develop data products that support analytics, experimentation, recommendation systems, personalization, and AI applications.

• Build and maintain highly reliable ETL/ELT frameworks processing billions of events and catalog updates.

User Data Platform

• Develop systems for user identity resolution and cross-surface signal aggregation across Mobile, TV, OEM, and Commerce ecosystems.

• Build datasets and services that support user profiling, audience creation, segmentation, and personalization.

• Contribute to deterministic and probabilistic identity stitching frameworks.

Commerce Catalog Platform

• Build ingestion and enrichment pipelines for affiliate feeds, merchant catalogs, D2C integrations, and product metadata.

• Design scalable schemas and taxonomy frameworks for large and evolving commerce catalogs.

• Develop catalog quality, deduplication, normalization, and enrichment systems.

Feature Store & ML Enablement

• Build reusable feature generation frameworks for ML and recommendation systems.

• Create low-latency feature pipelines serving training and online inference workloads.

• Partner with Applied Scientists to improve feature discoverability, governance, and reusability.

AI-Powered Engineering Capabilities

• Develop internal AI-powered tools, agents, and self-service platforms that improve developer productivity.

• Build solutions for:

• Pipeline debugging

• Data quality triage

• SQL generation and optimization

• Metadata discovery

• Schema change analysis

• Cost optimization recommendations

Reliability & Operational Excellence

• Own production services and pipelines with strong SLAs.

• Build observability into every layer through monitoring, lineage, alerting, reconciliation, and quality checks.

• Participate in incident response, root-cause analysis, and operational reviews.

• Continuously improve platform reliability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Technical Leadership

• Lead architecture and design discussions for critical platform components.

• Drive engineering best practices around code quality, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and infrastructure management.

• Mentor junior engineers and contribute to raising the technical bar across the organization.

Impact You Will Make

• Accelerate AI Innovation - You will enable faster experimentation and model deployment by building trusted, reusable data assets and feature pipelines.

• Power Personalized Experiences - Your systems will help create a unified understanding of users across multiple surfaces, enabling highly personalized commerce experiences.

• Improve Platform Reliability - You will build observability-first infrastructure that ensures data quality, lineage, and trust across the ecosystem.

• Scale Commerce Intelligence - Your work will transform fragmented commerce and engagement signals into a strategic advantage for Glance's AI-powered commerce platform.

• Increase Engineering Velocity - Through automation, self-service capabilities, and AI-assisted workflows, you will reduce operational overhead and accelerate development cycles.

Experience & Requirements

Required Qualifications

Experience

• 6–10 years of experience in Data Engineering, Distributed Systems, or Data Platform development.

• Strong experience owning large-scale production systems end-to-end.

Data Engineering Expertise: Strong hands-on experience with:

• Apache Spark

• Kafka

• Flink

• Airflow

• Distributed Data Processing

• Batch and Streaming Architectures

Data Modeling

• Strong understanding of dimensional modeling, data warehousing, and large-scale schema design.

• Experience managing complex datasets and evolving schemas.

Data Quality & Observability

Experience with:

• Data validation frameworks

• Lineage systems

• Monitoring and alerting

• Reconciliation pipelines

• CI/CD for data systems

Cloud & Platform Engineering

Experience with:

• GCP

• Databricks

• BigQuery

• Infrastructure as Code

• Cluster management

• Performance tuning and cost optimization

Software Engineering

Strong programming skills in:

• Python

• Scala or Java

• SQL

Strong understanding of:

• System design

• Distributed systems

• Performance optimization

• Reliability engineering

Preferred Qualifications

Commerce Domain Experience

Experience working with:

• Product catalogs

• Affiliate commerce platforms

• Merchant feeds

• Search and recommendation systems

Identity & Personalization

Experience with:

• Identity resolution

• Audience platforms

• Customer 360 systems

• User profiling and segmentation

Feature Stores & ML Platforms

Experience building:

• Feature stores

• Training data pipelines

• Real-time inference data systems

• MLOps infrastructure

AI-Assisted Engineering

Exposure to:

• LLM-powered developer tools

• Agents and copilots

• Metadata intelligence systems

• Automated debugging and remediation workflows

What Success Looks Like in 12 Months

• Built and scaled multiple production-grade pipelines powering personalization and commerce intelligence.

• Reduced data quality incidents through automated observability and reconciliation frameworks.

• Delivered reusable feature generation capabilities adopted by Applied Science teams.

• Improved platform efficiency through workload optimization and infrastructure cost reduction.

• Developed self-service capabilities that significantly improve productivity for data consumers and ML teams.

• Become a go-to technical leader for large-scale data platform initiatives.

What This Role Is Not

• Not a pure ETL developer role focused only on pipeline implementation.

• Not a pure platform operations role.

• Not a people-management role.

This is a senior hands-on engineering role where you will design, build, operate, and influence the core data infrastructure that powers Glance's AI and commerce ecosystem. You are expected to own critical systems, drive technical decisions, and deliver business impact through engineering excellence.

• Ability to design abstractions balancing flexibility and performance.

• Strong knowledge of NCCL , NVLink, PCIe, and interconnects.

• Familiar with profiling automation and performance dashboards.

• Excellent technical leadership and mentoring capabilities.

Preferred Qualifications

• Background in compiler-aided optimization (TVM, XLA, MLIR, Triton).

• Experience tuning Stable Diffusion or transformer inference pipelines.

• Exposure to heterogeneous compute backends (AMD ROCm, TPU, ASICs).

There is no coordination layer to hide behind - you own your portfolio's outcomes, and you deliver them hands-on.

What You'll Do

• Own the roadmap and delivery for TV OEM and operator integrations across platforms (Android TV / Google TV incl. Operator Tier, and proprietary OEM platforms) - first-screen and screensaver placements, default-experience agreements, hub/launcher integrations, firmware/OTA paths.

• Constantly scan the platform landscape for the next integration surface that puts Glance on more devices and treat every integration as a growth lever: understand how TVs ship, how software gets placed, set as default, and activated, and design for footprint, activation, engagement, and revenue, not just technical completion.

• Productize partnerships with leading content, entertainment, travel, commerce, and music platforms - APIs, deep links, embedded experiences, tune-in surfaces, and transactional/agentic commerce flows and translate partnership agreements into product requirements, deliverables, and KPIs that both sides are held to.

• Own launch readiness and post-launch optimization across engineering, design, legal, marketing, and partner teams; be the product voice in partner reviews and QBRs.

How You Work

• AI-first, prototype-first. Working in an AI-first way is a baseline expectation, not a plus.

• You use AI tools across research, analysis, and spec-writing and you design and prototype yourself: interactive prototypes and design explorations that let partners and leadership react to something real, before engineering writes a line of production code.

• Ownership and accountability: You run your portfolio like it's your business. When a launch is at risk, it's your problem until it's solved.

• Independent thinking and execution: You form your own point of view, make sound calls with incomplete information, and drive execution end to end.

• Outside-the-box problem solving: Partner integrations rarely go by the book. You find the third option instead of accepting the stalemate.

• Deeply hands-on: You write the PRD, debug integration issues alongside engineering, and are in the war-room at launch. This is not a status-meeting PM role.

What You'll Bring

• Proven business impact: Product work that demonstrably moved core metrics - revenue, distribution, activation, engagement and you can point to the numbers and what you personally did to move them.

• Distribution and growth mindset: You are always asking what kind of integration gets us onto more devices, and you understand the mechanics placements, defaults, platform programs well enough to spot openings and drive growth from them.

• 8+ years of product management (SPM), or 11+ years including leading PMs and owning a portfolio (GPM), ideally in platform, ecosystem, or B2B2C products.

• Experience shipping partner integrations with OEMs, operators, or large platforms, where success depended on another company's roadmap and release cycles.

• Strong technical fluency - APIs, SDKs, deep linking, identity/attribution, system-level integrations and sharp commercial instincts about how partnership deals are structured and where product commitments create risk or leverage.

• Excellent communication: crisp PRDs, executive-ready partner updates, and comfort representing the company externally.

• Experience with TV platform ecosystems or content/commerce partnerships is a plus.

Location & Travel: Based in Bangalore, working closely with teams and partners in the US and other markets. Periodic travel to partner sites and launch markets is expected.

Glance is an equal opportunity employer. We celebrate diversity and are committed to building an inclusive environment for all employees.

Since 2019, Glance has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 5 offices in around 3 countries, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

title: Staff Applied Scientist - I
description:
Glance

Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. InMobi

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

What you will be doing

We are looking for a Data Scientist who can operate at the intersection of classical machine learning , large-scale recommendation systems , and modern agentic AI systems .

You will design, build, and deploy intelligent systems that power Glance’s personalized lock screen and live entertainment experiences. This role blends deep ML craftsmanship with forward-looking innovation in autonomous/agentic systems.

Your responsibilities will include:

Classical ML & Recommendation Systems

• Design and develop large-scale recommendation systems using advanced ML, statistical modeling, ranking algorithms, and deep learning.

• Build and operate machine learning models on diverse, high-volume data sources for personalization, prediction, and content understanding.

• Develop rapid experimentation workflows to validate hypotheses and measure real-world business impact.

• Own data preparation, model training, evaluation, and deployment pipelines in collaboration with engineering counterparts.

• Monitor ML model performance using statistical techniques; identify drifts, failure modes, and improvement opportunities.

Agentic Systems & Next-Gen AI

• Build and experiment with agentic AI systems that autonomously observe model performance, trigger experiments, tune hyperparameters, improve ranking policies, or orchestrate ML workflows with minimal human intervention.

• Apply LLMs, embeddings, retrieval-augmented architectures, and multimodal generative models for semantic understanding, content classification, and user preference modeling.

• Design intelligent agents that can automate repetitive decision-making tasks—e.g., candidate generation tuning, feature selection, or context-aware content curation.

• Explore reinforcement learning, contextual bandits, and self-improving systems to power next-generation personalization.

Cross-functional impact

• Collaborate with Designers, UX Researchers, Product Managers, and Software Engineers to integrate ML and GenAI-driven features into Glance’s consumer experiences.

• Contribute to Glance’s ML/AI thought leadership—blogs, case studies, internal tech talks, and industry conferences.

• Thrive in a multi-functional, highly collaborative team environment with engineering, product, business, and creative teams.

• Plus: Interface with stakeholders across Product, Business, Data, and Infrastructure to align ML initiatives with strategic priorities.

The experience we need

We are seeking candidates with deep expertise in ML, recommendation systems, and a strong appetite for building agentic AI systems.

You should have experience with:

• Large-scale ML and recommendation systems (collaborative filtering, ranking models, content-based approaches, embeddings).

• Classical ML and deep learning techniques across NLP, sequence modeling, RL, clustering, and time series.

• Experience in deploying ML workflows/models in production system

• Big data processing (Spark, distributed data systems) and cloud computing.

• Designing end-to-end ML solutions—from prototype to production.

• Plus: Building or experimenting with LLMs, generative models, and agentic AI workflows (e.g., autonomous evaluators, self-improving pipelines, automated experiment agents).

We value curiosity, problem-solving ability, and a strong bias toward experimentation and production impact.

Qualifications

• Bachelor’s/Master’s in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Electrical Engineering, Operations Research, Economics, Analytics, or related fields. PhD is a plus.

• 6+ years of industry experience in ML/Data Science, ideally in large-scale recommendation systems or personalization.

• Experience with LLMs, retrieval systems, generative models, or agentic/autonomous ML systems is highly desirable.

• Expertise with algorithms in NLP, Reinforcement Learning, Time Series, and Deep Learning, applied on real-world datasets.

• Proficient in Python and comfortable with statistical tools (R, NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch/TensorFlow, etc.).

• Strong experience with the big data ecosystem (Spark, Hadoop) and cloud platforms (Azure, AWS, GCP/Vertex AI).

• Comfortable working in cross-functional teams.

• Familiarity with privacy-preserving ML and identity-less ecosystems (especially on iOS and Android).

• Excellent communication skills with the ability to simplify complex technical concepts.

We're building the ad monetization platform behind Glance - the lock screen and mobile surfaces that 100M+ people across India, Southeast Asia, Japan, Brazil and the US see every day , roughly half of them actively engaging. Every ad request carries real money , a real user's screen and an OEM partner's trust, and is decided in milliseconds on a low-end Android phone.

We're starting a focused new team of senior engineers in Bangalore. As its Staff Engineer (individual contributor , tech-lead track), you'll set the architecture, hold the quality bar , and be the person the team turns to when a design decision could move revenue.

What you will do

Own the architecture of the money path

• Design a demand-source-agnostic serving layer: any exchange, ad server or deal plugs in behind one contract we own (OpenRTB 2.6 with Glance extensions).

• Keep decisioning — auction, floors, priority and ad-load policy — in our platform, never in adapters or partner consoles.

• Define the rendering contract the client SDK depends on (native, V AST , MRAID/HTML).

• Make the big calls and write them down: ADRs, latency budgets, build-versus-use decisions with InMobi platform teams.

Serve ads inside the Glance experience

• Build ad slots into Glance's content feed, with ad load balanced against dismiss rate, session depth and retention.

• Design for prefetch: ads fetched ahead of time and shown later , sometimes offline - caching, expiry , pacing and delayed impression beacons all have to hold.

• Own per-user frequency and ad load across every demand source, within latency, battery and memory budgets on low-end Android.

Set the bar and grow the team

• Run design reviews across serving, SDK, automation and revenue data, and own the API contracts between them.

• Make "what proves this?" the first question on any pricing or serving change, AI-assisted code included: replay evals, invariant checks, auto-rollback canaries.

• Be accountable for integrity gates: creative safety , invalid traffic, policy compliance.

• Review revenue-event and partner-reconciliation design so the numbers hold up to OEM audit.

• Mentor senior engineers into area leads, and make sure every service has a second owner

What we expect

• 10+ years, including ownership of a low-latency , high-throughput system where a bad deploy shows up as lost revenue - ad serving, payments, trading or pricing.

• Distributed systems depth: partitioning, replication, consistency , failure modes, graceful degradation.

• Deep, hands-on Java and Spring Boot (our serving stack), including JVM/GC tuning for low latency; comfortable in Python (F astAPI) for ML and data services.

• Cloud (GCP or A WS), Kubernetes and CI/CD , designing for cost of serving, not just uptime

• Event pipelines at scale (Kafka, Spark or Flink), reconciled against an external source of truth

• Safe releases without a manual pass: contract and replay testing, canaries, automated rollback, SL Os you've been paged on RFCs and ADRs that lead to decisions, and influence across teams you don't manage

If you match most of this but not all, we'd still like to hear from you.

Nice to have

• Sell-side ad tech: SSPs, ad servers, Prebid / Prebid Server , Google Ad Manager.

• OpenRTB, V AST , MRAID and OM SDK; privacy signals (T CF , GPP) and supply-chain transparency (schain, sellers.json, app-ads. txt)

• Android or mobile SDK work under size, battery and cold-start budgets

• Consent frameworks (DPDP , GDPR, L GPD), invalid-traffic defences, or partner-billing systems that external partners audit

• Room to grow: become the org's architecture authority as the team scales, or move into engineering management

title: Customer Experience & Retention Manager
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

About the Role

Harness is growing its Digital and Commercial customer base, and we will not scale it by adding people in proportion. This role owns customer experience and retention for a large book of Digital and Commercial customers , and its main job is to build and run the tech-touch engine that serves them .

You will design automated journeys, health signals, in-product and email programs, and self-service resources that deliver onboarding, adoption, risk detection, renewal and expansion without a person in every interaction. You will use human time on the moments that matter: a customer stuck on a technical blocker, an at-risk account, a renewal negotiation. You will also feed what you learn back into the automation so those moments become rarer.

Operating principle: Automate by default, involve a human by exception. Every manual touch should either solve a high-value problem or teach us what to automate next.

What You'll Own

• Tech-Touch Customer Experience Engine

• Design, scale and optimize automated lifecycle programs: onboarding, activation, adoption, renewal and win-back. Run them through the CRM, the CS platform, email and in-product channels. Build triggered plays driven by product usage, milestones, health score, support signals and contract events.

• Own the segmentation and coverage model: which customers get automation only, automation plus on-demand human help, or direct engagement.

• Build the self-service layer: guides, templates, pipeline examples, office hours, webinars, community content and a knowledge base. Measure what gets used and fill the gaps.

• Run experiments (A/B tests on messaging, timing and channel) and report on what changes adoption and retention.

• Use AI-assisted workflows for summarisation, content personalisation, ticket and usage insight, and outreach drafting to raise throughput without losing quality.

• Data-Driven Health, Risk & Prioritisation

• Own the customer health model: define, validate and tune the signals (usage depth, feature adoption, engagement, support trends, sentiment and commercial indicators).

• Turn the data into automated risk and opportunity alerts, and route them to the right play or person. Build dashboards that show portfolio health, coverage efficiency, adoption funnels and renewal risk. Run recovery plans for at-risk accounts, then capture the pattern as a repeatable, automated play.

• Technical Enablement & Hands-On Support

• Guide customers through product configuration, integrations (GitHub, GitLab, cloud platforms, CI/CD tools) and common pipeline issues when automation and self-service are not enough.

• Join technical discovery and proof-of-value work with Solutions Engineering and forward-deployed teams.

• Reproduce common issues, gather logs and configuration details, and escalate cleanly to Support and Engineering.

• Convert every recurring technical question into reusable enablement: a guide, template, in-product prompt or automated play.

• Turn recurring customer challenges into product feedback and prioritised requests.

• Renewals, Retention & Commercial Ownership

• Own renewal execution end to end: automated renewal journeys and reminders, risk assessment, commercial discussion and close, with human involvement focused on at-risk and strategic renewals. Identify expansion, cross-sell and right-sizing opportunities from usage signals, and trigger plays and handoffs to Account Executives.

The Role

We are looking for a Senior Manager to own and lead two connected disciplines: Cloud Security and IAM . You will manage and grow engineers and leads across these areas, set technical direction, and be the accountable owner for how Harness secures its cloud infrastructure and controls access to it.

Cloud Security

• Own the security architecture and posture of Harness's multi-cloud and Kubernetes-based production environments, including network segmentation, workload isolation, secrets management, and hardened baselines.

• Partner with Platform and SRE on dedicated-tenant and customer-hosted deployment models, including the controls that make those models safe at enterprise scale.

• Support the security of customer-facing runtime components such as the Harness Delegate, including token scoping, least-privilege execution, and containment of compromised components.

Identity & Access Management

• Own the workforce and workload identity strategy: SSO, MFA, privileged access, just-in-time access, service-account and machine-identity lifecycle, and access reviews.

• Advance Zero Trust principles across internal systems and production, using a central authority model with human-in-the-loop approvals for high-risk actions.

• Reduce standing privilege and credential sprawl; make least privilege measurable and auditable.

Leadership & Program Management

• Hire, coach, and develop a high-performing team; set clear expectations, growth paths, and a healthy on-call culture.

• Translate NIST CSF 2.0 goals into a prioritized roadmap with clear owners, milestones, and executive-ready reporting.

• Work with external red-team and penetration-testing partners to scope exercises, triage findings, and drive remediation to closure.

• Support customer trust: contribute to security briefings, questionnaires, and architecture reviews, and communicate the shared responsibility model clearly and credibly.

• Present security posture, risk, and progress to senior leadership, including the executive team.

Required

• 10+ years in security engineering, cloud security, or security operations, with 3+ years managing technical security teams.

• Deep hands-on experience securing AWS, GCP, and/or Azure and Kubernetes environments at scale.

• Strong IAM background: SSO/federation, privileged access management, workload identity, and Zero Trust architecture.

• Working knowledge of security frameworks and compliance regimes (NIST CSF, SOC 2, ISO 27001, FedRAMP or similar).

• Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting to executives and to customer security teams.

Preferred

• Experience at a SaaS, DevOps, or developer-tools company, especially one with customer-hosted or hybrid components.

• Experience with Enterprise Security.

title: Senior Security Engineer - Customer Engineering
description:
Harness is the AI Software Delivery Platform company, led by technologist and entrepreneur Jyoti Bansal (founder of AppDynamics, acquired by Cisco for $3.7B). Harness has raised approximately $570M in funding and is valued at $5.5B, backed by leading investors including Goldman Sachs, Menlo Ventures, IVP, Unusual Ventures, Citi Ventures, and more. As AI accelerates code creation, the real bottleneck has shifted to everything after the code – testing, deployments, application security, reliability, compliance, and cost optimization. Harness brings AI and automation to this “outer loop,” helping teams ship software faster while maintaining security and governance throughout the entire software delivery lifecycle.

Powered by Harness AI and the Software Delivery Knowledge Graph, the Harness Platform applies deep context and intelligent automation across the software delivery lifecycle with governance and policy-driven controls embedded throughout the platform.

Over the past year, Harness powered over 185M deployments, 82M builds, 18T flag evaluations, 8M security scans, 9.1B optimized tests, 3T protected API calls, and helped manage $2.8B in cloud spend — enabling customers like United Airlines, Morningstar, and Choice Hotels to accelerate releases by up to 75%, reduce cloud costs by up to 60%, and achieve 10x DevOps efficiency.

With a global team across 26 offices and 27 countries, Harness is shaping the future of AI software delivery — and we’re looking for exceptional talent to help us move even faster.

The Role

We're looking for a Senior Security Engineer to sit at the intersection of our Security Research Engineering team and our customers worldwide . This is a deeply technical, hands-on, detection-focused role for someone who understands how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually work — and can prove, in real customer traffic, whether a detection is firing correctly.

This is a high-impact role. The value customers realize from the entire platform depends on the outcomes this team produces: whether our detections fire correctly, whether the threats that matter get surfaced, and whether customers trust what we tell them. You'll be the technical authority who validates the detections our researchers build (ModSecurity/WAF rules, API security signatures, AI security detections, OWASP Top 10 / API Top 10 / LLM Top 10 coverage), separates true positives from noise, hunts across global customer environments for business logic abuse and fraud, and closes the loop back to Research and Product to sharpen detection efficacy.

You'll bring a deep understanding of the security landscape — the threat models, attacker techniques, and rapidly evolving AI security frontier — and you'll express that understanding through code: scripting, automating threat hunts, and using AI itself as a force multiplier in your investigations.

Day to day, you'll work hand in hand with customers' own security teams to operationalize the Traceable by Harness Protection module and then stay engaged as an extended SOC and red team — continuously improving their security posture rather than handing off at go-live.

What You'll Do

• Operationalize the Protection module. Work directly with customers' security teams to stand up and tune the Traceable by Harness Protection module in their environment, from initial rollout through steady-state enforcement.

• Be their extended SOC and red team. Engage continuously — not as a one-off deployment — acting as an extension of the customer's SOC to monitor and hunt, and as a red team to probe their defenses, steadily improving their overall security posture.

• Evaluate detections built by Security Research Engineering. Review and pressure-test ModSecurity (ModSec) rulesets, API security detections, AI Security detections, and OWASP Top 10 / OWASP API Top 10 / OWASP LLM Top 10 coverage for accuracy, coverage gaps, and false-positive rates before and after they reach customers.

• Validate true positives in production traffic. Partner directly with customer security teams to triage platform alerts, confirm genuine true positives, distinguish them from false positives and benign anomalies, and document the reasoning behind each verdict.

• Automate the hunt. Build scripts, tooling, and automated workflows — increasingly AI-assisted — that scale threat hunting across many customers at once, rather than investigating one alert at a time by hand.

• Run threat hunting engagements globally. Proactively hunt across the API traffic of Harness customers worldwide for business logic abuse (BOLA/BFLA, parameter tampering, workflow abuse), account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and fraud patterns that signature-based detection alone won't catch.

• Black-box test the platform and customer APIs. Attack detections and API endpoints the way a real adversary would — validating coverage, finding blind spots, and generating the adversarial traffic needed to confirm detections actually fire.

• Own the detection feedback loop. Turn field findings into concrete, prioritized input for Security Research Engineering and Product — new rule ideas, tuning recommendations, catalog/detection integration gaps, and coverage improvements.

• Reproduce and investigate incidents. Lead deep-dive investigations into anomalous API behavior, trace root cause (including upstream CDN/WAF/gateway layers), and produce clear RCA documentation and findings for both technical and executive audiences.

• Weed out false positives and report on what matters (critical). Aggressively filter noise so customers aren't chasing false alarms, and deliver clear reports that surface genuine threat insights — helping customer teams focus their limited attention on the true incidents that actually require action. This signal-over-noise discipline is central to the value customers get from the platform.

• Reduce customer noise at the source. Tune detections to each customer's API catalog, business context, and legitimate integration patterns so false positives are suppressed before they ever reach an analyst.

• Be a trusted technical advisor. Translate detection logic and threat findings into language customer security leaders can act on, and help them mature their API and AI security posture.

What You Bring

Required

• 4–6 years in security engineering, detection engineering, threat hunting, penetration testing, incident response, or a closely related discipline.

• A deep, current understanding of the security landscape — threat models, attacker techniques, and how attacks against APIs and AI systems actually play out.

• Ability to code and automate. You write your own tooling to scale threat hunting — this is not a point-and-click role.

• Ability to use AI for threat hunting. You actively leverage LLMs and AI-assisted workflows to accelerate investigation, triage, and hunt automation.

• Black-box penetration testing ability — you can attack an API or a detection with no prior knowledge and reason about what an adversary would do.

• Comfort working directly with enterprise customers globally — you can lead a technical conversation, defend a verdict, and write findings that stand up to scrutiny.

Core Technical Requirements

This is a core technical role. We expect real depth — not surface familiarity — across most of the following:

• Security frameworks & threat models: OWASP Top 10, OWASP API Security Top 10, and OWASP LLM (GenAI) Top 10; MITRE ATT&CK, and MITRE ATLAS for AI/ML threats.

• API security: REST, GraphQL, and gRPC; authentication and authorization flows (OAuth 2.0, OIDC, JWT, session handling); and the full range of API attack techniques (BOLA/BFLA, mass assignment, injection, SSRF, rate-limit and workflow abuse).

• AI / LLM security: prompt injection, sensitive-information disclosure, improper output handling, excessive agency, and abuse of AI-driven or agentic API endpoints — and how to detect them.

• Detection & WAF engineering: hands-on with WAF / ModSecurity rule logic — reading, writing, tuning, and reasoning about false-positive / false-negative tradeoffs.

• Offensive testing & tooling: black-box testing of APIs and detections using tools such as Burp Suite, Postman, and OWASP ZAP; generating adversarial traffic to confirm detections fire.

• Scripting & automation: Python (or equivalent) to build investigation tooling and automated, increasingly AI-assisted hunt workflows; comfort querying large volumes of traffic and telemetry.

• Threat hunting & fraud analysis: distinguishing business logic abuse and fraud from legitimate traffic — account takeover, credential stuffing, scraping, carding, and payment fraud.

Nice to Have

• Familiarity with CDN, gateway, and upstream traffic architectures (Akamai, Cloudflare, and similar) and how they interact with detection at the edge.

• Prior experience in a customer-facing security engineering, SOC, or professional services role.

• Certifications (a plus, not required). Because this role centers on API and AI security, the most relevant credentials are:

• API security: Certified API Pentester (C-APIPen), APIsec University ASCP, or PortSwigger Burp Suite Certified Practitioner (BSCP).

title: Cloud Security Engineer
description:
About Us

We are seeking a skilled Cloud Security Engineer to support Identity and Access Management (IAM) operations, cloud key management, secrets management, and security automation across multi-cloud environments, including Azure, AWS, and GCP. This role will also be responsible for implementing cloud security controls, managing network security operations, and administering firewalls on Fortigate platforms. The Cloud Security Engineer will ensure secure identity governance, controlled access, network segmentation, and policy-driven guardrails that align with enterprise security standards.

Responsibilities

Identity & Access Management (IAM)

• Execute IAM operations, including provisioning, access troubleshooting, RBAC/ABAC configurations, and access recertifications.

• Manage and implement AWS Service Control Policies (SCPs) to enforce governance and guardrails.

• Build and manage Azure Policies (definitions, initiatives, assignments) in accordance with compliance regulations.

• Support IAM architecture across Azure AD/Entra ID, AWS IAM, GCP IAM, and the enterprise Identity Center.

• Assist with IAM incident response and Level 2 escalations.

Key Management & Secrets/Vault Operations

• Operate cloud KMS platforms, including Azure Key Vault and AWS KMS, focusing on key rotation, key policies, and certificates/PKI operations.

• Enforce cryptographic standards (RSA, AES, ECC), manage TLS certificate lifecycles, and ensure secure key access patterns.

Cloud Security (Azure / AWS / GCP)

• Implement cloud security baselines, guardrails, and compliance controls in line with CIS, NIST, and ISO27001 standards.

• Support network and security posture configuration utilizing tools such as Wiz and Prisma.

• Configure and troubleshoot cloud-native firewalls, Network Security Groups (NSGs), routing, and segmentation.

Network Security (Fortigate)

• Manage, monitor, and troubleshoot Fortigate firewalls, including security policies, NAT, VPN (IPsec/SSL), and routing.

• Oversee IPS/IDS configurations and threat profiles.

• Ensure high availability operations (Active/Passive).

• Support network segmentation, micro-segmentation, and Zero Trust enforcement.

• Participate in firewall rule reviews, change management, and impact assessments.

• Analyze traffic flows, logs, and events using FortiAnalyzer tools.

Automation & Infrastructure as Code

• Develop Terraform modules for IAM, KMS, vault, firewall policies, and cloud security controls.

• Create Ansible playbooks to automate secret rollout, certificate deployments, firewall configurations, and configuration baselines.

• Support Kubernetes environments, focusing on secret management, RBAC, service accounts, workload identity, and Vault injector integration.

Documentation & Governance

• Maintain Standard Operating Procedures (SOPs), runbooks, architecture diagrams, and compliance documentation.

• Support internal audits, security reviews, and posture reporting.

Required Skills and Experience:

• Hands-on experience with Terraform and Ansible.

• Looking for 5 - 7 Years of experience.

• Strong understanding of identity protocols, including SAML, OAuth2, OIDC, LDAP, and Kerberos.

• Experience with Azure AD/Entra ID, AWS IAM, and GCP IAM.

• Expertise in HashiCorp Vault, Azure Key Vault, and AWS KMS.

• Proficiency in Kubernetes RBAC, secrets management, and workload identity management.

• Solid understanding of PKI, TLS certificates, and cryptographic primitives.

• Strong Linux administration skills (RHEL/CentOS/Rocky Linux).

• Familiarity with firewall technologies, particularly Fortigate (firewall/NAT/VPN/IPS/URL filtering) and cloud security controls across Azure, AWS, and GCP.

Desired/Bonus Skills:

• Certifications in Azure Security Engineer, AWS Security, or GCP Security.

• Network Security certification, such as Fortinet NSE (NSE4+).

• AWS Security Specialty certification.

• Lead technical discussions with potential clients, helping them move from simple automation to advanced AI that helps them make better decisions and scale their operations.

• Design tailored solutions that map autonomous agent capabilities to specific customer ROI drivers, such as productivity improvement and working capital optimization.

• Create custom technical solutions that help customers reach their financial goals, like improving cash flow or reducing late payments.

• Build clear business cases and financial models that demonstrate actual financial gains and productivity improvement using our solution.

• Partner with Marketing to refine value propositions and lead-generation messaging, ensuring alignment with customer automation needs and the competitive landscape.

• Develop and present sophisticated cost-benefit ROI models and conduct technical maturity assessments to define long-term account strategies and product roadmaps.

• Collaborate cross-functionally with Product, Engineering, and Customer Success teams to ensure seamless solution delivery and sustained customer satisfaction.

AI Innovation & Field Validation

• Work directly with key customers to demonstrate existing and new AI features, with custom workflows leveraging real-time client data.

• Drive structured feedback loops to Engineering and Product teams to harden the agentic platform based on field-validated insights.

Key Qualifications

• Minimum of 2+ years of relevant experience in Technical Sales, Solution Selling, or Consulting within a quota-bearing environment; experience selling to the Office of the CFO is highly preferred.

• Proven track record in Enterprise SaaS and a deep aptitude for technical business conversations with both IT and finance stakeholders.

• Advanced communication and interpersonal skills, with the ability to simplify complex AI concepts for executive audiences and provide technical specifications to Engineering.

• Demonstrated high agency and the ability to operate autonomously in high-stakes, ambiguous environments.

• Adequate technical knowledge of AI and Large Language Models (LLMs).

• Strong domain expertise in Finance (CFO office), with a solid understanding of ERP systems and Accounts Payable processes.

• Experience in technical consulting or pre-sales, with a knack for building ROI models.

• MBA preferred; Bachelor's degree with significant relevant work experience (2+ years) will be considered. Knowledge of Accounts Payable, Supplier Onboarding and Supplier Payment processes is a distinct advantage.

• Competitive salary.

• Fun-filled work culture (https://www.highradius.com/culture/)

Collaboration: Work closely with development teams to "containerize" applications and provide them with self-service infrastructure capabilities.

IaC Mastery: Expert-level experience with Terraform (HCL), including state management, workspaces, and reusable module development.

•

•
Container Orchestration: Proficiency in Kubernetes and Docker (writing Dockerfiles, managing K8s manifests/Helm charts).

•
Scripting: Advanced proficiency in Python, Bash, or Go for automation tasks.

•
Version Control: Expert knowledge of Git (branching strategies, GitOps workflows).

•
Build Tools: Experience with Maven, Gradle, or similar tools for Java/Node/Python environments.

Soft Skills & Mindset

•
Automation-First: A mindset that refuses to perform the same task manually twice.

•
Analytical Thinking: Ability to debug complex networking or deployment issues within a distributed system.

•
Communication: Ability to explain architectural decisions to both technical and non-technical stakeholders.

•
This position does not involve managing or configuring Monitoring/Logging stacks (e.g., Prometheus, Grafana, ELK, Datadog).

This is a pure Provisioning and deployment-focused role.

description:

Summary

• Strong customer relationships and account health: Own the day-to-day management for newly onboarded & existing customers. Flawless execution of campaigns. Strong coordination with internal resources for execution of core tasks. Awareness and understanding of all required billing and compliance requirements. Contribute to quality and actionable Customer Plan.

Leverage internal tool-directed tactics to inform and prioritize upsells and optimizations, seeking to drive swift implementation. Leverage self-serve tools and community forums to deliver insights for non-Insights enabled clients.

Ensure regular client engagement with the BingAds platform, and aim to reduce customer reliance on AM for routine tasks. Utilize all available readiness and insights to ensure you are a fluent advocate of the Bing story. Develop and demonstrate an intermediate level knowledge of emerging products/features.

• Collaborative and high-performing account team:  Ensure timely and proactive customer escalations by effectively leveraging Account Executive and internal partner network to resolve day-to-day escalations & revenue blockers. Partner with account team to submit actionable feedback on product, tool and processes through relevant channels. Own and effectively execute the customer transition process and operational excellence in execution of change management (Book of Business update).

• Continuous business learning and professional growth: Continually strengthen your Bing Ads and Search Industry expertise, take personal accountability for your career and personal development; create, update and regularly check in on your career development plan. Complete required and recommended trainings and apply what you learn to further your growth in role and career progression.

What is expected out of you ?

• Minimum 5 years’ in Search Engine Marketing Sales or online media and Service experience required

• Strong knowledge of Internet advertising: CPA, CPM, CPC, search marketing, lead generation, direct response, etc.

• Strong troubleshooting and problem solving tools with a 'can do' attitude and the ability to partner collaboratively with other functional areas within the company in support of the sales process.

• Demonstrated ability to consistently meet or exceed revenue goals or targets

• Proven ability to understand customer needs, create and deliver customized, customer-focused pitches and solutions

• Effectively navigate through ambiguity and complexities related to client management

• Talented in storytelling and delivering engaging presentations

• Solid knowledge of the search industry, trends, and customers needs

• Passion for technology as an enabler for customer and company growth

• Bachelor’s degree required. MBA preferable

• Critical thinker who is organized and can make decision based on clear priorities

• Collaborative teammate who can build successful team relationships with partners; and can prioritize multiple tasks

• Flexible and able to quickly adapt to changing business needs and processes

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills

• Willingness  to travel

Preferred

• Bing Ads Certification

• Experienced using Excel to analyze information, including data manipulation, V-Lookups, creating and using pivot tables, and data analysis

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

This is a place where ambition and belonging occupy the same space. Where the bar is high and the support is real. Where freedom comes with trust, and trust comes with accountability. Where you are valued not only for what you do, but for the perspective, judgment and humanity you bring to the work. Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

If this sounds like the place you have been looking for, join us.

Overview of the role:

We are looking for an Applied Scientist III to join our algorithmic and research science team. You'll work on mathematically rigorous, research-driven problems at production scale, while owning problems end to end. This role sits at the intersection of theory and application, designing algorithms that combine elegant modeling with measurable business impact. Specifically, our scientists tackle challenges across traffic shaping, fraud detection, ad quality, pricing strategies, and auction theory, along with their practical applications. We leverage the latest deep learning models alongside classical machine learning techniques to build innovative solutions.

As the heart of the InMobi Exchange, our team optimizes the company's core business functions and creates the strategic moat that sets us apart in the market. If you thrive on solving complex, high-impact problems and want to see your ideas shape the future of a global exchange, this is the place where your work will truly make a difference.

The impact you'll make:

• Formulate, analyze, and implement algorithms that power real-time auctions, dynamic pricing, bid shaping, pacing, and traffic allocation across a massive-scale ad marketplace.

• Design and experiment with methods in online learning, reinforcement learning, multi-armed bandits, forecasting, game theory, and Bayesian modeling—in non-stationary, adversarial environments.

• Collaborate with product and engineering teams to deploy your models in production and run real-world experiments with rapid feedback loops (measured in hours, not weeks).

• Participate in scientific design reviews and contribute to raising the methodological bar of the team.

• Contribute to the scientific community by publishing high-quality research, conducting internal seminars, and staying abreast of advances in machine learning, algorithms, and applied statistics.

• Help identify new areas for innovation by translating business challenges into research questions and proposing novel, high-impact methodologies.

• Translate mathematical ideas into practical, high-performance algorithms that operate at scale in production environments.

• Explore and close the loop between model predictions and real-world outcomes, refining algorithms based on system behavior.

• A Ph.D. in Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Operations Research, Physics, or a related quantitative discipline is strongly preferred. A degree is not a hard requirement—demonstrated research depth and production impact count.

• 4–7 years of experience working on algorithmic or applied research problems, including significant production deployment experience. Candidates with more or less experience are welcome to apply—we hire across Applied Scientist II, Applied Scientist III, and Staff Applied Scientist levels.

• Deep grounding in one or more of:

• Statistical learning theory, mathematical optimization, discrete algorithms, probability theory, and information theory

• Causal inference, decision theory, game theory, auction theory

• Online learning, bandits, RL, Bayesian methods

• Strong publication record (e.g., NeurIPS, ICML, AISTATS, KDD, UAI, WSDM, EC, SODA, COLT) is a strong plus—even if not recent.

• Proficient in scientific computing with Python, including packages such as NumPy, SciPy, PyTorch, or TensorFlow.

• Comfortable working with big data platforms like Apache Spark, distributed computing, and large-scale datasets.

• A researcher's mindset: questions first, implementation later. You are thoughtful about assumptions and rigorous about validation.

• End-to-end ownership: you can go from idea to production and thrive in applied settings.

Prior experience in ad tech, marketplaces, or dynamic pricing is helpful but not required.

• Establish standardized pricing templates and commercial playbooks.

• Identify patterns in pricing pressure and propose a corrective strategy.

• Drive data-backed commercial decision-making.

• Foster a culture of disciplined, data-driven deal execution.

Spanning diverse categories such as fashion, beauty, travel, accessories, home décor, pets, and beyond, Glance AI delivers deeply personalized shopping experiences. Role overview

We are looking for a Lead – Workspace Transportation to manage employee transportation for our Bangalore office. As the service expands, this role will own daily operations, vendor performance, route planning, employee communication, and cost control, with a strong focus on safety and reliable pickup and drop services.

The lead will be the primary contact for transportation matters and work closely with Workspace leadership, transport partners, Security, HR, Finance, and Procurement. The role requires hands-on operational ownership, sound judgment during disruptions, and a practical understanding of Bangalore traffic and employee commuting needs.

Key responsibilities

Daily operations and capacity planning

• Oversee daily pickup and drop operations, including trip scheduling, vehicle allocation, driver readiness, dispatch, and completion tracking.

• Plan service capacity using employee demand, office attendance, shift timings, new joiner requirements, and approved service coverage.

• Coordinate route planning and pickup points to balance employee convenience, travel time, vehicle occupancy, and cost. Review routes regularly as demand changes.

• Account for Bangalore traffic, rain, road closures, and peak-hour congestion when setting schedules. Arrange approved backup vehicles and vendors for disruptions.

• Monitor live trips through the transport platform and vendor control teams. Respond promptly to delays, missed pickups, vehicle breakdowns, and last-minute changes.

• Maintain clear operating procedures for bookings, cancellations, no-shows, route changes, exceptions, and escalation handovers.

Vendor and driver management

• Manage transport partners against agreed service levels, fleet commitments, pricing, and response times. Conduct regular reviews and document corrective actions.

• Coordinate with vendor supervisors and dispatch teams to ensure sufficient vehicles, qualified drivers, and operational support for each service window.

• Assess proposed vendors with Procurement and relevant teams, compare quotations, and support commercial discussions and onboarding.

• Monitor driver conduct, punctuality, route adherence, and complaints. Require vendors to address inappropriate behaviour and recurring performance issues.

• Track vendor contracts, renewal dates, rate cards, and service commitments. Maintain an updated contact directory and escalation matrix.

Safety service quality and financial ownership

Employee safety and transport compliance

• Coordinate verification of driver identity, licences, background checks, and required vehicle documents through approved company and vendor processes.

• Track validity of applicable vehicle permits, insurance, fitness, pollution certificates, and other required records with vendors and the relevant internal teams.

• Ensure vendors follow company-approved transport safety procedures, including applicable requirements for late-hour travel and women employee safety.

• Monitor the availability and functioning of required vehicle safety features, tracking systems, emergency contacts, and communication arrangements.

• Coordinate periodic vehicle and service checks with vendors. Escalate unsafe vehicles or drivers promptly and arrange replacements before service resumes.

• Handle employee location, contact, and trip data confidentially, with access and sharing limited to approved business needs.

Escalations and emergency response

• Act as the primary operational escalation contact for employee transport concerns and coordinate timely resolution with vendors and internal teams.

• Maintain response procedures for accidents, breakdowns, safety concerns, severe weather, and service disruptions. Coordinate with Security and emergency services when needed.

• Keep employees informed of delays and alternative arrangements through approved channels, with clear updates until the issue is resolved.

• Prepare contingency plans for vehicle shortages, vendor outages, and driver availability issues, including approved alternate providers.

• Document incidents, investigate causes with the responsible teams, and track preventive actions. Escalate material safety or service failures to Workspace leadership.

• Provide support during critical service windows and after-hours emergencies under an agreed coverage arrangement, with documented backup and handovers.

Budgets billing and cost control

• Prepare transportation budgets and demand forecasts. Monitor monthly spending and highlight variances or additional funding needs before commitments are made.

• Validate vendor invoices against completed trips, approved rate cards, kilometres or hours where applicable, and authorised additional charges.

• Maintain supporting trip records, approvals, purchase orders where applicable, invoices, and reconciliation reports for payment and audit.

• Work with Finance and Procurement to resolve billing discrepancies and ensure approved payments are processed within agreed timelines.

• Improve vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, reduce avoidable empty runs and no-shows, and assess savings without compromising safety or agreed service standards.

Employee experience reporting and candidate requirements

Employee communication and continuous improvement

• Explain transport eligibility, booking processes, pickup schedules, cancellations, and service changes clearly to employees.

• Coordinate with HR and Workspace teams to support new joiner transport onboarding and changes in employee commuting requirements.

• Collect employee feedback, track complaints to closure, and identify recurring issues requiring route changes or vendor action.

• Maintain an operational dashboard covering punctuality, completed and missed trips, occupancy, complaints, incidents, vendor performance, and costs.

• Share regular updates with Workspace leadership and recommend service improvements supported by operational data. Establish measurable service targets with leadership and vendors.

Education and experience

• Bachelor’s degree in any discipline. A qualification in operations, logistics, supply chain, hospitality, or business administration is preferred.

• Preferably five to eight years of relevant experience in corporate employee transportation, fleet operations, or transport vendor management, including experience independently leading operations.

• Experience managing multiple transport vendors, service escalations, route planning, billing validation, and operational reporting.

• Strong understanding of Bangalore commuting patterns and practical experience managing services during traffic congestion and operational disruptions.

• Experience using employee transport management platforms such as RouteMatic or similar systems is preferred.

Skills and working approach

• Strong English communication and stakeholder coordination. Working knowledge of Kannada or Hindi is helpful for local vendor coordination.

• Proficiency in Microsoft Excel, including expense trackers, data reconciliation, and service dashboards; working knowledge of Word and PowerPoint.

• Ability to prioritise live operational issues, make decisions within delegated authority, and escalate risks early.

• Strong negotiation, attention to detail, and follow-through, with a service mindset and a firm approach to safety and vendor accountability.

• Ability to guide vendor supervisors and transport coordinators, maintain clear handovers, and support onsite operations across required service windows.

Measures of success

• Pickup and drop punctuality and trip fulfilment against agreed service targets.

• Timely resolution of employee concerns and fewer recurring vendor failures.

• Complete and current driver and vehicle verification records, with safety actions tracked to closure.

• Accurate billing reconciliation, timely monthly reporting, and spending within approved budgets.

• Improved vehicle utilisation and route efficiency, supported by a tested contingency and escalation plan.

InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast

What does the team do?

Opportunity is part of the evolving cyber security group which is laser focussed on setting up industry benchmarks in managing & guarding against digital risks in a “Cloud Native- DevOps Only” environment. It is a lean-mean-special action group where every cyber sentinel gets an opportunity to work across domain, has an independence to challenge status quo & evolve cyber practises to next level of maturity. Our core competencies revolve around “Product & Platform security”, “Cloud Native Risk Management” and “Detection & Response”.

What will you be doing?

This role combines technical leadership and hands-on execution: you will spend ~60% of your time performing application security testing, vulnerability assessments and penetration testing, code reviews, AI/ML security testing, and automation, and ~40% of your time managing the AppSec domain, leading the team, defining strategy, and coordinating with stakeholders.

• Lead the Application Security program across products, platforms, and engineering teams, defining strategy, roadmap, and measurable KPIs for AppSec and AI security maturity.

• Manage and mentor a team of AppSec engineers, ensuring effective prioritization, workload management, and continuous skill development.

• Perform hands-on SAST, DAST, manual code review, penetration testing, and vulnerability validation across web, mobile (Android and iOS), API, and cloud platforms.

• Perform security assessments of AI/ML and GenAI systems, including LLM applications, model endpoints, RAG pipelines, and agentic workflows.

• Partner with Engineering, Product, Cloud, DevOps, and Data Science teams to embed security controls early in the SDLC and ML/AI development lifecycle through automation, guardrails, and secure-by-design principles.

• Drive remediation governance: triage, track, and report on vulnerabilities with accountability across stakeholders; ensure closure within defined SLAs.

• Conduct security architecture and design reviews for new applications, APIs, integrations, and AI/ML systems to ensure alignment with enterprise security standards.

• Define and enforce secure coding guidelines, threat modeling practices (including AI/LLM threat models), and application and model hardening standards.

• Collaborate with the GRC and Incident Response teams to ensure audit readiness, compliance evidence and support during incidents.

• Research and adopt emerging AppSec and AI security technologies, frameworks, and practices to continuously strengthen defenses and developer experience.

• Drive metrics and reporting to senior leadership on AppSec performance, risk posture, and progress against roadmap goals.

What is expected of you?

• 10 to 14 years of experience.

• Proven leadership experience in Application Security, DevSecOps, or Software Security Engineering, with the ability to lead a high-performing team while staying technically hands-on.

• Deep hands-on understanding of SAST, DAST, and secure SDLC integration; prior experience implementing and scaling security testing automation.

• Working knowledge of AI/ML and LLM security, threat modeling and testing against frameworks such as the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications, OWASP ML Security Top 10, and MITRE ATLAS; familiarity with securing GenAI/agentic applications and AI pipelines.

• Strong stakeholder management skills to influence and collaborate with product, engineering, cloud, and data science teams for timely triage and remediation.

• Experience managing AppSec tooling stack like Checkmarx, Burp Suite Enterprise, OWASP ZAP, MobSF, and open-source frameworks; exposure to AI security testing tooling (e.g., Garak, PyRIT, or equivalent) is a plus.

• Solid grasp of secure coding, vulnerability exploitation, and mitigation techniques across web, mobile, API, and AI/ML layers.

• Familiarity with CI/CD automation, scripting (Python, Bash, PowerShell), and container security (Docker/Kubernetes).

• Strong understanding of OWASP Top 10, SANS Top 25, OWASP LLM Top 10, and industry best practices.

• Excellent communication, reporting, and presentation skills for technical and executive audiences.

• Certifications such as OSCP, GWAPT, GPEN, or equivalent are preferred; AI security certifications (e.g., CAISP) are a plus.

• Prior experience in building or scaling AppSec or AI security programs and driving measurable security improvements is a strong plus.

This is a strategic leadership role at the intersection of organizational behavior, psychology, people experience design, and transformation. You’ll diagnose how the organization actually functions, design the rituals and experiences that shape culture, and lead a team executing both strategy and craft.

This is not program management. This is strategic thinking and deep organizational diagnosis.

Culture Strategy & Organizational Diagnostics (30%)

• Map organizational behavior patterns: where decisions get made, who has real influence, what behaviors get rewarded, where informal systems create flow or friction

• Identify gaps between espoused culture and lived culture

• Connect culture impact to business outcomes

• Design multi-channel communication campaigns that reinforce culture initiatives and shift organizational thinking

• Ensure consistent, authentic communication across leadership and all levels of the organization

• Hire for mindset: systems thinking, psychological curiosity, rigor

• Build organizational development capability within the team

Executive Influence & Partnership (10%)

• Partner with business leaders on org design and transformation

• Bring culture perspective into business strategy discussions

• Track record of shaping organizations through strategic partnership and influence, not just program execution

• Experience designing human experiences at scale—rituals, events, organizational ceremonies

• Evidence of helping organizations shift actual behaviors and patterns, not just improve sentiment

• Experience leading internal communications and narrative design around organizational change or culture initiatives

• Systems thinker with behavioral lens. You see organizations as interconnected systems. You understand how structure shapes behavior, how incentives drive culture, how informal networks operate

• Grounded in organizational behavior and psychology. You read and apply organizational behavior science, change psychology, and org development frameworks. You’re informed by research, not trends

• Willingness to challenge. You push back with evidence. You’re comfortable saying I think we should reconsider to a peer. You’re not a yes person

• Equal parts strategist and craftsperson. You can design org systems and design rituals that move people. You don’t divorce strategy from lived experience

• Comfort with complexity. Culture work is messy. You model learning, not certainty

Communication

• Excellent at translating complex organizational concepts for different audiences

• Strong stakeholder influence—people listen because you’ve done the work

• Comfortable in difficult conversations and organizational discomfort

You will work with batch and streaming data, distributed processing frameworks, cloud data platforms, and analytical storage systems to transform large volumes of data into reliable and actionable insights. You will collaborate with backend, product, and ML engineering teams to develop efficient data solutions that support DSP operations.

This role is ideal for an engineer with strong fundamentals in Python, SQL, and distributed data processing who is keen to solve data engineering challenges involving high-volume event streams, performance optimisation, and data reliability.

Key Responsibilities

1. Data Engineering and Pipeline Development

•
Develop, maintain, and optimise end-to-end batch and streaming data pipelines for processing events such as bid requests, impressions, clicks, and conversion signals.

•
Build data ingestion and transformation workflows using Python, SQL, Apache Spark/PySpark, and relevant data engineering frameworks.

•
Work with data lakehouse architectures and contribute to ingestion, storage, transformation, and serving layers.

•
Implement data quality checks, schema validation, error handling, and monitoring to ensure data accuracy and reliability.

•
Support data modelling and query optimisation for analytical and reporting workloads.

•
Contribute to pipeline performance improvements, resource utilisation, and efficient compute and storage usage.

2. Distributed Processing and Streaming

•
Work with distributed data processing technologies such as Apache Spark, PySpark, and Apache Kafka .

•
Develop and support streaming workflows for processing event-driven data, with attention to data freshness, reliability, and processing efficiency.

•
Implement mechanisms for handling duplicate, delayed, or failed events, including retries, checkpointing, and recovery where applicable.

•
Investigate production issues and troubleshoot data pipeline failures, performance bottlenecks, and data quality discrepancies.

•
Contribute to the adoption and effective use of technologies such as Apache Flink, Spark Structured Streaming, and open table formats where relevant to the platform.

3. Data Storage and Analytics

•
Work with cloud-based data platforms and storage services to support scalable data processing and analytics.

•
Develop and optimise SQL queries, data transformations, partitioning strategies, and table structures.

•
Contribute to analytical data stores such as StarRocks, ClickHouse, or similar technologies, based on project requirements.

•
Work with data lake table formats such as Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, or Apache Hudi, where applicable.

•
Support data modelling, metadata management, access controls, and data retention practices in line with established engineering standards.

4. Collaboration and Engineering Practices

•
Collaborate with backend engineers, ML engineers, and other stakeholders to understand data requirements and deliver reliable data solutions.

•
Work with workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow or equivalent to schedule, monitor, and manage data pipelines.

•
Participate in code reviews, technical discussions, testing, and deployment activities.

•
Follow engineering best practices for version control, CI/CD, observability, documentation, and production readiness.

•
Contribute to continuous improvement by identifying opportunities to enhance pipeline reliability, scalability, performance, and cost efficiency.

Required Skills and Qualifications

Experience and Education

•
2–5 years of experience in software engineering, data engineering, or big data development.

•
Bachelor's or Master's degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or a related technical field.

•
Experience developing and maintaining data pipelines in a production environment.

•
Experience handling large datasets or distributed data processing workloads is preferred.

•
Exposure to ad-tech, programmatic advertising, real-time bidding (RTB), or event-driven systems is an added advantage.

Core Data Engineering Skills

•
Strong programming skills in Python .

•
Good command of SQL , including joins, aggregations, data transformations, and query optimisation.

•
Hands-on experience with Apache Spark/PySpark or a comparable distributed data processing framework.

•
Experience building and maintaining ETL/ELT pipelines.

•
Understanding of batch processing and streaming data concepts.

•
Exposure to workflow orchestration tools such as Apache Airflow, Prefect, or Dagster.

•
Understanding of data modelling, partitioning, schema evolution, and data quality practices.

Streaming, Cloud, and Data Platform Skills

•
Familiarity with Apache Kafka or similar messaging and streaming technologies.

•
Exposure to AWS, GCP, or Azure data services.

•
Familiarity with data lakes, lakehouse architectures, or analytical databases.

•
Exposure to Apache Iceberg, Delta Lake, Apache Hudi, StarRocks, or ClickHouse is an advantage.

•
Understanding of monitoring, logging, error handling, and production troubleshooting.

Preferred Skills

•
Experience processing high-volume event data or building near-real-time data pipelines.

•
Exposure to ad-tech datasets such as bid requests, impressions, clicks, conversions, campaign performance, or attribution data.

•
Familiarity with Java or Scala in addition to Python.

•
Basic understanding of REST APIs, microservices, and event-driven architectures.

•
Exposure to Docker, Kubernetes, and CI/CD tools is a plus.

•
Experience collaborating with ML teams on feature engineering or training data pipelines is an advantage.
