Finance BI team is part of FP&A and is responsible to upscale the organization towards data driven strategic decision making by adding the intelligence layer on top of this data - to unlock the huge potential that the right analytics could provide. This intelligence layer will be consumed towards unlocking productivity, realizing efficiencies, improving RoI for our various Products.

What You Will Do

Own finance data end to end

• Act as SME for finance data sources, definitions, and business logic across FP&A, Accounting, Revenue, and Business Units.

• Design and build Python and Spark (PySpark) pipelines that ingest, transform, and reconcile data from ERP, billing, ad platform, and operational systems into a governed analytics layer.

• Model data for finance use cases (P&L, unit economics, forecasting inputs, variance analysis, close reporting) with clear lineage and documented logic.

• Connect disconnected datasets across businesses and tools to create a single version of truth.

Analyze and find the signal

• Apply statistical methods to explain performance: regression, time-series forecasting, variance decomposition, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.

• Explore large, messy datasets to find patterns, explain why numbers move, and turn those findings into recommendations leaders can act on.

• Validate models and metrics rigorously, including back-testing forecasts and quantifying uncertainty.

Automate reporting and decision support

• Replace manual reporting with automated, scheduled, and tested data solutions.

• Build interactive dashboards and metrics layers in Rill and Power BI that summarize performance and surface recommended actions, not just charts.

• Define metrics once in a governed semantic layer so every dashboard reports the same numbers.

Build AI agents and intelligent workflows

• Design and deploy automations, reporting and insight generation using agents and workflows for tasks such as commentary drafting, anomaly explanation, reconciliation checks, and ad hoc data Q&A.

• Identify where agents create real leverage and where simpler automation is the better answer.

Work independently and drive outcomes

• Scope requirements directly with stakeholders, make reasonable trade-offs, and deliver without step-by-step direction.

• Own the full lifecycle: technical design, build, testing, documentation, deployment, monitoring, and issue resolution.

• Write modular, reusable, version-controlled code that others can maintain.

Tool Stack

• Python: data processing, automation, statistical analysis, and LLM integration

• Spark / PySpark: large-scale transformation (on Databricks or equivalent)

• SQL: modeling and analysis

• Rill: metrics views and operational dashboards

• Power BI: executive reporting

• Claude / LLM APIs: agent and workflow development

• Git: version control

What We Are Looking For

Must-have

• 2 to 5 years of experience in analytics, data engineering, or finance systems.

• Python: 2+ years, including writing tested, modular code for data pipelines and automation.

• Spark / PySpark: 2+ years of hands-on experience building production jobs on Databricks or a comparable platform.

• SQL: Strong, with experience modeling data for analytics and finance use cases.

• Rill or a comparable BI-as-code tool (Looker LookML, Cube, or similar): 1+ year of hands-on use, or a demonstrated ability to become productive quickly.

• Power BI: Working knowledge of data modeling and DAX (or equivalent).

• Statistics: Applied experience with regression, time-series forecasting, hypothesis testing, and anomaly detection.

• ETL/ELT and lakehouse experience: Hands-on with tools such as Databricks, dbt, or Airflow, and familiarity with warehouse and lakehouse architecture.

• LLM APIs: Hands-on experience building with LLM APIs (Claude preferred), including prompt design, tool use, structured outputs, and evaluation.

• Finance fundamentals: Solid understanding of accounting, financial statements, and FP&A concepts. Able to build and check financial models.

• End-to-end delivery: A track record of translating a business problem into a sustainable data product and working independently as the go-to person for a domain.

• Communication: Able to document decisions, write clear specs, and explain results to non-technical leaders.

• Bachelor's or master’s in engineering, Computer Science, Statistics, Mathematics, Finance, or a related field.

Good to have

• Experience with agent frameworks (MCP, LangGraph, or similar) and multi-step AI workflow orchestration.

• Databricks certification (Data Engineer Associate or Professional) or an equivalent cloud data certification.

• Exposure to ad tech, digital media, or high-volume transactional businesses.

Key Traits

• Curiosity: You explore data, find patterns in messy datasets, and ask why numbers move.

• Pragmatism: You choose the simplest solution that is reliable, maintainable, and actually used.

Each business serves its own audiences and has its own identity. At group level, InMobi is the common thread: the company, the technology, and the point of view behind them. This role helps shape how that group is presented and understood.

What is the role about?

The Senior Manager, Corporate Marketing is a group-level position based in Bengaluru, reporting to the Global Head of Corporate Marketing. “Group level” means the role represents the InMobi Group as a whole, rather than any single business. The incumbent is responsible for turning the group narrative into the flagship events and content through which the group is seen and heard.

The role is primarily B2B in focus. The incumbent’s purpose is to shape how the InMobi Group is perceived by the audiences that matter most to its long-term standing: prospective talent, investors, the technology community, and industry thought leaders.

The incumbent will be the senior operator in the Corporate Marketing team: a leader who plans, builds, and delivers. The role works closely with the entire Corporate Marketing team and with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams, and across teams around the world, including leadership, engineering, product, design, talent, finance, and regional marketing functions. The incumbent owns the work from the first idea to the last outcome, including the flagship events that carry the group narrative and the content and creative that bring it to life.

• Own the strategy, planning, and delivery of large-scale corporate events, including flagship group events, leadership forums, industry summits, and employee-facing moments.

• Ensure each event brings the businesses together on one stage and gives audiences a single, coherent view of the group.

• Extend the life of every event through content, social amplification, and follow-up with the audiences it was designed for.

Content and Creative

• Set the editorial direction for corporate content, including long-form articles, leadership perspectives, thought-leadership pieces, case studies, and video.

• Direct the writers, designers, and video producers who create corporate content, and maintain quality standards across everything published under the group name.

• Develop reusable content assets, such as the corporate story and event collateral, that regional and business teams can adopt.

Global Collaboration

• Work with the InMobi Advertising and Glance marketing teams and with regional, talent, finance, and engineering teams across the world to maintain a consistent group presence while reflecting local relevance.

• Act as the point of coordination for corporate marketing programmes across stakeholders, setting clear timelines, owners, and approvals.

Team and Partner Leadership

• Lead and develop a team of marketers, content creators, designers, and producers.

• Set priorities, workflows, and quality standards for the programmes the team delivers.

• Manage agency and external partnerships across events, content, creative, and production.

Measurement and Reporting

• Define KPIs across event reach and outcomes, content performance, and brand sentiment.

• Use analytics and audience feedback to refine programmes and report to senior leadership.

What is expected out of you?

• 10–12 years of experience in corporate marketing, communications, content, or brand, within technology, media, or high-growth environments, including at least 3 years leading people or large programmes.

• Strong B2B experience, preferably in technology, SaaS, adtech, or martech, with a record of building influence among professional and technical audiences.

• Demonstrated experience planning and delivering large-scale corporate events or flagship platforms, from concept to outcome.

• Excellent writing and editorial skills, with a clear, intelligent, and credible voice.

• Experience in video and visual storytelling, and in directing creative and content teams.

• Experience working with stakeholders across regions and time zones, including senior leadership.

• Experience managing agencies, vendors, and budgets.

• Strategic thinking combined with strong execution.

• Curiosity, courage, initiative, and accountability: the ability to act without waiting for perfect conditions and to learn quickly when an attempt does not succeed.

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

Where you will be challenged by the work and supported by the communities, passions and experiences that shape who you are beyond your role.

Job Description: Senior Manager Account Manager – TikTok Ads

Company: InMobi
Function: Account Management / Client Services

As part of our TikTok business, we work with advertisers and ecosystem partners to help businesses scale their advertising investments on TikTok through effective campaign execution, performance optimization, and strategic account management.

Role Overview

We are looking for an experienced, performance-driven Account Manager with a strong understanding of digital advertising and hands-on familiarity with TikTok Ads. The ideal candidate will manage advertiser relationships, drive campaign performance, identify opportunities for account growth, and ensure a high standard of client service.

This role requires a combination of platform expertise, analytical thinking, client relationship management, and cross-functional collaboration. The candidate should be comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, managing multiple accounts, solving problems independently, and translating client objectives into effective advertising strategies.

Key Responsibilities

• Account Management & Client Relationships

• Own day-to-day relationships with a portfolio of advertisers, ensuring strong engagement, timely communication, and high client satisfaction.

• Understand client business objectives, marketing priorities, target audiences, and performance expectations.

• Act as a trusted advisor to clients, providing strategic recommendations to improve campaign outcomes and grow advertising investments.

• Proactively identify opportunities to expand existing accounts through increased budgets, new campaign objectives, additional products, and new market opportunities.

• Manage client escalations effectively and ensure timely resolution of issues.

• TikTok Ads & Campaign Performance

• Demonstrate a strong understanding of the TikTok Ads platform, including campaign setup, targeting, bidding, budgets, creatives, optimization, measurement, and reporting.

• Monitor campaign performance against KPIs such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, CPM, and other relevant business metrics.

• Analyse campaign data to identify performance trends, optimization opportunities, and potential risks.

• Recommend actionable improvements across campaign structure, audience targeting, bidding strategies, creative performance, and budget allocation.

• Stay updated on TikTok Ads features, product releases, platform policies, and best practices.

• Support advertisers in troubleshooting campaign delivery, tracking, attribution, and performance-related challenges.

• Business Growth & Revenue Ownership

• Drive account growth by identifying opportunities to increase advertiser investment and improve campaign effectiveness.

• Develop account plans aligned with client objectives, revenue targets, and business priorities.

• Maintain visibility into account-level performance, revenue forecasts, growth opportunities, and potential risks.

• Work closely with sales teams to support client acquisition, onboarding, account expansion, and retention.

• Contribute to business reviews, quarterly planning, and revenue-growth initiatives.

• Data, Insights & Reporting

• Prepare and present regular campaign performance reports, business reviews, and actionable insights.

• Translate complex campaign data into clear recommendations that clients and internal stakeholders can understand.

• Use data to identify trends, diagnose performance gaps, and make evidence-based decisions.

• Maintain accurate account documentation, campaign records, forecasts, and performance trackers.

• Cross-functional Collaboration

• Work closely with sales, campaign operations, product, engineering, analytics, finance, and other internal teams to deliver a seamless advertiser experience.

• Coordinate campaign launches, platform integrations, tracking requirements, billing queries, and operational dependencies.

• Represent the voice of the customer internally and collaborate with relevant teams to resolve recurring issues and improve processes.

• Share client feedback, market intelligence, and platform-level insights to support product adoption and business strategy.

• Process Excellence & Ownership

• Manage multiple accounts and priorities effectively while maintaining strong attention to detail.

• Take end-to-end ownership of client issues, following through until resolution rather than relying solely on escalations.

• Identify process gaps and recommend scalable improvements to increase operational efficiency and client satisfaction.

• Operate with accountability, urgency, and a solutions-oriented mindset in a dynamic, high-growth environment.

Required Qualifications & Experience

• Minimum 10 years of experience in account management, client services, or campaign management within digital advertising, adtech, performance marketing, or a digital media platform.

• Hands-on experience with TikTok Ads Manager and a practical understanding of how the platform operates.

• Experience managing digital advertising campaigns and interpreting performance metrics such as CPA, ROAS, CTR, CVR, and CPM.

• Demonstrated ability to manage client relationships, solve problems, and identify opportunities for account growth.

• Strong analytical skills, with the ability to translate campaign data into actionable recommendations.

• Proficiency in Excel or Google Sheets and experience preparing client-facing reports and presentations.

• Excellent written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to present insights confidently to clients and senior stakeholders.

• Ability to manage multiple accounts, deadlines, and competing priorities independently.

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience working with performance-driven advertisers, particularly in e-commerce, mobile applications, gaming, lead generation, or other digital-first businesses.

• Experience with TikTok Pixel, Events API, conversion tracking, attribution, and measurement solutions.

• Familiarity with other major advertising platforms such as Meta Ads, Google Ads, or Microsoft Advertising.

• Experience in an agency, adtech, media platform, or channel-partner environment.

• Exposure to international advertisers, multiple geographies, or cross-border digital advertising.

• Experience collaborating with sales teams to drive advertiser adoption, retention, and revenue growth.

What Makes You Successful in This Role?

• Client-first mindset: You build trust, understand business needs, and focus on delivering measurable value.

• Platform curiosity: You understand TikTok Ads beyond the basics and actively keep up with changes in the platform.

• Analytical thinking: You use data to diagnose problems and recommend practical solutions.

• Commercial orientation: You recognise opportunities to grow accounts while protecting client outcomes and long-term relationships.

title: Staff Machine Learning Manager
description:
InMobi (Corporate)

InMobi Group is a global technology company shaping the future of agentic commerce and advertising. Through its ecosystem of businesses — including InMobi Advertising and flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi leverages data, machine learning, and generative AI to help brands reach audiences more precisely and consumers discover products more intuitively. Glance, which is pioneering new models of agentic commerce, is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd.

InMobi Advertising

InMobi Advertising, part of global technology company InMobi, is an agentic advertising platform helping brands and merchants achieve their business outcomes. Through its proprietary intelligence, AI-led solutions, and vast consumer reach — including flagship consumer platform Glance — InMobi Advertising delivers the omnichannel performance defining what's next in advertising and commerce. Glance is owned and operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of InMobi Pte. Ltd. To learn more, visit advertising.inmobi.com.

Glance

Glance is an intelligent shopping agent, redefining the commerce experience. Powered by proprietary agentic intelligence and generative AI, Glance delivers a hyper-personalized consumer experience across mobile and TV — shaping the new era of shopping. Glance is operated by Glance InMobi Pte. Ltd., a non-consolidated subsidiary of global technology leader InMobi, and is backed by Mithril Capital, Google and Jio Platforms. To learn more, visit glance.com.

Who are we and What do we do?

InMobi Group’s mission is to power intelligent, mobile-first experiences for enterprises and consumers. Its businesses across advertising, marketing, data and content platforms are shaping consumer experience in a world of connected devices. InMobi Group has been recognized on both the 2018 and 2019 CNBC Disruptor 50 list and as one of Fast Company’s 2018 World’s Most Innovative Companies.

What’s the InMobi family like?

Consistently featured among the “Great Places to Work” in India since 2017, our culture is our true north, enabling us to think big, solve complex challenges and grow with new opportunities. InMobians are passionate and driven, creative and fun-loving, take ownership and are results-focused. We invite you to free yourself, dream big and chase your passion.

What do we promise?

We offer an opportunity to have an immediate impact on the company and our products. The work that you shall do will be mission critical for InMobi and will be critical for optimizing tech operations, working with highly capable and ambitious peer groups. At InMobi, you get food for your body, soul, and mind with daily meals, gym, and yoga classes, cutting-edge training and tools, cocktails at drink cart Thursdays and fun at work on Funky Fridays. We even promise to let you bring your kids and pets to work.

What will you be doing?

We are looking for a Staff Machine Learning Manager to build and lead the ML function for Accelerate. You will own the entire ML stack - from defining the roadmap to hiring the team to shipping models into production. This is not a role where you inherit an existing ML system; you will architect and build the foundational ML capabilities that become the platform's core competitive moat: cross-channel intelligence that autonomously optimizes marketing spend.

You will report to the engineering leadership and work closely with product, data engineering, and the existing platform engineering team.

What You'll Build

Cross-Channel Budget Allocation Engine Build optimization models that allocate a brand's total marketing budget across channels to maximize aggregate ROAS. Account for channel-specific dynamics: auction mechanics, audience overlap, frequency caps, diminishing returns curves. Move from static allocation to continuous rebalancing based on real-time performance signals.

Bid Optimization & Pacing Develop bid strategy models that work across platforms with different auction types. Build spend pacing algorithms that distribute budget optimally across time (dayparting, day-of-week, seasonality). Model the response curves (spend vs. conversions) per channel and campaign type.

Multi-Touch Attribution Build cross-channel attribution models that go beyond last-click to understand the true incremental value of each channel and touchpoint. Design incrementality testing frameworks to validate attribution models and feed insights back into budget allocation and bid optimization.

Performance Forecasting Predict campaign performance (impressions, clicks, conversions, ROAS) before and during campaign execution. Build anomaly detection to flag underperforming campaigns or unusual spend patterns in real-time.

Audience Intelligence Build audience segmentation and lookalike modeling that works across channel boundaries. Identify high-value audience segments and optimize targeting recommendations based on historical cross-channel conversion data.

Creative Performance Prediction Predict creative asset performance before launch, identify creative fatigue signals, and connect creative attributes (copy, visuals, CTA type) to performance outcomes.

What We're Looking For

• 8+ years in ML/Data Science , with at least 1 year in a tech lead or management role building and shipping ML systems in production

• Strong ML breadth with depth in at least one of: optimization algorithms, recommender systems, time-series forecasting, causal inference, reinforcement learning, or auction/marketplace ML

• Hands-on technical leader : You can architect ML systems, review model code, and mentor engineers - not just manage roadmaps

• Production ML experience : You've taken models from research to production, dealt with data quality issues, and understand the gap between offline metrics and business impact

• Ads/MarTech domain experience is a strong plus: bid optimization, budget allocation, attribution, audience targeting, or media mix modeling at an ad platform, DSP, or marketing platform

Why This Role

• Greenfield ML with real data : The platform already has production data flowing from major ad platforms. You're not waiting for data - you're building the intelligence layer on top of a live system

• Clear business impact : Every model you build has a direct line to ROAS improvement for brands. The feedback loop between model and revenue is short

• The problem is genuinely hard : Cross-channel marketing optimization is a multi-objective, partially-observable, adversarial optimization problem. The ad platforms themselves are black boxes. Building intelligence across them is an unsolved problem at the industry level

• Full ownership : You define the ML strategy, hire the team, choose the tools, and ship the models. No inherited tech debt in the ML layer

• Scale potential : InMobi is one of the largest independent ad-tech companies globally. Accelerate is a strategic bet with executive sponsorship

Since 2007, InMobi has built the extraordinary. Beyond just technology. It has built a way of working.

Across 16 offices globally, through every pivot and breakthrough, one thing has remained constant: we are builders, dreamers, doers. We are fluid enough to move fast, grounded enough to own outcomes, and human enough to care deeply about the work and about one another.

Culture is at the core of that ethos. It has been co-created by the people who built this company and by those continuing to shape it every day. It lives in how we work, how decisions are made, how teams show up for one another, and how seriously we take the responsibility to build the best.

title: Customer Value Architect
description:
About Mixpanel

About the Team

The Customer Value Architect (CVA) team sits inside Mixpanel's Revenue organization and owns the connection between what customers buy and what they actually get out of Mixpanel. You'll work alongside an Account Executive (AE), who owns growth, new business, and expansion; a Renewal Manager (RM), who owns the commercial renewal; and a Delivery Engineer (DE), who owns technical implementation and data health — each with a clear lane, converging on the same outcome for the customer.

About the Role

This is not a build role, but real comfort with data is required. As a Customer Value Architect, you are accountable for adoption, value realization, and account health across a portfolio of existing Mixpanel customers, from onboarding through to a renewal-ready handoff. Responsibilities

• Own the onboarding outcome and time-to-value for your accounts: take the handoff from the Account Executive, partner with the Delivery Engineer on the technical build, and drive the customer to their first realized value.

• Own the success plan for each account — map business objectives to specific use cases and set a measurable baseline at definition time, so value can be proven later. • Lead customer enablement and training (dashboard design, funnel analysis, retention modeling) to grow how deeply and widely a customer uses Mixpanel.

• Build and maintain a network of champions and evangelists across the account, rather than relying on a single point of contact.

• Monitor product usage and account health signals; run regular business reviews that surface adoption gaps early and turn them into targeted enablement.

• Quantify value delivered against baseline and lead Quarterly Business Reviews (QBRs) and value reviews — partnering with the Renewal Manager as renewal approaches and the Account Executive for executive engagement, while staying out of the pricing conversation entirely.

• Own the day-to-day relationship with a customer's technical stakeholders — you do not build the pipeline, but you need enough fluency in data models and product metrics to be trusted by the people who do.

• Build a working point of view on each customer's AI maturity and guide adoption of Mixpanel's own AI surface (Mixpanel AI, Mixpanel Agent); escalate Model Context Protocol (MCP), headless, or agentic build requests to your Delivery Engineer.

• Detect churn and health risk early, root-cause it, and own the value-linked save — pulling in your Account Executive (commercial lever), Delivery Engineer (technical lever), or Renewal Manager (if inside the renewal window) as needed.

• Route technical requests (pipeline issues, tracking-plan changes, integration troubleshooting) to your Delivery Engineer, and unpurchased-product feasibility questions to your Customer Engineer (CE) via the Account Executive.

• Spot use-case gaps that need a new product and source them to the Account Executive as expansion signals, with evidence attached. • Contribute back to the team's playbooks and best practices.

We're Looking For Someone Who Has

• 3–5 years of experience in Customer Success, account management, or consulting, supporting business-to-business (B2B) Software-as-a-Service (SaaS) accounts — backgrounds from product analytics, Customer Data Platform (CDP), or martech companies

• Genuine comfort working directly with data: can read a dashboard, reason about an event taxonomy, and hold a credible conversation with a customer's technical team, without needing to be the one implementing it.

• A track record of managing relationships across a range of stakeholders, from day-to-day practitioners to business executives.

• Experience building and running structured adoption or success plans that tie daily work to a defined, measurable outcome.

• Hands-on experience with AI or agentic tooling beyond casual use — MCP-based workflows, LLM copilots, or similar.

• Good judgment on prioritizing across a portfolio of accounts by risk, tier, and opportunity.

Bonus Points For

• Background in product analytics, growth, or data-driven product development.

• Experience in a technical advisory or professional-services capacity.

• Familiarity with analytics instrumentation, event tracking, or data tooling.
Benefits and Perks

• Comprehensive Medical, Vision, and Dental Care

• Mental Wellness Benefit

• Generous Vacation Policy & Additional Company Holidays

• Enhanced Parental Leave

• Volunteer Time Off

• Additional US Benefits: Pre-Tax Benefits including 401(K), Wellness Benefit, Holiday Break

*please note that benefits and perks for contract positions will vary*

Culture Values

• Make Bold Bets: We choose courageous action over comfortable progress.

• Innovate with Insight: We tackle decisions with rigor and judgment - combining data, experience and collective wisdom to drive powerful outcomes.

• One Team: We collaborate across boundaries to achieve far greater impact than any of us could accomplish alone.

• Candor with Connection: We build meaningful relationships that enable honest feedback and direct conversations.

• Champion the Customer: We seek to deeply understand our customers’ needs, ensuring their success is our north star.

• Powerful Simplicity: We find elegant solutions to complex problems, making sophisticated things accessible.

Why choose Mixpanel?

We’re a leader in analytics with over 29,000 customers and $277M invested from prominent investors: like Andreessen-Horowitz, Sequoia, YC, and, most recently, Bain Capital. Mixpanel’s pioneering event-based data analytics platform offers a powerful yet simple solution for companies to understand user behaviors and easily track overarching company success metrics. Our accomplished teams continuously facilitate our expansion by tackling the ever-evolving challenges tied to scaling, reliability, design, and service. Choosing to work at Mixpanel means you’ll be helping the world’s most innovative companies learn from their data so they can make better decisions.

Mixpanel is an equal opportunity employer supporting workforce diversity. At Mixpanel, we are focused on things that really matter—our people, our customers, our partners—out of a recognition that those relationships are the most valuable assets we have. We actively encourage women, people with disabilities, veterans, underrepresented minorities, and LGBTQ+ people to apply. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. Pursuant to the San Francisco Fair Chance Ordinance or other similar laws that may be applicable, we will consider for employment qualified applicants with arrest and conviction records. We’ve immersed ourselves in our Culture and Values as our guiding principles for the impact we want to have and the future we are building.

title: Business Systems Analyst 3
description:
We are seeking an experienced, techno-functional Business Systems Analyst (BSA) with broad experience across enterprise finance systems and processes, including accounting, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), and Procure-to-Pay (P2P). The ideal candidate will bridge business stakeholders and technical teams to deliver system enhancements, integrations, automation, and process improvements across the finance function. The role requires an understanding of end-to-end finance processes, requirements gathering, functional configuration, integration design, testing, production support, and stakeholder management.

1. Business Analysis and Process Management

• Partner with Procurement, Accounts Payable, Finance, and business stakeholders to gather, analyze, and document business requirements

• Translate business requirements into functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution designs

• Analyze and optimize end-to-end finance processes, including general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close

• Facilitate stakeholder workshops, requirement reviews, and solution walkthroughs

• Analyze integration failures, data discrepancies, synchronization issues, and transaction errors

• Document interface specifications, field mappings, dependencies, and reconciliation procedures

• Collaborate with ERP teams, particularly NetSuite, SAP, or Oracle, to support financial postings and master data synchronization

3. Testing, Deployment, and Production Support

• Execute functional, integration, regression, and user acceptance testing (UAT)

• Coordinate defect triage, root cause analysis, and resolution with technical teams

• Support release management, deployment validation, and post-implementation stabilization

• Maintain functional documentation, configuration records, support procedures, and knowledge articles

4. Governance, Controls, and Stakeholder Management

• Ensure solutions align with internal controls, audit requirements, segregation of duties, and financial compliance standards

• Support access reviews, approval hierarchy validation, and audit evidence collection

• Manage incidents, service requests, and enhancement backlogs using tools such as Jira or ServiceNow

• Communicate status, risks, dependencies, and resolutions to business and technical stakeholders

• Identify opportunities for automation, standardization, and continuous process improvement

Required Qualifications and Skills

• 6+ years of experience in business systems analysis, enterprise applications, or finance systems

• Strong techno-functional experience with enterprise finance systems

• Good understanding of core finance and accounting processes, such as general ledger, record-to-report, accounts payable, accounts receivable, Order-to-Cash (OTC), Source-to-Pay (S2P), Procure-to Pay (P2P), billing, collections, reconciliations, and financial close

• Experience gathering requirements and creating functional specifications, user stories, process flows, and solution documentation

• Practical understanding of APIs, integration patterns, data mapping, file-based interfaces, and troubleshooting

• Experience with functional testing, UAT coordination, defect management, and production support

• Familiarity with Finance systems such as NetSuite, Concur, COUPA etc

• Strong analytical, problem-solving, communication, and stakeholder management skills

• Ability to work independently and collaborate effectively with business users, developers, and integration teams

Preferred Qualifications

• Experience with finance systems integrations involving ERP, CRM, billing, HR, banking, procurement, and other business platforms

• Familiarity with SQL, data analysis, API testing tools such as Postman, and integration monitoring

• Experience supporting multi-entity, multi-subsidiary, or global finance environments

• Knowledge of SOX controls, audit requirements, approval governance, and financial reconciliations

• Experience with Agile delivery, Jira, ServiceNow, and ITIL-based support processes

Key Success Criteria

• Accurate translation of business requirements into effective system solutions

• Reliable operation of finance systems business processes and integrations

• Reduced transaction errors, integration failures, and manual intervention

description:

We are looking for a Digital Success Manager to foster high-impact customer relationships at scale by leveraging data, automation, and digital channels to deliver tailored, value-led experiences. Blending strategic insight with digital programmes, you will help advance our Digital-First strategy.

Serving as a subject matter expert across a high volume of accounts, you will build deep knowledge of your assigned region, analyzing retention trends and uncovering new ways to add value. Because this role is still evolving, we seek an entrepreneurial self-starter who is curious, driven, and excited to take initiative, and who uses AI hands-on to accelerate their work, conduct research, and manage programmes while understanding its limitations.

Cross-functional partnership is central to this role: you will build a deep understanding of the priorities, programmes, and customer work underway across Sales and partner teams, then use that context to shape Digital Customer Success so our solutions connect with and complement existing efforts rather than being built in silos.

• Lead customer engagement and retention through digital-first programmes, designing 1:many workshops, webinars, and targeted digital touchpoints. Drive the regional 1:many strategy for our long tail segment, and drive selective 1:1 interactions where appropriate to ensure high impact

• Partner closely with Sales, account teams, and cross-functional partners to deeply understand customers and the priorities, programmes, and solutions already underway across teams. Use that knowledge to align objectives and co-design digital-first programmes that connect with, complement, and scale existing efforts rather than duplicate work or build in silos. Share regional insights and unlock enablement opportunities, improve onboarding, and mitigate churn

• Use AI tools and techniques to build your own dashboards, conduct your own research, and manage your own programmes, bringing curiosity and initiative to how you work, not just what you deliver.

What You'll Bring:

• Experience: 3+ years in Customer Success, account management or a similar role; familiarity with scaled or digital models across onboarding and consumption phases

• AI Fluency: Genuine enthusiasm for and hands-on experience with AI tools, with a track record of using them independently to build dashboards, automate research, or manage programmes

title: Director of Global Security Operations
description:
MongoDB's Global Security Organization (GSO) is looking for a Director of Global Security Operations to build and lead GSO's first dedicated team in India. This is a foundational leadership role: your first mandate is to stand up a 20-person team from scratch.

This team’s first mission will be extending US based teams in three different areas:

• Vulnerability management - AI driven detection, triage and workflow management of vulnerabilities from code to components to applications to infrastructure

• Launch readiness - shifting security analysis left to proactively address security needs as far upstream from product launch as possible

• Core enterprise security - projects focusing on improving protection against insider threats and and newly emerging AI Governance and Security needs

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Who We Are

GSO secures MongoDB's products, infrastructure, and the trust our customers place in us — spanning product security, corporate security, and risk, and working across engineering, go-to-market, and corporate development to keep security moving at the same speed as the business.

Responsibilities

• Recruit, hire, and onboard a 20-person team including 3 managers - across vulnerability management, launch readiness, and core enterprise security

• Stand up the operating rhythms, tooling, and documentation the India team needs to work as a first-class part of GSO from day one

• Get new hires productively engaged quickly and working seamlessly with required stakeholders

• Actively manage matrix reporting, ensuring ambiguity doesn't slow the team down — resolve competing priorities between local and functional leadership before they become the team's problem

• Represent the India team's capacity, constraints, and growth needs back to GSO leadership

• Build the durable leadership bench and processes that let the India team operate as an accountable, outcome-owning part of GSO going forward

Requirements

• 12+ years of experience in security operations, security engineering, or a related technical discipline, including at least 5 years in a people-leadership role

• Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, Information Security, or a related field, or equivalent practical experience

• Direct, hands-on experience in at least one of: vulnerability management, security automation or workflow tooling, or enterprise security operations

• A track record of hiring and ramping a technical team quickly while holding the line on quality and culture

• Experience operating successfully in a matrix structure — with the judgment to manage functional dotted-line relationships without losing ownership of your own team

• Comfort with a mandate that will evolve as the team matures — you're building this job as much as filling it

• Strong communication and relationship-building skills across geographies and time zones spanning the US, EMEA, and India

Don't feel that you meet all of the requirements? We encourage you to apply anyway — studies show strong candidates sometimes rule themselves out prematurely. MongoDB has a diverse, inclusive, equitable, and high-performing environment, and we want to keep improving our ability to deliver for customers.

Nice to Haves

• Background specifically in vulnerability management platforms, security orchestration/automation (SOAR) tooling, or enterprise security operations at scale

• Prior experience in a matrix organization with international, distributed reporting lines

Success in This Role Means

• The India team is fully staffed and operating to MongoDB's standards for quality, pace, and culture

• Ability to step into direct delivery level accountability vs. extending capabilities of other teams once the initial team build phase is complete

• The India GSO team has moved from a build-phase support function to owning clear, accountable delivery in vulnerability management, workflow automation, and enterprise security

title: Engineering Manager, AI Builder Experience
description:
AI frameworks like LangChain, LlamaIndex, and n8n are quickly becoming the default way developers build with AI — and MongoDB wants to be the data platform that shows up everywhere they build. As part of the AI Builders Experience org at MongoDB, we’re forming a brand new engineering team to make that happen, and we're looking for the founding Engineering Manager to hire the team, set the technical direction, and ship integrations into some of the fastest-moving open-source ecosystems in tech.

In this role, you'll be close enough to the code to jump into exploratory work yourself while also building the team, process, and operational rigor to keep a growing integration portfolio healthy long-term. The new team will work mostly in Python and TypeScript while collaborating closely with client library teams and other engineering groups across MongoDB that deliver the underlying driver, platform, and product capabilities needed to support these integrations well.

You’ll collaborate closely and move quickly with product, partners, field teams, the developer community, and open source project maintainers to ship where demand is real, deepen investment where adoption proves out, and evolve the portfolio over time as it becomes a critical part of MongoDB’s future in AI.

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our values every day. We value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

Position expectations

• Work closely with recruiting to hire a team of Python and TypeScript engineers who will build and own MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like Langchain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra

• Help the team build and maintain sustainable engineering practices, including CI/CD, automated testing, version compatibility awareness, and strong integration health over time

• Develop a team that stays current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems, including important frameworks, community discussions, and emerging patterns; maintain awareness of trends and discourse in contemporary AI

• Bring a research and discovery mindset to the role, using customer, community, partner, and field signals to help guide roadmap and investment decisions; identify emerging opportunities in the ecosystem and help decide where early investment could create strategic advantage

Qualifications

• 8+ years of experience building developer platforms, libraries, or other high-scale technical systems, with strong proficiency in Python or TypeScript and an ability to lead teams working across both the Python and TypeScript ecosystems. Experience working with programming language polyglot teams is a plus

• 3+ years of experience managing a team of software engineers and providing technical leadership for complex projects or products

• Experience with query optimization (especially MongoDB) and AI coding tools; distributed systems experience would be an asset

• Demonstrated success hiring, mentoring, and growing high-performing engineering teams, including experience supporting career development, feedback, and performance management

• Demonstrated ability to operate effectively in a fast-moving technical landscape with frequent context switching, incomplete information, and competing opportunities, while maintaining sound prioritization and strong judgment

• Strong technical depth in developer-facing software, with the judgment to make and guide architectural trade-offs

• Experience leading the launch of new features or systems and operating them successfully in production after release

• Excellent written and verbal technical communication, with a strong instinct to collaborate across engineering, product, and other stakeholder groups

• A track record of escalating issues early and fostering a team culture that values intellectual honesty and collaboration

• Comfort operating in ambiguous, evolving spaces and helping teams make progress when customer behavior, technical requirements, or ecosystem priorities are still taking shape

• Strong and demonstrated interest in modern AI builder workflows and the developer tooling landscape, ideally with familiarity across frameworks, retrieval patterns, agent workflows, embedding, vector search, or adjacent areas; experience in this area would be an asset

• Experience working with open source software, external ecosystems, or integrations with third-party frameworks and communities, especially in the Python ecosystem; familiarity with open source contribution models, external maintainers, and engineering work that spans company-owned and upstream repositories would be a plus

Success measures

As "Program Manager, Customer Strategy & Operations" you’ll play a critical role as part of our PMO in the scaling of our Customer Organization.

In this role, you'll be the driving force behind a portfolio of programs and strategic initiatives, each aimed at realizing customer value, optimizing our operations, and advancing our capabilities. Your ability to anticipate obstacles, work through developing problem spaces, influence cross-functional alignment, and realize strategic outcomes will be crucial in maximizing our collective impact.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model. The working model for this role can be in office (3 days a week) or flexible (2 days a week).

The ideal candidate will:

Orchestrate multiple, interconnected projects, programs, and portfolios to maximize long term benefits. Drive high-level decision-making that aligns program objectives with organizational goals and customer needs

• Have a knack for looking around corners: Recognize patterns in a sea of information and take action accordingly. Anticipate program-wide risks and opportunities. Develop strategies to mitigate issues across multiple projects and programs, manage interdependencies, and capitalize on synergies within the portfolio

• Follow the data: Understand how data contributes to better story telling. Devise compelling program-wide metrics and analytics frameworks. Leverage cross-program data to inform strategic decision-making and drive continuous improvement across the entire portfolio

• Detest surprises: Sweep nothing under the rug. Establish clear program objectives, scope, deliverables, and roadmaps in partnership with senior leadership and key stakeholders that account for dependencies, constraints, and conflicts. Ensure alignment between individual programs and overarching portfolio goals

• Live in the future: Take a long term position in all that you do and help others see the big picture. Develop long-term program strategies that anticipate evolving business needs. Implement scalable frameworks and best practices that elevate program management capabilities across the organization

• Be a good human: Leave your ego at the door. Model accountability and create the structures that help cultivate it in others. Provide mentorship and guidance to teams across your programs. Foster a culture of ownership, integrity, and collaboration that spans multiple teams and departments

Requirements

• Experience: At least 5+ years in a program or portfolio management role overseeing a portfolio of complex, interdependent programs in a technical environment. Proven track record of delivering strategic outcomes through multi-program initiatives across various methodologies

• Communication & Consensus: Exceptional ability to articulate program vision, status, and impact to diverse audiences. Orchestrate collaboration between senior leaders, cross-functional teams, and external stakeholders to ensure program outcomes align with organizational strategy and customer needs. Skilled at influencing without authority and facilitating high-level strategic discussions to drive results

• Adaptability: Navigate complex, evolving program landscapes. Ability to pivot program direction in response to changing business priorities while maintaining overall strategic alignment across the portfolio

• Improvement: Implement program-wide continuous improvement initiatives. Foster a culture of innovation and efficiency across multiple programs and portfolio teams

• Optimization: Develop and execute strategies for optimal resource allocation across the program portfolio. Balance competing priorities and interdependencies to maximize overall program impact

• Change: Lead large-scale organizational and structural changes through strategic program and portfolio initiatives. Ensure smooth adoption of new processes, tools, or methodologies across multiple teams and departments

Success Measures

• In 3 months you will have gained a comprehensive understanding of MongoDB's ecosystem, fully integrated into Customer and PMO processes, and begun developing a strategic roadmap for your programs and portfolio

• In 6 months you'll have established robust program governance structures, aligned multiple projects and programs with our organizational goals, and demonstrated initial strategic impact across your portfolio

• In 9 months you'll have identified opportunities for program-wide operational improvements, built consensus among senior stakeholders for these initiatives, and begun implementing changes that enhance overall program and portfolio effectiveness to materialize organizational value

What's In It For You

• Mentorship & Career Growth: Our team is dedicated to supporting new members. We have a broad mix of experience levels and tenures, and we celebrate knowledge sharing and mentorship. We care about your career growth and strive to help you achieve your goals

• Work-Life Harmony: Our team puts a high value on work-life harmony. It isn't about how many hours you spend at home or at work; it's about the flow you establish that benefits both parts of your life. We offer flexibility and encourage you to find your own balance

• Empowerment & Autonomy: Our team believes in empowering you to #OwnWhatYouDo and #MakeItMatter. You'll receive the support you need to achieve a high level of independence

• Location & Flexibility: MongoDB provides multiple working model options for our employees, including the flexibility to work from home to opportunities for collaboration and social interaction in a MongoDB office. These working models may be dependent on specific roles and are mutually agreed upon between employees and their managers

• Generous compensation package: MongoDB believes in the value our employees add to the company and we pay in the top 95th percentile. Salary is just one part of MongoDB's total compensation and benefits package. Other benefits for eligible employees may include: equity, participation in the employee stock purchase program, flexible paid time off, 20 weeks fully-paid gender-neutral parental leave, fertility and adoption assistance, 401(k) plan, mental health counseling, access to transgender-inclusive health insurance coverage, and health benefits offerings. Compensation at the time of offer is unique to each candidate based on a variety of factors such as skill set, experience, qualifications, and work location

You'll work closest with the engineers sitting next to you, pairing on hard problems, reviewing each other's code, and dividing up a broad portfolio, while collaborating with product, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers as the work requires.

You'll integrate with fast-moving, often unproven technologies, make pragmatic calls in the face of ambiguity, and own high-visibility projects with minimal guidance. Priorities can shift week to week based on framework changes, customer demand, and partner needs, so we're looking for product-minded engineers who thrive on autonomy and take pride in shipping. Much of your work will happen in public: sending pull requests to upstream repositories, working through external maintainer review cycles, and representing MongoDB in developer communities.

MongoDB engineering teams pride themselves on building high-quality software and living our cultural values every day — we value intellectual curiosity, intellectual honesty, customer empathy, and building together in an environment that prioritizes collaboration over competition.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram for our hybrid working model.

• Design, build, test, and ship MongoDB integrations across a broad AI framework ecosystem that includes technologies like LangChain, LangGraph, LlamaIndex, n8n, and Mastra, owning them from first exploratory spike through production release and ongoing maintenance.

• Take ownership of ambiguous problems and drive them to completion independently, making sound decisions as requirements, frameworks, and customer needs evolve.

• Do the initial, exploratory work: assess a new framework, define the smallest useful version of an integration, get it in front of users quickly, and make a clear recommendation about whether and how to invest further.

• Contribute high-quality code upstream to repositories MongoDB doesn't own, maintaining a high standard of professionalism and courtesy while working through external maintainer review cycles.

• Build and maintain the team's engineering practices for a broad integration portfolio, including CI/CD, automated testing across framework and server versions, version compatibility awareness, and release readiness.

• Own the operational health of the integrations you build — monitoring, upgrades, breaking-change response, issue triage, and follow-through after launch.

• Partner with the Database Experience (DBX) org to define the driver, platform, and product capabilities your integrations depend on, making the case for what's needed and why.

• Work with product management, product design, partners, field teams, and open source maintainers to define the first version and future evolution of these integrations.

• Raise the technical bar within the team: shape architecture and development practices, give thorough code reviews, share what you know, and mentor peers and less experienced engineers.

• Stay current with the Python, TypeScript, and broader AI builder ecosystems and bring what you learn back to the team's roadmap.

• Bring a research and discovery mindset: notice emerging opportunities in the ecosystem, surface them early, and make the case for where MongoDB should show up next.

title: Technical Services Engineer
description:
MongoDB Technical Services partners with customers to help them successfully run MongoDB in production. Our globally distributed organization provides 24x7x365 support through a follow-the-sun model, combining deep technical expertise with a strong commitment to customer outcomes.

The Role

MongoDB Technical Services Engineers use their exceptional problem solving and customer service skills, along with their deep technical experience, to advise customers and to solve their complex MongoDB ecosystem problems. Technical Service Engineers are experts in the entire MongoDB ecosystem - database server, drivers, cloud and infrastructure. This also includes services such as Atlas (database as a service), or Cloud Manager (which helps customers with automation, backup and monitoring of their MongoDB systems). Our engineers combine their MongoDB expertise with passion, initiative, teamwork and a great sense of humor to help our customers to be successful with MongoDB.

We are looking to speak to candidates who are based in Gurugram and Bengaluru for our hybrid working model.

Cool things you’ll do

You’ll bring strong SQL (and/or NOSQL) and database fundamentals, a practical approach to technical problem-solving, and genuine curiosity about the trade-offs between performance and cost. You’ll also help build the AI-enabled support infrastructure that lets customers and engineers solve problems more effectively.

What you’ll do

• Diagnose problems across application, database, network, storage and infrastructure layers using logs, metrics, traces, query plans and other diagnostic evidence

• Advise customers and prospects on data architecture, query performance, and practical ways to meet their performance and cost goals

• Be a trusted technical voice throughout evaluation and adoption, communicating trade-offs clearly to engineers and other stakeholders

• Bring customer feedback, recurring issues, and product gaps to Product and Engineering, and help turn those signals into improvements

What you’ll bring

You should have 5+ years of proven experience, we consider all candidates with an eye for those who are self-taught, insatiably curious, and multi-faceted.

The ideal candidate should have strong technical experience in more than one of the following areas:

• Strong SQL and hands-on experience diagnosing analytical database workloads, including interpreting query plans and investigating performance issues

• Hands-on experience working with databases, including diagnosing behavior and performance in real workloads

• Lead customers through production incidents end to end: triage, recovery planning, live communication, and post-incident root cause analysis

• Practical systems troubleshooting experience across Linux or comparable operating systems, networking, storage, compute, and clustered or distributed environments

• Troubleshoot and improve the ecosystem around the database: drivers, connectors, and integrations customers depend on

• Ability to design or assess customer workload evaluations and benchmarks, interpret results critically, and explain performance and cost trade-offs

• Guide customer migrations and onboarding, from workload analysis and data model design through data validation and go-live

• Strong written and verbal communication, customer empathy, and ownership through to resolution

Helpful experience

• Scripting or automation with Python or Bash; working with APIs, SDKs, or database drivers

• Familiarity with cloud data platforms and object storage; Docker or Kubernetes exposure

• Experience with analytical databases or data warehouses, including columnar storage, indexing or partitioning, query optimization, and data ingestion

• Experience supporting database migrations, production operations, or customer-facing technical support

• Familiarity with scripting or automation and with AI-assisted support workflows

• Experience in pre-sales, consulting engineering, or a customer-facing engineering role is a plus

• Ability to understand customer goals and workloads, explain technical trade-offs clearly, and recommend practical solutions is valued

Success Measures

• In 3 months, build working knowledge of the platform, tools, support processes, and customer workloads through structured training and case shadowing

• In 6 months, you will be comfortable working frontline with our customers. You will also complete the MongoDB Certified DBA Associate exam

• In 12 months, you will work on gaining expertise to be a part of a technical experts group within the MongoDB ecosystem and will be helping your peer engineers in advance diagnostics. Also, you will be encouraged to handle technical escalations independently

description:

The IT SaaS Engineering Team is the backbone of MongoDB's go-to-market operations. We build and run the Salesforce platform — with the automation, security, and governance that Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Security, and Compliance rely on daily to manage customer relationships and drive business growth.

Role Overview

We're hiring a Technical Staff Engineer - Salesforce to own the architecture, design, and evolution of our CRM platform. This role combines deep technical leadership, hands-on solution design, and a modern engineering mindset that embraces AI-powered development responsibly. As a senior individual contributor, this person sets technical direction and raises the engineering bar through architecture, design, and mentorship.

What You'll do

• Lead architecture, design, and development of scalable Salesforce solutions — custom applications, automations, and integrations

• Translate business requirements into secure, maintainable, technical solutions aligned with long-term platform strategy

• Partner with business stakeholders, product teams, and engineering to refine requirements and deliver high-quality solutions

• Oversee integrations between Salesforce and other enterprise platforms, ensuring reliable data flow and sound system design

• Drive platform optimization across performance, scalability, usability, and governance

• Establish and enforce engineering standards for coding, testing, documentation, CI/CD, and release management

• Troubleshoot complex production issues and drive long-term, scalable resolutions

• Identify tech debt and drive modernization efforts across the Salesforce ecosystem

• Leverage AI-powered engineering tools (Apex Guru, GitHub Copilot, Salesforce Agentforce Vibes, Claude Code) to improve productivity and code quality — with strong judgment on security, privacy, and accuracy.

Responsibilities

• Provide technical leadership through architecture reviews, design reviews, code reviews, and engineering best practices

title: Manager, Customer Identity, Security Engineering
description:
Secure Every Identity, from AI to Human

Identity is the key to unlocking the potential of AI. Okta secures AI by building the trusted, neutral infrastructure that enables organizations to safely embrace this new era. This work requires a relentless drive to solve complex challenges with real-world stakes. We are looking for builders and owners who operate with speed and urgency and execute with excellence.

This is an opportunity to do career-defining work. We're all in on this mission. If you are too, let's talk.

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Role

We seek a technical, research-minded Security Engineering Manager to lead security engineering teams within Auth0 Customer Identity. Your teams' work spans two areas. The first is threat protection: providing general and AI-driven threat intelligence in partnership with Identity Security, and researching how attackers leverage AI, how we build AI-assisted defenses, and how we protect AI workloads across our products, infrastructure, and customer tenants. The second is software development for security: building micro-services and tooling that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including how secrets are generated, stored, distributed, rotated, and retired.

This role leads teams embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to deliver proactive threat intelligence, get ahead of emerging attack vectors, and build the security software that protects our platform, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused organization that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you will set direction for teams that don't just assess our current security posture — they research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, build the software that delivers those protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses and secure-by-default secrets handling into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

You will lead a globally distributed group of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment .

You will stay technical enough to challenge designs, evaluate research, review software architecture, and earn the respect of strong engineers, while spending most of your time on leadership: hiring, growing, and retaining your teams and shaping their roadmaps.

Responsibilities:

• Hire, lead, coach, and develop globally distributed teams of security engineers (Senior through Staff), building a culture of research discipline, technical excellence, and ownership

• Define and execute a multi-quarter roadmap for your teams, aligned with Customer Identity business goals and Okta's company-wide security strategy, and balance investment and prioritization across them

• Lead the delivery of scalable, reliable micro-services and automation that secure Customer Identity products and infrastructure, including secrets storage, rotation, access control, auditing, and workload identity

• Drive adoption of secure-by-default secrets handling across Auth0 engineering teams, and reduce the risk from hard-coded, long-lived, or over-privileged credentials

• Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from, then prioritize investments in detection, tooling, and protections to get there

Security Engineer, Customer Identity, Advanced Threat Protection

Get to know Okta

Okta is The World’s Identity Company. We free everyone to safely use any technology—anywhere, on any device or app. Our Workforce and Customer Identity Clouds enable secure yet flexible access, authentication, and automation that transforms how people move through the digital world, putting Identity at the heart of business security and growth.

At Okta, we celebrate a variety of perspectives and experiences. We are not looking for someone who checks every single box - we’re looking for lifelong learners and people who can make us better with their unique experiences.

Join our team! We’re building a world where Identity belongs to you.

The Role

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role does two things at once: it researches how attackers will use AI against identity systems, and it researches and builds how we use AI to defend our products, our infrastructure, and — most importantly — our customers' tenants.

This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment .

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

Responsibilities:

• Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)

We seek a knowledgeable and research-focused Security Engineer to join a new Advanced Threat Protection team within Auth0 Customer Identity. This role is a key member of the Security team embedded within the Customer Identity product unit and works across multiple functions to get ahead of emerging AI threats, supporting the growth of our global Customer Identity business.

We are an engineering-focused team that seeks to stay on the cutting edge of security technology and the threat landscape. In this role you won't just assess our current AI security offering — you'll research what we should be protecting customers from one to two years ahead, turn that research into concrete protections, and help put AI-assisted defenses into the hands of the teams and customers who protect their tenants.

In this role you will work as part of a globally distributed team of talented engineers who share a passion for security and enjoy solving complex problems at scale. This role works closely with and alongside the members of the broader Okta Security team in support of Okta's company-wide security strategy and Okta’s Secure Identity Commitment .

This is a level-agnostic description; scope, autonomy, and leadership expectations scale with level (Senior through Staff).

Responsibilities:

• Research and lead how we can use AI to protect customer tenants — both proactively (hardening posture before an attack) and during active incidents (accelerating detection, triage, and response)

• Research and build protections against novel AI attacks that Auth0 and Auth0's customers can be subjected to — adversarial ML, prompt injection, abuse of agentic protocols (MCP, A2A, UCP, and emerging equivalents), model and data poisoning — as they apply to identity systems and customer tenants

• Partner with the identity security teams to help customers strengthen their own tenant security posture through AI-assisted defenses

• Research the emerging AI threat landscape and translate it into a forward-looking (12–24 month) view of what we need to protect ourselves and our customers from — then architect, recommend, and build the tooling to get there

• Review and harden Auth0's AI security offering, identifying gaps and recommending mitigations before they're exploited

• Partner across a globally distributed product-aligned team of security engineers to turn research into shipped protections for customer tenants

• Establish and execute a long-term engineering and threat research roadmap for Advanced Threat Protection aligned with company-wide business and security goals.

• Own high-impact security architecture designs and decisions across Auth0 and Okta Customer Identity infrastructure to support long-term threat resilience.

• Drive cross-functional security strategies and partner across engineering, product, and enterprise security leadership across Okta to influence platform-wide standards and policies.

• Actively coach, mentor, and level up Senior (P3) engineers and team members, fostering technical excellence, research discipline, and leadership growth.

• AWS and/or Azure security

• Kubernetes

• You have strong knowledge of OWASP (including the OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications) and secure coding best practices

• You have a strong foundation in secure software development lifecycle best practices

• You have strong written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to turn research into clear guidance for engineering and product teams

• You have experience working with a globally distributed and remote team

Bonus points if:

• You have built AI/ML-powered security tooling or defensive automation in a production environment

• You have working knowledge and experience with one or more of the following:

About the Team

Authentication tells you who someone is. Authorization decides what they can do, and doing that well at scale is hard. Role-based access breaks down as applications grow, and AI agents are changing who, and what, asks for access. Auth0 FGA solves this with fine-grained authorization. Its engine is OpenFGA, a CNCF incubating open source project that Okta maintains with contributors from other companies, and Auth0 FGA runs that same engine as a managed service.

FGA DevEx owns how developers experience both: our SDKs, CLI, IDE plugins, Helm charts and docs, all developed in the open. The FGA group owns its product end to end, from infrastructure to docs, so we move quickly and see our work reach developers.

Our guiding principle: one developer experience, many deployment models.

About the role

We're hiring a Staff Engineer to set the technical direction for everything the team owns, and to mentor the senior engineers who build it, starting with our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python, Java and more. From there, you'll shape where the developer experience goes next, from how our SDKs evolve to new surfaces like MCP servers. You'll partner with the Core team on API design, so every new capability feels natural in each language.

This is an individual contributor role. You'll work closely with the engineering manager, who owns people and delivery

Responsibilities

Set the direction:

• Define and drive the technical direction for FGA DevEx across open source and SaaS, and turn it into a roadmap with the engineering manager and the product team.

• Build support for that direction across the team, the FGA group and open source community

• Mentor the team's senior engineers, and raise the level of everyone around you.

• Establish how a new team builds software, from design reviews and coding standards to how we test and ship, and set the quality bar.

• Make the calls that are hard to undo: when an API is ready to ship across every language, how it evolves, and when to deprecate.

• Be the voice of developer experience across FGA : partner with the Core team on API design and with internal teams such as Integrations, and flag developer friction wherever you see it.

Own the Platform:

• Architect our SDKs in Go, JavaScript, .NET, Python and Java, including the generator every client is built from.

• Set the standards every SDK follows, from authentication and error handling to retries and rate limiting.

• Shape the tooling and content around the SDKs: the CLI, IDE integrations, Helm charts, GitHub automation, docs and examples.

• Drive the release and versioning strategy across all divisions

• Grow our open source community: build the contributor and maintainer base beyond the team today, and make it easy for outside developers to contribute.

Requirements

• 8+ years as a software engineer, including time leading the technical direction of a team or a significant area, with or without the title.

• Strong proficiency in at least one of Go, JavaScript/TypeScript, C#/.NET, Python or Java, and the curiosity to work across several.
