title: Member of Technical Staff, Platform Architect
location_text: Bangalore, India | Office - India (Bangalore - Prestige Dynasty Phase 2)
description:
Everpure (NYSE: P) has evolved from storage pioneer to data platform, closing fiscal 2026 with $3.7 billion in revenue, its first billion-dollar quarter, and accelerating growth into FY27. Our strategic agenda spans the companies defining the next era of technology - hyperscalers, AI labs, the AI hardware supply chain, data platform providers, and the broader AI ecosystem.

This type of work—work that changes the world—is what the tech industry was founded on. So, if you're ready to seize the endless opportunities and leave your mark, come join us.

THE ROLE

The FlashBlade team builds the industry’s most innovative, high-performance, and highly available portfolio of products that are designed for the most demanding mission critical applications. While we deliver a hardware storage array, over 90% of our engineering staff are software engineers. Our customers are the most important part of our business and they love FlashBlade for its simplicity of management, the constant flow of new and exciting upgrades, and ability to live on the cutting edge of technology while never taking downtime, ever. FlashBlade enables our customers to leverage the agility of the public cloud for both traditional IT and cloud-native applications. You’ll architect, implement, and optimize core services that span on-premises arrays and cloud deployments—delivering seamless storage experiences to enterprises around the globe. If you thrive on solving hard problems, influencing technical direction, and driving innovation end-to-end, this is the role for you.

WHAT YOU AND YOUR TEAM WILL BE DOING…

· Own the platform software architecture for New Product Introduction (NPI) programs across FlashArray and FlashBlade, from concept and ERD/PRD review through bring-up, validation, manufacturing handoff and GA.
· Define and drive the platform security architecture, including Platform Root of Trust (PRoT), UEFI Secure Boot, Platform Firmware Resilience (PFR), TPM, measured boot, device identity and attestation, and boot drive encryption.
· Extend the secure boot chain of trust across firmware, bootloaders, kernel, Purity software and devices (BMC, NICs, HBAs, drives). Work with the security team on key management, the signing infrastructure and the production vs. development provisioning flows.
· Drive the post-quantum cryptography (PQC) readiness roadmap for platform firmware and boot, and keep us aligned with industry frameworks such as OCP Security / SAFE, NIST SP 800-193 and NIST SSDF.
· Architect secure, resilient firmware update and lifecycle flows: fw_update_tool, factory images, manufacturing provisioning and lock, RMA and re-provisioning, and non-disruptive hardware upgrades.
· Lead early hardware bring-up and debug for new CPUs, chipsets, PCIe switches, NICs and add-in cards. Partner with silicon vendors (Intel, AMD, Broadcom, Marvell and others) and with ODM/JDM partners.
· Shape the long-term direction for unifying hardware-adjacent management layers (chassis manager, HAL, BMC interfaces) across FlashArray and FlashBlade.
· Review hardware designs, ERDs and requirements so that platform software, diagnostics and manageability are designed in from day one, not bolted on later.
· Work with BMC Firmware, Kernel IO, Diags, Systems Networking, Hardware, Manufacturing, Security and Program Management teams in Bengaluru, Silicon Valley and Prague.
· Own root-cause analysis for the hardest platform, boot and security escalations, from internal test through customer field issues.
· Write the design documents and architectural reviews that set standards for the org. Mentor senior engineers and raise the technical bar across teams.

WHAT YOU’LL NEED TO BRING TO THIS ROLE...

· 15+ years of experience in platform, system or firmware software for servers, storage, networking or other enterprise systems.
· A proven track record as the technical lead or architect on multiple NPI programs taken from bring-up to production.
· Deep, hands-on expertise in platform security: UEFI Secure Boot, hardware root of trust, TPM 2.0, measured boot, and code-signing and key-management workflows. Experience with Intel PFR, Caliptra, OpenTitan or a similar RoT is a strong plus.
· Strong understanding of the x86 boot flow (BIOS/UEFI, bootloaders, Linux kernel boot), plus experience working with BIOS vendors and silicon reference code.
· Solid knowledge of BMC and out-of-band management (IPMI, Redfish, PLDM, MCTP, SPDM).
· Strong knowledge of hardware interfaces and system architecture: PCIe Gen5/Gen6, I2C/SMBus, SPI, eSPI, CPLD/FPGA interactions, CPU/NUMA architecture.
· Strong Linux systems programming and kernel/driver experience. Expert-level C, plus proficiency in Python and shell.
· Excellent debugging skills across hardware/software boundaries using JTAG, logic and protocol analyzers, serial consoles, crash dumps and boot logs.
· Experience working directly with silicon vendors, ODM/JDM partners and manufacturing teams.
· Proven ability to lead and influence through technical credibility across distributed teams without direct authority.
· Bachelor’s or higher in Computer Science, Computer Engineering or Electrical Engineering.
· Good to have: knowledge of PQC algorithms and migration, Common Criteria / FIPS certification, OCP standards, and ARM-based platforms.
· Storage experience is desirable but not required.
· You are flexible, accountable and a strong communicator who thrives in a globally distributed team.

• Hands-on experience with platforms such as Tenable, Qualys, Wiz, Prisma Cloud, or similar technologies.

• Strong security fundamentals across TCP/IP, DNS, HTTP/HTTPS, TLS, proxies, firewalls, operating systems, identity, and cloud infrastructure.

• Experience automating security workflows using Python, PowerShell, REST APIs, or similar technologies.

• Strong troubleshooting and analytical skills with the ability to independently investigate complex security problems.

• Ability to influence and collaborate with engineering and infrastructure teams to drive remediation.

Experience in one or more of the following is highly valued:

• Zscaler ZIA/ZPA/ ZDeception/ Zero Trust

THE ROLE

We are seeking an experienced Sr. Sales Operations Business Partner to partner closely with the India Sales Leader and District Managers across India. The role will provide dedicated operational support, business insight, and execution capacity to help sales leaders run their businesses effectively and improve seller productivity. Working as part of the APJ Sales Operations organisation, the Ops partner will own forecasting, pipeline management, performance analysis, business reviews, planning, and operational execution for the patch. The role reports to the APJ Theater Operations leader and will work closely with the India leadership team and Regional Sales Operations Business Partner to translate regional priorities into consistent execution at country and district level.

This is an advisory role. You are expected to explain why the numbers moved, recommend what to do about it, drive workflow improvement across the segments you support, and be in the room when the decision is made.

The role will create operating leverage through:

• Country and district partnership: Providing the India Sales Leader and District Managers with the analysis, insight, and recommendations required to improve sales performance.

• The three strategic pillars: Owning Territory & Account Planning, Forecasting, and Pipeline for India — the disciplines Sales Ops partners on, and where the partnership is judged.

• Operating cadence: Owning forecast and pipeline reviews, business reviews, KPI reporting, and the follow-through needed to keep priorities on track.

• Execution and follow-through: Operationalising agreed GTM priorities, tracking actions, upholding sales excellence and SFDC rigor and removing recurring friction for sellers and managers.

WHAT YOU'LL DO

• Partner with sales leaders: Work closely with the India Sales Leader and District Managers as a trusted business advisor, providing operational analysis, insight, and recommendations across their businesses.

• Own weekly forecasting: Prepare and pressure-test the forecast and pipeline pre-read: explain week-to-week movement, quantify gap-to-close, frame risk and upside scenarios, name risks with owners, and set out the actions required.

• Lead business reviews: Own country and district reviews end to end, including KPI analysis, performance commentary, action capture, and follow-up to closure.

• Analyse performance: Assess pipeline coverage, conversion, linearity, seller productivity, territory, and account performance; diagnose root causes and translate findings into clear recommendations.

• Territory and quota design: Lead territory analysis and design for India, model quota and run equity checks, and manage account assignment and white-space analysis, bringing options with clear trade-offs and working within agreed regional governance.

• Account planning: Own the account planning standard in the patch — guidance, content standard and KPIs, the refresh cadence, and plans maintained live in SFDC rather than produced as audit artifacts. Review plan quality with District Managers and drive follow-up on gaps.

• Annual planning campaign: Act as the analytical lead for the annual planning campaign across India — territory design, quota modelling, account assignment and scenario support — as a quarter-long program, not a single meeting.

• Operationalise decisions & programmes: Lead the implementation and adoption of agreed GTM, organisational, and process changes with Regional Sales Operations and cross-functional teams.

• Sales excellence & SFDC rigor: Own sales excellence by maintaining strict CRM (Salesforce) and forecasting hygiene: run the standard checks, surface data-quality and process issues to sales managers with named owners, and drive resolution.

• Drive follow-through: Track actions, dependencies, and performance interventions arising from forecast calls, business reviews, and planning discussions, and close them out without prompting.

• Improve processes and alignment: Recommend and implement practical improvements that reduce operational friction, and partner with Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Planning, and Corporate Operations to support execution.

• Support account and deal execution: Coordinate account-planning, win/loss, and big-deal review cadences, providing analysis and tracking agreed actions through to completion.

• Own pipeline coverage: Track create against target by source, run coverage and health analysis for CQ, Q+1 and Q+2, monitor hygiene (age, stage, BVS, pushed), and build remediation plans with Marketing, SE and Channel so that gaps surface a quarter early with a named plan.

• Identify leading indicators: Monitor performance trends and leading indicators across pipeline, productivity, and execution, highlighting gaps early and proposing improvement initiatives.

• Drive adoption and field feedback: Lead adoption of new processes and tools, gather structured feedback from the field, and work with Regional Sales Operations to recommend practical improvements.

• Coordinate cross-functional execution: Partner with Channel Operations, SE Operations, Renewals Operations, Finance, HR, Deal Desk, Planning, and other relevant teams to align priorities, coordinate dependencies, and ensure consistent execution across India.

• Improve workflows for scale: Improve the workflows behind recurring deliverables so they run consistently and at scale, and share the resulting working practice with Business Partners across the theater. This is influence, not people management.

• We are primarily an in-office environment and therefore, you will be expected to work from the Bangalore office in compliance with Everpure's policies, unless you are on PTO, or work travel, or other approved leave.

HOW WE WORK: THE PARTNERSHIP STANDARD

Insight, not just data. Every recurring deliverable answers three questions in order: what happened, why it happened, and what we recommend. A page that reports a number without naming the driver and the action does not meet the standard.
Prepared, never reactive. Every cadence has a standard pre-read prepared in advance: movement explained, gaps quantified, risks named with owners, and open actions carried forward.
Clear boundaries. Strategic work is owned; field-service work is performed as a bounded, time-boxed service; operational requests are routed to the owning function within one business day with context.
A trusted business partner. Objective perspective, constructive challenge, and recommendations grounded in data and business context. Forecasts and pipelines are pressure-tested with candour; hygiene and forecast discipline gaps are surfaced to the Sales Leader with named owners on their team.

WHAT YOU BRING

• Experience: 10+ years of relevant experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, Commercial Planning, business analytics, or a related role, ideally within a multinational technology company, including experience partnering directly with a country or regional sales leader.

• Sales leadership partnership: Experience partnering with sales managers and senior commercial stakeholders in a fast-paced sales organisation, including a track record of recommendations that changed a decision.

• Territory and account planning: Hands-on experience with territory design, quota modelling and equity checks, account assignment and white-space analysis, and running an account planning standard across a sales team.

title: AI Builder (Senior Product Designer)
description:
Razorpay is one of India’s leading full-stack financial technology companies, powering the way businesses move, manage, and grow money. Founded in 2014 by Harshil Mathur and Shashank Kumar with a simple vision - to simplify payments for Indian businesses - we’ve since grown into a fintech powerhouse driving India’s digital payment revolution.

Razorpay powers millions of businesses with a smarter, scalable stack that goes beyond transactions to help them truly build and grow.

From building AI-native agentic payments, to AI-assisted fraud detection and real-time risk intelligence to automated reconciliation, smart payouts, and predictive financial insights, we are embedding intelligence across our stack to make money movement faster, safer, and more efficient. In close collaboration with ecosystem partners - including banks, networks, regulators - we are pioneering industry-first solutions that are shaping the next era of fintech

Across India, Singapore and Malaysia, our products span everything from seamless checkouts to payroll automation - powering a fintech ecosystem that’s redefining how money moves across Asia.

Today, that ecosystem supports everyone from early-stage startups to some of India’s largest enterprises, enabling them to accept, process, and disburse payments at scale while expanding into new ways of managing money more efficiently.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

About the Role

This role exists because we believe the future of design is fundamentally agentic. You're not here to use AI as a productivity tool - you're here to redesign the entire practice of design itself. Part engineer, part designer, part systems architect, entirely at the frontier.

Roles & Responsibilities

• Set the new standard : Be the living proof of AI-native design workflows. Build remarkable things, show them to the team.

• Build the stack : Ship projects that progressively automate the design process - from discrete tools to full end-to-end automation.

• Enable the org : Build AI workflows that 60 designers can run end-to-end - independently, without bottlenecks. Raise the floor.

• Find the friction : Research where designers get stuck. Turn those observations into tools, agents, and systems.

• Stay ahead : Maintain frontier knowledge of AI possibilities. Not as a hobby - as a core job function

You are an Ideal fit, if you are

• Top percentile in AI × Design : You apply AI to product design workflows better than almost anyone and have at least 4 - 6 years of core product design experience.

• Credible designer and builder : You have taste and you ship. Both matter equally here.

• Exceptional communicator : Whether 1:1 or to a group - you make complex ideas land simply.

• Systems thinker : You solve entire classes of problems, not individual tasks.

• Obsessively curious : Dissatisfied with what exists. Energised by what's next.

What You Get :

• Virtually unlimited AI compute budget.

• Work with 60 talented designers who are eager to transform.

• Direct access to Design, Product, and Company leadership -zero bureaucracy.

• Full independence to build and experiment.

• Authority to drive adoption - if it's worth doing, it will happen.

• The most interesting AI-design infrastructure problem in global tech.

Razorpay believes in and follows an equal employment opportunity policy that doesn't discriminate on gender, religion, sexual orientation, colour, nationality, age, etc. We welcome interests and applications from all groups and communities across the globe.

Follow us on LinkedIn & Twitter

Day to day, you'll move between illustration and information design, and help shape the publication's visual voice as it grows — working alongside editors and writers who care about how stories look, with real room to experiment.

What we expect from you

• A distinct visual point of view, with oodles of personality and wit. Your work should be recognisable as yours.

• Conceptual thinking above all: you turn abstract ideas into visual metaphors. Given a draft, you propose the treatment — illustration, collage, infographic, or a smart type-only cover — rather than decorating the obvious.

• Adept with AI tools and workflows - with the curiosity to stay on top of the newest ones as the industry moves: you experiment early, form your own view on what's actually useful, and build it into how you work.

• Genuine range across mediums: hand-drawn and digital illustration, collage,mixed media, photo manipulation, expressive typography, and AI-assisted graphics/illustration used with taste and craft (curation and finishing, not raw prompt output).

• Strong fundamentals - layout, typography, hierarchy, colour, grid systems - with an editorial (not just product) sensibility.

• Ability to turn data and complex reporting into clear, engaging infographics and data visualizations: charts, timelines, maps, explainer diagrams.

• Comfort designing for long-form digital reading - scrollytelling, interactive charts, embedded visual essays - not just static pages.

• Plugged into visual culture: you follow design trends, internet aesthetics, and editorial art globally - and you have opinions about them that show up in your work.

• Strong self-direction: you take a piece from concept sketch to shipped visual with minimal hand-holding, and can explain your choices clearly to editors and reporters.

Tools

• Figma, Illustrator, Photoshop for graphics, illustration, collage, and layout

• AI image tools (Midjourney, Gemini, Firefly, or similar) as one instrument among many - you know when to reach for them and when not to

• Hand-drawn illustrations are a plus

What you'll work on

• Cover art, hero illustrations, and key visuals for features and essays — conceptual pieces that carry the story's argument, tone, and wit.

• Infographics and data visualizations that make complex reporting (data stories, explainers, research pieces) engaging without dumbing it down.

• Interactive story formats — scrollytelling pieces, interactive timelines, explorable charts, quizzes and calculators tied to stories.

• An evolving illustration and visual style guide for the publication — a system with room for play, not a straitjacket.

• A mix of fast-turnaround daily visuals and longer, high-craft feature pieces, in close partnership with editors, reporters, and developers.

Nice to have

• Motion and interaction skills for storytelling — After Effects for short animated explainers, Lottie or CSS/SVG animation for lightweight web interactivity, scroll-triggered animation and animated data reveals. A real plus, not a prerequisite.

• Experience in a newsroom, magazine, or editorial environment — you understand deadline-driven, story-first design.

• Basic front-end literacy (HTML/CSS) — enough to collaborate with or hand off to developers on interactive pieces.

How to apply: Send a portfolio that shows range - illustration, collage or mixed media, an infographic, and an interactive or motion piece if you have one.

International Payments (i18n) takes Razorpay's products into these markets: local payment methods, cross-border flows, and the partnerships with banks, wallets and schemes that make them work. Much of this is 0 to 1 work.

The role
You will own an international market end to end: deciding what to build, building it with engineering, taking it to merchants, and growing it. There is no running playbook to inherit. You will write it.

This is a builder role as much as a product role. In a new market, Razorpay has no brand recall and few relationships, so you will open doors yourself: reach out to merchants, banks, wallets and partners, earn their trust from scratch, and turn those conversations into products they adopt.

External stakeholder management, 0 to 1

• Build relationships from scratch with merchants, banks, acquirers, wallets and ecosystem partners in a market where Razorpay is new.

• Represent Razorpay in merchant meetings, partner negotiations, regulator and scheme conversations, and industry events.

• Travel extensively to be in market with customers and partners.

Strategy

• Define the long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap for your market, tied to GMV, active merchants and success rate.

• Size the opportunity, pick the segments and payment methods to win first, and decide what not to do.

• Start from the problem: frame it with data, test and iterate, and prioritise by value.

• Write high-quality specs, manage scope, and ship MVPs on time with engineering, design and partners.

• Design for the platform, so what works in one market extends to the next.

• Own the GTM plan with Product Marketing, Sales and Partnerships: positioning, pricing, onboarding and launch sequencing.

• Track activation, integration success and time-to-first-transaction, and own the funnel from first meeting to live merchant.

AI leverage

• Use AI tools such as Claude, Claude Code and Cursor to write SQL, analyse data, prototype tools, and draft and stress-test PRDs.

• Look for places where AI can make the product better for merchants, and help set the bar for AI fluency in the team.

• Bias toward action: prototype first, refine with real feedback.

• Customer-obsessed in practice: you get on calls, visit merchants and learn what is really happening.

• Happy being the only PM in the room.

• A greenfield mandate: build a market for Razorpay from the ground up, with rare autonomy.

• A proven platform behind you: India's most tested payments infrastructure.

• A global problem space: multiple currencies, regulators, payment methods and cultures in one role.

• An AI-first culture, where PMs who build and ship faster with AI are the norm.

• Direct access to senior leadership, so decisions happen fast.

About the team
Razorpay is India's leading full-stack payments and financial services company. The SME Payments Group owns the end-to-end experience for small and medium businesses across 14 product pods: onboarding, activation, payments, dashboard, growth and AI-native products.

Onboarding Infra is the platform layer under every merchant's first mile. It runs sign-up and identity, KYC and verification, and the workflow and state systems that take a business from sign-up to live payments while keeping Razorpay compliant with RBI and CKYC norms. It also powers agentic onboarding: RAY, our AI assistant, verifies and activates merchants through this team's APIs.

You will own a platform whose consumers are other product teams, AI agents and regulators as much as merchants.

What you'll own
You will own six platform areas end to end, with a senior engineering team of principal, staff and senior engineers.

Area

What it covers

Sign-up and identity

Sign-up, login and user and merchant creation across email, mobile and Google

KYC and verification

CKYC, video KYC; world class OCR platforms; KYC partnerships

Onboarding workflows and state

The workflow engine and state machine behind merchant KYC and periodic re-KYC; event-driven state sync to downstream systems

Data privacy and segregation

PII vaulting, consent, and clean separation of data and services across legal entities

Agentic onboarding rails

The APIs, tools and guardrails that let an AI agent verify and activate a merchant safely

Platform reliability

SLOs, incident load, support tickets caused by system issues, and test coverage, owned jointly with engineering

What you'll do

• Own the Onboarding Infra roadmap and its outcomes: compliance, verification coverage and accuracy, latency, reliability and cost per verification, all tied back to merchant activation.

• Write PRDs and API specs engineers can build from: data models, state transitions, failure modes, idempotency, retries and SLAs.

• Review tech specs and design docs as a peer, and make the call on build-versus-buy, sync-versus-async and consistency tradeoffs.

• Turn regulation into system design with Compliance, Legal and Risk: RBI KYC directions, CKYC and the DPDP Act. Keep Razorpay audit-ready.

• Pick and manage verification partners (registries, bureaus, video KYC and data providers) on coverage, accuracy, latency, uptime and cost. Design the fallbacks when one fails.

• Build the rails for agentic onboarding: expose verification and workflow capabilities as clean tools an AI Agent can call safely, with evals, guardrails and human review where risk demands it.

What we're looking for

Experience and background

• 4 to 8 years of product management, with at least 2 years owning a platform, API or infrastructure product.

• An engineering foundation: a degree in computer science or engineering is not a mandate, ideally 2+ years as a software engineer, solutions architect or similar before moving into product.

• Fintech, payments, banking, lending or identity experience is a plus.

Technical depth

• Reads and writes API specs (REST, OpenAPI) and designs contracts other teams depend on.

• Understands distributed-systems basics: event-driven architecture and queues, workflow orchestration, idempotency, retries, eventual consistency and state rollback.

• Holds their own in design reviews: data models, service boundaries, latency budgets, SLOs and failure modes.

• Reads observability data (dashboards, traces, logs) and can triage an incident alongside engineers.

• Fluent in SQL; analyses funnels and system data without waiting on an analyst.

• Knows the basics of PII handling, encryption, access control and data vaulting.

AI and agentic systems

• Has shipped or prototyped with LLMs and agents: tool calling, agent orchestration, evals and guardrails. Not a future interest; show us what you built.

• Uses AI tools daily in their own work: specs, analysis, prototyping.

Collaboration and communication

• Earns the trust of principal and staff engineers through technical judgment

• Works well with Compliance, Legal, Risk and external partners, and turns ambiguous regulation into crisp requirements.

• Writes clear, short docs that ends the debate.

Good to have

• Built or run KYC, AML, identity verification, onboarding or risk platforms.

• Working knowledge of India's KYC stack: CKYC, video KYC, DigiLocker, and PAN, GSTIN and Udyam verification.

• Has been through RBI regulatory programs or audits, or DPDP Act compliance work.

• Identity and auth experience: OAuth, SSO, OTP login and account security.

• Managed external vendors against SLA-backed contracts.

• Founder or early-stage experience building infrastructure from zero.

Why this role

• Every Razorpay merchant passes through your platform. Your work shows up directly in activation and compliance.

• You will make onboarding, usually a merchant's longest and dullest step, feel fun: you'll build one of the first AI agents in Indian fintech that takes a business from sign-up to live payments in one conversation.

Our scale speaks volumes: Razorpay processes $180+ billion in annualized transactions, powering leading businesses like Airbnb, Facebook, WhatsApp, Airtel, CRED, BookmyShow, Zomato, Swiggy, Lenskart, Mirae Asset Capital markets, Indian Oil, National Pension Scheme - and over 100 of India’s unicorns. With strong roots in India and growing operations in Southeast Asia, we are shaping the next chapter of financial technology across the region.

We are backed by global investors including GIC, Peak XV Partners (formerly Sequoia Capital India & SEA), Tiger Global, Ribbit Capital, Matrix Partners, MasterCard, and Salesforce Ventures, having raised over $740 million to date. Strategic acquisitions - including Ezetap (POS and offline payments), Curlec (Malaysia expansion), BillMe (digital invoicing), and POP (rewards-first UPI) - along with earlier moves in fraud prevention, payroll, and lending, have further strengthened our platform and widened our footprint across Asia.

But what truly sets Razorpay apart is our culture. At Razorpay, ownership is our oxygen - you own what you build, with no micromanagement or red tape, just the runway to make your ideas fly. Learning is a lifestyle - if you’re curious, you’ll feel at home here. People > Pedigree - we hire for attitude, hustle, and hunger more than degrees. Transparency thrives over titles - this is where interns question CXOs and CXOs say “thank you.” Guided by our values of Customer First, Autonomy & Ownership, Agility with Integrity, Transparency, Challenging the status quo and a strong belief that Razorpay grows with Razors, you’ll be part of a 3000+ strong team building not just products, but the financial infrastructure of the future.

What we need:

• Data-native PM — you think in funnels, cohorts, and experiments before PRDs. You write SQL, build dashboards, and catch insights nobody asked you to find.

• Hands-on with AI agents — you've actually built something with LLMs, not just read about them. Prompt engineering is table stakes.

• Entrepreneur DNA — you've tried building something of your own (a startup, a side project, a 0→1 product) or you're a seasoned Growth PM who's operated across the full acquisition-to-revenue loop.

• Business-grade judgment — you hold your own in revenue conversations, understand unit economics, and translate growth levers into P&L impact.

This is not a feature PM role. There's no stable roadmap someone hands you. You define problems, find levers, ship fast, and measure what matters.

What you'll do -

• Build Customer Empathy: PMs have to regularly meet and understand customer needs first-hand as well as stay on top of the customer pulse via secondary insights - both qualitative and quantitative.

• Devise Strategy: Define both long-term strategy and quarterly roadmap to achieve the product vision and create impact.

• Conceptualize new solutions: Product Conceptualization with a problem first, data-driven, and test & iterate approach. Ensures conceptualization from a platform and a long-term view. Ensures value-based prioritization of product initiatives.

• Build products: Collaborate with Engineering and ecosystem players to build products that customers love. Produce high-quality product specifications and effectively prioritize and manage the scope of each product launch to deliver products and features on time.

• Launch products: Draft and execute a go-to-market plan in conjunction with Product Marketing. Be the internal and external authority and advocate for your given area of focus.

• Ecosystem collaboration: Self-starter to collaborate closely with ecosystem players to co-build products that don’t exist

Mandatory Qualifications:

• You have 8+ years of experience in product management with at least 2 years focused on growth or PLG initiatives.

• You understand technology deeply enough to work well with engineers, but your core superpower is thinking from a customer-first and business-first lens.

As a member of the team, you’ll help own network technology and processes that enable our people to do their best work. We are responsible for identifying, designing, implementing, and supporting the applications and networks to create a streamlined experience for Samsarians. As a Network/Infrastructure Engineer on the team, you will work alongside our senior network engineers to help maintain, optimize, and troubleshoot our global on-premise network infrastructure, with a particular focus on our Cisco Meraki environment. This is a great opportunity for someone early to mid-career in network engineering to build hands-on expertise while learning from experienced mentors, all while helping ensure high availability and performance for a growing company. You will work closely with operations team members to operate, repair, and improve existing network infrastructure, including providing tier-1 and tier-2 support to other members of the Information Technology team and escalating more complex issues to senior engineers as needed.

This role is based at our Bangalore office and requires on-site presence 2-3 days a week.

You should apply if:

• You want to impact the industries that run our world: Your efforts will result in real-world impact helping to keep the lights on, get food into grocery stores, reduce emissions, and most importantly, ensure workers return home safely.

• You are the architect of your own career: If you put in the work, this role is a launchpad rather than your last stop at Samsara. You’ll work alongside senior network engineers who will mentor you, and we’ve built a culture that encourages rapid career development and countless opportunities to grow your networking craft in a hyper growth environment.

• You’re energized by our opportunity: The vision we have to digitize large sectors of the global economy requires your full focus and best efforts to bring forth creative, ambitious ideas for our customers.

• You want to be with the best: At Samsara, we win together, celebrate together and support each other. You will be surrounded by a high-caliber team that will encourage you to do your best.

Click here to learn about what we value at Samsara.

In this role, you will:

• Configure, install, and maintain network hardware and software components, including Meraki switches, access points, and firewalls, under the guidance of senior network engineers.

• Perform hands-on troubleshooting and issue resolution for day-to-day network incidents, using the Meraki Dashboard, Wireshark, and packet captures to help identify root cause, escalating more complex issues to senior team members.

• Assist in developing and deploying network automation scripts and tools to enhance efficiency, partnering with senior engineers on more advanced automation projects.

• Support network maintenance activities including hardware and software upgrades, migrations, capacity upgrades, and decommissioning.

• Collaborate with other IT team members to integrate network systems with other applications and systems.

• Help build and maintain dashboards and reporting to monitor the health and performance of our network environments.

• Provide technical support and training to end-users as needed.

• Create and update documentation for network designs, best practices, and operational procedures.

• Support hardware lifecycle management, from procurement to decommissioning.

• Assist in system deployment and configuration for new projects or initiatives.

• Partner with vendors and service providers to help procure and maintain hardware and software.

• Participate in duty rotation of 7-day by 24-hour on-call support.

Minimum requirements for the role:

• Bachelor's degree in Electrical Engineering, Computer Engineering, relevant technical field, or equivalent professional experience.

1-3 years of hands-on experience in network engineering, IT infrastructure, or a related technical role, with exposure to Cisco Meraki hardware. Hands-on familiarity with the Cisco Meraki platform, including configuring VLANs, SSIDs and wireless settings, group policies, and site-to-site VPN (Auto VPN) across MX, MS, and MR devices. Solid understanding of the OSI model and core TCP/IP networking concepts, including routing and switching fundamentals, DHCP, DNS, and QoS/DSCP.

• Ability to troubleshoot common network issues using the Meraki dashboard, packet captures, and tools like Wireshark, digging in before escalating more complex problems to senior engineers.

• Exposure to network monitoring and diagnostic tools (e.g., SolarWinds, LogicMonitor, PRTG, ELK, Meraki dashboard alerts and reporting, or similar).

• Comfortable learning and applying SD-WAN specific features such as firewall and content filtering rules and adaptive policy, with eagerness to grow into more advanced protocols over time.

• Strong documentation habits, including experience creating and maintaining network diagrams using tools like Visio or Lucidchart or similar platforms documentation is a critical part of this role.

• Experience with IT asset and inventory management, tracking network hardware from procurement through deployment and decommissioning.

• Willingness to participate in a rotational on-call schedule, responding to production network incidents outside of standard business hours.

• Strong communication skills and a collaborative mindset, partnering with senior network engineers and cross-functional IT teams on incident tickets and SLA-based response and resolution.

An ideal candidate also has one or more:

• Early experience or strong interest in designing, deploying, and operating networks at scale.

• Familiarity with the Atlassian suite (Jira, Confluence, OpsGenie, StatusPage).

• Familiarity with Splunk or similar log analysis tools.

• Cisco Certified Network Associate (CCNA), or actively working toward it.

• Basic proficiency in API or other scripting/programming languages.

• Familiarity with Google Workspace and Google Cloud Platform.

• Exposure to cloud network management in AWS and/or GCP.

description:

Samsara (NYSE: IOT) is the pioneer of the Connected Operations™ Cloud, which is a platform that enables organizations that depend on physical operations to harness Internet of Things (IoT) data to develop actionable insights and improve their operations. At Samsara, we are helping improve the safety, efficiency and sustainability of the physical operations that power our global economy. Representing more than 40% of global GDP, these industries are the infrastructure of our planet, including agriculture, construction, field services, transportation, and manufacturing — and we are excited to help digitally transform their operations at scale.

Working at Samsara means you’ll help define the future of physical operations and be on a team that’s shaping an exciting array of product solutions, including Video-Based Safety, Vehicle Telematics, Apps and Driver Workflows, and Equipment Monitoring. title: SME, Support Systems Specialist
description:
Scale is looking for a Support Systems & Routing Specialist to own and optimize the core infrastructure powering our contributor support operations. In this role, you will be responsible for configuring and maintaining systems like Zendesk, designing routing logic, and building scalable frameworks that ensure tickets are assigned accurately and efficiently.

As our operations continue to grow, this role will play a critical part in ensuring our support systems scale seamlessly with increasing volume and complexity. You will partner closely with Support Ops, Product, Engineering, and cross-functional stakeholders to translate operational needs into robust system configurations.

You will be part of a highly detail-oriented and systems-driven team, where your work directly impacts operational efficiency and contributor experience. This role is ideal for someone who thrives in building and improving systems that others rely on daily, and who enjoys solving complex operational challenges at scale.

You will:

• Own end-to-end Zendesk configuration, including ticket forms, fields, macros, triggers, automations, SLAs, and views

• Design and maintain routing logic to ensure accurate ticket distribution across skills, queues, and teams

• Build and manage the support agent skills framework (skills, tiers, certifications, queue structures)

• Monitor and optimize queue health, load balancing, and ticket assignment accuracy

• Configure and maintain integrations across support tools and reporting systems

• Troubleshoot system issues and partner with Engineering or vendors when needed

• Collaborate with Support Ops, T&S, TPMs, and Product to implement and improve workflows

• Document system configurations, workflows, and best practices clearly

• Provide training and guidance to stakeholders on system usage and routing logic

Ideally you’d have:

• Experience administering Zendesk or similar support CRM systems

• Experience designing routing logic or managing skills-based systems in high-volume environments

• Strong systems-thinking and analytical mindset

• High attention to detail with the ability to identify risks and inconsistencies

• Experience working cross-functionally with both technical and non-technical stakeholders

• Ability to own and manage complex system configurations end-to-end

• Familiarity with SQL or data analysis for routing optimization

Nice to haves:

• Experience working with operational data (Google Sheets, dashboards, reporting tools)

• Basic scripting knowledge (Python or JavaScript)

• Experience scaling support systems in fast-growing environments

title: Cloud Platform Engineer
description:
About Us

SingleStore engineers build the real-time data platform that enables some of the world’s most demanding applications. Our cloud-native database architecture enables high-performance transactional and analytical workloads at scale.

Position Overview

We are seeking a highly skilled DevOps/Cloud Platforms Engineer to join our engineering organization and help drive the next generation of our infrastructure and platform capabilities. In this role, you will be responsible for designing, operating, and optimizing cloud environments, maintaining cloud infrastructure, and creating internal developer platforms that support fast, reliable and secure software delivery. You will work closely with engineering, QA, data, and product teams to ensure our systems are scalable, resilient, and easy to use.

The ideal candidate brings a strong blend of cloud infrastructure expertise, DevOps mindset, and hands-on development skills. You will automate wherever possible, use Infrastructure as Code to maintain consistency, and leverage modern DevOps tooling, including AI-assisted automation to enhance operational efficiency and developer productivity.

This is an operations role for someone who thrives in solving complex technical problems, improving processes, and building platforms that accelerate engineering velocity.

Primary Roles and Responsibilities

• Automate infrastructure provisioning, configuration management, monitoring, and operational workflows using IaC and scripting languages.

• Own the deployment, maintenance, and lifecycle management of systems supporting engineering (Kubernetes clusters, container registries, artifact systems, and internal developer platforms) leveraging deep expertise in Kubernetes, container runtimes, and the broader cloud-native ecosystem (Helm, Kustomize, operators).

• Troubleshoot complex infrastructure and application issues, driving root-cause analysis and developing long-term remediation solutions

• Design, build, and maintain cloud infrastructure across major cloud providers (AWS, GCP, Azure), and develop/support deployments of applications, services, and monitoring with a strong focus on scalability, reliability, and cost optimization.

• Develop, enhance, and maintain CI/CD pipelines using modern DevOps tooling (GitHub Actions, ArgoCD, Terraform, etc.).

• Develop internal tooling and automation using Terraform, Python, Go, or similar languages to streamline operational tasks and improve developer productivity.

• Implement and manage security best practices across cloud environments, including identity management, secrets handling, audit logging, and network controls.

• Leverage AI/ML tools to automate repetitive DevOps tasks, operational workflows.

Required Skills and Experience

• 4-8+ years of experience in DevOps, Cloud Engineering, Systems Administration, or similar infrastructure-focused roles.

• Familiar with GIT and comfortable with at least one systems programming language (Golang) and one scripting language (Python, Bash).

• Proficiency with Infrastructure as Code (Terraform, Pulumi, or CloudFormation) and configuration management (Ansible, Chef, or SaltStack).

• Working knowledge of at least one of observability stacks (Prometheus, Grafana, ELK/OpenSearch, Datadog, etc.) and operational troubleshooting.

• Strong hands-on experience with Kubernetes management in production environments

• Experience designing, developing, and/or troubleshooting distributed systems.

• Comfort with shells on *nix family systems.

• B.S. degree or equivalent experience in Engineering, Computer Science or a related field.

Preferred Qualifications:

• Certifications from cloud service providers (e.g., AWS DevOps, GCP DevOps Engineer).

• Strong software development skills, with experience building production-grade services, automation, APIs, and infrastructure tooling.

• Proficiency in Go, Python, or other modern programming languages.

• Strong cloud networking fundamentals, including VPC/VNet, subnets, NAT Gateways, Transit Gateways, routing, DNS, load balancing, and private connectivity.

• Hands-on experience with VPN and secure networking technologies such as Tailscale, Headscale, WireGuard, or similar solutions.

• Strong Kubernetes experience, including cluster architecture, networking, service discovery, ingress, observability, and troubleshooting.

• Understanding of distributed systems concepts and experience working with highly available, scalable, and fault-tolerant systems.

• Natural curiosity and a strong drive to learn new and adjacent technologies.

• Experience applying AI/ML tools (e.g., GitHub Copilot, cloud AI services, LLM-based automation, anomaly detection tools) to streamline DevOps and infrastructure workflows is a strong plus.

• Experience with LangChain, AI agents, and MCP (Model Context Protocol), including building and integrating agent-based solutions.

• Hands-on experience implementing AI-enhanced threat detection and security systems.

SingleStore delivers our cloud-native database with the speed and scale to power the world’s data-intensive applications. SingleStore is venture-backed and headquartered in San Francisco with offices in Sunnyvale, Raleigh, Seattle, Boston, London, Lisbon, Bangalore, Dublin and Kyiv.

Role Summary

You will build the shared development primitives that make multiple product teams faster, with clean abstractions across the Python/JVM boundary. This role is a force multiplier: instead of building product features directly, you build the platform, SDK, and tooling that enables every other engineer on the team to ship faster.

You will own the developer experience for agent development at Starburst, building from 0 to 1 and scaling across teams. Your work is measured by other engineers' velocity, not your own feature output.

As an AI Platform Engineer at Starburst, you will:

• Design and build an agent development SDK that abstracts common patterns (tool registration, context management, evaluation hooks, prompt management)

• Build the language bridge between Python (AI ecosystem) and JVM (Starburst platform) with type safety, error propagation, and observability across the boundary

• Create developer tooling: local development environments, debugging tools, test harnesses, CI integration

• Define and maintain API contracts between the AI layer and the Starburst platform

• Build shared infrastructure: model gateway, observability pipeline, experiment framework

• Develop unified, product-agnostic components used across multiple products

• Own platform health beyond feature delivery: performance, reliability, developer ergonomics

Some of the things that we look for:

• 5+ years of software engineering experience, with at least 2 years building platform, infrastructure, or developer tooling

• Proficiency in both Python and JVM languages (Java or Kotlin)

• Experience designing APIs and SDKs consumed by other engineering teams

• Strong distributed systems fundamentals: RPC, serialization, error handling, observability

• Experience with containerization, CI/CD pipelines, and cloud infrastructure (AWS preferred)

• Track record of building tools that measurably improve other engineers' velocity

• Ability to Travel : This role will require 25% in-person travel for purposes including but not limited to new hire onboarding, team and department offsites, customer engagements, and other company events. Actual travel expectations may vary by role and business needs

• Experience supporting both research and production workloads on the same platform

About the role

SAIL Platform in India starts with you. This is not a satellite team. You will own a charter, hire the engineers who deliver it, and be accountable for outcomes that customers feel.

The charter is the agent platform, and it has three arcs.

• Internal agent platform. The foundation Starburst's own teams build agents on today, spanning the agent SDK, evaluation frameworks, guardrails, and model serving infrastructure. Your users are Starburst's own engineers, and their feedback lands in hours, not quarters.

• Extending it toward customers. Take what proves itself internally and harden it for customer-facing use cases. That means multi-tenancy, security boundaries, and APIs stable enough to run in environments we do not control.

• Observability. What an agent did, why it did it, what it cost, and how well it performed, for both audiences. Internal teams need it to debug and improve; external customers need it to trust agents with production workloads.

You serve two customer bases in sequence, internal agent teams first, external enterprises as the platform matures.

You will be a player-coach. In the first months you will build alongside the first hires you make. As the team grows, you will shift toward leading, but you will never be far from the code.

As the Head of Engineering, AI Platform at Starburst you will:

• Own the agent platform roadmap, from internal foundation to customer-facing capabilities, and deliver it

• Hire and grow a team of senior engineers in India, and set the technical bar through your own work

• Make architecture decisions for the agent SDK, evaluation, guardrails, serving, and observability, with the internal-to-external evolution in mind from day one

• Run the platform like a product in production, with an on-call rotation, incident response, and a culture of root-cause analysis over quick patches

• Operate autonomously across time zones, making the call when counterparts are offline, documenting the reasoning, and aligning when they come back online

• Work with US-based product, agent, and research teams as peers who shape decisions together, and with engineering leaders across Starburst to redefine how we build, test, and ship software with agents in the loop

• Engage directly with enterprise customers when platform capabilities are on the line

Some of the things we look for:

• You have led an engineering team through a full cycle, hiring it and raising the bar with each hire, shipping with it, and growing the people on it. Typically this means 10+ years of engineering with 3+ leading, but we weight the evidence over the years

• You have built platform or infrastructure products that served multiple engineering teams, and you can talk concretely about the interface contracts, the adoption curve, and what you intentionally left out

• You have run LLM systems in production and know the difference between a demo and a system enterprises trust. That includes the unglamorous parts of LLMOps, timeout and retry design, token cost discipline, latency budgets, capacity, and the different ways models fail

• You can articulate what you adopted, what you waited on, what you built yourself, and why, in a field that changes every quarter

• You are product curious. You ask who the user is and what they are trying to do before you ask what the architecture should be, and you have sat with users of what you built and changed course based on what you saw

• Experience with data systems, SQL engines, or analytics products

title: Principal Product Manager
location_text: Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India | Noida, Uttar Pradesh, India
description:
Principal Product Manager - Agentic Investigation & Reliability Experiences

Sumo Logic is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead how engineers and operators investigate incidents, understand reliability risk, and act on their operational and security telemetry.

The observability category was built around collecting telemetry and giving people tools to navigate it: dashboards, queries, monitors, traces, and alerts. Customer expectations are now shifting. Teams don't just want more dashboards; they want help getting from a signal to a resolution, understanding what's broken, why, what's impacted, and what to do next. As AI agents move into production operations, this role owns how Sumo Logic brings intelligent, agent-assisted investigation and reliability workflows to customers, grounded in evidence, context, and enterprise governance.

This is a senior, high-ownership role. It requires genuine observability domain background. You should have lived in this space and understand how monitoring, troubleshooting, and reliability actually work, combined with the ambition to define a new category of experience on top of it.

What You Will Own

The current data experiences. Log Search, Live Tail, query and query optimization, Metrics Search, Tracing, Dashboards, and the data-experience UI. This is a live, revenue-generating product with real customers, and keeping it strong is part of the job. You own its health, roadmap, and competitiveness today while steering it toward an AI-native future, focusing new investment where it strengthens investigation, speed, and value for both new and power users.

The reliability and alerting surface. Monitors, Alerts, SLOs, Scheduled Searches, and the reliability workflows around them. You will own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals both as capabilities customers depend on today and as the foundation for more automated, agent-assisted detection and investigation.

The agentic investigation experience. You will define how a user moves from a search, a monitor, a dashboard, or an alert to likely cause faster, with supporting evidence. This means productizing investigation workflows that reason across logs, metrics, traces, monitors, dashboards, and related context, and evolving them from reactive troubleshooting toward more proactive detection over time.

What You Will Be Doing

• Set the multi-quarter vision for Sumo Logic's investigation and reliability experiences, and turn it into a roadmap engineering can execute against.

• Own the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of the current data and reliability product surfaces.

• Define how search, metrics, tracing, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs evolve from human-navigated tools into more intuitive, AI-assisted experiences.

• Productize investigation workflows that reason across telemetry and related operational context, and surface findings customers can act on.

• Own alerting accuracy, noise reduction, and operational health signals.

• Shape how skills, tools, and agents are built on top of the data surfaces, and ensure they respect enterprise controls such as RBAC, audit, cost limits, and approvals.

• Work with engineering and architecture on query execution, performance, and reliability at enterprise scale.

• Translate strategy into clear PRDs, proposals, user stories, acceptance criteria, and phased rollout plans.

• Use telemetry to understand how customers search, investigate, and configure alerts, and where they hit friction, latency, false positives, or cost.

• Create leadership-facing proposals that frame tradeoffs across customer demand, governance, performance, cost, and long-term architecture.

What You Bring

• 8+ years of product management experience with real observability or monitoring domain background. You have owned products in observability, monitoring, incident response, APM, or a closely adjacent operational-telemetry space. This is a hard requirement.

• Deep, first-hand understanding of the observability surface area including logs, metrics, traces, dashboards, monitors, alerts, and SLOs, and of how engineers and operators actually investigate incidents and decide what to trust.

• Proven ability to run a live, at-scale product, owning the roadmap, health, and competitiveness of shipping surfaces while driving a larger transformation.

• A track record of owning broad, technically deep surfaces and setting direction that other teams build on.

• Familiarity with how AI and agents are changing data interaction, including natural-language investigation, tools, guardrails, and human-in-the-loop action, or the ability to ramp quickly.

• Strong technical instincts around query engines, time-series and trace data, and alerting systems, plus the judgment to know where an AI-assisted experience should replace a manual flow and where depth must stay.

• Strong analytical skills and comfort using telemetry, dashboards, SQL, and usage data to understand adoption, friction, reliability, and cost.

• Excellent communication across technical and business audiences, and the ability to write clear proposals, decision docs, PRDs, and acceptance criteria.

• High ownership and drive to make progress across a large, ambiguous, fast-moving surface.

Must-Have Qualities

• Runs today, builds tomorrow. Keeps a live product healthy and competitive while reinventing it, and knows what to sustain and what to rebuild.

• Deep observability judgment. Understands search, metrics, tracing, and alerting well enough to make hard architecture and tradeoff calls with engineering.

• Operator empathy. Knows what makes an alert trustworthy, an investigation fast, and a recommendation credible enough to act on.

• Governance-minded. Treats RBAC, audit, cost, and approvals as part of the product.

• Sets direction. Defines a vision for a broad area and rallies teams around it.

• Analytical. Uses data to prioritize, validate, and refine decisions.

• High drive and ownership. Pushes through ambiguity across a large surface and drives execution to conclusion.

• Tradeoff thinker. Frames options and recommendations clearly for leadership.

About Us

Sumo Logic, Inc. helps make the digital world secure, fast, and reliable by unifying critical security and operational data through its Intelligent Operations Platform. Built to address the increasing complexity of modern cybersecurity and cloud operations challenges, we empower digital teams to move from reaction to readiness—combining agentic AI-powered SIEM and log analytics into a single platform to detect, investigate, and resolve modern challenges. Customers around the world rely on Sumo Logic for trusted insights to protect against security threats, ensure reliability, and gain powerful insights into their digital environments. For more information, visit www.sumologic.com.

• Follow engineering best practices, including version control, code reviews, automated testing, CI/CD, and technical documentation.

• Partner with Data Analytics and business stakeholders to translate requirements into trusted, well-documented, analytics-ready datasets.

• Provide technical guidance to team members and identify opportunities to improve automation, engineering standards, platform reliability, and resource utilization.

Requirements:

• 5+ years of experience in data engineering or a related technical role, including developing and supporting production data pipelines.

• Strong hands-on expertise in Databricks, including developing, troubleshooting, and optimizing production workloads.

• Strong proficiency in Python/PySpark, SQL, and Apache Spark for scalable data processing and transformation.

• Practical experience with Delta Lake, including table management, incremental processing, and performance optimization.

• Experience with data architecture and modeling, including medallion architecture and the development of analytics-ready datasets.

• Experience with Databricks Workflows or equivalent orchestration solutions.

• Proven experience building data ingestion pipelines and integrating REST APIs, databases, and enterprise applications.

• Understanding of reliable data processing patterns, including retries, idempotency, schema evolution, backfills, and failure recovery.

• Working knowledge of AWS services and cloud infrastructure, particularly IAM roles and policies, S3 storage and access management, and secure connectivity between source systems and data platforms.

• Experience with Git/GitHub, code reviews, automated testing, and CI/CD practices.

• Strong problem-solving skills and the ability to independently design, build, deploy, and maintain production data solutions.

• Good communication and collaboration skills to work effectively with Data Analytics, Engineering, IT/Cloud, Security, and business stakeholders.

Desirable:

• Experience with Databricks Lakeflow Spark Declarative Pipelines (formerly Delta Live Tables), Auto Loader, and advanced incremental ingestion patterns.

• Experience implementing Unity Catalog governance, including fine-grained access controls, data lineage, auditing, and sensitive-data protection.

Sumo Logic is hiring a Senior Product Manager to own the data, query, and context foundations that help customers and AI agents understand and act on operational and security telemetry.

Effective investigation depends on finding the right data, querying it efficiently, and understanding how it relates to the customer's environment. As AI agents take on more analytical work, they need dependable access to telemetry and context: which service an entity belongs to, what it depends on, who owns it, and what changed. This role owns the shared platform capabilities that make that possible across observability, security, and platform optimization.

title: Technical Account Engineer I
description:
Technical Account Engineer - I

Sumo Logic helps companies keep applications reliable and secure. Our Technical Account Engineers are the people who make sure customers actually get value out of the platform, and they are the first point of contact for a portfolio of named post-sales accounts.

About the Role

Around 70% of the role is technical, hands-on-keyboard work: guiding customers through complex use cases, untangling deployment problems and showing practitioners how to get more out of the platform. The other 30% is building the kind of trust that makes you the first person customers call, whether that’s an engineer stuck on a query or a security lead thinking about renewal.

Our playbooks and automated health signals will give you a strong baseline, but at this level you’ll go well beyond them. You’ll know your named customers’ environments well enough to spot problems before they do and find the next use case before they ask. You’ll also design tailored plans when the standard play doesn’t fit, and bring in Support, Product, Engineering or Sales when a situation calls for it. You’ll help shape the playbooks themselves, and support Associate TAEs as they grow into the role.

You’ll have real visibility internally, including with senior leadership, and a genuine say in how we serve these customers.

What You Will Actually Do

• Own your named accounts technically. Be the go-to technical lead for a portfolio of customers, and know their environments, priorities and risks inside out.

• Get customers using the platform extensively. Build new use cases, bring in new data sources, teach advanced features and work through hard problems with security, DevSecOps and observability teams.

• Craft success plans that can be measured. Understand what customers are trying to achieve, turn it into a technical plan, help them deliver it and expand it as the value shows up.

• See trouble coming. Combine automated usage signals with your own judgement to spot adoption or technical risk early. Then pull the account team together to turn a wobbly account into an advocate.

• Run the cadence. Lead health checks and contribute to Business Reviews, building credibility with practitioners, team leads and executive stakeholders.

• Help the accounts grow. Work with Sales on renewals and expansion in a way that’s good for the customer and delivers additional value.

• Make the team better. Feed customer insight back to Product and Engineering and improve our playbooks.

Where and When

• This role is based in Noida, India, and candidates must be located in Noida.

• Shifts are designed to overlap core Australia and New Zealand business hours.

• You’ll join the local team in our Noida office from time to time, typically once a fortnight.

What You Will Bring

• 5 to 6 years in a technical, customer-facing role such as technical account management, customer success engineering, professional services, solutions engineering, DevOps or SOC analysis.

• Real production experience across enterprise infrastructure: operating systems, virtualisation, databases, networking and security.

• Hands-on experience with at least one major cloud platform (AWS, Azure or GCP).

• SQL or query language skills, and the ability to look at usage data, work out what’s really going on and act on it.

• A track record of owning multiple customer accounts and building relationships from practitioners to senior stakeholders.

• Comfort with ambiguity: if something is unclear, you go and find out rather than waiting to be told.

• A strong team player who collaborates across GTM functions and gets things done with no fuss.

• A degree in Computer Science, Engineering or a related field (B.Tech/BE or equivalent).

The Technical Stuff We Would Love to See

• Experience with Observability or SIEM platforms (e.g. Splunk, Datadog, Elastic, Dynatrace, CrowdStrike, QRadar, Exabeam).

• A background in alerting and monitoring in security, operations or DevSecOps settings.

• Familiarity with security frameworks and how they apply across customers’ lifecycle.

• Knowledge of Kubernetes (Helm), OTel, Prometheus and API scripting.

• Proficiency in using AI tools to accelerate day-to-day work. Certifications such as AWS AI Practitioner or Microsoft AI Fundamentals are a plus.

• Hyperscaler certifications at Associate level or above.

• Sumo Logic experience is a big plus but not required.

title: Associate of R&D Strategic Finance (FP&A)
description:
Toast creates technology to help restaurants and local businesses succeed in a digital world, helping business owners operate, increase sales, engage customers, and keep employees happy. Toast is driven by building a platform that helps restaurants adapt, take control, and get back to what they do best: building the businesses they love. Our Finance team serves as a trusted advisor to the company, guiding critical business decisions through insightful analyses & thought partnership with executive leaders.

We are seeking an R&D Finance associate to own key aspects of our financial reporting, monthly and quarterly processes, and support critical planning activities within our R&D Finance & Strategy team. In this role, you’ll contribute to the foundation of our finance operations as we advance as a public company, with a focus on enhancing efficiency through process improvements and automation. You’ll work closely with our R&D and Corporate Finance team, and collaborate across functions to deliver essential insights and drive strategic initiatives for our senior R&D leaders.

A day in the life (Responsibilities)

• Support Toast’s monthly and quarterly financial close processes for the R&D function, including reporting and analysis of budget vs. actual results, forecast updates, and preparation of standard financial packages that provide actionable insights for R&D leadership.

• Own headcount tracking, reporting, and reconciliation activities for R&D, conducting trend analysis and collaborating closely with Finance, R&D leadership, and Talent Acquisition to align resource planning with strategic priorities.

• Oversee the financial management for the R&D vendor portfolio, including PO and invoice reconciliation, variance analysis, and trend reporting to ensure alignment with budget and financial goals.

• Leverage Toast’s financial systems, tools, and datasets to build and maintain standard reports and analyses, identifying opportunities to improve insight depth and forecast accuracy, specifically tailored to R&D’s unique needs and objectives.

• Assess and refine existing financial processes for R&D, implementing automation and standardization initiatives to reduce manual workload and create efficiencies across the finance team.

• Partner closely with cross-functional teams, to research, analyze, and advise on financial processes and reporting that directly support R&D’s innovation, operational, and financial goals.

• Able to work 2 pm - 11 pm IST

What you'll need to thrive (Requirements)

• 4+ years of work experience in FP&A, investment banking, consulting, private equity, business operations or accounting

• Strong analytical skills including financial modeling, data/trend analysis and manipulation of large datasets, with proven ability to summarize complex data into key takeaways

• Highly proficient in advanced Excel/Google Sheets and PowerPoint/Google Slides

• Experience working with financial systems, such as WorkDay, Adaptive, Greenhouse, NetSuite, or other similar products

• Positive attitude with high aptitude to learn new things quickly. Team player eager to further develop and grow with us

• Demonstrates intellectual curiosity, problem-solving skills, and hunger to continually up-level current approaches and processes

• Strong ability to work in a collaborative, diverse, inclusive, and open-minded office environment with a desire to contribute to a thriving culture

AI at Toast

At Toast, one of our company values is that we're hungry to build and learn. We believe learning new AI tools empowers us to build for our customers faster, more independently, and with higher quality. We provide these tools across all disciplines, from Engineering and Product to Sales and Support, and are inspired by how our Toasters are already driving real value with them. The people who thrive here are those who embrace changes that let us build more for our customers; it’s a core part of our culture.

Our Total Rewards Philosophy

We strive to provide competitive compensation and benefits programs that help to attract, retain, and motivate the best and brightest people in our industry. Our total rewards package goes beyond great earnings potential and provides the means to a healthy lifestyle with the flexibility to meet Toasters’ changing needs. Learn more about our benefits at https://careers.toasttab.com/toast-benefits .
How Toast Uses AI in its Hiring Process

Throughout the hiring process, our goal is to get to know you. We use AI tools to support our recruiters and interviewers with tasks like note-taking, summarization, and documentation of interviews to ensure they can be fully focused on your conversation. All hiring decisions are made by people. We ask that you complete interviews and assessments on your own, without real-time AI tools, recording, or transcription bots, unless we tell you otherwise in advance. To learn more: https://careers.toasttab.com/ai-in-hiring

Our Approach to Hybrid Working

We embrace a hybrid work model that fosters in-person collaboration while valuing individual needs. Our goal is to build a strong culture of connection as we work together to empower the hospitality community, regardless of location. Please visit the Locations page on our career site to learn more about our in-office expectations by region: https://careers.toasttab.com/locations-toast

People Are the Secret Ingredient in Our Recipe for Success

At Toast, our employees are our secret ingredient—when they thrive, we thrive. We strive to build a culture grounded in authenticity, respect, and humility, where every Toaster has a real opportunity to grow, contribute, and do their best work—raising the bar in delivering exceptional experiences for our customers and each other.

title: Credit Risk Senior Analyst - CECL Reporting, Loss Forecasting
description:
Credit Risk Senior Analyst

We are a rapidly growing company that’s revolutionizing the way the restaurant industry does business by pairing technology with an extraordinary commitment to customer success. We help restaurants streamline operations, increase revenue, and deliver amazing guest experiences through our platform that combines restaurant point of sale, guest-facing technology, and award-winning customer support. Join us as we empower the restaurant community to delight guests, do what they love, and thrive.

The Fintech Risk team at Toast is responsible for driving risk informed growth for the rapidly expanding Toast Fintech line of business. We are seeking a Lead Credit Risk Strategist as part of the team, with a focus on the portfolio risk management space. You will partner with cross-functional analysts and senior leadership to decode complex portfolio risk trends, refine our loss forecasting models, develop and oversee line management strategies for credit cards and other revolving products, and build the early-warning defenses that allow us to stay resilient under stress and profitable in any market cycle. If you have an analytic and data driven mindset, eye for detail and can-do attitude then you are right for this position.

Responsibilities :

• CECL Reporting : Oversee the monthly CECL calculations and reporting process, collaborating closely with accounting and strategic finance teams to ensure the robustness of methodology and accuracy of loss reserve calculations.

• Loss Forecasting: Refine existing loss forecasting models / methodologies which feed into monthly CECL calculations, to improve the overall accuracy and stability of forecasts. Develop loss projection and expected loss estimation methodologies for revolving products (e.g. credit card).
