title: Principal Adversary Emulation Specialist (Offensive Security)
description:
Zscaler (NASDAQ: ZS) accelerates digital transformation so customers can be more agile, efficient, resilient, and secure. The Zscaler Zero Trust Exchange platform protects thousands of customers from cyberattacks and data loss by securely connecting users, devices, and applications in any location. Distributed across 200+ public data centers globally and thousands of private sites at the edge, the SASE-based Zero Trust Exchange is the world’s largest in-line cloud security platform.

We believe the future of work is Human + AI and are building an AI-native enterprise where human potential is amplified by machine intelligence to solve the world’s hardest security challenges. Driven by deep customer obsession, we are committed to the mission, outcome, and to each other. We bring these commitments to life through three core behaviors: ownership and collaboration, trust through outcomes and impact, and a challenge culture with ongoing feedback. Ready to make an impact at the company pioneering security transformation in the AI era? Join us at Zscaler.

Role

We are looking for a Principal Information Security Engineer to join our team. This is a Hybrid role, reporting to the Director, Software Development Engineering in the Engineering department.

In this role, we are building an Adversarial Exposure Validation platform in which autonomous agents find and validate real-world security exposures. As Lead Adversary Emulation Specialist, you will own the quality, realism, and safety of our enterprise attack playbooks. This is a hands-on technical role where you will be responsible for tuning our systems to effectively compose and execute complex chained attacks across diverse security domains.

What you’ll do (Role Expectations)

• Design, review, and refine multi-stage adversary emulation playbooks covering identity, endpoints, networks, and cloud environments

• Evaluate exploitation actions proposed by agents for technical thoroughness, correctness, operational safety, and adherence to execution guardrails

• Reproduce and validate findings hands-on when evidence is unclear or disputed, review validation evidence, and explain attack paths, impact, and remediation to engineering teams

• Own the coverage roadmap for enterprise attack scenarios, prioritized by real customer environments and current threat activity

• Translate offensive security requirements into clear, testable guidance for software engineers while guiding developers on improving platform accuracy, reliability, and workflow

Who You Are (Success Profile)

• You act as an owner with an authentic passion for operational excellence and a strong bias for action, navigating seamlessly between high-level strategy and tactical execution

• You foster a high-trust, collaborative environment that values transparent feedback, healthy debate, and shared team success above individual accolades

• You champion the customer experience by anchoring engineering decisions in solving critical, real-world problems for both internal stakeholders and external users

• You bring deep technical curiosity and an innovative mindset to solve complex architectural challenges, continuously seeking more resilient, automated, and scalable solutions

• You lead with unwavering integrity and high accountability, cultivating trust across organizations through transparent communication and consistent follow-through

What We’re Looking for (Minimum Qualifications)

• Demonstrated curiosity and active exploration of AI tools, with a proven history of integrating new technologies to enhance daily workflows and augment problem-solving

• 9–14 years hands-on offensive security experience, with significant depth in red teaming, adversary emulation, and a proven track record of leading full engagements from planning to reporting

• Deep, hands-on expertise in Active Directory, Microsoft Entra ID (including hybrid environments), enterprise PKI, privileged access management, and identity providers such as Okta

• Hands-on experience testing web applications and APIs for complex attack vectors (including bypasses, injections, IDOR, and SSRF) combined with cloud security testing experience across AWS, Azure, or GCP

• Practical understanding of endpoint and detection controls (EDR, SIEM) with experience bypassing them using common red team tools, command-and-control frameworks, and the MITRE ATT&CK framework

• Strong scripting skills in Python, Bash, or PowerShell, coupled with technical writing skills to clearly document attack paths, findings, and playbooks

What Will Make You Stand Out (Preferred Qualifications)

• Proven ability to leverage AI technologies and workflows to drive measurable operational efficiency

• Experience building, contributing to, or using offensive security tooling, including AI-assisted tools and breach and attack simulation or continuous security validation platforms

• Industry certifications (such as OSCP, OSEP, CRTO, or CRTE), public security research contributions (talks, blog posts, tools, or CVEs), and familiarity with enterprise Linux/macOS/container environments or LLM evaluation frameworks

title: Product Manager
description:
About Sarvam

Sarvam is building the bedrock of Sovereign AI for India. The company is developing India's full-stack sovereign AI platform, building across research, models, infrastructure and applications with a singular focus on making AI genuinely work for India. Sarvam works with leading enterprises and public institutions and is backed by Lightspeed, Peak XV, and Khosla Ventures. Sarvam partners with India's leading brands, including Tata Capital, SBI Life, CRED, IDFC, and LIC.

 

About the Role

We're looking for product managers who are builders first — people who talk to customers constantly, ship real product to real users, and get into the details of how AI systems behave in production. This is not a role tied to one specific product line. Based on your strengths and interests, you could work across consumer AI products, enterprise platforms, developer tools, speech and voice systems, or edge deployments.

You have 3–7 years of product building experience, have shipped products at meaningful scale at strong B2C or B2B companies in India, and have real, hands-on familiarity with how AI products work under the hood.

 

What You'll Do

• Own a product area end-to-end — talk to users, write specs, define success metrics, ship, and measure outcomes

• Get into the details of how AI systems behave in production: prompt design, model selection, latency budgets, failure modes, and eval pipelines

• Write code, prompts, and copy when that's the fastest path to learning or validating an idea

• Set up funnels, write queries, and instrument events to diagnose what's working and what's broken

• Work directly with engineering, design, and leadership — no layers, no hand-offs

• Ship product every week, not plans

 

What We're Looking For

• 3–7 years of product management experience; you have shipped real products at meaningful scale at strong B2C or B2B companies in India

• Currently a product manager — this role is not for people transitioning from consulting, project management, or program management

• Hands-on familiarity with AI: you've built agents, understand how context windows work, and have thought through trade-offs like cost vs. latency vs. accuracy — experience with evals, tool calling, or agentic workflows is a strong plus

• Strong data skills: comfortable writing SQL, setting up funnels from scratch in PostHog, Mixpanel, or similar tools, and defining meaningful success metrics (not vanity numbers)

• Strong product thinking: you start with the customer's problem, talk to users regularly, can structure vague problem spaces, and ship v1 without over-engineering

• Systems thinker: you see the handshakes between components, the failure modes, and the dependencies when you look at a product

• High ownership, high agency: you don't wait for permission, you solve problems, and you've stayed up to fix something because you couldn't let it stay broken

• Clear communicator: you can explain complex technical concepts simply — to engineers, leadership, and users alike

 

Bonus Points

• You've built at least one working AI agent end-to-end — not a demo, something that actually does a job

• You've used tools like Claude Code, built skills, or set up agentic workflows, and have opinions on when to use agents vs. simpler approaches

• You have side projects, open-source contributions, or products shipped outside of work

• You can point to 2–3 things in your life — product or otherwise — where you went deep and had real impact

 

Why Sarvam?

Sarvam is a fast-moving, high talent-density team building full-stack AI for India, working on problems that push the frontiers of AI with real population-scale impact.

• Work alongside researchers, engineers, builders, and business leaders who move fast and hold each other to a very high bar

• High ownership and high impact, from day one

• Everything we do is AI-first, from the way we build and ship to the way we think about problems

• You can work on problems that could change how an entire country learns, works, and communicates

If you want to work on problems at the frontier of AI in India, Sarvam is the place to be.
